english.objectives: Speak to King Gurboggle.
english.description: From what I've learned about these water-goblins, this should work.$b$bI've crafted a shark-tooth necklace from the items you scrounged up. Not only is it a shiny trinket, but it's a memento of Gnaws' death. There's no telling how many gilblins were eaten alive by that monster.$b$bOffer the necklace to the gilblin leader. In exchange, I need an artifact called The Pewter Pounder.$b$bAnd be quick about it, kid. I'm already beginning to miss my flesh...

text.title: Shallow End of the Gene Pool
text.objectives: King Gurboggle wants you to kill Gilblingle in Gurboggle's Ledge.
text.description: <Gurboggle inspects the Gnaws Tooth Necklace for a moment.>$b$bNot bad, $r, assuming it's the real thing. I'll hafta send one of my boys out to make sure your story checks out.$b$bIn the meantime, you're gunna do a little somethin' for me, see, 'cause this little trinket ain't worth givin' up The Pewter Pounder - not by a longshot!$b$bMy cousin, Gilblingle, has had his eye on my throne for years. Dumb as a bag of coral, that one - but still dangerous.$b$bYou take him out, and then we'll talk.
text.completed: Speak with King Gurboggle.

english.title: Shallow End of the Gene Pool
english.objectives: King Gurboggle wants you to kill Gilblingle in Gurboggle's Ledge.
english.description: <Gurboggle inspects the Gnaws Tooth Necklace for a moment.>$b$bNot bad, $r, assuming it's the real thing. I'll hafta send one of my boys out to make sure your story checks out.$b$bIn the meantime, you're gunna do a little somethin' for me, see, 'cause this little trinket ain't worth givin' up The Pewter Pounder - not by a longshot!$b$bMy cousin, Gilblingle, has had his eye on my throne for years. Dumb as a bag of coral, that one - but still dangerous.$b$bYou take him out, and then we'll talk.
english.completed: Speak with King Gurboggle.

text.title: 要是部落没把你干掉……
text.objectives: 杀死蛛后西莉丝。
text.description: <军队长科萨克虚弱地咳嗽着。>$B$B被伏击时我正从南边的北卫远征军营地出来，走在蛛网小径上。不是部落，是蜘蛛。又大、又丑、毛茸茸，恶心的蜘蛛。$B$B杀掉了一些，也许几百个，数不清了。被它们的皇后放倒了。她咬了我一大口。好不容易才活了下来。可能要死了。$B$B还有更多的人要来，得保证通路的安全。杀掉蛛后。$B$B<军队长科萨克晕了过去。>
text.completion: Don't worry about me. Should be ok now that big hero killed the spider queen. Can get reinforcements through safely now.
text.completed: Return to Northwatch Captain Kosak at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: If the Horde Don't Get You...
english.objectives: Kill Queen Silith.
english.description: <Captain Kosak coughs weakly.>$B$BWas traveling up Webwinder Path, coming from Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in the south. Ambushed. Not by Horde. Spiders. Big, ugly, hairy, nasty spiders.$B$BFought off dozens, maybe hundreds. Lost count. Overtaken by their queen. She took a chunk right out of me. Barely made it out alive. Might be dying.$B$BMore of my men coming. Must provide safe passage. Kill spider queen.$B$B<Captain Kosak passes out.>
english.completion: Don't worry about me. Should be ok now that big hero killed the spider queen. Can get reinforcements through safely now.
english.completed: Return to Northwatch Captain Kosak at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 实地调查任务
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山塞西莉亚的栖地入口的希萨莉。
text.description: 必须阻止巨龙塞西莉亚。我们只知道她的巢穴在南边，海加尔山的南部悬崖处，除此之外我们知之甚少。$B$B我已经派希萨莉前往塞西莉亚的栖地进行实地调查。她特别指名要你帮忙——很明显你让这位年轻的德鲁伊印象颇深。$B$B到前往塞西莉亚的栖地的通道那里去见希萨莉。记住，这是一次实地调查任务——不要干什么傻事！
text.completion: Ah, $n! I was hoping to see you out here. What, Omnuron calls this a 'fact-finding mission?' Bah! Facts are best found on corpses. Let's do some damage.
text.completed: 去找海加尔山塞西莉亚的栖地入口的希萨莉。

english.title: Fact-Finding Mission
english.objectives: Report to Thisalee at the entrance to Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: The dragon Sethria must be stopped. We know that her roost is south of here, along the southern cliffs of Hyjal, but beyond that we know little else.$B$BI have sent Thisalee on a fact-finding mission to Sethria's roost. She specifically requested your help - evidently you made quite an impression with the young druid.$B$BMeet Thisalee just beyond the tunnel leading to Sethria's Roost. And remember, this is a fact-finding mission - don't do anything crazy!
english.completion: Ah, $n! I was hoping to see you out here. What, Omnuron calls this a 'fact-finding mission?' Bah! Facts are best found on corpses. Let's do some damage.
english.completed: Report to Thisalee at the entrance to Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 未雨绸缪
text.objectives: 收集10个深苔蜘蛛的毒囊。
text.description: 旅行者中毒已经成为风剪要塞的普遍现象了。这也是为什么那天有个北卫军队长在蛛网盆地沦为蜘蛛猎物的原因。要不是我的解毒剂，他早就死了。糟糕的是我的库存几近枯竭。$B$B要是你到南边的蛛网盆地去的话，能不能好心帮我收集一些深苔蜘蛛毒囊来？你可以在深苔蜘蛛身上找到这些毒囊。
text.progress: Have you recovered the venom sacs I requested?
text.completion: This will keep us stocked on anti-venom for the foreseeable future. Thank you, $n!
text.completed: Return to Alithia Fallowmere at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Preparations for the Future
english.objectives: Collect 10 Deepmoss Venom Sacs.
english.description: Poisoned travelers are becoming a common occurrence around Windshear Hold. Why just the other day a Northwatch Captain fell prey to the spiders of the Webwinder Hollow. He would have died to the poison had it not been for my anti-venom. Sadly my stock of anti-venom is almost completely depleted.$B$BIf you're heading south towards Webwinder Hollow, would you kindly recover Deepmoss venom sacs for me? You should be able to acquire them from Deepmoss spiders.
english.progress: Have you recovered the venom sacs I requested?
english.completion: This will keep us stocked on anti-venom for the foreseeable future. Thank you, $n!
english.completed: Return to Alithia Fallowmere at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: What? This Old Thing?
text.objectives: Bring The Pewter Pounder to Harrison at The Accursed Reef.
text.description: A deal's a deal.$b$bI present you - mysterious $r stranger - with the one and only Pewter Pounder.$b$bYou may approach and receive this illustrious gift.$b$bThere, now, while it may look to be a simple hammer to the untrained eye, there are surely many hidden properties that will only manifest themselves when the appropriate situation arises.$b$bTake good care of this treasure, stranger. It has been in my royal possession for... well... days, now!

english.title: What? This Old Thing?
english.objectives: Bring The Pewter Pounder to Harrison at The Accursed Reef.
english.description: A deal's a deal.$b$bI present you - mysterious $r stranger - with the one and only Pewter Pounder.$b$bYou may approach and receive this illustrious gift.$b$bThere, now, while it may look to be a simple hammer to the untrained eye, there are surely many hidden properties that will only manifest themselves when the appropriate situation arises.$b$bTake good care of this treasure, stranger. It has been in my royal possession for... well... days, now!

text.title: 左右为难
text.objectives: 你必须使用锡镴古锤摧毁锡镴先知。
text.description: 这不是可以解除我的诅咒的魔法！它只不过是一柄锤而已！$b$b我也许是疯了，但我不傻。$b$b我绝对不会用它砸碎我的宝贝——我花了这么大工夫才得到这宝贝呢。$b$b<巴德思考了一小会。>$b$b但这就意味着我要困在这里一辈子了……$b$b你知道，我才刚刚学会驾船呢。$b$b啊啊啊……真是为难啊。$b$b给，你拿着这柄锤，我会把宝贝放在这里，然后朝别的地方看。
text.completion: Oh, what might have been...
text.completed: Speak to Budd in The Skeletal Reef in Kelp'thar Forest.

english.title: Decisions, Decisions
english.objectives: You must use The Pewter Pounder to destroy The Pewter Prophet.
english.description: This is no magic solution to my curse! It's just a hammer!$b$bI may be crazy, but I'm not stupid.$b$bThere's NO WAY I'm gunna use this to break my shiney - not after all I've gone through to get it.$b$b<Budd pauses in thought for a moment.>$b$bBut that means I'm stuck down here for eternity...$b$bI had just learned to sail, you know.$b$bOhhh... I can't decide.$b$bHere, you take the hammer and I'll just set the shiney down and look the other way.
english.completion: Oh, what might have been...
english.completed: Speak to Budd in The Skeletal Reef in Kelp'thar Forest.

text.title: 谈判
text.objectives: 同千针石林裂蹄高地的克拉兹·滑链交谈。
text.description: $n，多亏有你守住了赛艇平台！我还有事情要你帮忙。$B$B我派克拉兹·滑链和克拉维尔·浓须去同半人马幸存者谈判，他们的裂蹄高地上有石油！$B$B我盘算那些臭烘烘的马尾巴不会知道我们发现的是什么，所以应该能轻松地拿到开采权，把黑色金子舀上来。不过我觉得让你来主持谈判还是好些。$B$B你怎么说？
text.completion: I've got Kravel Koalbeard up there talking to one of their chiefs, but now that you're here, we'll have the rights to pump up their oil in no time!

english.title: Negotiations
english.objectives: Speak with Crazzle Sprysprocket at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
english.description: $n, great job defending the Speedbarge! I've got something else that I need you to help out with.$B$BI've sent Crazzle Sprysprocket and Kravel Koalbeard northeast to negotiate with the centaur survivors. Their Splithoof Heights is dripping with oil!$B$BI figure those smelly half horses won't know what they've got and we'll get the rights to pump up that black gold for a song, but I'd feel better if you took charge of the talks.$B$BWhat do you say?
english.completion: I've got Kravel Koalbeard up there talking to one of their chiefs, but now that you're here, we'll have the rights to pump up their oil in no time!

text.title: 谈判
text.objectives: 同千针石林裂蹄高地的瑞兹尼克交谈。
text.description: $n，多亏有你守住了赛艇平台！我还有事情要你帮忙。$B$B我派瑞兹尼克和赛道管理员泽尔林去同半人马幸存者谈判，他们的裂蹄高地上有石油！$B$B我盘算那些臭烘烘的马尾巴不会知道我们发现的是什么，所以应该能轻松地拿到开采权，把黑色金子舀上来。不过我觉得让你来主持谈判还是好些。$B$B你怎么说？
text.completion: I've got Trackmaster Zherin up there talking to one of their chiefs, but now that you're here, we'll have the rights to pump up their oil in no time!

english.title: Negotiations
english.objectives: Speak with Riznek at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
english.description: $n, great job defending the Speedbarge! I've got something else that I need you to help out with.$B$BI've sent Riznek and Trackmaster Zherin northeast to negotiate with the centaur survivors. Their Splithoof Heights is dripping with oil!$B$BI figure those smelly half horses won't know what they've got and we'll get the rights to pump up that black gold for a song, but I'd feel better if you took charge of the talks.$B$BWhat do you say?
english.completion: I've got Trackmaster Zherin up there talking to one of their chiefs, but now that you're here, we'll have the rights to pump up their oil in no time!

text.title: 塞西莉亚的血脉
text.objectives: 消灭12名塞西莉亚的仆从：只要是暮光龙人或暮光龙人护甲师就行。
text.description: 头一桩买卖就是要精简一下这里的人员。这地方也太挤了。$B$B咱们先宰几条龙人，然后再来操心他们为什么会在这里出现的问题吧。
text.completion: You're good at this. I like you.
text.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Sethria's Brood
english.objectives: Slay 12 of Sethria's Minions: Any combination of Twilight Dragonkin or Twilight Dragonkin Armorers.
english.description: First order of business is to thin the herd here. This place crawls.$B$BLet's start slaughtering these dragonkin and worry about why they're here later.
english.completion: You're good at this. I like you.
english.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.

objectiveDetails.description: 被消灭的塞西莉亚仆从

text.title: 朝前看
text.objectives: 去瓦丝琪尔废墟南部平台下找德沃雷克将军谈一谈。$B$B骑上波涛语者瓦罗伦的海马可以快速抵达前哨站。
text.description: 将军根据你收集的情报在西边平台下建立了前哨站。他在那里准备对纳迦展开进攻。$B$B你要马上去告诉他你所目睹的一切。我们的部队寡不敌众，我担心要是贸然进击士兵们会性命不保。$B$B坐我的海马去，它认识路。
text.completion: Good to see you again, $c. I almost thought we'd lost you to the Wavespeaker's fool errand. Did anything come of it?

english.title: Looking Forward
english.objectives: Find and speak to Admiral Dvorek under the southern terrace in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.$B$BUse Wavespeaker Valoren's sea horse to reach the forward post quickly.
english.description: The Admiral used the information you gathered for him to make a forward post under the terrace to our west. He's been preparing there for some kind of attack against the naga.$B$BYou should go to him immediately and inform him of the scope of what you've witnessed. Our force is small, and I fear for our soldiers if we charge in too recklessly.$B$BTake my sea horse. It knows the way.
english.completion: Good to see you again, $c. I almost thought we'd lost you to the Wavespeaker's fool errand. Did anything come of it?

text.title: 清晰的目标
text.objectives: 消灭10名在西南部平台下聚集的纳迦。
text.description: 我明白了。你带来的消息很可怕，但我也不是完全没有考虑过这种可能性。我知道在没有侦察过纳迦数量的情况下，我们的计划很冒险，但这就是为什么我们在这里建立前哨站的原因。$B$B让我跟你直说吧，$c。要是我们不能让纳迦无暇他顾，他们就会主动找上来。我们既没有人手，也没有设备可以形成防御，所以这就不可取。$B$B我们需要更多的时间，你能去南边削弱一下他们的兵力吗？
text.completion: More naga are amassing to the south than reported too it seems. We shall have to move quickly then.
text.completed: Return to Admiral Dvorek under the southern terrace in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

english.title: Clear Goals
english.objectives: Kill 10 of the naga forces building up on the ground level, under the southwestern terrace.
english.description: I see. The news you bring is grim, but I was not entirely unprepared for such possibilities. Without any effective scouting of naga numbers, I knew our plan was risky, but that's why we established this forward post.$B$BLet me put it to you plainly, $c. If we do not keep the naga off-balance, they will bring the fight to us. We do not have the structures or the men to mount a defense, so that is not an option.$B$BWe need more time. Can you thin their numbers to the south?
english.completion: More naga are amassing to the south than reported too it seems. We shall have to move quickly then.
english.completed: Return to Admiral Dvorek under the southern terrace in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

text.title: 并非毫无准备
text.objectives: 给南部平台下的联盟警戒哨兵送去8捆十字弓弩箭矢。
text.description: 我听到了你和将军的对话。我知道我们听起来可能疯了，不过真的没有别的办法。洞里的人全指望我们呢。$B$B我在周边地区的各个要冲部署了警戒哨。他们在稀稀拉拉的纳迦斥候身上浪费了太多弹药。你能给他们捎些十字弓弩箭矢，好给我们多争取些时间吗？
text.completion: You are perhaps the most dependable person I've ever met. I wish I could have more men half as thorough as you.
text.completed: Return to Captain Taylor under the southern terrace in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

english.title: Not Entirely Unprepared
english.objectives: Deliver 8 Bundles of Crossbow Bolts to Alliance Lookouts positioned on ledges under the southern terrace.
english.description: I overheard your conversation with the Admiral. I know what we're doing sounds insane, but we really don't have much choice. There are people back at that cave that are depending on us.$B$BI've stationed lookouts on various ledges in the immediate area. They're burning ammo fast on the scattered naga scouts. Can you bring them more crossbow bolts to buy us some extra time?
english.completion: You are perhaps the most dependable person I've ever met. I wish I could have more men half as thorough as you.
english.completed: Return to Captain Taylor under the southern terrace in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

text.title: Curious Distraction
text.objectives: Transcribe the 4 Highborne Tablets.
text.description: Hah! Did you see the Admiral giving me dirty looks and decide to throw some sympathy my way? I've pretty much lost hope of making him understand that these ruins offers us some opportunity to salvage some usefulness out of this whole  mess.$B$BI'd actually hoped that you might turn up again - you seem like the only one I can rely on. I've seen a few tablets like this one spread about the nearby ruins and I put together a rubbing kit for transcribing them. Up to the task?
text.completed: Return to Levia Dreamwaker under the southern terrace in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

english.title: Curious Distraction
english.objectives: Transcribe the 4 Highborne Tablets.
english.description: Hah! Did you see the Admiral giving me dirty looks and decide to throw some sympathy my way? I've pretty much lost hope of making him understand that these ruins offers us some opportunity to salvage some usefulness out of this whole  mess.$B$BI'd actually hoped that you might turn up again - you seem like the only one I can rely on. I've seen a few tablets like this one spread about the nearby ruins and I put together a rubbing kit for transcribing them. Up to the task?
english.completed: Return to Levia Dreamwaker under the southern terrace in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

text.title: 备受启发
text.objectives: 在西南部平台下收集8颗胀大的海藻球。
text.description: 你好！我被将军的进攻计划弄得要抓狂了。他志得意满，打算把一切都炸上天……还是该说炸下水？无所谓啦。$B$B把东西炸飞是要炸药的！我没有炸药。真可悲。真是可悲哪。$B$B不过我受到了一定的启发，解决办法十分明了。悬挂在废墟上的海藻上的那些球体里，富含着高爆性的瓦斯。也许你可以帮我收集一些过来？帮帮忙吧？
text.progress: Tick, tock, tick, tock. Always in such a hurry. No time for innovation. What I wouldn't give for a lab again!
text.completion: You are brave indeed! I've seen you battling all manner of murloc, naga, and pointy-toothed fish, but that was nothing! The way you just sling those kelp bulbs under your arm like that is a whole new kind of fearless. BOOM! You could blow up at any second. You're my kind of $r.
text.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub under the southern terrace in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

english.title: Properly Inspired
english.objectives: Gather 8 Bloated Kelp Bulbs hanging under the southwestern terrace.
english.description: Hello! I've been scrambling, scrambling to prepare for the Admiral's assault. He's got high hopes and high plans to blow all kinds of things sky high! ...or water high? That would do.$B$BBlowing things high takes EXPLOSIVES! I don't have explosives. It's saddening. Very saddening.$B$BI've been properly inspired to improvise though, and the solution has become apparent. The bulbs on the seaweed hanging from the ruins contain a surprisingly volatile gas. Maybe you might gather some for me? Pretty Please?
english.progress: Tick, tock, tick, tock. Always in such a hurry. No time for innovation. What I wouldn't give for a lab again!
english.completion: You are brave indeed! I've seen you battling all manner of murloc, naga, and pointy-toothed fish, but that was nothing! The way you just sling those kelp bulbs under your arm like that is a whole new kind of fearless. BOOM! You could blow up at any second. You're my kind of $r.
english.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub under the southern terrace in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

text.title: 动如脱兔
text.objectives: 跟房子外面的工程师“洗衣桶”交谈并加入总攻，使用你的速成炸药杀死平台上的100个艾萨尔士兵、20个艾萨尔波涛尖啸者和12个艾萨尔上古卫士。
text.description: 我们已经一切就绪。$B$B假如你所言不虚，那么只要抓紧坐骑同我们一起进攻就会没事。谁都知道在开阔水域是别想游过纳迦的。$B$B一路杀出去，尽量多消灭一些。炸药用光后，我们就去上面平台的破损海崖汇合。但愿那时他们人数不多，我们可以用常规战消灭掉他们。
text.completion: You did great up there! You devastated their ranks, but there were far more than we accounted for, and most of our men went down out there in the masses of naga. We'll need to hold this position as long as possible to buy them time. Hopefully some of them will still make it to the rendezvous.
text.completed: Speak to Admiral Dvorek on Nar'shola Terrace.

english.title: Swift Action
english.objectives: Speak to Engineer Hexascrub just outside of the building to join the assault, then use your improvised explosives to kill 100 Azsh'ir Soldiers, 20 Azsh'ir Wave Screamers, and 12 Azsh'ir Archaens.
english.description: We have everything we need to begin the attack.$B$BIf your claims were correct, you would do well to make sure you cling tight to your mount as we make the attack. Anyone who gets caught in the open water isn't likely to out-swim a naga.$B$BKill as many as you can as we make the attack run and we'll rendezvous on the broken ledge of the terrace above once we've expended our explosives. Hopefully by that point there will be few enough that we can finish them off the old-fashioned way.
english.completion: You did great up there! You devastated their ranks, but there were far more than we accounted for, and most of our men went down out there in the masses of naga. We'll need to hold this position as long as possible to buy them time. Hopefully some of them will still make it to the rendezvous.
english.completed: Speak to Admiral Dvorek on Nar'shola Terrace.

text.title: 任何人都不能落下
text.objectives: 营救6名受伤的突击志愿兵。
text.description: 真是一场灾难！我们的人大部分还没挺到汇合就被消灭了。$B$B我们只能尽可能地守住这个地方，直到纳迦把我们彻底包围。我们需要从这里逃到西南去，沿途尽量多救一些人——尽你的所能吧。$B$B他们撑不了多久。请快些！
text.completion: Thank you. Truly. We need to get these men moving as soon as possible. I'll meet you back at the forward post soon, I'm sure.
text.completed: Return to Captain Taylor on Nar'shola Terrace.

english.title: Fallen But Not Forgotten
english.objectives: Rescue 6 Injured Assault Volunteers.
english.description: That was a disaster! Most of our men went down to spears before making it anywhere near the rendezvous.$B$BWe're only going to be able to hold this position for so long before the naga overrun us. We need to get out there to the southwest and save as many of the men as we can find - do anything you can.$B$BThey won't last long. Please hurry!
english.completion: Thank you. Truly. We need to get these men moving as soon as possible. I'll meet you back at the forward post soon, I'm sure.
english.completed: Return to Captain Taylor on Nar'shola Terrace.

objectiveDetails.description: 营救受伤的突击志愿兵

text.title: 估测胜算
text.objectives: 侦察圆形平台的西北边缘，以及北部主台阶下的隧道。这两个地点都在废墟的中层。
text.description: 可恶的混蛋……他们的矛对我们伤害不小。$B$B<将军捂住身侧的一个伤口，疼得缩了一下。>$B$B我们在这里尽量坚守，直到所有的人都挺过来。我需要人去侦察一下它们的数量，看我们战果如何。$B$B最多的一群敌军就在平台的西北部分，其他敌军在北边稍远的小隧道里，位置也在这个废墟的中层。$B$B你行吗？
text.completion: Still so many? They must want something very important here to come in such numbers. I will be honest with you, $n, because you deserve at least that: I don't know how much hope there is. We will retreat shortly, but we won't be able to defend ourselves when they strike back. We don't have anywhere to run... we're running out of options. I'm sorry, I should keep such thoughts to myself. Do me a favor and don't mention any of that to the men. I'll figure something out.
text.completed: Return to Admiral Dvorek on Nar'shola Terrace.

english.title: Gauging Success
english.objectives: Scout the northwestern portion of the circular terrace and the tunnel under the main stairs to the north. Both locations are on Nar'shola Terrace, the middle level of the ruins.
english.description: Vicious louts... they did a lot of damage with those spears.$B$B<The admiral winces slightly as he clutches a wound on his side.>$B$BWe'll hold here as long as we can for all the men to make it. I need someone to scout their numbers to see how much damage we did.$B$BOne of the biggest groups of them was around the corner on the northwest portion of this round terrace, and the other was a bit farther to the north in the small tunnel, also on this middle level of the ruins.$B$BUp for some scouting?
english.completion: Still so many? They must want something very important here to come in such numbers. I will be honest with you, $n, because you deserve at least that: I don't know how much hope there is. We will retreat shortly, but we won't be able to defend ourselves when they strike back. We don't have anywhere to run... we're running out of options. I'm sorry, I should keep such thoughts to myself. Do me a favor and don't mention any of that to the men. I'll figure something out.
english.completed: Return to Admiral Dvorek on Nar'shola Terrace.

text.title: 过去的影像：贝耶拉兰山惨案
text.objectives: 在克瓦迪尔将军的阵亡之地使用女武士的断剑，目睹她随后的经历。
text.description: 瞧，我知道在这种时候提这样的要求很过分，但我要你暂时从失败的悲伤中振作起来。$B$B我会照顾这些士兵，你得找到之前你所说克瓦迪尔将军在西边的战场。在那里，你能窥视到女武士更多的经历。我有种强烈的预感，那名女武士是我们打败纳迦的关键。$B$B请你赶快——我会尽我所能为你争取时间。
text.completion: You're finished! Just in time. I don't think we could have held them much longer. An artifact? Could this be something we can use against the naga? I suppose that would require finding it. We may have to attend to more pressing matters first, until an opportunity to pursue this further presents itself.
text.completed: Speak to Wavespeaker Valoren on Nar'shola Terrace.

english.title: Visions of the Past: The Slaughter of Biel'aran Ridge
english.objectives: Witness the continuing story of the Battlemaiden by using her broken blade at the site of the Kvaldir General's death.
english.description: Look, I know this is asking a lot during a time like this, but I need you to tear yourself away from this defeat for a moment.$B$BI will tend to these soldiers - you need to find the location of that battle with the Kvaldir General to the west that you told me about. You should be able to glimpse more of the Battlemaiden's experiences from there. I have a strong feeling that the key to defeating these naga will lie with that Battlemaiden.$B$BPlease hurry - I will do everything I can to buy you time.
english.completion: You're finished! Just in time. I don't think we could have held them much longer. An artifact? Could this be something we can use against the naga? I suppose that would require finding it. We may have to attend to more pressing matters first, until an opportunity to pursue this further presents itself.
english.completed: Speak to Wavespeaker Valoren on Nar'shola Terrace.

objectiveDetails.description: 目睹女武士随后的经历

text.title: 搞定泽尔林！
text.objectives: 获得部落投标书。
text.description: 要是我们想拿下探油权，我们就得知道部落出的什么标。要是我们的条件不比他们好，怎么能成？！$B$B他们的谈判员赛道管理员泽尔林就在上面同人马可汗交涉。你为什么不去说服他把部落投标书交给我们呢？$B$B你不用杀掉他……我们又不是野蛮人！暴打他一顿就好啦。
text.progress: Do you have the Horde's proposal? What are they offering for the drilling rights?
text.completion: What?! How'd they get that much gold to offer? We don't have that kind of money!
text.completed: Return to Crazzle Sprysprocket at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 从他身上拿到部落投标书！

english.title: Get Zherin!
english.objectives: Obtain the Horde's Proposal.
english.description: If we're going to get those oil drilling rights, we need to know what the Horde is offering. How can we win if we can't do them one better?!$B$BTheir negotiator, Trackmaster Zherin, is up there talking with one of their khans right now. Why don't you head up and persuade him to hand over the Horde's proposal?$B$BYou don't have to kill him... we're not savages! Just rough him up a bit.
english.progress: Do you have the Horde's proposal? What are they offering for the drilling rights?
english.completion: What?! How'd they get that much gold to offer? We don't have that kind of money!
english.completed: Return to Crazzle Sprysprocket at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Get the Horde's Proposal from him!

text.title: 搞定浓须！
text.objectives: 获得联盟投标书。
text.description: 要是我们想拿下探油权，我们就得知道联盟出的什么标。要是我们的条件不比他们好，怎么能成？！$B$B他们的谈判员克拉维尔·浓须就在上面同人马可汗交涉。你为什么不去说服他把联盟投标书交给我们呢？$B$B你不用杀掉他……我们又不是野蛮人！暴打他一顿就好啦。
text.progress: Do you have the Alliance's proposal? What are they offering for the drilling rights?
text.completion: What?! How'd they get that much gold to offer? We don't have that kind of money!
text.completed: Return to Riznek at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 从他身上拿到联盟投标书！

english.objectives: Obtain the Alliance's Proposal.
english.description: If we're going to get those oil drilling rights, we need to know what the Alliance is offering. How can we win if we can't do them one better?!$B$BTheir negotiator, Kravel Koalbeard, is up there talking with one of their khans right now. Why don't you head up and persuade him to hand over the Alliance's proposal?$B$BYou don't have to kill him... we're not savages! Just rough him up a bit.
english.progress: Do you have the Alliance's proposal? What are they offering for the drilling rights?
english.completion: What?! How'd they get that much gold to offer? We don't have that kind of money!
english.completed: Return to Riznek at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Get the Alliance's Proposal from him!

text.title: 护甲上的破绽
text.objectives: 收集8件暮光护甲。
text.description: 你看到他们在干嘛了吗？他们在往龙人身上安护甲。我猜这就是他们从死亡之翼那里学来的新把戏。$B$B看来一旦完成，这些暮光主宰就将刀枪不入。一定有办法对付那些护甲的！$B$B跑过去给我弄些等着备用的暮光护甲来。我们会搞清楚怎么对付这东西。
text.progress: Did you get a hold of some plates? Did you have to kill anyone to get them?$B$BI hope so.
text.completion: Look at these things. Ugh, the runes make my eyes hurt. This one here is meant to sear flesh? Seriously? Ouch! Wait a minute... These plates are designed to be riveted directly into flesh. The pain must be unbearable!
text.completed: Bring the plates back to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: A Gap in Their Armor
english.objectives: Gather 8 Twilight Armor Plates.
english.description: Do you see what they're doing here? They're affixing armored plates onto the Dragonkin. A page out of Deathwing's book, I suppose.$B$BThose Twilight Juggernauts look like they'll be invincible once they're complete. There's got to be a way around that armor plating!$B$BRun out there and fetch some of the Twilight armor plates that are waiting to be installed. We'll figure out how to beat this.
english.progress: Did you get a hold of some plates? Did you have to kill anyone to get them?$B$BI hope so.
english.completion: Look at these things. Ugh, the runes make my eyes hurt. This one here is meant to sear flesh? Seriously? Ouch! Wait a minute... These plates are designed to be riveted directly into flesh. The pain must be unbearable!
english.completed: Bring the plates back to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: Hammering It Out
text.objectives: Take the Mysterious Device to Orgrimmar, Undercity, Silvermoon City or Thunder Bluff and show it to an Earthen Ring Representative.
text.description: The rift that was here left behind this strange device, but why?$B$BSomeone in a capital city may have more information.
text.progress: What's this then?  Another device?
text.completion: Not another one! $n, these devices have been springing up all around Azeroth. We know that they can instigate elemental disturbances in the area, including causing tears in the elemental planes. The devices stink of Twilight's Hammer.  The engravings covering the surface and the captured elemental essence implicate Cho'gall and his minions are behind this. If you find more of these, please bring them to me or one of my associates. We need to learn more about what's behind this attack.

english.title: Hammering It Out
english.objectives: Take the Mysterious Device to Orgrimmar, Undercity, Silvermoon City or Thunder Bluff and show it to an Earthen Ring Representative.
english.description: The rift that was here left behind this strange device, but why?$B$BSomeone in a capital city may have more information.
english.progress: What's this then?  Another device?
english.completion: Not another one! $n, these devices have been springing up all around Azeroth. We know that they can instigate elemental disturbances in the area, including causing tears in the elemental planes. The devices stink of Twilight's Hammer.  The engravings covering the surface and the captured elemental essence implicate Cho'gall and his minions are behind this. If you find more of these, please bring them to me or one of my associates. We need to learn more about what's behind this attack.

text.title: 过去的影像：瓦丝琪尔的入侵
text.objectives: 在花园东南部尽头的战斗现场使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃。
text.description: 你发现的碎片看来源自纳迦。我一直希望能找到像这样一件具有强大聚焦能力的物体，好将我一直钻研的法术释放出来，以便窥视不远的过去。$B$B我已经将这片利刃附魔，但你还是要把它带到其主人曾经所在之地。我想让你回到发现它的地方，使用这片利刃。$B$B也许我们能明白纳迦究竟在这里干什么，或许运气好的话，还能找到他们的弱点，给我们一线生机。
text.completion: A Battlemaiden? I never heard of such a thing. The way you explain it, it sounds like the naga forces are far greater in scope than the Admiral could possibly have realized. We might be able to learn more through the blade if we can find other locations where this Battlemaiden was present, but the information you gave me makes me fear for the admiral and his soldiers. We must warn them.
text.completed: Speak to Wavespeaker Valoren in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

english.title: Visions of the Past: The Invasion of Vashj'ir
english.objectives: Use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at the battle site at the southeast end of the ruins.
english.description: The shard you recovered looks to be of naga origin. I had hoped to find a strong focal object like this for a spell I've been working on that would allow us to glimpse into the recent past.$B$BI've enchanted the blade, but you'll have to take it to a place where we know its owner was. I want you to travel back to the site where you found it and use the blade.$B$BPerhaps we can uncover more behind what the naga are doing here. Or even better, maybe we'll uncover a weakness that will give us a better chance.
english.completion: A Battlemaiden? I never heard of such a thing. The way you explain it, it sounds like the naga forces are far greater in scope than the Admiral could possibly have realized. We might be able to learn more through the blade if we can find other locations where this Battlemaiden was present, but the information you gave me makes me fear for the admiral and his soldiers. We must warn them.
english.completed: Speak to Wavespeaker Valoren in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

objectiveDetails.description: 与断剑的主人进行意志同调

text.title: 解体
text.objectives: 用希萨莉的尖刀唤醒并消灭3名暮光主宰。尖刀可以使用多次，割裂主宰的盔甲。
text.description: 我们要在这些主宰完全被盔甲包裹之前阻止他们。只要我们撬开甲片，朝下面薄弱的部位砍下去，他们就不是无敌的。$B$B带上我的尖刀，插到主宰的甲片中，把他们身上的盔甲剥下来。$B$B一旦他们被惊醒，你就要面对一场苦战——不停地拆开他们的盔甲，才能阻止这些主宰！
text.progress: Oh good.$B$BYou're still alive.
text.completion: That was some fancy bladework, $n! There's one less threat for us to worry about in Hyjal.
text.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Disassembly
english.objectives: Use Thisalee's Shiv to awaken and kill 3 Twilight Juggernauts. The shiv can be used multiple times to tear down a Juggernaut's armor.
english.description: We have to stop these juggernauts before they're completely encased in armor. Right now they're vulnerable, but only if we pry aside the plates and hack at the marred flesh beneath.$B$BTake my shiv, and jam it between the plates of armored juggernauts to deprive them of their armor.$B$BOnce they break from their trance, you're in for a tough fight - keep prying loose that armor and stop those juggernauts!
english.progress: Oh good.$B$BYou're still alive.
english.completion: That was some fancy bladework, $n! There's one less threat for us to worry about in Hyjal.
english.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 远古火盆
text.objectives: 重新点燃远古火盆，获得神圣烈焰。
text.description: 这是谁来了？一名$r？想凭着花言巧语来窃取我们的土地吗？$B$B你愚弄不了我。我活了这么久，知道同你们打交道意味着什么。但是可汗们不像以前那样对长老言听计从了。$B$B既然你来了，我自当让你派上点用处。当大水来袭时，伟大的水之精灵宝瓶之灵浇熄了位于裂蹄堡深处的远古火盆。$B$B用这根铁烙重新点燃火盆，宝瓶之灵自会前来。将神圣烈焰带给我。
text.progress: You have the Sacred Flame? Do not speak to me unless you do, $r!
text.completion: You did this favor to ingratiate yourself with me, but I will not sing your praises. I know what is to come. Where the sea failed, the great air spirit will strike you and your people down for your many transgressions against the elements. Begone from my sight!
text.completed: Return to Skycaller Vrakthris at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 他熄灭了远古火盆！他带着神圣烈焰。

english.title: The Ancient Brazier
english.objectives: Reignite the Ancient Brazier and obtain the Sacred Flame.
english.description: What do we have here? A $r? Come to steal our land with your honeyed tongue and promises?$B$BYou do not fool me. I have lived a long time, and I know what dealing with your kind means. But the khans do not listen to their elders like they used to.$B$BSince you are here, I will put you to use. When the waters rushed in, the great water spirit, Aquarian, doused the Ancient Brazier deep inside of Splithoof Hold.$B$BUse this brand to reignite the brazier. Aquarian is sure to come. Bring me the Sacred Flame.
english.progress: You have the Sacred Flame? Do not speak to me unless you do, $r!
english.completion: You did this favor to ingratiate yourself with me, but I will not sing your praises. I know what is to come. Where the sea failed, the great air spirit will strike you and your people down for your many transgressions against the elements. Begone from my sight!
english.completed: Return to Skycaller Vrakthris at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: He snuffed out the Ancient Brazier! He has the Sacred Flame!

text.title: 暗影圣典
text.objectives: 海加尔山塞西莉亚的栖地的希萨莉·黑鸦报告你的发现。
text.description: <这本精心制作的书籍长篇累牍，被封在石板封面里。上面书写着很多语言，大多数都不为人所熟悉。精心绘制的插图描述着巫师们乃至整幢建筑消失在阴影的帷幕下的场面。>$B$B<不少图像描绘了你在营地周围所看到的魔法圣物。你怀疑巨龙塞西莉亚试图把什么东西藏起来。希萨莉一定很想听到这个消息！>
text.completion: They're doing what? They're cloaking something? Of course - so our aerial scouts can't see anything with our eagle-eyes!
text.completed: 将你的发现告诉海加尔山塞西莉亚的栖地的希萨莉·黑鸦。

english.title: The Codex of Shadows
english.objectives: Report what you've discovered to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: <This elaborate book contains hundreds of vellum pages bound within a slate cover. It's written in many languages, most unfamiliar. Carefully inked illustrations depict sorcerers or even entire buildings vanishing into curtains of shadow.>$B$B<Many illustrations depict magical artifices like those you see around camp. You suspect the dragon Sethria is trying to keep something hidden. Thisalee will want to hear about this!>
english.completion: They're doing what? They're cloaking something? Of course - so our aerial scouts can't see anything with our eagle-eyes!
english.completed: Report what you've discovered to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 寻找艾维娜的卵
text.objectives: 关闭暗影遮罩发生器直到你找到艾维娜的卵。一旦找到，全力守护它直到猛禽德鲁伊们能把它安全带走为止。
text.description: 啸天者欧穆隆要我们找到艾维娜的卵，我可以向你保证，它一定是被塞西莉亚的暗影装置藏起来了。$B$B在营地周围找找看有没有暗影遮罩发生器，把它们关掉，直到你找到那枚卵。$B$B一旦你找到了，我就会召唤其他的德鲁伊。在我们有能力把它安全运走之前，好好保护它。$B$B去把卵找回来，$n！
text.completion: We did it, $n! Aviana's Egg should soon be tucked safely in the boughs of her shrine. Do you think this means she'll really return to us?
text.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Egg Hunt
english.objectives: Disable the Shadow Cloak Generators until you unveil Aviana's Egg. Once the egg is unveiled, defend it until the Druids of the Talon can carry it to safety.
english.description: Skylord Omnuron wants us to find Aviana's Egg, and I can almost guarantee you it's cloaked by one of Sethria's shadow devices.$B$BSearch around the camp for shadow cloak generators and shut those things down until you find the egg.$B$BOnce you've unveiled it, I'll call out to the other druids. Defend that egg until we can carry it off to safety.$B$BGo get that egg, $n!
english.completion: We did it, $n! Aviana's Egg should soon be tucked safely in the boughs of her shrine. Do you think this means she'll really return to us?
english.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到并保护艾维娜的卵

text.title: 跟他们说科科派你去的
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉北卫远征军营地的部队指挥官范伦。
text.description: 北卫军正需要像你一样强大的$r。我们在南贫瘠之地被打得很惨，需要你的帮助！你有没有兴趣帮联盟一把？$B$B那炸弹？是的，是挺棘手，但石爪山不是什么黄金地段。这地方在部落把爪子伸进来之前就是垃圾！$B$B我把选择权交给你。要是你想去贫瘠之地帮我们，就骑我的马——蓝钢。他就在南边十字路口那里吃草，他会帮你突破兽人封锁的。
text.completion: Kosak sent you, eh? Surprising. I thought for sure that he'd be dead by now. Well if you made it past the blockade then you definitely have something that we can use. Now, do you have any news of the Horde? What are they doing? Where are they going? Tell me everything.

english.title: Tell 'Em Koko Sent You
english.objectives: Report to Force Commander Valen at the Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Northwatch could really use a powerful $r like you. We're taking a beating in the Southern Barrens and need your help! Are you interested in lending the Alliance a hand?$B$BThe bomb? Yea, it's a problem, but Stonetalon isn't exactly prime real estate. This place was a dump before the Horde sunk their claws into it!$B$BI'll leave the choice in your hands. If you want to help us out in the Barrens, take my horse, Blue Steel. He's grazing at the crossroads south of here. He'll get you past the orc blockade.
english.completion: Kosak sent you, eh? Surprising. I thought for sure that he'd be dead by now. Well if you made it past the blockade then you definitely have something that we can use. Now, do you have any news of the Horde? What are they doing? Where are they going? Tell me everything.

text.title: 奥术遗产
text.objectives: 使用上层精灵的禁锢束缚5只上层精灵之魂。
text.description: 元素的愤怒将石爪山脉心脏地带隐藏许久的上层精灵城市带上了地面。$B$B在西南方，穿过希塞尔山谷，你就可以发现埃德雷萨废墟。废墟里的财宝已经有一万年未被凡人所触及了！$B$B带上这个装置，在废墟里的上层精灵鬼魂身上使用它。它能……让它们的灵魂安息，并且收集宝贵的数据供我日后参考。
text.completion: I assure you, simpleton, the spirits you captured are at rest. Do not let their protests move you.
text.completed: Return to Arcanist Valdurian at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Arcane Legacy
english.objectives: Use the Highborne Prison to bind 5 Highborne Spirits.
english.description: The rage of the elements has unearthed a hidden Highborne city in the heart of Stonetalon Mountains.$B$BDirectly southwest of here, through Sishir Canyon, you will find the Ruins of Eldre'thar. Within the ruins lie treasures untouched by mortals for ten thousand years!$B$BTake this device and use it on the Highborne ghosts that inhabit the ruins. It will... put their souls to rest and also collect valuable data which I may peruse at a later date.
english.completion: I assure you, simpleton, the spirits you captured are at rest. Do not let their protests move you.
english.completed: Return to Arcanist Valdurian at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 捕获记忆
text.objectives: 收集8个埃德雷萨圣物。
text.description: 大灾变让石爪山脉里一座被遗忘的上层精灵城市重见天日。你必须到西南方的埃德雷萨废墟里去，寻找那里的远古圣物。把圣物带来给我，$n，我好研究。$B$B去吧！免得奥术师久等！
text.progress: Have you recovered the ancient relics?
text.completion: Wonderful! Arcanist Valdurian will be most pleased.
text.completed: Return to Neophyte Starcrest at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Capturing Memories
english.objectives: Collect 8 Eldre'thar Relics.
english.description: The great cataclysm has unearthed a forgotten Highborne city within Stonetalon Mountains. You must venture southwest to the Ruins of Eldre'thar. Once you are there, search the area for ancient relics. Return the relics to me so that I may study them, $n.$B$BGo! Lest we keep the arcanist waiting!
english.progress: Have you recovered the ancient relics?
english.completion: Wonderful! Arcanist Valdurian will be most pleased.
english.completed: Return to Neophyte Starcrest at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 炸弹投放：暗色哨站！
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉暗色哨站的斥候指挥官巴努斯。
text.description: 斥候指挥官巴努斯驻扎在西北方的暗色哨站，他已经目击到部落的炸弹了。炸弹就挂在克罗姆加热气球上，其目前的位置在暗色湖的地精加油站上方。这可能是我们把那玩意打下来的好机会。$B$B收拾你的东西，$n，然后出发！斥候指挥官巴努斯在暗色哨站等你。$B$B还有，$n，你的不懈努力就是联盟力量和坚韧的明证！$B$B愿荣耀属于你！
text.completion: I'm assuming you saw the Krom'gar hot air balloon on your way here. If not, get your eyes checked. It's hovering directly over the oil platform.

english.title: Bombs Away: Mirkfallon Post!
english.objectives: Report to Scout Commander Barus at Mirkfallon Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Scout Commander Barus, stationed at Mirkfallon Post, to the northwest, has spotted the Horde bomb. The Krom'gar hot air balloon, with bomb attached, is currently at the new goblin fueling station at Mirkfallon Lake. This might be the opportunity we need to take that thing out once and for all.$B$BGather your things, $n, and move out! Scout Commander Barus awaits your arrival at Mirkfallon Post.$B$BAnd $n, your tenacity is a testament to the strength and fortitude of the Alliance!$B$BGlory be unto you!
english.completion: I'm assuming you saw the Krom'gar hot air balloon on your way here. If not, get your eyes checked. It's hovering directly over the oil platform.

text.title: 法罗米尔召唤
text.objectives: 跟石爪山脉风剪要塞的指挥官法罗米尔谈一谈。
text.description: 你还在这里？还等什么，私人邀请吗？指挥官法罗米尔在召唤，蠢材！现在马上去找他！
text.completion: Good to see you again, $n. I have some news from Mirkfallon Lake.

english.title: Fallowmere Beckons
english.objectives: Speak to Lord Fallowmere at Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: You're still here? What are you waiting for, a personal engraved invitation? Lord Fallowmere beckons, fool! Go to him now!
english.completion: Good to see you again, $n. I have some news from Mirkfallon Lake.

text.title: 送酒
text.objectives: 将巡山人的麦酒送给硬凿勘测队的弗巴·硬凿。
text.description: 好了，我们得赶紧押着麦酒上路了！$B$B铁炉堡派出了一队勘测人员来评估大坝决堤对湿地造成的损失。弗巴·硬凿是领头的……相信我，你不会想要跟她唱对台戏的！$B$B怀抱一大桶麦酒出现会有所帮助。去把这些给她带去，说不定她还会让你留下给你些活儿干。
text.progress: Aye? What've you got for me there?
text.completion: Hah! Nice to see those addlebrained mountaineers knew to hand the ale off to a real man to get the job done. Welcome to my survey. If you're of the mind to help Ironforge by takin' over the intended jobs of some useless, lazy sods that call themselves dwarves, you're in the right place!

english.title: Keg Run
english.objectives: Deliver the Mountaineer's Ale to Forba Slabchisel at Slabchisel's Survey.
english.description: Alright. We need to get this ale to where it's going right away!$B$BIronforge has sent out an expedition of surveyors to check the damage done to the wetlands when the dam burst. Forba Slabchisel's the one leading it...and believe me, you don't want to get on her bad side!$B$BShowing up with an armful of ale will help with that. Go and take this ahead to her, and she might even ask you to stick around for some work.
english.progress: Aye? What've you got for me there?
english.completion: Hah! Nice to see those addlebrained mountaineers knew to hand the ale off to a real man to get the job done. Welcome to my survey. If you're of the mind to help Ironforge by takin' over the intended jobs of some useless, lazy sods that call themselves dwarves, you're in the right place!

text.title: 一件德莱尼垃圾
text.objectives: 将不完美的德莱尼水晶碎片交给诅咒之地的收藏家库米沙。
text.description: 一块微微闪着光的石块摆在你的面前。你觉得这件东西对于诅咒之地的某人来说可能很有价值。
text.progress: Well? Draenethyst?
text.completion: Just a shard?  Pfuh!  This gets me nothing!  Take your reward and get out of my sight. Sounds familiar?  It should, because I say it a thousand times per day. Oh how I loathe this world.

english.title: One Draenei's Junk...
english.objectives: Return the Imperfect Draenethyst Fragment to Kum'isha the Collector in Blasted Lands.
english.description: A shard of glimmering rock sits before you.  You sense that this item would be of value to someone within the Blasted Lands.
english.progress: Well? Draenethyst?
english.completion: Just a shard?  Pfuh!  This gets me nothing!  Take your reward and get out of my sight. Sounds familiar?  It should, because I say it a thousand times per day. Oh how I loathe this world.

text.title: 库米沙的努力
text.objectives: 将无瑕的德莱尼水晶球交给诅咒之地的收藏家库米沙。
text.description: 一枚微微闪着光的球体摆在你的面前。你觉得这件东西对于诅咒之地的某人来说可能是价值连城的。
text.progress: Have you found a flawless draenethyst sphere?
text.completion: Simply amazing.  I had doubted that anyone could find another sphere, yet here it is, pulsating in my hands. Well done, $n! Should you find anymore--and I believe this to be an impossibility--return them to me and I shall reward you again.

english.title: Kum'isha's Endeavors
english.objectives: Bring the Flawless Draenethyst Sphere to Kum'isha the Collector in Blasted Lands.
english.description: A glimmering sphere sits before you.  You sense that this item would be of great value to someone within the Blasted Lands.
english.progress: Have you found a flawless draenethyst sphere?
english.completion: Simply amazing.  I had doubted that anyone could find another sphere, yet here it is, pulsating in my hands. Well done, $n! Should you find anymore--and I believe this to be an impossibility--return them to me and I shall reward you again.

text.title: 自然异象
text.objectives: 将元素碎片交给铁炉堡、暴风城、埃索达或达纳苏斯的大地之环使者。
text.description: 曾经出现在这里的裂隙已经消失，只剩下了这块碎片。我完全不知道这块碎片和裂隙之间有什么联系。但也许会有精通元素知识的人能告诉你更多关于它的知识。$B$B你可以去各个首都找到大地之环使者。他们应该正在搜寻这样的东西。
text.progress: You found this near an Elemental Rift?
text.completion: Yes, $n, this shard does explain the occurrence of the rift.  The elemental planes have been in chaos in Outland ever since Draenor was destroyed. These shards cause a weakness in the already damaged elemental planes and allow the elementals to cross into our world We're still looking into how these rifts are appearing in Azeroth.  Keep bringing us the shards.  Every shard we get brings us closer to understanding how these rifts are appearing.

english.title: A Natural Occurrence
english.objectives: Take the Elemental Shard to an Earthen Ring Emissary in Ironforge, Stormwind, Exodar or Darnassus.
english.description: This shard is all that is left from the rift that stood here before.  The connection between the shard and the rift is unknown, but perhaps someone more versed in the elements would know more.$B$BSeek out an Earthen Ring Emissary at any capital city.  This could be exactly what they are looking for.
english.progress: You found this near an Elemental Rift?
english.completion: Yes, $n, this shard does explain the occurrence of the rift.  The elemental planes have been in chaos in Outland ever since Draenor was destroyed. These shards cause a weakness in the already damaged elemental planes and allow the elementals to cross into our world We're still looking into how these rifts are appearing in Azeroth.  Keep bringing us the shards.  Every shard we get brings us closer to understanding how these rifts are appearing.

text.title: 愚人的金子
text.objectives: 收集8份大块千针石林燃铁矿石。
text.description: 我们肯定没有部落出的价高。$n，我们要是不做点什么的话，就别想拿到探油权啦！$B$B且慢！好像我们有一份水下勘探报告，就在大灾变来临之后，说是某种金色的矿石从地下被挤压了上来。就是它了！$B$B西边半人马出没的地方就是，裂蹄峭壁和裂蹄堡那儿，挖点出来。
text.progress: Once you return with enough of that pyrite, we'll give it a once over with a paint brush, pile it all up on a pallet, and send you back up with it to the chieftain.
text.completion: Genius! Now, where's that gold paint? I know it's around here somewhere.
text.completed: Return to Crazzle Spryspocket at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Fool's Gold
english.objectives: Collect 8 Needles Pyrite Ore Chunks.
english.description: We definitely DO NOT have the kind of gold that the Horde is offering. $n, we have to do something or we're not going to be able to get those drilling rights!$B$BWait a minute! There was this report from an underwater survey that we did right after the Cataclysm struck. Something about some gold-looking ore that was pushed up from underground. That's it!$B$BHead west to the old stomping grounds of the centaur, Splithoof Crag and Splithoof Hold, and dig some up.
english.progress: Once you return with enough of that pyrite, we'll give it a once over with a paint brush, pile it all up on a pallet, and send you back up with it to the chieftain.
english.completion: Genius! Now, where's that gold paint? I know it's around here somewhere.
english.completed: Return to Crazzle Spryspocket at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 愚人的金子
text.objectives: 收集8份大块千针石林燃铁矿石。
text.description: 我们肯定没有联盟出的价高。$n，我们要是不做点什么的话，就别想拿到探油权啦！$B$B且慢！好像我们有一份水下勘探报告，就在大灾变来临之后，说是某种金色的矿石从地下被挤压了上来。就是它了！$B$B西边半人马出没的地方就是，裂蹄峭壁和裂蹄堡那儿，挖点出来。

text.title: 塞西莉亚的末日
text.objectives: 消灭巨龙塞西莉亚。当她显露原形时，你需要使用信号火箭来呼叫支援！
text.description: 当你扫荡塞西莉亚的巢穴时，圣殿和这里消息往来不断。啸天者欧穆隆起初并不情愿，但我说服了其他的德鲁伊对塞西莉亚本人冒险进行一次直接进攻。$B$B大家都同意我的计划……那就是让你做排头兵。$B$B带上这支信号火箭到山脊远端同塞西莉亚交战。当她显露真身，转变成巨龙形态的时候，发射这枚火箭，后援就会来助你一臂之力！
text.progress: If a minor dragon like Sethria can cause us so many problems, I hate to see what else Twilight's Hammer has in store...
text.completion: Sethria is slain! I knew it was worth the risk. I'll stay here to look for survivors, but I imagine they'll want to see you back at the shrine.
text.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: 当她显露出巨龙形态时，立即给我们打出信号！

english.title: Sethria's Demise
english.objectives: Slay the dragon Sethria. Once she reveals her true form, you will need to use the signal rocket to call in reinforcements!
english.description: While you've been raiding Sethria's nest, messages have been flying back and forth between here and the shrine. Skylord Omnuron was at first reluctant, but I've persuaded my fellow druids to risk a direct assault on Sethria herself.$B$BEveryone agreed to my plan... provided YOU spearhead the attack.$B$BTake this signal rocket and engage Sethria on the far ridge. When she reveals her true colors and shifts to her dragon form, fire the rocket and backup will arrive to help you!
english.progress: If a minor dragon like Sethria can cause us so many problems, I hate to see what else Twilight's Hammer has in store...
english.completion: Sethria is slain! I knew it was worth the risk. I'll stay here to look for survivors, but I imagine they'll want to see you back at the shrine.
english.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: As soon as she reveals her dragon form, signal us for help!

text.title: 前往米奈希尔
text.objectives: 将硬凿的报告送交米奈希尔港的斯托菲队长。
text.description: 这消息得尽快送到米奈希尔。我会把最快的山羊牵给你，$n。$B$B他认识路，你就抓紧鞍子便是。$B$B就别在营地打混了，情况紧急！
text.progress: Welcome to Menethil, stranger. I hope you've got good news or a stiff drink with you.
text.completion: Let's take a look here.$B$BOh, this is just lovely. "Significant geological instabilities"? "Threat of sudden, massive topological destabilization"?$B$BNice to hear that somethin' bad might happen around here. I guess we'll just pick up our flooded town and fly it off somewhere safe!$B$BBah!

english.title: Onwards to Menethil
english.objectives: Deliver the Slabchisel Report to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor.
english.description: This news needs to get to Menethil as soon as possible. I'll send you along on my fastest ram, $n.$B$BHe knows the way, just make sure you're steady in the saddle and hold on tight.$B$BDon't dawdle around the camp. We've got to send word quickly!
english.progress: Welcome to Menethil, stranger. I hope you've got good news or a stiff drink with you.
english.completion: Let's take a look here.$B$BOh, this is just lovely. "Significant geological instabilities"? "Threat of sudden, massive topological destabilization"?$B$BNice to hear that somethin' bad might happen around here. I guess we'll just pick up our flooded town and fly it off somewhere safe!$B$BBah!

text.title: 假金子和黑金子
text.objectives: 将那盘“金子”送给千针石林裂蹄高地的阿布力可汗。
text.description: 现在“金子”准备好了，我要你把它带给阿布力可汗。他肯定会喜出望外，然后帮咱们安设钻机。我们用的着他们的马力。$B$B哈哈，听明白了吗？马力？
text.progress: What's this? That is a lot of gold you have there.
text.completion: Just put it down on the ground, $r.

english.title: Fake Gold for Black Gold
english.objectives: Deliver the Pallet of "Gold" to Khan Ablinh at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Now that the "gold" is ready, I want you to take it up to Khan Ablinh. He'll be so overwhelmed, I bet he'll offer to help us setup the drilling rigs. We could use the horsepower.$B$BHaha, get it? Horsepower?
english.progress: What's this? That is a lot of gold you have there.
english.completion: Just put it down on the ground, $r.

text.title: 米奈希尔城堡攻掠战
text.objectives: 杀死荷加斯特·狂焰。
text.description: 我们刚刚从大水里回过神来，黑铁矮人就袭击了镇子。我和我的人疲于保卫乡亲们，但这些疯狂的蠢货退守到了城堡里。$B$B他们藏得可好了，我们无法摧毁城堡，半个镇子都成废墟了。$B$B这儿就交给你了，$n。要不是他给了我这一下，我就亲自上阵。杀进城堡，干掉荷加斯特，结束这一切！
text.progress: Is he dead? Is Horghast dead?
text.completion: He's dead! Thank the Makers...$B$BI don't like the looks of them, lad. The Dark Iron I've tussled with were never this crazy. Something's getting to these sods...
text.completed: Return to Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
text.giverWindow: 去击败他！

english.title: Assault on Menethil Keep
english.objectives: Kill Horghast Flarecrazed.
english.description: We'd barely pulled ourselves together after the flood when the Dark Iron hit the town. My men and I all rushed to defend the townsfolk, but the crazed fools retreated right into the keep itself.$B$BThey're holed up good, and we can't destroy the keep. Not with half the town in ruins already.$B$BTake my place, $n. I'd take the leader on myself if he hadn't dealt me this blow. Enter the keep, slay Horghast, and bring this to an end!
english.progress: Is he dead? Is Horghast dead?
english.completion: He's dead! Thank the Makers...$B$BI don't like the looks of them, lad. The Dark Iron I've tussled with were never this crazy. Something's getting to these sods...
english.completed: Return to Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
english.giverWindow: I want him dead!

text.title: Hammering It Out
text.completion: Not another one! $n, these devices have been springing up all around Azeroth. We know that they can instigate elemental disturbances in the area, including causing tears in the elemental planes. The devices stink of Twilight's Hammer.  The engravings covering the surface and the captured elemental essence implicate Cho'gall and his minions are behind this. If you find more of these, please bring them to me or one of my associates. We need to learn more about what's behind this attack.

text.title: 回去找克拉兹
text.objectives: 同千针石林裂蹄高地的克拉兹·滑链交谈。
text.description: 我不蠢！$B$B回到你的主子那儿告诉他，生意谈崩了！没错，要是你能活着回去的话。
text.completion: THEY WHAT?!

english.title: Back to Crazzle
english.objectives: Speak with Crazzle Sprysprocket at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
english.description: I am NOT stupid!$B$BGo back to your master and tell him that there will be NO deal! That is, if you can survive to make it back to him.
english.completion: THEY WHAT?!

text.title: 回去找瑞兹尼克
text.objectives: 同千针石林裂蹄高地的瑞兹尼克交谈。
text.description: 我不蠢！$B$B回到你的主子那儿告诉他，生意谈崩了！没错，要是你能活着回去的话。
text.completion: THEY WHAT?!

english.title: Back to Riznek
english.objectives: Speak with Riznek at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
english.description: I am NOT stupid!$B$BGo back to your master and tell him that there will be NO deal! That is, if you can survive to make it back to him.
english.completion: THEY WHAT?!

text.title: 推进
text.objectives: 使用烈焰符文在霜鬃前线摧毁4根压缩图腾。
text.description: 丹莫罗大多数的巡山人和蒸汽坦克都在霜鬃前线上作战，战线正从东南朝我们逐渐推进。我们只能勉强抵御住巨魔，就别提推进到他们的村子里，干掉他们的首领了。$B$B他们用神秘的图腾阻挡了我们的去路，进入其范围内的巡山人都会窒息，任敌人宰割。这块石头上刻着烈焰的符文，应该能摧毁那些图腾，解救我们的巡山人。
text.completion: Finally, some good news from the Frostmane Front. I'll have the mountaineers press their attack immediately. Now, we must signal our gnomish allies at Steelgrill to start their advance.
text.completed: Return to Captain Tharran in Kharanos.

english.title: Pushing Forward
english.objectives: Use the Rune of Fire to destroy 4 Constriction Totems in the Frostmane Front.
english.description: Most of the mountaineers and steam tanks in Dun Morogh are battling along the Frostmane Front, which is approaching us from the southeast. We can barely hold the trolls back, let alone advance into their village and take on their leader.$B$BThey've blocked our path of approach with mysterious totems that choke mountaineers who come in range, leaving the victims helpless against their enemies. This stone is inscribed with a rune of fire; it should be able to destroy the totems and free our mountaineers.
english.completion: Finally, some good news from the Frostmane Front. I'll have the mountaineers press their attack immediately. Now, we must signal our gnomish allies at Steelgrill to start their advance.
english.completed: Return to Captain Tharran in Kharanos.

text.title: 幽暗曲径
text.objectives: 跟石爪山脉幽暗曲径的钢趾麦格谈一谈。
text.description: 这个基地的初衷是在石爪山为塞拉摩建立一个据点，为暗夜精灵开通一条补给线。但不幸的是，部落和我们打得不可开交。地狱咆哮的军队势不可挡。自从第二次大战以来我还没见部落这么拼过。$B$B现在看来，部落要用探险者协会挖掘的矿井来走我们的“后门”。我们得把那儿给封住！
text.completion: Seal it off? That's gonna take some work, friend.

english.title: The Deep Reaches
english.objectives: Speak to Steeltoe McGee at the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: The purpose of this base was to establish a foothold in Stonetalon for Theramore and to open up a supply line to the night elves. The Horde, unfortunately, has given us one hell of a fight. Hellscream's armies are mighty and unrelenting. I haven't seen this type of ferocity from the Horde since the second war.$B$BNow it would appear that the mine the Explorers' League dug out is being used by the Horde to "backdoor" us. We need to seal that thing off!
english.completion: Seal it off? That's gonna take some work, friend.

text.title: 海底避难所
text.objectives: 使用埃鲁纳克的占卜球观测重雾洞穴的位置。
text.description: 我想，我找到了你的那张便笺的作者，朋友。$b$b看来，如果他想要活命的话，就得非常小心才行。$B$B我来同调一下我的占卜球，这样你就可以自己看看他了。
text.completion: We must make haste! As you can surely see, his time is not long.
text.completed: Speak to Erunak at Shallow's End.

english.title: Undersea Sanctuary
english.objectives: Use Erunak's Scrying Orb to view the location of Deepmist Grotto.
english.description: I believe I've located the author of your note, friend.$b$bIt would seem that he is in desperate need of attention if he is to survive.$b$bI shall attune one of my scrying orbs, that you might see him for yourself.
english.completion: We must make haste! As you can surely see, his time is not long.
english.completed: Speak to Erunak at Shallow's End.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用埃鲁纳克的占卜球

text.title: 回到圣殿
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山艾维娜圣殿的楚伦娜。
text.description: 艾维娜的蛋应该已经安全抵达圣殿了。你应该去看看！楚伦娜大概知道怎么处理。$B$B我在这儿做完收尾工作就去找你。
text.completion: $n! Is it true you led an assault against a twilight dragon? You are truly a herald of the ancients!
text.completed: 去找海加尔山艾维娜圣殿的楚伦娜。

english.title: Return to the Shrine
english.objectives: Return to Choluna at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: Aviana's Egg should have arrived safely back at the Shrine. You should go check on it! Choluna should know how to handle this.$B$BI'll finish the last of our business here and catch up with you later.
english.completion: $n! Is it true you led an assault against a twilight dragon? You are truly a herald of the ancients!
english.completed: Return to Choluna at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 强行征用
text.objectives: 杀死15只裂蹄高地半人马。
text.description: 我们一定要拿下石油。很不幸的是半人马正巧在海水淹来时撤到了这里。$B$B对他们来说，很不幸。$B$B他们给脸不要脸，$n。我们出的价那么慷慨，他们却敬酒不吃吃罚酒。现在我们……你要让他们看看自己犯下的什么错误。$B$B把裂蹄高地上的半人马清走。石油必定要为我们流淌！
text.completion: That'll teach them. You've softened the Splithoof up enough that we should be able to govern them now with a minimal guard presence from the Speedbarge. That is, once we've dealt with their supposed air elemental leader.
text.completed: Return to Crazzle Sprysprocket at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Eminent Domain
english.objectives: Slay 15 Splithoof Heights centaurs.
english.description: It is our destiny to take this oil. Unfortunate that the centaur retreated to here when the sea rushed in.$B$BUnfortunate for them, that is.$B$BThey've spit in our faces, $n. We made them a generous offer and they made the mistake of not accepting. Now we... you, will show them the error of their ways.$B$BClear the centaur off of the Splithoof Heights. The oil must flow!
english.completion: That'll teach them. You've softened the Splithoof up enough that we should be able to govern them now with a minimal guard presence from the Speedbarge. That is, once we've dealt with their supposed air elemental leader.
english.completed: Return to Crazzle Sprysprocket at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.

text.description: 我们一定要拿下石油。很不幸的是半人马正巧在海水淹来时撤到了这里。$B$B对他们来说，很不幸。$B$B他们给脸不要脸，$n。我们出的价那么慷慨，他们却敬酒不吃吃罚酒。现在我们……你要让他们看看自己犯下的什么错误。$B$B把裂蹄高地上的半人马清走。石油必定要为我们流淌！
text.completion: That'll teach them. You've softened the Splithoof up enough that we should be able to govern them now with a minimal guard presence from the Speedbarge. That is, once we've dealt with their supposed air elemental leader.
text.completed: Return to Riznek at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.

We made them a generous offer and they made the mistake of not accepting. Now we... you, will show them the error of their ways.$B$BClear the centaur off of the Splithoof Heights. The oil must flow!

text.title: 保卫钻机
text.objectives: 保卫钻油机。
text.description: 我不会空着手离开！你呢？$B$B我打赌你在纳闷这巨大的箱子里装的到底是啥。好吧，答案马上揭晓。我要你拿上钻机到油井那儿，抽点原油上来。$B$B当然，你会受到半人马的攻击，只要保护好钻机，让我们打上一两桶就好。
text.completion: Oil! Black gold! Tanaris Tea! We're rich! We just have to clear out the remaining pesky centaur. I'm sure with all the money we're going to make, we can relocate them to some other bluff.
text.completed: 去找千针石林裂蹄高地的克拉兹·滑链。

english.title: Defend the Drill
english.objectives: Defend the Oil Drilling Rig.
english.description: I'm not leaving here empty-handed! Are you?$B$BI bet you were wondering what's in the giant crate. Well, wait no longer. I want you to take one of our drilling rigs to the oil pools and pump us up some crude.$B$BOf course, you should expect the centaurs to attack. Just defend the drill long enough for us to get a barrel or two out of the ground.
english.completion: Oil! Black gold! Tanaris Tea! We're rich! We just have to clear out the remaining pesky centaur. I'm sure with all the money we're going to make, we can relocate them to some other bluff.
english.completed: Return to Crazzle Sprysprocket at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.

text.objectives: 保卫钻油机。
text.description: 我不会空着手离开！你呢？$B$B我打赌你在纳闷这巨大的箱子里装的到底是啥。好吧，答案马上揭晓。我要你拿上钻机到油井那儿，抽点原油上来。$B$B当然，你会受到半人马的攻击，只要保护好钻机，让我们打上一两桶就好。
text.completion: Oil! Black gold! Tanaris Tea! We're rich! We just have to clear out the remaining pesky centaur. I'm sure with all the money we're going to make, we can relocate them to some other bluff.
text.completed: 去找千针石林裂蹄高地的瑞兹尼克。
