english.objectives: Defend the Oil Drilling Rig.
english.description: I'm not leaving here empty-handed! Are you?$B$BI bet you were wondering what's in the giant crate. Well, wait no longer. I want you to take one of our drilling rigs to the oil pools and pump us up some crude.$B$BOf course, you should expect the centaurs to attack. Just defend the drill long enough for us to get a barrel or two out of the ground.
english.completion: Oil! Black gold! Tanaris Tea! We're rich! We just have to clear out the remaining pesky centaur. I'm sure with all the money we're going to make, we can relocate them to some other bluff.
english.completed: Return to Riznek at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 生活给了你螃蟹
text.objectives: 从港湾蟹身上拆5只多肉的蟹爪。
text.description: 要做的事情还有很多，$c，不过总要留意命运给你安排的礼物。$B$B大水来犯，淹没了我们的屋子，也将海洋生物带上了岸。米奈希尔海湾现在爬满了螃蟹，又大又肥，就等着人去捡。$B$B要我说，生活若是给你螃蟹，你就去借点儿醋。给我拆几只最大、最饱的蟹钳子来，我会给你钱。
text.progress: Don't bother with the smaller claws, they're more work to shell than the meat's worth.
text.completion: A hearty seafood dinner will lift everyone's spirits and help us get the town back in shape again. Thanks for the help, $n.
text.completed: Return to Karl Boran at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

english.title: When Life Gives You Crabs
english.objectives: Collect 5 Meaty Crawler Claws from Harbor Crawlers.
english.description: There's a lot to do here, $c, but we need to keep an eye out for the gifts of fate.$B$BWhen the flood rolled in, right over our houses, it swept a good number of ocean dwellers with it. Menethil Bay's full of crabs now, large and ripe for the picking.$B$BWhen life gives you crabs, go crab fishing, I say. Bring me back the largest, meatiest claws you can find and I'll pay you.
english.progress: Don't bother with the smaller claws, they're more work to shell than the meat's worth.
english.completion: A hearty seafood dinner will lift everyone's spirits and help us get the town back in shape again. Thanks for the help, $n.
english.completed: Return to Karl Boran at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

text.title: 海中的鱼人
text.objectives: 从高布勒尔那儿拿走高布勒尔的徽记，杀死12名任意种类的蓝鳃鱼人。
text.description: 鱼人们正从深水里朝海岸线上迁徙，还不住地骚扰我们的渔夫和商贩，必须阻止它们。$B$B其中一名鱼人，唤作高布勒尔的，伙同蓝鳃鱼人埋伏在沿路，侵扰我们的商贩，却总能全身而退，回到附近的鱼人小屋。商人们苦不堪言，我们愿意礼聘高人来为民除害。$B$B高布勒尔出没在北边的河口一带，找到他，杀掉他的同伙，把他的徽记带来。
text.progress: 高布勒尔和它的鱼人爪牙们不死，我们的商人就得不到安宁。
text.completion: 啊，干得好，$N。$B$B请收下由商会提供的这份奖金，以作为你成功完成任务的酬劳。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Karl Boran at Menethil Harbor in Wetlands.
text.giverWindow: 他再也不能给我们找麻烦了。

english.title: Claws from the Deep
english.objectives: Collect Gobbler's Head from Gobbler and slay 12 Bluegill Murlocs of any kind.
english.description: Murlocs are crawling out from the deep waters and building their villages on the coastline.  They are harassing our fishers and merchants and must be stopped.$B$BOne of these murlocs, Gobbler, skulks with other bluegill murlocs and harries merchants along the road, always then retreating to the safety of the nearby murloc hovels.  Our merchants are in jeopardy, and we will pay to secure them.$B$BGobbler prowls the river inlet north of here.  Find him, slay his kin, and bring me his head.
english.progress: Our merchants will not be safe until we are rid of Gobbler and those murlocs.
english.completion: Ah, well done $n.$B$BAccept this as payment for fulfillment of your contract with the Merchant Marines.
english.completed: Return to Karl Boran at Menethil Harbor in Wetlands.
english.giverWindow: He'll trouble us no more.

text.title: 寻找货物
text.objectives: 在沿海的鱼人营地搜索木箱和木桶。
text.description: 不久之前，一艘名为盲眼公主号的商船遭到了鱼人的洗劫。尽管船是完好无损地逃了出来，可货物却被那些家伙拖下了水，其中也包括一尊价值连城的泰瑞纳斯·米奈希尔像。我们得把雕像夺回来。$B$B去海边搜搜那些鱼人小屋，把那些木箱、木桶以及其他的可能是失踪货物的东西都翻一遍。把米奈希尔雕像给我找回来。
text.completion: 这只木箱上满是爪印，还有被水长时间浸泡过的痕迹。你努力撬开了它，发现木箱中满是水，还有一些腐烂的稻草，似乎这里面曾经装过某些很贵重的物品。你继续在稻草堆中寻找……$B$B……很快，你就发现其中有一堆红色的瓶子。$B$B

english.title: Reclaiming Goods
english.objectives: Search the crates and barrels at the coastal Murloc camps.
english.description: Not long ago a merchant vessel, the Blind Princess, was raided by murlocs.  Although the ship escaped intact, much of its cargo was dragged overboard by the creatures, including a very valuable statuette of Terenas Menethil.  We want that statuette recovered.$B$BSearch the coastal murloc hovels for crates, barrels and other evidence of lost cargo.  Find the Menethil Statuette and return it to me.
english.completion: This crate is covered with clawed scratches, and the marks of water damage.  Prying it open reveals soggy and rotted straw, as if something of value was stored in the crate.  You search through the straw...$B$B...and find an armload of red-colored bottles.

text.title: 继续搜寻
text.objectives: 寻找米奈希尔雕像。
text.description: 你在这片鱼人小屋里搜了个遍，却没有发现米奈希尔雕像的踪迹。$B$B也许北边和东北两处小屋有更多的线索。
text.completion: 这个木桶似乎还没有人碰过。你用力撬开了它……$B$B你一下子就被扑鼻而来的浓烈乳酪味给冲了个天旋地转。虽然有点发潮，但这些乳酪的味道似乎还不错!$B$B

english.title: The Search Continues
english.objectives: Search for the Menethil Statuette.
english.description: You thoroughly search this cluster of murloc hovels, and find no trace of the Menethil Statuette.$B$BPerhaps one of the two nearby hovels to the north and northeast will have more clues.
english.completion: This barrel is largely untouched.  Prying it open...$B$B...you are assaulted by the pungent odor of cheese.  It's a little wet, but still tasty!

text.title: 搜索小屋
text.objectives: 继续在鱼人小屋里寻找米奈希尔雕像。
text.description: 这几栋鱼人小屋被你翻了个底朝天，结果啥也没有。$B$B……不过你很肯定继续搜索下去一定会有所斩获。$B$B米奈希尔雕像肯定在北边的某座小屋里！
text.completion: 这只桶半埋在泥土和杂草之中……$B$B

english.title: Search More Hovels
english.objectives: Continue searching the Murloc hovels for the Menethil Statuette.
english.description: This grouping of murloc hovels, after a thorough inspection, reveals nothing.$B$B...but you're certain that the next clue you find will be fruitful.$B$BOne of the hovels to the north must have the Menethil Statuette!
english.completion: This barrel is halfway buried amidst the mud and grass ...

text.title: 归还雕像
text.objectives: 把米奈希尔雕像交给位于米奈希尔港的卡尔·伯伦。
text.description: <你刚把木桶从污泥里拖出来打开，一尊精心包裹在稻草里的银质塑像就掉了出来。一个年轻的长发圣骑士，高举着战锤。$B$B这一定就是米奈希尔雕像！你必须马上把它还给米奈希尔港的卡尔·伯伦。>
text.progress: 你拿到雕像了没有?
text.completion: The captain of the Blind Princess will be relieved to hear this precious cargo has been recovered.  You've well earned this payment for services rendered.$B$BIt's good to see dependable folk like you, especially in trying times such as these.
text.completed: Report to Karl Boran at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

english.title: Return the Statuette
english.objectives: Bring Karl Boran at Menethil Harbor in Wetlands the Menethil Statuette.
english.description: After pulling the barrel free from the muck and opening it, a silvery figurine is found packed in fine straw.  It depicts a young, long-haired Paladin with hammer upraised.$B$BThis must be the Menethil Statuette!  You must now return it to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.
english.progress: Do you have the statuette?
english.completion: The captain of the Blind Princess will be relieved to hear this precious cargo has been recovered.  You've well earned this payment for services rendered.$B$BIt's good to see dependable folk like you, especially in trying times such as these.
english.completed: Report to Karl Boran at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

text.title: 他们把刺客放进来……算了
text.objectives: 消灭12名克罗姆加刺客。
text.description: 啊，探险者协会——一群彻头彻尾的白痴。不仅仅是牛头人的鬼魂对我们紧追不舍，探险者协会还成功地打开了通往石爪山克罗姆加壁垒部落主营的一道后门。$B$B现在克罗姆加刺客在矿洞里悄无声息，见人就杀。$B$B我要你去把他们除掉。$B$B差点忘了把护目镜给你。现在就戴上。它可以让所有隐形的刺客无所遁形。
text.completion: Hey, this thing on? Anybody there?
text.completed: Report to Lieutenant Paulson at the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: They Put the Assass in... Never Mind
english.objectives: Kill 12 Krom'gar Assassins.
english.description: Ah, the Explorers' League - such a profound group of morons. Not only do we have tauren ghosts up our butts, the Explorers' League has also managed to open up a backdoor to the primary Horde base in Stonetalon, Krom'gar Fortress.$B$BNow we've got Krom'gar assassins silently executing everyone in the mine.$B$BI need you to head in there and clean house.$B$BI almost forgot to give you these goggles. Put them on immediately. They'll make all the stealthed assassins in the mine plainly visible.
english.completion: Hey, this thing on? Anybody there?
english.completed: Report to Lieutenant Paulson at the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 一个古神的重生
text.objectives: 在艾维娜圣殿里的艾维娜的卵前使用预兆熏香。
text.description: 我相信你就是艾维娜的使者，$n。是你先发现了她，把她的魂魄从龙爪里救下。$B$B是的，我相信艾维娜就要在我们的世界中重生。而引导她破壳而出的荣誉理当属于你。$B$B拿上这焚香，在上方屋子里的艾维娜的蛋前点燃。$B$B古神等着你，$n。我们解脱的时候到了！
text.completion: I ... live. Those that tried to corrupt me and kidnap my children will soon feel the rake of my talons, $c. Believe it. Continue to push forward across Hyjal. I will collect myself and assemble with the other Ancients.
text.completed: Speak with Aviana within her shrine in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: An Ancient Reborn
english.objectives: Use the Herald's Incense before Aviana's Egg at the Shrine of Aviana.
english.description: I'm convinced that YOU are the herald of Aviana, $n. It was you who first saw her and rescued her essence from the claws of a dragon.$B$BYes, I believe Aviana is to be reborn into our world. And you shall have the honor of ushering her over the threshold.$B$BTake this incense and burn it before Aviana's egg in the room just above me.$B$BThe ancient awaits, $n. Our deliverance is here!
english.completion: I ... live. Those that tried to corrupt me and kidnap my children will soon feel the rake of my talons, $c. Believe it. Continue to push forward across Hyjal. I will collect myself and assemble with the other Ancients.
english.completed: Speak with Aviana within her shrine in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 这东西开了吗？
text.objectives: 杀死刺客大师凯莉丝卓。
text.description: <侏儒通讯器接通了。你可以在那头听到鲍尔森中尉的声音。>$B$B愚蠢的侏儒垃圾……到底有人没有？$n，是你吗？$B$B也许$g他:她;死了。$B$B听着，要是你还能听见的话，我们刚收到消息，部落刺客大师就在矿井里，指挥着其他的刺客。找到她，杀掉她，然后回来告诉我。$B$B鲍尔森通话完毕。
text.completion: Nicely done, $n! You worked the mines like a pro. Now how about returning my goggles.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Paulson at the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.giverWindow: 倒霉的侏儒装置！有人吗？！

english.title: Is This Thing On?
english.objectives: Kill Master Assassin Kel'istra.
english.description: <The Gnomecorder crackles with energy. You can hear Lieutenant Paulson on the other end.>$B$BStupid gnome junk... Is ANYBODY there? $n, are you there?$B$BMaybe $g he's:she's; dead.$B$BListen, if you can still hear me, we just got word that a Horde master assassin is in the mines, directing the other assassins. Find her, kill her, report back to me.$B$BPaulson, out.
english.completion: Nicely done, $n! You worked the mines like a pro. Now how about returning my goggles.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Paulson at the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.giverWindow: Damned gnomish contraption!  HELLO?!

text.title: 一个人都不能落下！
text.objectives: 营救8名惊恐的矿工。
text.description: 部落的畜生！$B$B<沃卡德下士啐了一口唾沫。>$B$B看看这个地方！他们滥杀无辜！平民！$B$B听好，$n，你得帮我们。到幽暗曲径里去寻找幸存的矿工。假如还有人活着，他们多半会被吓得不知所措的！去矿井的各个角落找找看，说不定矿车里也有！肯定有人还活着，藏在那儿。
text.completion: Thank the Light! You truly are a righteous instrument of power! The Alliance is lucky to you have, $n.
text.completed: Return to Corporal Wocard at the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Leave No Man Behind!
english.objectives: Rescue 8 Frightened Miners.
english.description: Horde monsters!$B$B<Corporal Wocard spits.>$B$BLook at this place! They've wiped out innocents! Civilians!$B$BListen, $n, you've got to help us. Go into the Deep Reaches and look for surviving miners. If any are still alive they're probably scared witless! Check in the nooks and crannies of the mine. Maybe in mine carts! There are bound to be some left alive and in hiding.
english.completion: Thank the Light! You truly are a righteous instrument of power! The Alliance is lucky to you have, $n.
english.completed: Return to Corporal Wocard at the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 必须烧掉孵化场
text.objectives: 穿过位于海加尔山烈焰之痕中心的火焰之门。跟里面的法登·爪击谈一谈。
text.description: $n！楚伦娜说的是真的：女神已经回来了！这简直是个奇迹。$B$B虽然你击败了暮光之龙塞西莉亚，但我们还没有找到鹰身人交给她的所有卵。希萨莉和我找到了它们在火焰之地中建造的一处大孵化场。它不在这个世界中，所以艾维娜无法跟你同去。$B$B飞往南边，进入峡谷中间的火焰之门。法登·爪击已经在那边等你了。
text.completion: So it's true - Aviana has returned, with you as her herald. There's much to be done here. We are deep in the heart of the Firelands. Sethria smuggled stolen eggs from Mount Hyjal here to hatch her own hideous creations - birds of prey, trained for war. I hope you're ready to fight back!
text.completed: 穿过位于海加尔山烈焰之痕中心的火焰之门。跟里面的法登·爪击谈一谈。

english.title: The Hatchery Must Burn
english.objectives: Travel through the flamegate in the center of the Flamewake in Mount Hyjal. Speak with Farden Talonshrike once you are inside.
english.description: $n! Choluna spoke true: the goddess has returned! A miracle in our midst.$B$BWhile you were able to kill the twilight dragon Sethria, we have not yet located all of the eggs that the harpies had delivered to her. Thisalee and I have tracked them to a great hatchery constructed within the Firelands. It is not of this realm, so Aviana cannot accompany you.$B$BFly south and enter the flamegate in the center of the valley. Farden Talonshrike has been sent ahead and will be waiting for you within.
english.completion: So it's true - Aviana has returned, with you as her herald. There's much to be done here. We are deep in the heart of the Firelands. Sethria smuggled stolen eggs from Mount Hyjal here to hatch her own hideous creations - birds of prey, trained for war. I hope you're ready to fight back!
english.completed: Travel through the flamegate in the center of the Flamewake in Mount Hyjal. Speak with Farden Talonshrike once you are inside.

text.title: 关门大吉
text.objectives: 将一捆炸药装在第一、第二、第三及第四承重梁上。
text.description: 要把矿井弄塌，你就得炸毁它的承重梁。我可以给你提供炸药，但你得从克罗姆加刺客的包围里杀出去，才能前往承重梁。$B$B好消息是，我们总是用大叉来标记承重梁——如果它们还在的话。找到那些标记，把炸药安放在旁边。一旦你把炸药都装好，就回到我这儿来，我来点火。$B$B呯砰！
text.completion: 什么都没有！
text.completed: Return to Steeltoe McGee at the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Shuttin Her Down
english.objectives: Plant the Dynamite Bundle at the First Beam, Second Beam, Third Beam and Fourth Beam.
english.description: To bring this mine down you're gonna need to blow up her support beams. I can provide you with the explosives you'll need, but you're gonna have to trudge through Krom'gar assassins to get to all of the beams.$B$BThe good news, if any exists, is that we always mark our support beams with a big 'X.' Look for the markers and plant this dynamite near 'em. Once you've planted all the dynamite come on back up here and I'll activate the explosives.$B$BKaboom!
english.completion: Here goes nothin'!
english.completed: Return to Steeltoe McGee at the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

objectiveDetails.description: 在第一承重梁上安放炸药
在第二承重梁上安放炸药
在第三承重梁上安放炸药
在第四承重梁上安放炸药

text.title: 洞穴探险
text.objectives: 跟重雾洞穴的列兵伯纳德谈一谈。
text.description: $n，快！$b$b立即前往洞穴。$b$b我们断后，确保没有敌人跟踪你。
text.completion: A... a $r? Here? I must be mad...

english.title: Spelunking
english.objectives: Speak to Private Pollard in Deepmist Grotto.
english.description: Hurry, $n!$b$bMake your way to that cavern at once.$b$bWe shall go behind you to ensure that you are not followed.
english.completion: A... a $r? Here? I must be mad...

text.title: 去吹响号角
text.objectives: 杀死乌尔。
text.description: 那头老不死的半人马唤天者乌拉克西里斯提到过人马崇拜着一个空气之魂。为了占领高地，我们的最后一步就是要对付这个家伙。$B$B我曾见过他们在山顶吹响一只巨大的号角，随后一个空气元素出现了，它下了几道命令后就消散不见。$B$B你也去吹吹那号角，$n。
text.completion: Well then, let's see them get any kind of magical hocus pocus air support now when we take over!
text.completed: Return to Crazzle Sprysprocket at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 吹响号角并且击败他！

english.title: Go Blow that Horn
english.objectives: Slay Whrrrl.
english.description: That old, bitter centaur, Skycaller Vrakthris, mentioned a great air spirit that the centaur worship. To secure the Heights, the last step is for us to deal with this thing.$B$BI've seen them blow the giant horn at the top of the hill up there and an air elemental came down. It gave them orders and then dissipated.$B$BGo blow that horn, $n.
english.completion: Well then, let's see them get any kind of magical hocus pocus air support now when we take over!
english.completed: Return to Crazzle Sprysprocket at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Blow the horn and then slay him!

text.title: 去吹响号角
text.objectives: 杀死乌尔。
text.description: 那头老不死的半人马唤天者乌拉克西里斯提到过人马崇拜着一个空气之魂。为了占领高地，我们的最后一步就是要对付这个家伙。$B$B我曾见过他们在山顶吹响一只巨大的号角，随后出现了一个空气元素，它下了几道命令后之后就消散不见了。$B$B你也去吹吹那号角，$n。
text.completion: Well then, let's see them get any kind of magical hocus pocus air support now when we take over!
text.completed: Return to Riznek at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 吹响号角并且击败他！

english.objectives: Slay Whrrrl.
english.description: That old, bitter centaur, Skycaller Vrakthris, mentioned a great air spirit that the centaur worship. To secure the Heights, the last step is for us to deal with this thing.$B$BI've seen them blow the giant horn at the top of the hill up there and an air elemental came down. It gave them orders and then dissipated.$B$BGo blow that horn, $n.
english.completion: Well then, let's see them get any kind of magical hocus pocus air support now when we take over!
english.completed: Return to Riznek at the Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 第三舰队
text.objectives: 从米奈希尔港旅店的酒窖里拿到菲兹莫斯的蜂蜜酒。
text.description: 我曾经是库尔提拉斯第三舰队的主力舰浪花女神号上的大副。这是一支注定遭难的舰队。注定遭难，因为它在最后一次出航中遭到了红龙的攻击。被兽人控制的红龙！$B$B在龙焰下我们毫无还手之力……舰队在这片海域燃烧殆尽，尽数沉没。我是全队唯一的幸存者……$B$B……把我的蜂蜜酒拿来，$c。就在旅店的酒窖里，没有它我可过不下去。
text.progress: 哦，我非常口渴!你不愿意为我这样一个穷困潦倒的可怜虫买点喝的吗?
text.completion: 啊!那正是我要的东西，我乾裂的唇舌终於好受一些了。谢谢你，夥计!$B$B
text.completed: Return to First Mate Fitzsimmons at Menethil Harbor in Wetlands.

english.title: The Third Fleet
english.objectives: Obtain Fitzsimmons' Mead from the cellar of the inn in Menethil Harbor.
english.description: I was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, ship-of-the-line in the Kul Tiras Third Fleet.  The Doomed Fleet.  Doomed, for on its last voyage the fleet was attacked by red dragons.  Dragons controlled by orcs!$B$BWe didn't stand a chance against that dragonfire...and our fleet was burned and sunk off this here coast.  I'm the sole survivor of those poor vessels...$B$B...Bring me my mead, $c. It's down in the cellar of the inn. As far away as I put it from me, I can't go without it in the end.
english.progress: Oh, I'm so very thirsty!  Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?
english.completion: Ah!  That hits the spot, and loosens the tongue.  Thanks, mate!
english.completed: Return to First Mate Fitzsimmons at Menethil Harbor in Wetlands.

text.title: 诅咒成魂
text.objectives: 同大副斯涅利格的鬼魂交谈。
text.description: <菲兹莫斯振作起来，继续他的故事……>$B$B我就成了命运多舛的库尔提拉斯第三舰队唯一的幸存者。在北方海岸的船骸中，有一艘藏着一件可怕而重要的财宝，它神秘的力量将弟兄们的灵魂禁锢在腐烂的船壳里。$B$B我被他们日夜萦绕。大副斯涅利格在喊我！他本已经死了！求求你，$n，到船骸附近找找看，就……就告诉他别来缠着我。
text.completion: Fitzsimmons sent you, didn't he? It's been so long...

english.title: Cursed to Roam
english.objectives: Talk to the ghost of First Mate Snellig.
english.description: <Bolstered, Fitzsimmons continues his tale...>$B$BI am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. On one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.$B$BI'm haunted by them day and night. First Mate Snellig calls for me! He's supposed to be dead! Please, $n, look for him near the shipwrecks and just...tell him to leave me alone!
english.completion: Fitzsimmons sent you, didn't he? It's been so long...

text.title: 被诅咒的船员
text.objectives: 在失落的舰队杀死5名被诅咒的水手和5名被诅咒的水兵。
text.description: 第三舰队的水手都被诅咒了，只能永远痛苦地徘徊在这片海岸上。菲兹莫斯的痛楚同我们的联系在一起，只要我们一日不得安宁，那他也就一样。$B$B你必须解放我那些船员的灵魂。净化他们的鬼魂，然后回来找我。
text.completion: The cries of anguish have been stifled...but the source of the curse still lurks.
text.completed: Return to First Mate Snellig at The Lost Fleet in the Wetlands.

english.title: The Cursed Crew
english.objectives: Kill 5 Cursed Sailors and 5 Cursed Marines in The Lost Fleet.
english.description: The sailors of the Third Fleet are damned, forever cursed to wander these shores in agony. Fitzsimmons' anguish is tied to us; so long as we suffer, there can be no rest for him, either.$B$BYou must end the suffering of my crewmates' spirits. Purge their ghosts from this plane, and return to me.
english.completion: The cries of anguish have been stifled...but the source of the curse still lurks.
english.completed: Return to First Mate Snellig at The Lost Fleet in the Wetlands.

text.title: 解除诅咒
text.objectives: 从哈林多尔船长身上获得无畏号保险箱钥匙。
text.description: 为了破除诅咒，必须来一次清算。哈林多尔船长诅咒我们，使我们渴求一件被禁止的神器：帕雷斯之眼。他的灵魂还在贪求着它，让他守在老船无畏号的保险箱旁。$B$B战胜那个诅咒我们的灵魂，$c。打败船长，拿到他的钥匙，把帕雷斯之眼带离这个地方。
text.progress: 这个箱子被牢牢地锁着。
text.completion: 钥匙已经生锈了，不过它与锁孔吻合得非常好。$B$B
text.completed: Seek out the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox in the Wetlands.

english.title: Lifting the Curse
english.objectives: Get the Intrepid Strongbox Key from Captain Halyndor.
english.description: To break the curse, there must be a reckoning. Captain Halyndor damned us all to covet a forbidden artifact; the Eye of Paleth. His spirit still covets it, standing guard over the strongbox of his old ship, the Intrepid.$B$BVanquish the soul of the one who cursed us so, $c. Defeat the Captain, claim his key, and spirit the Eye of Paleth far from this place.
english.progress: This chest is securely locked.
english.completion: The key is rusted but it fits the lock neatly.
english.completed: Seek out the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox in the Wetlands.

enders.name: Caja fuerte de El Intrépido cerrada

text.title: 帕雷斯之眼
text.objectives: 把被诅咒的帕雷斯之眼交给湿地米奈希尔港的戈罗林·钢眉。
text.description: 打开箱子之后，你看到了一颗发黑的宝珠，它还在闪烁着可怕的光芒。这一定诅咒了水手灵魂的帕雷斯之眼。$B$B它必须得到净化。也许米奈希尔港的牧师可以帮助你。
text.progress: How can I help you, $glad:lass;?
text.completion: The Eye of Paleth? You say Fitzsimmons sent you out? By the light...not again. Fitzsimmons is dead, lad. You've not the first to come to me like this, either.

english.title: The Eye of Paleth
english.objectives: Bring the Cursed Eye of Paleth to Glorin Steelbrow at Menethil Harbor in Wetlands.
english.description: Opening the chest reveals a blackened orb, pulsing with an eerie light. This must be the foul Eye of Paleth that damned these sailors' souls.$B$BSuch corruption should be purged. Perhaps a priest in Menethil Harbor could help you.
english.progress: How can I help you, $glad:lass;?
english.completion: The Eye of Paleth? You say Fitzsimmons sent you out? By the light...not again. Fitzsimmons is dead, lad. You've not the first to come to me like this, either.

starters.name: Caja fuerte de El Intrépido cerrada

text.title: 母亲的担忧
text.objectives: 杀死10条海湾裂鳍鱼。
text.description: 我的儿子吉姆洛克是我的心肝肉。只要看见他和别的小朋友在一块儿玩，再苦再累我也甘。$B$B可我忍不住操这心啊。几尺外的海湾里就有鲨鱼，要是水不够浅让一只游进来……$B$B我受不了！求求你，你显然比我们这些乡下人见过大阵仗，$r。能不能行行好帮我除掉那些吓人的鲨鱼啊？就几条也行，啊？
text.completion: Oh, bless your heart, to do such a thing for a married woman like me. You're too kind.
text.completed: Return to Derina Rumdnul at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

english.title: A Mother's Worries
english.objectives: Kill 10 Harbor Shredfins.
english.description: My son Gimlok's the light of my life. It warms my heart to see him playin' with the other children.$B$BI can't help but worry, though. There's sharks not but a few feet away in the bay. If it's deep enough for one to swim its way here...$B$BI can't bear it! Please, you're clearly one $r that's seen tougher situations than us townsfolk. Would you get rid of those nasty sharks for me? At least a few?
english.completion: Oh, bless your heart, to do such a thing for a married woman like me. You're too kind.
english.completed: Return to Derina Rumdnul at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

text.title: 一件特别的工作
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉北卫远征军营地的部队指挥官范伦。
text.description: 你所做的十分出众，$n。部队指挥官范伦已经注意到这一点，并且要求你立刻去见他。他有一个特别任务要交给你——一件可能阻止部落入侵石爪山的任务。
text.completion: I knew that you'd be a special snowflake when I first set my eyes upon you, $n. So special, in fact, that I'd trust no one else here with what I'm about to ask of you.

english.title: A Special Kind of Job
english.objectives: Report to Force Commander Valen at Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: You've done an admirable job down here, $n. Force Commander Valen has taken notice and requested that you see him immediately. He's got a special mission lined up for you - one that'll hopefully put a cold stop on the Horde's incursion into Stonetalon.
english.completion: I knew that you'd be a special snowflake when I first set my eyes upon you, $n. So special, in fact, that I'd trust no one else here with what I'm about to ask of you.

text.title: 军备
text.objectives: 收集10个联盟武器箱。
text.description: 我得让你再去冒一次险，$n。东边是一处富矿挖掘场，最近被部落侵占了。那里堆放着我们的武器箱，散落得到处都是。部落最近刚刚接手，因此他们不大可能缴获我们所有的补给。$B$B去给我们的恐怖图腾朋友弄点武器来！
text.progress: Have you gathered the armaments of war?
text.completion: This should be enough to supply a hundred Grimtotem! Now to present the weaponry to their chieftain.
text.completed: Return to Force Commander Valen at Northwatch Expedition Base camp in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Armaments for War
english.objectives: Collect 10 Alliance Weapon Crates.
english.description: I am going to need to put you in harm's way once more, $n. To the east you will find a mineral rich excavation site that was recently overrun by the Horde. At that site are crates of our weaponry, scattered about all over the place. The Horde has only recently taken over, so it is unlikely that they've found all of our supplies.$B$BGet in there and get our Grimtotem friends some weapons!
english.progress: Have you gathered the armaments of war?
english.completion: This should be enough to supply a hundred Grimtotem! Now to present the weaponry to their chieftain.
english.completed: Return to Force Commander Valen at Northwatch Expedition Base camp in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 没完没了的部落
text.objectives: 在不毛之地杀死12名部落敌人。
text.description: 立刻夺回武器箱固然至关重要，东边不毛之地的部落也需要清除掉。要想给恐怖图腾的盟友开通补给线，就得保障通往挖掘场的道路畅行无阻。$B$B杀死你在不毛之地遭遇的任何部落，$n。为了联盟的荣耀！
text.completion: I will call for the infantry to move in and clear up whatever might be left over. If only we had ten-thousand more like you, $n!
text.completed: Return to Force Commander Valen at Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: The Unrelenting Horde
english.objectives: Slay 12 Horde enemies at the Unearthed Grounds.
english.description: While it is of utmost importance that you secure weapon crates immediately, we need the Unearthed Grounds to the east clear of Horde. If we are to open a supply line for our Grimtotem allies, we're going to need full access to the dig site.$B$BKill all Horde that you come across at the Unearthed Grounds, $n. For the glory of the Alliance!
english.completion: I will call for the infantry to move in and clear up whatever might be left over. If only we had ten-thousand more like you, $n!
english.completed: Return to Force Commander Valen at Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 最后的汇报
text.objectives: 听列兵伯纳德讲述他经历的种种磨难。
text.description: 这名士兵就快死了，我们没时间等他完全康复。他有我们急需了解的重要信息。$b$b耐心点，跟他谈谈，尽可能地了解情况。$b$b说不定我们可以就此揭开敌人的面纱……
text.completion: Well, it's not encouraging, but it's something...

english.title: Debriefing
english.objectives: Speak to Private Pollard and learn about his ordeal.
english.description: This soldier was near death, but I fear we do not have the time to await his full recovery. He has information we desperately need to know.$b$bBe patient with him, but keep him talking until we've learned all that we can.$b$bWith luck we might discover just what we're up against...
english.completion: Well, it's not encouraging, but it's something...

text.title: 送货
text.objectives: 将这一桶油送交给千针石林菲兹尔和普兹克的赛艇平台的菲兹尔·铜栓。
text.description: 行了，$n，我要你把这些石油送回到赛艇平台的菲兹尔那儿，把好消息也告诉他！
text.progress: What's this? Is that oil?!
text.completion: It is oil! You're really proving yourself to be invaluable, $n! Too bad I'm going to have to send you off now.

english.title: Deliver the Goods
english.objectives: Deliver the Barrel of Oil to Fizzle Brassbolts on Fizzle & Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Alright, $n, I need you to get this oil back to Fizzle on the Speedbarge, and let him know the good news!
english.progress: What's this? Is that oil?!
english.completion: It is oil! You're really proving yourself to be invaluable, $n! Too bad I'm going to have to send you off now.

text.title: 送货
text.objectives: 将这一桶油送交给千针石林菲兹尔和普兹克的赛艇平台的普兹克。
text.description: 行了，$n，我要你把这些石油送回到赛艇平台的普兹克那儿，把好消息也告诉他！
text.progress: Hello again, friend. Is that oil?!
text.completion: It is oil! You're the best, $n! Too bad I'm going to have to send you off now.

english.title: Deliver the Goods
english.objectives: Deliver the Barrel of Oil to Pozzik on Fizzle & Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Alright, $n, I need you to get this oil back to Pozzik on the Speedbarge, and let him know the good news!
english.progress: Hello again, friend. Is that oil?!
english.completion: It is oil! You're the best, $n! Too bad I'm going to have to send you off now.

text.title: Lo'Gosh is Ready for Battle
text.objectives: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.
text.description: Thanks to your efforts, the great wolf ancient once more walks among us.$B$B$C, I need you to return to the World Tree and let Ysera know that Lo'Gosh is ready to take the fight to the front lines.$B$BYou may also speak with her about how to go about unleashing the other ancients.$B$BLok'tar Ogar, my friend. You have been an inspiration.
text.completed: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Lo'Gosh is Ready for Battle
english.objectives: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: Thanks to your efforts, the great wolf ancient once more walks among us.$B$B$C, I need you to return to the World Tree and let Ysera know that Lo'Gosh is ready to take the fight to the front lines.$B$BYou may also speak with her about how to go about unleashing the other ancients.$B$BLok'tar Ogar, my friend. You have been an inspiration.
english.completed: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: Goldrinn's Message to Ysera
text.objectives: Speak to Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.
text.description: Goldrinn已被释放，并在我们身边游行！你所做的只是一个奇迹。$B$BWe必须通知世界之树的Ysera。卧铺正在协调我们的海加尔回收工作，她很高兴听到哥德林的传奇顽强在她身上。$B$BYou也可以和Ysera谈谈如何释放其他古人。 b，告别，$N。谢谢你你是一个灵感！
text.completed: Speak to Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Goldrinn's Message to Ysera
english.objectives: Speak to Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: Goldrinn has been unleashed, and marches by our side! What you've done is nothing short of a miracle.$B$BWe must notify Ysera, at the World Tree. The sleeper is coordinating our reclamation of Hyjal, and she'll be delighted to hear that Goldrinn's legendary tenacity is at her disposal.$B$BYou may also speak with Ysera about how to unleash the other ancients.$B$BFarewell, $n. And thank you. You're an inspiration!
english.completed: Speak to Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 最后一名博学者
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山烈焰之痕的知识古树诺尔度。
text.description: 你唤醒了古神，$n，但荒野之灵艾森娜依然沉寂。有了她的帮助，我们才能逆转攻势，消除暮光之锤所造成的伤害。$B$B也许有一个人能帮我们。最年迈的古树——诺尔度，矗立在如今是烈焰之痕的中央已数千年了。他的智慧同这座山脉一样久远。假如那株古树依然活着，也许他能唤醒艾森娜……去找到他。
text.completion: I ... have not yet ... perished.
text.completed: 去找海加尔山烈焰之痕的知识古树诺尔度。

english.title: The Last Living Lorekeeper
english.objectives: Seek out Nordu, an Ancient of Lore, at the Flamewake in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: You have awakened the ancients, $n, but the wilderness spirit Aessina remains silent. With her help, we can turn the tide of this attack and undo the damage Twilight's Hammer has done.$B$BThere may be one who can help us. The oldest of the trees, Nordu, stood in the center of what is now the Flamewake for thousands of years. His wisdom is as old as this mountain. If that old tree still lives, perhaps he can awaken Aessina... seek him out.
english.completion: I ... have not yet ... perished.
english.completed: Seek out Nordu, an Ancient of Lore, at the Flamewake in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: Hamuul's Message to Ysera
text.objectives: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.
text.description: $n, we have prepared the soil and enlisted the help of the enigmatic turtle ancient.$B$BPlease travel to Nordrassil, the World Tree, and notify Ysera that I am prepared to take the next step.$B$BIt is important the we awaken all of the ancients we can; speak to Ysera and find out where else on Mount Hyjal you are needed.
text.completed: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Hamuul's Message to Ysera
english.objectives: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: $n, we have prepared the soil and enlisted the help of the enigmatic turtle ancient.$B$BPlease travel to Nordrassil, the World Tree, and notify Ysera that I am prepared to take the next step.$B$BIt is important the we awaken all of the ancients we can; speak to Ysera and find out where else on Mount Hyjal you are needed.
english.completed: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 返回艾维娜身边
text.objectives: 回到海加尔山的艾维娜圣殿，去找艾维娜。
text.description: $n，你已经尽力了。整座洞穴都快要崩塌了！$B$B我会带领剩余的角鹰兽最后撤离，并彻底封印我身后的烈焰之门。$B$B你应该马上出发，让艾维娜知道这座罪恶的孵化场已经不复存在了！
text.completion: They stole my eggs, $c. They took them to that foul place. Corrupted them. My children stolen, tormented, killed in a vat of flame... Yes, we will make Twilight's Hammer pay. But I confess, part of me wants to fly up and simply watch this whole... world... burn.
text.completed: 去找海加尔山艾维娜圣殿的艾维娜。

english.title: Return to Aviana
english.objectives: Return to Aviana at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: $n, you've done all you can here. This whole cavern is about to collapse in on itself!$B$BI'll gather up the last of our feathered steeds and ensure that the flamegate is sealed behind me.$B$BYou should go on ahead and let Aviana know that this abominable hatchery is no more!
english.completion: They stole my eggs, $c. They took them to that foul place. Corrupted them. My children stolen, tormented, killed in a vat of flame... Yes, we will make Twilight's Hammer pay. But I confess, part of me wants to fly up and simply watch this whole... world... burn.
english.completed: Return to Aviana at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: Aviana's Message to Ysera
text.objectives: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.
text.description: For ten thousand years I drifted without form within the Emerald Dream. I awake to a nightmare.$B$B$R, seek out the dreamer - the dragon aspect you call Ysera - and let her know that I have returned and will aid the Guardians of Hyjal as they crush the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BI will fill their skies with suffering.
text.completed: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Aviana's Message to Ysera
english.objectives: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: For ten thousand years I drifted without form within the Emerald Dream. I awake to a nightmare.$B$B$R, seek out the dreamer - the dragon aspect you call Ysera - and let her know that I have returned and will aid the Guardians of Hyjal as they crush the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BI will fill their skies with suffering.
english.completed: Speak with Ysera at the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 死亡代理人
text.objectives: 跟石爪山脉北卫远征军营地的“曲奇”米维克索斯谈一谈。
text.description: 你能听见下面的战斗吗，$n？看来恐怖图腾牛头人和部落闹翻了，我不知道发生了什么事，但我们可以善加利用这个机会。$B$B我会安排同恐怖图腾大使会一次面。你要做的就是布置一场和平盛会。$B$B<部队指挥官范伦指了指曲奇。>$B$B去跟“曲奇”谈谈，$n。他已经知道我们该怎么做了。
text.completion: The name be "Cookie," lad: greatest cook 'cross Azeroth. Now the Commander's told me what we be needin' to do. To gain audience with the Grimtotem chief we're gonna have to cook up the finest of tauren cuisine. Ye get me the ingredients and I'll put together an offerin' no tauren could refuse. Not even a grim tauren or whatever them things be.

english.title: Death by Proxy
english.objectives: Speak with "Cookie" McWeaksauce at Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Can you hear them fighting down below, $n? It would appear that the Grimtotem tauren are no longer in the good graces of the Horde. I don't know what happened, but we can turn this to our advantage.$B$BI will arrange a meeting with an ambassador from the Grimtotem. What I need you to do is put together a peaceful offering.$B$B<Force Commander Valen points to Cookie.>$B$BTalk to "Cookie," $n. He's already been briefed on what we need to do.
english.completion: The name be "Cookie," lad: greatest cook 'cross Azeroth. Now the Commander's told me what we be needin' to do. To gain audience with the Grimtotem chief we're gonna have to cook up the finest of tauren cuisine. Ye get me the ingredients and I'll put together an offerin' no tauren could refuse. Not even a grim tauren or whatever them things be.

text.title: 解放乱风岗
text.objectives: 同千针石林乱风岗的库恩汀交谈。
text.description: 唉，你我终须一别。小鸟也有离巢之时啊。基本上就这意思啦。$B$B不管怎么说，你在这儿干得象模象样，我的朋友，但暗夜精灵哭着喊着要你帮他们铲除西北边乱风岗的恐怖图腾。$B$B要我说，这根本是败局已定的事情，可谁知道呢……说不定有你帮忙，他们或许能赢？
text.completion: I'm glad that Fizzle finally sent you here. We're helping the tauren to retake Freewind Post and push back the Grimtotem.

english.title: Free Freewind Post
english.objectives: Speak with Quentin at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Alas, it's time for you to leave. How quickly the chicks fall from the nest. Or, something.$B$BAnyway, you've done solid work here, my friend, but Quentin and the night elves have been crying that they urgently need your help with the Grimtotem at Freewind Post to the northwest.$B$BIf you ask me, it's a lost cause, but who knows... maybe with your help they'll actually succeed?
english.completion: I'm glad that Fizzle finally sent you here. We're helping the tauren to retake Freewind Post and push back the Grimtotem.

text.title: 解放乱风岗
text.objectives: 同千针石林乱风岗的萨利亚·琥皮交谈。
text.description: 哎，看来天下没有不散的宴席，我们也要暂时分别了。往西北方走吧，乱风岗的牛头人迫切需要你的援助，以抵御恐怖图腾氏族！$B$B你也知道，你在这里帮了大忙，我敢说你一定会是他们的救星！
text.completion: I am honored that you have come to help, $c. It was kind of Pozzik to send you.

english.title: Free Freewind Post
english.objectives: Speak with Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Well, it looks like it's time for us to part ways, at least for a while. To the northwest, the tauren of Freewind Post are in desparate need of your assistance in pushing back the Grimtotem clan!$B$BYou know, you've been such a great help around here, I bet you're going to be their $g hero : heroine; in no-time!
english.completion: I am honored that you have come to help, $c. It was kind of Pozzik to send you.

text.title: 体面的感恩祭
text.objectives: 收集6枚卡利姆多鹰蛋、8块羊腰肉和10片滚岩奶酪。
text.description: 为了组织一场完美的和平献祭，我需要以下的食材：卡利姆多鹰蛋，从卡利姆多鹰巢里获得。它们分布在森林的西边。$B$B羊腰肉！你可以在石爪山羊身上找到羊腰肉。$B$B最后一种有点难搞到，但没了它我们的馅饼就做不出来。到西南滚岩峡谷去找狗头人洞穴。杀掉狗头人，把他们的特制奶酪拿来。$B$B都带来后，我就能做出一道绝美的佳肴！
text.progress: This ramlette ain't gonna make itself!
text.completion: Stand back, $n, there's about to be a flavor explosion and I wouldn't want ya gettin' hurt.
text.completed: Return to "Cookie" McWeaksauce at Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: A Proper Peace Offerin'
english.objectives: Collect 6 Kalimdor Eagle Eggs, 8 Ram Haunches and 10 Boulderslide Cheese pieces.
english.description: To make the perfect peace offerin', I be needing the following ingredients:$B$BKalimdor eagle eggs, obtained from Kalimdor eagle nests. They be scattered about the forest to the west.$B$BRam haunches! You'll find ram haunches on Stonetalon rams.$B$BThe last ingredient be a little tougher to come by, but we be needin' it to make the ramlette. Head southwest to Boulderslide Canyon and find the kobold caves. Kill the kobolds and take their special cheese.$B$BBring it all back and I'll cook up a masterpiece!
english.progress: This ramlette ain't gonna make itself!
english.completion: Stand back, $n, there's about to be a flavor explosion and I wouldn't want ya gettin' hurt.
english.completed: Return to "Cookie" McWeaksauce at Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 来自钢架补给站的帮手
text.objectives: 跟钢架补给站的戴博·曲针谈一谈。
text.description: 在你的帮助下，我们才能推进到霜鬃营地。我们的部队将立刻就位，消灭霜鬃巨魔的残部，让他们的村子门户洞开。$B$B这时候就得用到诺莫瑞根秘密部队了。他们的技师有办法在敌后展开行动，而不被霜鬃发现。到镇子东北方的钢架补给站去，跟戴博·曲针谈一谈。他会告诉你更多。
text.completion: Ah, you must be the $r that Captain Tharran said he'd be sending. I've already used the deploy-a-tron to get most of the covert ops team into position at Frostmane Retreat. They're just waiting on your arrival.
text.completed: 跟钢架补给站的戴博·曲针谈一谈。

english.title: Help from Steelgrill's Depot
english.objectives: Speak to Delber Cranktoggle at Steelgrill's Depot.
english.description: With your help, we've managed to push toward Frostmane Retreat. Our forces will soon be in position to dwindle down the Frostmane trolls' reserves, leaving their village open to attack.$B$BThat's where the Gnomeregan covert ops team comes in. Their technicians have figured out a way to deploy operatives behind enemy lines without alerting the Frostmanes to our presence. Head to Steelgrill's Depot, just northeast of town, and speak with Delber Cranktoggle. He'll tell you more about it.
english.completion: Ah, you must be the $r that Captain Tharran said he'd be sending. I've already used the deploy-a-tron to get most of the covert ops team into position at Frostmane Retreat. They're just waiting on your arrival.
english.completed: Speak to Delber Cranktoggle at Steelgrill's Depot.

text.title: 超安全单兵发射器
text.objectives: 使用超安全单兵发射器前往霜鬃营地。
text.description: 大灾变把敌人带到了我们的家门口，因此诺莫瑞根秘密部队的头要我制造一种装置，以便能把人员安静迅速地转移到丹莫罗的任意一个角落。$B$B看吧，这就是超安全单兵发射器！$B$B只要一股电流和一套VLD降落伞系统，呃，那是专门为你们这些门外汉准备的“最新改良”，这个宝贝儿就能瞬间把你送往前线。跳进来准备起飞吧！斯拉姆·摇轮会在降落点等你。
text.completion: Don't worry, the feeling of being zapped won't stay with you for more than a few minutes. All in all, it's not a bad way to get where you're going. That parachute system needs some work, though. Very late deployment, indeed. Sometimes, too late. Anyway, we have a mission to carry out.
text.end: 使用超安全单兵发射器前往霜鬃营地。
text.completed: 跟霜鬃营地的斯拉姆·摇轮谈一谈。

english.title: The Ultrasafe Personnel Launcher
english.objectives: Use the Ultrasafe Personnel Launcher to deploy to Frostmane Retreat.
english.description: The cataclysm has brought our enemies closer to home, so the chief of Gnomeregan covert operations asked me to build a device to dispatch personnel quickly and quietly to any corner of Dun Morogh.$B$BBehold, the ultrasafe personnel launcher!$B$BWith a jolt of electricity and the benefit of a VLD parachute system, uh, that's 'very late deployment' for you laymen, this baby'll get you to the front in no time. Just hop aboard and prepare for flight! Slamp Wobblecog will be waiting for you in the drop zone.
english.completion: Don't worry, the feeling of being zapped won't stay with you for more than a few minutes. All in all, it's not a bad way to get where you're going. That parachute system needs some work, though. Very late deployment, indeed. Sometimes, too late. Anyway, we have a mission to carry out.
english.end: Use Ultrasafe Personnel Launcher to deploy to Frostmane Retreat
english.completed: Speak with Slamp Wobblecog at Frostmane Retreat.

text.title: 消灭抵抗
text.objectives: 在霜鬃营地消灭狂战士巴托克和5名霜鬃战士。
text.description: 霜鬃酋长在最初的穴居人进攻中身亡了，不过他们一直由一名备受尊敬的战士所领导。狂战士巴托克把霜鬃营地组织了起来，建立了新的村庄，攻打卡拉诺斯和巡山人。$B$B如果我们除掉巴托克，霜鬃巨魔就会变成无头苍蝇，成为等待巡山人宰杀的羔羊。巴托克就在东边的村子里。
text.completion: Excellent job, $n. With Battok dead, I'll send the signal to Captain Tharran. This should be the end of the Frostmane threat.
text.completed: Return to Slamp Wobblecog at Frostmane Retreat.

english.title: Eliminate the Resistance
english.objectives: Slay Battok the Berserker and 5 Frostmane Warriors in Frostmane Retreat.
english.description: The Frostmane chieftain died in the initial trogg onslaught, but they've been led by a well-respected warrior ever since. Battok the Berserker was the one who organized the Frostmane retreat, the construction of the new village, and the strikes against Kharanos and the mountaineers.$B$BIf we remove Battok, the Frostmanes' organization should crumble, leaving the mountaineers free to pick off the survivors. Battok will be in the village, just east of here.
english.completion: Excellent job, $n. With Battok dead, I'll send the signal to Captain Tharran. This should be the end of the Frostmane threat.
english.completed: Return to Slamp Wobblecog at Frostmane Retreat.

text.title: 从天而降
text.objectives: 在霜鬃营地北端和南端用信号枪呼叫空中打击。
text.description: 戴博的技师们没日没夜地帮我们准备这次进攻。除了建造和调试单兵发射器以外，他的人还准备了秘密部队空军来打击霜鬃营地。他们一等信号就会起飞。$B$B拿上这把信号枪，在村子北部和南端的建筑群打出信号。飞行器会对两侧进行一次迅速的打击。
text.completion: Both you and the air wing performed admirably. There's no way that the Frostmanes will remain here now. All that remains is to begin mopping up the survivors.
text.completed: Return to Slamp Wobblecog at Frostmane Retreat.

english.title: Strike From Above
english.objectives: Use the Signal Flare to call in airstrikes at the northern and southern ends of Frostmane Retreat.
english.description: Delber's technicians have been up day and night helping us prepare for this strike. Aside from building and tuning the personnel launcher, his men have prepared the covert operations air wing for a strike on Frostmane Retreat. They'll be waiting for a signal to begin their strikes.$B$BTake this flare with you, and set it off near the cluster of buildings at the northern end of the village, and the buildings at the southern end of the village. The flying machines will make a quick strike at each site.
english.completion: Both you and the air wing performed admirably. There's no way that the Frostmanes will remain here now. All that remains is to begin mopping up the survivors.
english.completed: Return to Slamp Wobblecog at Frostmane Retreat.

text.title: 涅槃之火
text.objectives: 消灭5名火焰折磨者，让他们远离诺尔度。
text.description: 已经……太迟了。除了核心，一切都烧光了。我活了数万年……但是我命运的终点来得还是太突然。$B$B我的离去也会焕发出更多的新生。我还有智慧需要传承。请……在我完成最后的仪式之前，不要让它们伤害我。$B$B把那些折磨者挡在外面……只要坚持上一会儿就行了，$c。$B$B给我几分钟的时间，我会给你我毕生的智慧。
text.completion: Thank you, $r. I am ready now. All that I am, and all that this forest once was... it is now yours.
text.completed: Return to Nordu at the Flamewake in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Firefight
english.objectives: Kill 5 Fiery Tormentors to keep them from Nordu.
english.description: It is... too late for me. Burned to all but the core. I have lived eons ... yet still my end seems sudden.$B$BNew life can spring from old. I still have wisdom to pass on. Please... do not let them take me before my work is done.$B$BKeep the tormentors at bay... just a little longer, $c.$B$BGive me minutes, and I will give you a thousand lifetimes.
english.completion: Thank you, $r. I am ready now. All that I am, and all that this forest once was... it is now yours.
english.completed: Return to Nordu at the Flamewake in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 托尔托拉的复仇
text.objectives: 跟海加尔山焦痕平原的托尔托拉谈一谈。
text.description: 群山再次焕发了生机！如果行动迅速，我们就能占据上风。$B$B我们的老朋友，上古龟神托尔托拉已经开始行动了。当然，是在以他自己的速度……$B$B到东边找到托尔托拉，就在通往焦痕平原的路前面。我们在那里的要塞于战役初期就沦陷了，不过现在我们或许能把它夺回来。
text.completion: $r. I remember you. Savior of my children. The time has come. For vengeance.
text.completed: 跟海加尔山焦痕平原的托尔托拉谈一谈。

english.title: Tortolla's Revenge
english.objectives: Speak to Tortolla at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: The mountain blooms again! If we act quickly, we can press our advantage.$B$BOur old friend Tortolla, the Turtle Ancient, is already on the move. At his own pace, of course...$B$BFind Tortolla east of here, at the head of the path leading down into the scorched plains. Our strongholds there fell early in the campaign, but perhaps now we can reclaim them.
english.completion: $r. I remember you. Savior of my children. The time has come. For vengeance.
english.completed: Speak to Tortolla at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.

starters.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾
大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾
大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 让野兽满意
text.objectives: 将丰盛的贡品献给石爪山脉恐怖图腾岗哨的图恩·风弓。
text.description: 你听到指挥官说什么了，$n。把完美的贡品献给恐怖图腾大使！他和他的人就在东南小径的尽头等你。$B$B这肯定能让他们的酋长对我们青睐有加。
text.progress: You have brought something for us?
text.completion: This... this is the greatest thing I have ever tasted. You may prove to be a valuable ally, but before the Grimtotem agree to work with the Alliance, you must agree to our terms. I will now give to you those terms as told to me by my leader. Take them back to your commander and see if he accepts.

english.title: Sating the Savage Beast
english.objectives: Deliver the Meaty Offering to Ton Windbow at Grimtotem Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: You heard the commander, $n. Deliver me perfect offerin' to the Grimtotem ambassador! Him and his crew be waitin' for you at the bottom of the southeastern path.$B$BThis is sure to put us in the good graces of their chieftain!
english.progress: You have brought something for us?
english.completion: This... this is the greatest thing I have ever tasted. You may prove to be a valuable ally, but before the Grimtotem agree to work with the Alliance, you must agree to our terms. I will now give to you those terms as told to me by my leader. Take them back to your commander and see if he accepts.

text.title: 服务条款
text.objectives: 将恐怖图腾工作条款转达给石爪山脉北卫远征军营地的部队指挥官范伦。
text.description: 恐怖图腾需要武器！部落在酋长的授权下，在新盟友地精的帮助下，攒集了强力的武器。我们的装备根本无法与之抗衡。用强悍的武器把恐怖图腾武装起来，我们就可以一起消灭部落！$B$B这些是我们的要求！补给恐怖图腾，我们就为联盟作战！
text.progress: Well???
text.completion: Weapons, eh? I'm about to make an executive decision here, $n. Let's hope this pays off, else King Wrynn will have my head!

english.title: Terms of Service
english.objectives: Deliver the Grimtotem Terms of Service to Force Commander Valen at Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Grimtotem need weapons! The Horde, empowered by their Warchief and with the help of their new goblin allies, have amassed powerful weaponry. Our armaments are simply no match for their firepower. Supply the Grimtotem with strong weapons and we will work together to destroy the Horde!$B$BThese are our demands! Supply the Grimtotem and we will fight for the Alliance!
english.progress: Well???
english.completion: Weapons, eh? I'm about to make an executive decision here, $n. Let's hope this pays off, else King Wrynn will have my head!

text.title: 恐怖图腾酋长，格鲁迪格·黑云
text.objectives: 将联盟武器箱交给石爪山脉恐怖图腾岗哨的格鲁迪格·黑云。
text.description: 恐怖图腾酋长等着你的到来，$n。将武器箱带上，到南边的恐怖图腾岗哨去。$B$B祝你好运，$n。不管你发生了什么事，我都会亲自通知你最亲的家人，并让乌瑞恩国王知道你为联盟所做的一切。
text.progress: Do you have the weapons?
text.completion: These are fine weapons! Powerful steel! My warriors will be unstoppable armed with such weaponry. Magatha smiles down upon you, $n. There is but one thing I ask of you, perhaps two.

english.title: Grundig Darkcloud, Chieftain of the Grimtotem
english.objectives: Deliver the Alliance Weapon Crates to Grundig Darkcloud at Grimtotem Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: The Grimtotem chieftain awaits your arrival, $n. Take the weapon crates with you and head to Grimtotem Post, south of here.$B$BGood luck, $n. Should anything happen to you I will personally notify your next of kin and let King Wrynn know what you have done for the Alliance.
english.progress: Do you have the weapons?
english.completion: These are fine weapons! Powerful steel! My warriors will be unstoppable armed with such weaponry. Magatha smiles down upon you, $n. There is but one thing I ask of you, perhaps two.

text.title: 恐怖图腾霸权
text.objectives: 使用联盟武器箱武装12名恐怖图腾。
text.description: 在巨木谷，你将发现恐怖图腾到处都在遭受着部落的攻击。地狱咆哮的军队残忍无情，赶尽杀绝。$B$B但不再会继续这样了！把你给我们带来的军备送到战场去，给那些与部落交战的恐怖图腾成员装备上。把联盟的武器交给他们，看它们是如何摧毁部落侵略者的！去吧，盟友，要做的事情还有很多。
text.progress: Have you armed the Grimtotem?
text.completion: The fight is far from over, $n. The Horde generals still live...
text.completed: Return to Grundig Darkcloud at Grimtotem Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Grimtotem Supremacy
english.objectives: Use the Alliance Weapon Crate to arm 12 Grimtotem.
english.description: Throughout all of Greatwood Vale you will find Grimtotem under attack by the Horde. Hellscream's armies show no mercy and no compassion, killing anything that stands in their way.$B$BBut no more! Take the armaments you brought for us and find Grimtotem in battle with the Horde. Give them the weapons of the Alliance and watch as they destroy their Horde assailants! Go, there is much work to do, ally.
english.progress: Have you armed the Grimtotem?
english.completion: The fight is far from over, $n. The Horde generals still live...
english.completed: Return to Grundig Darkcloud at Grimtotem Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 垮台
text.objectives: 杀死阿帕拉耶营地的部落将军，获得部落将军的徽记。
text.description: 等我们收到消息说，地狱咆哮已经派另一个玛格汉兽人来南石爪山指挥部落军队时，已经太迟了。阿帕拉耶营地已经被烧为灰烬，那一地区所有的恐怖图腾都化为了焦炭。$B$B现在部落指挥巨木谷战斗的是他们四个最为可怕的将军，包括那个玛格汉部族的格布葛克将军在内。$B$B你必须前往南面阿帕拉耶营地废墟，杀掉那些将军们。我们现在就要阻止部落！把他们的徽记给我带来！
text.progress: Are the generals dead?
text.completion: Yes, ally, you have done it! It will take Hellscream weeks to recover from this blow. Southern Stonetalon belongs to the Grimtotem... and the Alliance, of course.
text.completed: Return to Grundig Darkcloud at Grimtotem Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Downfall
english.objectives: Kill the Horde generals at Camp Aparaje and recover the Insignia of the Horde General.
english.description: By the time that we received word that Hellscream had sent another mag'har orc to oversee the Horde troops in southern Stonetalon, it was too late. Camp Aparaje was burned to the ground and all Grimtotem in the area incinerated.$B$BNow the Horde have four of their most fearsome generals commanding the battle for Greatwood Vale, including the mag'har, General Glubgok.$B$BYou must travel to the ruins of Camp Aparaje, south of here, and kill the generals. We stop the Horde NOW! Return to me with their mark!
english.progress: Are the generals dead?
english.completion: Yes, ally, you have done it! It will take Hellscream weeks to recover from this blow. Southern Stonetalon belongs to the Grimtotem... and the Alliance, of course.
english.completed: Return to Grundig Darkcloud at Grimtotem Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 考古也疯狂
text.objectives: 从活生生的化石处收集10份石化骨骼。
text.description: 听着，$g小子:姑娘;，任何一个称职的考古学家都明白干这一行的风险。要是你没能出土一件上古邪物，或是遭恶灵诅咒，那你就压根没挖出什么值钱玩意儿！$B$B不，真正的考古学家知道，像骨骼化石死而复生这种小事可不是放下手头工作的理由。$B$B我还是需要那些化石。给我从到处游荡的石化怪物身上收集一些来，我会给你报酬的。
text.progress: Don't be coy about it, now! Bring back a good armful of 'em!
text.completion: See? Not bad, eh? Why, I almost wish all my finds decided to dig themselves up for me. It'd make my job a lot easier! Of course, you made it easier too, $n. Much obliged.
text.completed: Return to Prospector Whelgar at Whelgar's Retreat in the Wetlands.

english.title: When Archaeology Attacks
english.objectives: Collect 20 Fossilized Bones from Living Fossils.
english.description: Listen, $glad:lass;, any good archaeologists know the risks that come with the job. If you don't unearth an ancient evil or get cursed by wicked spirits at least once in your career, you're not digging up anything worthwhile!$B$BNo, the real archaeologists know that a little thing like fossilized bones reanimating into skeletal creatures is no reason to stop working.$B$BI still need those fossil bones. Collect 'em from the fossil monsters roaming around and bring them back to me, and I'll reward you.
english.progress: Don't be coy about it, now! Bring back a good armful of 'em!
english.completion: See? Not bad, eh? Why, I almost wish all my finds decided to dig themselves up for me. It'd make my job a lot easier! Of course, you made it easier too, $n. Much obliged.
english.completed: Return to Prospector Whelgar at Whelgar's Retreat in the Wetlands.

text.title: 攻击大地！
text.objectives: 杀死7只古老的石元素。
text.description: 你可能没注意到，湿地现在已经乱透了。洪水、地震……雪上加霜的，大地也来凑热闹。$B$B我从没料到我们的挖掘现场也会攻击我们，但显然，这些大土块横行霸道，一心想把它们瞧见的矮人拍扁。$B$B你看上去是个结实魁梧、身强力壮的$r……介不介意去把那些泥巴蛋子抽醒？
text.completion: That's showin' em what for! Good on you.
text.completed: Return to Ormer Ironbraid at Whelgar's Retreat in the Wetlands.

english.title: Strike the Earth!
english.objectives: Kill 7 Paleolithic Elementals.
english.description: In case you didn't notice, the land here in the Wetlands is pretty messed up. Floods, earthquakes... and on top of it all, even the ground's got a wild hair now.$B$BI never thought we'd be attacked by our own dig site, but sure enough, big chunks of it are now rampaging around trying to flatten any dwarf they see.$B$BYou look like a strong, strapping young $r... mind going down there and slapping some sense into the clods?
english.completion: That's showin' em what for! Good on you.
english.completed: Return to Ormer Ironbraid at Whelgar's Retreat in the Wetlands.

text.title: 与恐怖图腾共舞
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉北卫远征军营地的部队指挥官范伦。
text.description: 现在，回到你的领袖那里去，把你为恐怖图腾所做出的一切贡献告诉他，同时跟他说联盟可以自由出入我们的边境。
text.completion: Outstanding work, $n! Now our forces only need to worry about the Horde as they enter Stonetalon.

english.title: Dances with Grimtotem
english.objectives: Report to Force Commander Valen at Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Return now to your leader and tell him all that you have done for the Grimtotem. Tell him that the Alliance may pass freely across our borders.
english.completion: Outstanding work, $n! Now our forces only need to worry about the Horde as they enter Stonetalon.

text.title: 都清楚了
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉石爪小径的部队指挥官托马斯·瓦波尔。
text.description: 收拾装备，$n，该加入南贫瘠之地北卫军的余部了。你在南贫瘠之地的第一个任务应该很简单。$B$B两天前我们收到指挥官瓦波尔的求救信号。他和他的战斗营在石爪小径陷入了苦战，就在荣耀岗哨外面。那里到处都是部落！过去帮帮他们。我会把咱们同恐怖图腾结盟的消息送到北卫军指挥部去。
text.completion: You say the Grimtotem are no longer a threat? That's great, but we've got Horde all up our keesters!

english.title: All's Clear
english.objectives: Report to Commander Thomas Walpole at Stonetalon Pass in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Pack up your gear, $n, it's time to join up with the rest of the Northwatch forces in Southern Barrens. Your first mission in Southern Barrens should be fairly straightforward.$B$BTwo days ago we received a distress signal from Commander Walpole. He and his battalion are pinned down in Stonetalon Pass, just outside of Honor's Stand. They've got Horde all over the place! Get there and help him out. I'll forward news of our alliance with the Grimtotem to Northwatch command.
english.completion: You say the Grimtotem are no longer a threat? That's great, but we've got Horde all up our keesters!

text.title: 一地工具
text.objectives: 收集6个考古学家的工具箱。
text.description: 我负责为挖掘工作保障后勤。倒也不是抱怨，不过那么快就要打包出发实在是太仓促！$B$B考古学家离不开工具，你知道。你不可能空手就把无价的古董挖出来。要是你回挖掘场的话，能不能把我们落下的工具带回来？
text.progress: Are they all here? We left a lot back there.
text.completion: That's a relief! Maybe we can dig our way out of the hole we're still in, eh? No, nevermind, just a bad joke.
text.completed: Return to Merrin Rockweaver at Whelgar's Retreat in the Wetlands.

english.title: Tooling Around
english.objectives: Collect 6 Archaeologist's Tools.
english.description: I'm in charge of supplying this dig. It's not that bad, but having to pick up and move out so fast wasn't exactly ideal!$B$BArchaeologists need tools, you know. You can't run around pulling up priceless antiquities with your bare hands. If you're going back to the dig site, can you bring back the tools that got left behind?
english.progress: Are they all here? We left a lot back there.
english.completion: That's a relief! Maybe we can dig our way out of the hole we're still in, eh? No, nevermind, just a bad joke.
english.completed: Return to Merrin Rockweaver at Whelgar's Retreat in the Wetlands.

text.title: 我要叫它咬咬
text.objectives: 收集6枚晃动的迅猛龙蛋。
text.description: 你听说了吗，有些迅猛龙的智商高得足以驯养？是真的！我就见过猎人把它们当宠物。$B$B就算有温纳在身边，这儿也太冷清了……有只宠物来调剂生活再好不过。小迅猛龙就很好！$B$B你去杀死那些成年龙的时候，能不能给我带些成熟的蛋回来？你看那些晃动着的就是快要孵出来的。
text.progress: Do you have enough eggs? I can't take my chances with only one. Statistics, you know.
text.completion: Wonderful! These should be ready to hatch within the day... Now I just need to cobble up a raptor pen before they all hatch nigh-simultaneously. What could go wrong?
text.completed: Return to Fradd Swiftgear at Swiftgear Station.

english.title: I'll Call Him Bitey
english.objectives: Collect 6 Wobbling Raptor Eggs.
english.description: Have you heard some raptors are intelligent enough to be domesticated? It's true! I've seen hunters tame them.$B$BIt gets quite lonely out here, you know, even with Wenna to keep me company... a pet's just what I need to brighten my spirits. A little baby raptor would be the best!$B$BIf you're out there slaughtering the adults, would you mind bringing me back some mature eggs? You can tell if they're ready to hatch by the wobbling.
english.progress: Do you have enough eggs? I can't take my chances with only one. Statistics, you know.
english.completion: Wonderful! These should be ready to hatch within the day... Now I just need to cobble up a raptor pen before they all hatch nigh-simultaneously. What could go wrong?
english.completed: Return to Fradd Swiftgear at Swiftgear Station.

text.title: 小零小件儿
text.objectives: 找到7件飞轮装置。
text.description: 最近我的工程计划零件短缺，有一天我终于知道为什么了：它们叫藓皮豺狼人给拿走了！$B$B我不知道他们拿这些有什么用，不过我需要我的零件。它们多半已经散落在沼泽地里了，但要是你看见，能不能帮我收好带回来啊？
text.progress: Did you find them?
text.completion: Oh, wonderful! I'll be able to start reassembling these right away. Thank you so much!
text.completed: Return to Fradd Swiftgear at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

english.title: Gizmos and Gadgets
english.objectives: Find 7 Swiftgear Gizmos.
english.description: I've been coming up short on parts recently for my engineering projects, and the other day I finally saw why: the Mosshide gnolls have been making off with them!$B$BI don't have any idea what they could possibly want them for, but I need those gizmos back. They're probably strewn all over the marsh by now, but if you see any, could you gather them and bring them back?
english.progress: Did you find them?
english.completion: Oh, wonderful! I'll be able to start reassembling these right away. Thank you so much!
english.completed: Return to Fradd Swiftgear at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

text.title: 鳄鱼皮
text.objectives: 从湿地鳄鱼身上割下10张沼泽鳄鱼皮。
text.description: 我在湿地扒鳄鱼皮已经多年了，$c。不过今非昔比。$B$B你瞧，不是想跟你吐苦水，可自从大灾变袭击米奈希尔港，我们的房子也遭了殃。老婆孩子没地方去，我得拼命挣钱才能让咱们重新有地方可以住。$B$B我已经竭尽全力地扒鳄鱼皮，可还是不够卖的。要是你能给我弄些来，我可以付你点钱。
text.progress: Got any croc hides for me?
text.completion: I'm much obliged, $c. This'll go a ways towards getting my family back on their feet.
text.completed: Return to James Halloran at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

english.title: Crocolisk Hides
english.objectives: Collect 10 Marshy Crocolisk Hides from Wetlands Crocolisks.
english.description: I've skinned crocs in the wetlands for years, $c. Things have changed though.$B$BYou see, not to bore you with a sob story, but when the cataclysm flooded Menethil Harbor, our house went with it. My wife and kids don't have a place to stay, and I need to make as much money as I can to get us under a roof again.$B$BI've been skinning crocs 'til I was too tired to move, but I still need more skins to sell. If you bring me some croc hides, I'll pay you a bit for them.
english.progress: Got any croc hides for me?
english.completion: I'm much obliged, $c. This'll go a ways towards getting my family back on their feet.
english.completed: Return to James Halloran at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

text.title: 狩猎恐钳
text.objectives: 杀死恐钳，扒下恐钳的皮。
text.description: 我打算打个大家伙，这儿最大的鳄鱼，恐钳。它的皮足够让我的家人有地方可住。$B$B但我不是傻瓜。一不留神我就可能少条腿，或者是没了命，那我老婆孩子该怎么办？还是无家可归，家里也没了主心骨。$B$B说来惭愧，但我家人的安全胜过一切。求求你，$c……帮我去打恐钳。它就潜伏在北边一个阴凉的池塘里。
text.progress: Did you get it? Do you have Horrorjaw's hide?
text.completion: Amazing! You're a true hero, $n. I'll never forget what you've done for me and my family. I know it's not much, but please, take this with my blessing.
text.completed: Return to James Halloran at Swiftgear Station.

english.title: Hunting Horrorjaw
english.objectives: Slay Horrorjaw and collect Horrorjaw's Hide.
english.description: I've been tempted to go after the big kill... the largest crocolisk out there, Horrorjaw. His hide alone would be enough to get my family out of this hole.$B$BBut I'm no fool. One mistake and I could lose a leg, or my life, and then where would my wife and kids be? Still homeless and without a father to care for them.$B$BIt's not my proudest moment, but I'll pick my family's safety over pride any day. Please, $c... hunt Horrorjaw for me. You'll find him in his shady pool to the north, lurking.
english.progress: Did you get it? Do you have Horrorjaw's hide?
english.completion: Amazing! You're a true hero, $n. I'll never forget what you've done for me and my family. I know it's not much, but please, take this with my blessing.
english.completed: Return to James Halloran at Swiftgear Station.

text.title: 秉承女士的命令
text.objectives: 跟深水领主金加塔尔、希拉柯丝女士和监督者埃卓凯丝谈一谈。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士影像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回影像。
text.description: 希拉柯丝女士已经开始准备召唤仪式了，但纳萨林坩埚被人偷走了。显然是克瓦迪尔在撤回浅水的时候把它拿走的。$B$B与各个阶层的首领们交谈，促成主战派，带他们从西边的贝耶拉兰山夺回神器。$B$B我信任你，女武士，因为你从未辜负我交予你的任务。你受尊于我，正如我受尊于女王。随着我的祝福去吧。
text.completion: Reinforcements have begun to circle the waters around the ledge, preparing for the attack. They await only your lead.
text.completed: Find Fathom-Stalker Azjentus on Biel'aran Ridge, east of the Ruins of Vashj'ir, on the other side of the Severed Span.

english.title: By Her Lady's Word
english.objectives: Speak to Fathom-Lord Zin'jatar, Lady Sira'kess, and Overseer Idra'kess.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: Lady Sira'kess has begun preparations for the ritual of summoning, but the Crucible of Nazsharin has been stolen from us. The Kvaldir have surely taken it with them as they retreated to shallower waters.$B$BSpeak to the caste leaders to secure a war party, and then lead them in retrieving the artifact from Biel'aran Ridge to the east.$B$BI trust you my Battlemaiden, for you have never failed in any task that I have given you. As I am revered to the Queen, so are you revered to me. Go with my blessings.
english.completion: Reinforcements have begun to circle the waters around the ledge, preparing for the attack. They await only your lead.
english.completed: Find Fathom-Stalker Azjentus on Biel'aran Ridge, east of the Ruins of Vashj'ir, on the other side of the Severed Span.

objectiveDetails.description: 与深水领主金加塔尔交谈
与监督者埃卓凯丝交谈

text.title: 此路不通
text.objectives: 杀死20名维库崖上的克瓦迪尔人。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士影像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回影像。
text.description: 我知道您，正如我们可敬的女士一般，不幸地也有动恻隐之心之时。但今时今日，我却要谏言不可慈悲。克瓦迪尔人心高气傲，若不斩草除根，定会反扑而来。一定要斩尽杀绝。$B$B不幸的是，我摊到了这份苦差，不能放一个人回到城里，所以只有你能尽情享受了。当然，我会为你摇旗呐喊的。
text.completion: Not one slipped through to the bridge. Not one.$B$BIt was very boring. I'd appreciate it if you shared a little next time.
text.completed: Return to Fathom-Stalker Azjentus on Biel'aran Ridge.

english.title: No Trespass Forgiven
english.objectives: Kill 20 Kvaldir on the Vrykul Ledge.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: I know that you, like our revered lady, have unfortunate streaks of mercy that you succumb to at times. I would advise against such kindnesses this day. The Kvaldir are proud, and they will strike back if we do not cripple them completely. Kill all that you find.$B$BSadly, I have the inglorious task of making sure none return to the city, so you can go have all of the fun. I will cheer you on though, of course.
english.completion: Not one slipped through to the bridge. Not one.$B$BIt was very boring. I'd appreciate it if you shared a little next time.
english.completed: Return to Fathom-Stalker Azjentus on Biel'aran Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死维库崖上的克瓦迪尔人

text.title: 不惜代价
text.objectives: 杀死20名进犯奎尔多米尔神殿的克瓦迪尔人。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士影像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回影像。
text.description: 我们马上就开始仪式，你则要确保我们不被打扰。$B$B克瓦迪尔人若是进入神殿格杀勿论。不惜代价，也要保障我的祭司活着完成她们的任务。
text.completion: Azjentus is to be taken at his word. Lady Naz'jar's Honor Guard should be sufficient to see the rest of the ritual through.
text.completed: Return to Lady Sira'kess on the upper level of Quel'Dormir Temple.

english.title: At All Costs
english.objectives: Kill 20 Kvaldir attackers within Quel'Dormir Temple.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: We are to begin the ritual immediately, and you are to see to it that we are not interrupted.$B$BSlaughter any Kvaldir that enter the temple. See to it that my priestesses live to see their task complete, no matter the cost.
english.completion: Azjentus is to be taken at his word. Lady Naz'jar's Honor Guard should be sufficient to see the rest of the ritual through.
english.completed: Return to Lady Sira'kess on the upper level of Quel'Dormir Temple.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死来犯的克瓦迪尔人

text.title: 杀鸡儆猴
text.objectives: 将一名克瓦迪尔高阶萨满祭司押送给行刑者瓦拉萨雷斯。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士影像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回影像。
text.description: 高阶萨满祭司就在附近的建筑里，又吟又唱，就是不敢当面同我交手。这些克瓦迪尔只有缩着才有胆量。他们不过是波涛下的一帮可怜虫。$B$B我有个口信要送，若不劳烦您，帮我押一个高阶萨满祭司来，我好把信息传达给他的人。
text.completion: My scythe is sated. Thank you, my lady.
text.completed: Speak to Executioner Varathress on Biel'aran Ridge.

english.title: Setting An Example
english.objectives: Bring a Kvaldir High-Shaman to the feet of Executioner Varathress.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: The High-Shaman are in the buildings nearby, chanting and taunting, but not daring to approach me. These Kvaldir find their courage and strength only in the mist. They are a pitiful nuisance beneath the waves.$B$BI came bearing a message. If your ladyship has the time, bring a high-shaman to my feet that I might deliver this message to him and his people.
english.completion: My scythe is sated. Thank you, my lady.
english.completed: Speak to Executioner Varathress on Biel'aran Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 处决克瓦迪尔高阶萨满祭司

text.title: 失窃物品
text.objectives: 夺回纳萨林坩埚。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士影像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回影像。
text.description: 我们可敬的女士派我助你一臂之力。她要你夺回被窃的纳萨林坩埚，将其尽快带回来。$B$B她急切地想要开始召唤仪式，我们才好展开全面备战。
text.completion: The crucible looks far too heavy to carry on your own, but more than enough naga forces remain to prepare it for transport.
text.completed: 夺回纳萨林坩埚。

english.title: Stolen Property
english.objectives: Retrieve the Crucible of Nazsharin.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: Our revered lady has sent me to aid you in your task. She wants you to retrieve the stolen Crucible of Nazsharin and bring it back here as soon as you can.$B$BShe grows impatient to start the ritual of summoning so that we might fully begin our preparations for war.
english.completion: The crucible looks far too heavy to carry on your own, but more than enough naga forces remain to prepare it for transport.
english.completed: Retrieve the Crucible of Nazsharin.

text.title: 天降之任
text.objectives: 将夺回纳萨林坩埚的消息带回贝耶拉兰山西侧。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士幻像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回幻像。
text.description: 有了纳萨林坩埚，剩下的就是向纳兹夏尔女士报捷了。
text.completion: Well done, my Battlemaiden.$B$BThis crucible will serve as a font of power for our summoning ritual. With it, Sira'kess will beckon our allies from the depths to bolster our already swelling forces.
text.completed: 将纳萨林坩埚的消息带回贝耶拉兰山西侧。

english.title: Chosen Burden
english.objectives: Return to the western edge of the Biel'aran Ridge with news of the Crucible of Nazsharin.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: With the Crucible of Nazsharin, all that remains is to inform Lady Naz'jar of your success.
english.completion: Well done, my Battlemaiden.$B$BThis crucible will serve as a font of power for our summoning ritual. With it, Sira'kess will beckon our allies from the depths to bolster our already swelling forces.
english.completed: Return to the western edge of the Biel'aran Ridge with news of the Crucible of Nazsharin.

text.title: 恐龙危机
text.objectives: 杀死8头任意种类的高地迅猛龙。
text.description: 我们接到越来越多的报告，迅猛龙正在滋扰附近的地区。我立志要将这里变成安居乐业之所，因此我给那些畜牲挂了悬赏。$B$B大部分的已经被处理掉了，但北边的高地迅猛龙数量猛增。不过不会太久了，是吧？$B$B多干掉一些高地迅猛龙，我保证报酬丰厚。
text.completion: A job well done. Consider this reward not from me, but from Ironforge; the preservation of Khaz Modan is a matter that concerns every dwarf.
text.completed: Return to Shilah Slabchisel at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

english.title: Dinosaur Crisis
english.objectives: Kill 8 Highland Raptors of any kind.
english.description: We've been getting more and more reports of raptor attacks in the area. I'm seeing to it that this place is safe enough for more settlement to start occuring, so I've put a bounty on the buggers.$B$BA lot have been cleared out already, but the Highland raptors to the north have been growing in number. That won't be true for long, now will it?$B$BClear out a good deal of Highland raptors, and I'll have a nice reward for you.
english.completion: A job well done. Consider this reward not from me, but from Ironforge; the preservation of Khaz Modan is a matter that concerns every dwarf.
english.completed: Return to Shilah Slabchisel at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

text.title: 藓皮偷金
text.objectives: 从藓皮豺狼人身上获得8块铁炉堡金锭。
text.description: 你看起来是个靠得住的，能帮我解决麻烦的人，$n。我是被铁炉堡派来接收一船金锭的。$B$B它们是铁炉堡王室财产的一部分，上面有皇家钢印……只有白痴才会把这种容易追查的东西偷去卖钱。凑巧的是，这地方全是白痴：藓皮豺狼人。$B$B我不知道你以前对付过多少豺狼人，但他们是肮脏野蛮的畜牲，并且很危险。我要你去把他们杀掉，把失窃的金锭抢回来。
text.progress: There should be about eight ingots stolen.
text.completion: Well done! The Ironforge Guard appreciates this, $n. You've done our city a fine favor. But something new has come up...
text.completed: Return to Shilah Slabchisel at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

english.title: The Mosshide Job
english.objectives: Recover 8 Ironforge Ingots from Mosshide Gnolls.
english.description: You seem trustworthy enough to help me out with my real problem, $n. I was sent here by Ironforge to recover a shipment of gold ingots.$B$BThe ingots are part of the Ironforge Royal Treasury, stamped with the royal seal... only an idiot would steal them for profit, far too easy to trace. Oddly enough, this area is full of idiots: Mosshide Gnolls.$B$BI don't know how many gnolls you've fought before, but they're foul and brutal beasts, and dangerous. I need you to slay them and recover the missing ingots.
english.progress: There should be about eight ingots stolen.
english.completion: Well done! The Ironforge Guard appreciates this, $n. You've done our city a fine favor. But something new has come up...
english.completed: Return to Shilah Slabchisel at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

text.title: 黑铁诱捕者
text.objectives: 杀死10名黑铁诱捕者。
text.description: 你也许在外面见过黑铁氏族，但他们在这里也有活动。这些家伙从不安好心，貌似他们正在绑架藓皮豺狼人。$B$B我不知道他们葫芦里卖的什么药，不过我们得趁阴谋没有得逞之前阻止他们。$B$B要是你觉得这样有失公允，不妨先去跟他们礼貌交涉一下，看看你能进展到哪一步。
text.completion: I don't suppose they agreed to come along quietly? Didn't think so.
text.completed: Return to Shilah Slabchisel at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

english.title: Dark Iron Trappers
english.objectives: Kill 10 Dark Iron Trappers.
english.description: You may have seen them while you were out, but the Dark Iron clan has been spotted in this area. They're never up to any good, and it looks like they're kidnapping the Mosshide gnolls for some reason.$B$BI don't know what their game is, but we're putting a stop to this before more foul play occurs. Go and stop them.$B$BAnd if you're worried about fairness, try askin' them politely first and see how far that gets you.
english.completion: I don't suppose they agreed to come along quietly? Didn't think so.
english.completed: Return to Shilah Slabchisel at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

text.title: 豺狼人大逃亡
text.objectives: 从黑铁诱捕者身上搜到捕猎者的钥匙，打开豺狼人牢笼释放6名豺狼人。
text.description: 我知道我们自己刚刚攻打过这些豺狼人，但我不能让黑铁矮人把它们抓去奴役。第一，我们找到贼，也把东西拿回来了，所以正义已经得到了伸张；这第二，无论黑铁矮人想要让他们干什么，我就不能允许。$B$B不管怎么说，得把豺狼人放出来。诱捕者身上应该有钥匙，用它打开那些牢笼。
text.completion: That should do it! The more gnolls those fools have to chase after, the easier it'll be to keep them in line.
text.completed: Return to Shilah Slabchisel at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

english.title: Gnoll Escape
english.objectives: Obtain Trapper's Keys from Dark Iron Trappers and use them to free 6 Gnolls from the Gnoll Cages.
english.description: I know we were just attacking the gnolls ourselves, but I'm not about to let the Dark Iron capture them as slaves. For one, we found the thieves and took back what was missing, so justice is served; for another, whatever work the Dark Iron will be putting them to isn't something I want to allow.$B$BEither way, the gnolls need to be freed. The trappers should have keys on them, so use those to open the cages.
english.completion: That should do it! The more gnolls those fools have to chase after, the easier it'll be to keep them in line.
english.completed: Return to Shilah Slabchisel at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.

text.title: 约尔拉·暗网
text.objectives: 杀死约尔拉·暗网。
text.description: 我已经发现是谁在后面指使这次行动了。约尔拉·暗网在东边的一个营地里指挥着黑铁矮人，一开始让豺狼人偷走铁炉堡金锭的说不定也是她下的命令。$B$B此外，她还是个通缉要犯……麦格尼还在世的时候她就煽动谋反，攻打过铁炉堡。$B$B这次可不能让她再溜了，$n。去把她搞定！
text.completion: A job well done! You've brought one of Ironforge's most wanted to justice today, $n. I'd say you've earned a mighty fine reward.
text.completed: Return to Shilah Slabchisel at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.
text.giverWindow: 去干掉她！

english.title: Yorla Darksnare
english.objectives: Slay Yorla Darksnare.
english.description: I've found out who's pulling the strings on this operation here. Yorla Darksnare is directing the Dark Iron dwarves from a camp to the east, and it might've been orders to have the gnolls steal Ironforge's gold in the first place.$B$BWhat's more, she's a wanted criminal... she's been inciting rebellion and attacks against Ironforge since Magni was still alive.$B$BShe can't slip through our fingers this time, $n. Go and get her!
english.completion: A job well done! You've brought one of Ironforge's most wanted to justice today, $n. I'd say you've earned a mighty fine reward.
english.completed: Return to Shilah Slabchisel at Swiftgear Station in the Wetlands.
english.giverWindow: Go an' get her!

text.title: 岗哨里的恐怖图腾
text.objectives: 杀死10名恐怖图腾入侵者。
text.description: 你接下来的旅程将从杀死乱风岗上的恐怖图腾入侵者开始。假如你不能阻止他们，我们将无法深入他们的腹地。
text.completion: Grim business, that. No pun intended.
text.completed: Return to Quentin at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Grimtotem in the Post
english.objectives: Slay 10 Grimtotem Invaders.
english.description: The journey ahead must begin with you killing the Grimtotem invaders at Freewind Post. If you can't stop them here, we won't be able to move into their territory.
english.completion: Grim business, that. No pun intended.
english.completed: Return to Quentin at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 岗哨里的恐怖图腾
text.objectives: 杀死10名恐怖图腾入侵者。
