text.description: 你必须赶走乱风岗上的恐怖图腾入侵者。这是他们自找的，那些懦夫！$B$B我们可不能腹背受敌地打到他们老巢里去。请帮我们把家园夺回来，$c。
text.completion: It's a good start. Normally, I wouldn't wish harm on any of the Earth Mother's creatures. But attacking us at our most vulnerable moment?! They deserve to die!
text.completed: Return to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Grimtotem in the Post
english.objectives: Slay 10 Grimtotem Invaders.
english.description: You must do away with the Grimtotem invaders at Freewind Post. They brought it on themselves, the cowards!$B$BWe can't take the fight to their territory with our back to them. Please help us take back our home, $c.
english.completion: It's a good start. Normally, I wouldn't wish harm on any of the Earth Mother's creatures. But attacking us at our most vulnerable moment?! They deserve to die!
english.completed: Return to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 拯救哨兵
text.objectives: 救出菲拉斯哨兵。
text.description: <布琳娜挥舞着一张用牛头人语写的字条。>$B$B那些禽兽抓住了我们的一个哨兵！他们威胁说要是我们不后撤，就杀了她！$B$B我们不和懦弱的畜牲谈判！求求你，要是可以的话，请趁早把她救出来，$c。
text.completion: Thank you for freeing her, $n. Those Grimtotem monsters would have killed her in cold blood.
text.completed: Return to Brienna Starglow at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 赶紧把她放出来。

english.title: Save the Sentinel
english.objectives: Rescue the Feralas Sentinel.
english.description: <Brienna waves a note around with Taur-ahe markings on it.>$B$BThose monsters have captured one of our sentinels! They're threatening to kill her if we don't pull back!$B$BWe don't negotiate with cowardly beasts! Please, if you can, rescue her before it's too late, $c.
english.completion: Thank you for freeing her, $n. Those Grimtotem monsters would have killed her in cold blood.
english.completed: Return to Brienna Starglow at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Free her before it's too late.

objectiveDetails.description: 释放被俘虏的菲拉斯哨兵

text.title: 勇敢与鲁莽
text.objectives: 救出乱风岗卫士。
text.description: <拉乌轻蔑地挥舞着一张用牛头人语写的字条。>$B$B那些杂种抓住了我们的一个卫士！他们威胁说要是我们不后撤，就杀了他！$B$B我们决不允许这些恐怖图腾的懦夫占据乱风岗！请你趁早把他救出来，$c。
text.completion: Thank you for freeing him, $n. Those Grimtotem would have killed him in cold blood.
text.completed: Return to Rau Cliffrunner at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 赶紧把他放出来。

english.title: The Brave and the Bold
english.objectives: Rescue the Freewind Brave.
english.description: <Rau dismissively waves a note around with Taur-ahe markings on it.>$B$BThose mongrels have captured one of our braves! They're threatening to kill him if we don't pull back!$B$BWe'll never allow those Grimtotem cowards to keep Freewind Post! Please, rescue him before it's too late, $c.
english.completion: Thank you for freeing him, $n. Those Grimtotem would have killed him in cold blood.
english.completed: Return to Rau Cliffrunner at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Free him before it's too late.

objectiveDetails.description: 释放被俘虏的乱风岗卫兵

text.title: 叛徒的角
text.objectives: 拿到长角之角。
text.description: 躺在这里的是乱风岗博学者莫塔尔的残躯。上了年纪的牛头人尸体支离破碎，倒在自己的血泊中。$B$B血迹一路延伸到旅店里……
text.progress: What's this, $c?
text.completion: A traitor amongst the tauren? I've never heard of such a thing. Clan rivalries and warfare are one thing, but killing your own in cold blood.
text.completed: Return to Quentin at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 叛徒。把他剩下来那只角砍了！

english.title: Horn of the Traitor
english.objectives: Collect Longhorn's Horn.
english.description: Here lies the broken body of the Freewind Post lorekeeper, Montarr. The aged tauren's body is broken, lying in a pool of his own blood.$B$BA trail of droplets leads back to the inn....
english.progress: What's this, $c?
english.completion: A traitor amongst the tauren? I've never heard of such a thing. Clan rivalries and warfare are one thing, but killing your own in cold blood.
english.completed: Return to Quentin at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: The Traitor. Get his remaining horn!

text.title: 叛徒的角
text.objectives: 拿到长角之角。
text.description: 躺在这里的是乱风岗博学者莫塔尔的残躯。上了年纪的牛头人尸体支离破碎，倒在自己的血泊中。$B$B血迹一路延伸到旅店里……
text.progress: $n? What news do you have?
text.completion: The cliffwatcher was a Grimtotem spy?! No wonder we had no warning! I don't want that damned thing. Throw it into the water and let the Longhorn name never be spoken again!
text.completed: Return to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 叛徒。把他剩下来那只角砍了！

english.title: Horn of the Traitor
english.objectives: Collect Longhorn's Horn.
english.description: Here lies the broken body of the Freewind Post lorekeeper, Montarr. The aged tauren's body is broken, lying in a pool of his own blood.$B$BA trail of droplets leads back to the inn....
english.progress: $n? What news do you have?
english.completion: The cliffwatcher was a Grimtotem spy?! No wonder we had no warning! I don't want that damned thing. Throw it into the water and let the Longhorn name never be spoken again!
english.completed: Return to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: The Traitor. Get his remaining horn!

text.title: 里面的侏儒
text.objectives: 去石爪山脉油污潭找伪装成“地精”油泵操作员的明克斯。
text.description: 暗色湖到处都是部落。地精建起了商店，除非石爪山的最后一滴油都被吸干，不然他们是不会离开的。$B$B幸好我有个侏儒内应，一直在为我们收集情报。如果有人知道那个炸弹是怎么回事的话，就只有我的侏儒了。$B$B到北边的油污潭去找明克斯。她伪装成了一名“地精”油泵操作员。
text.completion: Get in here and hug a wall! I can't risk blowing my cover!

english.title: Gnome on the Inside
english.objectives: Seek out Minx who is disguised as a "Goblin" Pump Controller at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Mirkfallon Lake is crawling with Horde. The goblins have set up shop and they aren't going to leave until all the oil under Stonetalon is sucked dry.$B$BThankfully I have a gnome on the inside that's been collecting information for us. If anyone knows what's going on with that bomb, it's my inside gnome.$B$BMake your way to the Sludgewerks, north of here, and find Minx. She'll be disguised as a "goblin" pump controller.
english.completion: Get in here and hug a wall! I can't risk blowing my cover!

text.title: 就在上面！
text.objectives: 偷走克罗姆加日志簿.
text.description: 听着，自从你把我从灰谷救出来以后，我就一直在追查这颗炸弹。不管他们要干什么，都只是这几天的事情。$B$B大型钻油塔上面有一个控制室，里面可以找到一本克罗姆加日志簿。日志簿是了解炸弹投放地的关键。上去把日志薄拿到手！带回来，我来帮你破译。
text.progress: Did you recover the log book?
text.completion: OH NO! They plan to "test" the bomb at Thal'darah Grove! That's the school for young druids located in the heart of Battlescar Valley. You've got to return to Barus with this information! Master Thal'darah must be warned!
text.completed: Return to the "Goblin" Pump Controller at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: It's Up There!
english.objectives: Steal the Krom'gar Log Book.
english.description: Listen, I've been tracking this bomb since you rescued me in Ashenvale. Whatever they're doing with it is going to happen real soon.$B$BAt the top of the large oil rig is a control room. Inside that control room you'll find a Krom'gar log book. That log book is the key to where this bomb is heading. Get up there and get the log book! Bring it back here and I'll decipher it for you.
english.progress: Did you recover the log book?
english.completion: OH NO! They plan to "test" the bomb at Thal'darah Grove! That's the school for young druids located in the heart of Battlescar Valley. You've got to return to Barus with this information! Master Thal'darah must be warned!
english.completed: Return to the "Goblin" Pump Controller at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 没时间道别了！
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉暗色哨站的斥候指挥官巴努斯。
text.description: 快跑！快离开这里，$n。回去告诉巴努斯你都发现了什么。他会把你安全送过战痕谷，前往萨拉达瞭望塔。$B$B要救那些年轻的德鲁伊，为时还不晚！
text.completion: Blasted Horde! I've got friends at that grove. Hopefully you know how to ride a hippogryph. We've got to get you to Master Thal'darah at the overlook immediately!

english.title: No Time for Goodbyes!
english.objectives: Return to Scout Commander Barus at Mirkfallon Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: RUN! Get out of here, $n. Get back to Barus and inform him of what you've discovered. He'll arrange for you to get safely across Battlescar Valley to Thal'darah Overlook.$B$BIt's not too late to save those young druids!
english.completion: Blasted Horde! I've got friends at that grove. Hopefully you know how to ride a hippogryph. We've got to get you to Master Thal'darah at the overlook immediately!

text.title: 密谋破坏
text.objectives: 用地精油泵控制器摧毁4座地精油泵。
text.description: 地精……这世界要是没有地精会怎么样？我来告诉你：干干净净！$B$B那些污秽的小混账东西在湖面上建满了油泵，想把石爪山的最后一滴油都榨干。每个油泵都有一个控制器，确保油泵不出什么问题。$B$B是该出点问题了。$B$B干掉地精油泵管理员，控制他们的油泵，然后让它们过载！
text.completion: I could see the explosions from here, $n! The Horde won't be refueling from Mirkfallon anymore, thanks to you!
text.completed: Return to Scout Mistress Yvonia at Mirkfallon Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Schemin' That Sabotage
english.objectives: Use the Goblin Pump Controller to destroy 4 Goblin Oil Pumps.
english.description: Goblins... What would this world be without goblins? I'll tell you what: CLEAN!$B$BThose filthy little scum suckers have planted their oil pumps all over the lake with the hope of extracting every last drop of oil that exists in Stonetalon. At each oil pump they've stationed an oil pump controller whose sole job it is to watch the pump and make sure nothing goes wrong.$B$BSomething is about to go wrong.$B$BTake out the goblin pump controllers and take their pump controls. Use 'em to overload the pumps!
english.completion: I could see the explosions from here, $n! The Horde won't be refueling from Mirkfallon anymore, thanks to you!
english.completed: Return to Scout Mistress Yvonia at Mirkfallon Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 伐木场巨怪之难
text.objectives: 杀死10头伐木场巨怪。
text.description: 见过大地精吗？他们是另一种可耻的地精造物。找个地精，把他弄得丑点，胖点，大点，再蠢点，就是大地精了。再给它上面加点臭脾气，就是我们现在手头的麻烦。$B$B徘徊在油污潭和暗色湖的伐木场巨怪，扮演着地精的打手。$B$B去把他们除掉。永远除掉。
text.completion: Slowly, but surely, we pick away at the Horde's numbers. They won't have a leg to stand on when this war really opens up.
text.completed: Return to Scout Mistress Yvonia at Mirkfallon Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: The Lumbering Oaf Problem
english.objectives: Kill 10 Lumbering Oafs.
english.description: Ever seen a hobgoblin? They're another vile goblin creation. Take a goblin, make it even uglier, fatter, bigger and stupider and you have a hobgoblin. Add to all of that a nasty mean streak and we've got a problem.$B$BThese lumbering oafs wander the Sludgewerks and Mirkfallon Lake, acting as muscle to the goblins.$B$BGet out there and thin 'em out. Permanently.
english.completion: Slowly, but surely, we pick away at the Horde's numbers. They won't have a leg to stand on when this war really opens up.
english.completed: Return to Scout Mistress Yvonia at Mirkfallon Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 警告萨拉达大师
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉萨达拉瞭望台的萨拉达大师。
text.description: 萨达拉树林有好多学生。大多数手无缚鸡之力，只能坐以待毙。$B$B你必须带话给萨拉达大师，告诉他部落的计划。他会指引你下一步如何做。$B$B菲欧拉·月翔允许你使用她最快的一头角鹰兽。骑上它前往萨达拉瞭望台！不要回头，$n！一定要阻止部落！
text.completion: These are dire times, indeed, $n. Our outpost in Stonetalon Peak has been overrun by fiendish creatures from the depths and the Horde seeks to destroy us. We need a hero, $n; a soldier of the Alliance strong enough to guide us through these trying times.

english.title: Warn Master Thal'darah
english.objectives: Report to Master Thal'darah at Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: There are dozens of students at Thal'darah Grove. Most of them have no means of defending themselves, ripe for the slaughter.$B$BYou must get word to Master Thal'darah of the Horde's plans. He will direct you in what you must do next.$B$BFiora Moonsoar has granted you the use of her fastest hippogryph. Take it now to Thal'darah Overlook! Don't look back, $n! The Horde must be stopped!
english.completion: These are dire times, indeed, $n. Our outpost in Stonetalon Peak has been overrun by fiendish creatures from the depths and the Horde seeks to destroy us. We need a hero, $n; a soldier of the Alliance strong enough to guide us through these trying times.

text.title: 失踪的守望者
text.objectives: 找到并救出8名失踪的守望者。
text.description: 我们已经尽全力抵挡了，$c。但大火……还有灼热……我们失去了整个镇子。$B$B火焰包围上来时，铁木队长拒绝撤退。我们的部队都失散了。也许还有人活了下来？我们还能进行反击！$B$B去焦痕平原把所有掉队迷路的守望者们都救出来，然后去找铁木队长——他很可能在固守阵地，同敌人鏖战呢。
text.completion: You've assembled the survivors? Good, good. And the rest of the mountain - healed? Haha, strike me down! We're on the front lines again!
text.completed: Find Captain Irontree at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Lost Wardens
english.objectives: Locate and rescue 8 Lost Wardens.
english.description: We held out as long as we could, $c. But the flames... the heat... We lost the whole town.$B$BCaptain Irontree refused to pull back when the flames engulfed us. Our forces are scattered. Maybe some of the others survived? We can mount a counter-attack!$B$BGo into the Scorched Plain and rescue any lost wardens that got separated from the group. Then find Captain Irontree - he's probably taken up a fortified position in the middle of the fighting.
english.completion: You've assembled the survivors? Good, good. And the rest of the mountain - healed? Haha, strike me down! We're on the front lines again!
english.completed: Find Captain Irontree at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 支援农场
text.objectives: 跟冻石农场的火锤中士谈一谈。
text.description: 萨兰恩队长要我转达他对你的谢意，并恭喜你顺利地完成了任务。他和他手下的人正在清理残余的巨魔以及照顾伤者。$B$B他还希望你可以去北面的冻石农场跑一趟，有报告称那里也遭到了巨魔的攻击。抵达目的地后找火锤中士谈谈。
text.completion: So you're the one who's been helping Captain Tharran beat back the Frostmane trolls? I've seen your name in the reports. It's good to finally meet you. You might be just the $c we need to help secure the ranch.

english.title: A Hand at the Ranch
english.objectives: Speak with Sergeant Flinthammer at Amberstill Ranch.
english.description: Captain Tharran asked me to pass along his thanks for your help and congratulations on a successful mission. He and his men are cleaning up the last of the trolls and tending to the wounded.$B$BHe also wanted me to ask you to check out reports about troll raids on the Amberstill Ranch to the north. Ask for Sergeant Flinthammer when you arrive.
english.completion: So you're the one who's been helping Captain Tharran beat back the Frostmane trolls? I've seen your name in the reports. It's good to finally meet you. You might be just the $c we need to help secure the ranch.

text.title: 拆卸武器
text.objectives: 你必须摧毁6套纳迦三叉戟。
text.description: 纳迦的武器……$b$b你发现关押所内堆放着许多三叉戟，看起来是经过精心布局的。$b$b摧毁那些武器，至少能打击纳迦暗地里进行的计划……
text.completion: You're confident that your assault on the naga armaments has made an impact on their effectiveness.

english.title: How Disarming
english.objectives: You must destroy 6 sets of Naga Tridents.
english.description: Naga weapons...$b$bAs you cast your vision on the naga Holding Pens, you see dozens of similar stacks of tridents positioned strategically.$b$bDestroying their weapons could only hamper whatever wicked designs they are carrying out in this region...
english.completion: You're confident that your assault on the naga armaments has made an impact on their effectiveness.

text.title: 赴汤蹈火
text.objectives: 在柯尔普萨之森的关押所击败12只金加塔尔纳迦。
text.description: 噢，天哪……$b$b我知道这位幸存者的本意是好的，但是他遭受了严重的精神创伤。$b$b要对付这些被诅咒的怪物，唯一的办法是让他们尝尝矮人斧头的厉害。$b$b击败足够多的纳迦，今后他们就不敢贸然造次了。$b$b$g小伙子:姑娘;，听好了，那些渣滓比我们更不愿意看见自己流血。$b$b去吧，让他们尝尝厉害！
text.completion: The waters surrounding the Holding Pens are red with the blood of the naga. Rendel would be proud!
text.completed: Speak with Rendel in Deepmist Grotto in Kelp'thar Forest.

english.title: Come Hell or High Water
english.objectives: Kill 12 Zin'jatar Naga at The Clutch in Kelp'thar Forest.
english.description: Oh fer the love of...$b$bI know our survivor friend here means well, but the lad's been severely traumatized.$b$bThere only be one way ta deal with these accursed beasts, an' that be a fine dwarven axe buried hilt-deep in the noggin.$b$bPile up enough o' their corpses an' they'll think twice before fiddlin' with yer tasty bits.$b$bMark me words $gladdie:lassie;, them buggers don't like the sight o' their own blood any more than you or I.$b$bNow git out there an' give 'em what fer!
english.completion: The waters surrounding the Holding Pens are red with the blood of the naga. Rendel would be proud!
english.completed: Speak with Rendel in Deepmist Grotto in Kelp'thar Forest.

text.title: 啊……痛！我的肚子……
text.objectives: 从关押所里的光脊收割者身上收集7株蜷草苗芽。
text.description: 啊……这是怎么回事！？$b$b我的肚子……痛得厉害。$b$b痛……啊……他们肯定下了毒！$b$b他们在要塞里种植了奇怪的海草，强迫我们吃下……$b$b如果不继续服食，恐怕疼痛会加剧的……$b$b求求你了，$r。快给我找些海草来！
text.progress: Were you able to find me any of their seaweed, $c?
text.completion: Yes, yes. This is the stuff. Maybe I can gradually eat less of it and avoid that side-effect. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: 跟重雾洞穴的列兵伯纳德谈一谈。

english.title: What? What? In My Gut...?
english.objectives: Collect 7 Wiggleweed Sprouts from Shimmerspine Harvesters in The Clutch.
english.description: Wha...what IS this!?$b$bThere's great pain growing... from deep in my bowels.$b$bI think... ugh... they must have poisoned me!$b$bThey fed us strangely glowing seaweed that they grow around their stronghold...$b$bI think these cramps will worsen if I don't get more soon...$b$bPlease, $r. Try to find me some!
english.progress: Were you able to find me any of their seaweed, $c?
english.completion: Yes, yes. This is the stuff. Maybe I can gradually eat less of it and avoid that side-effect. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Private Pollard in Deepmist Grotto.

text.title: 扩大优势
text.objectives: 消灭4名暮光战地头领。
text.description: 看上去大多数暮光之锤的人员都在后撤重组，打算发动另一次攻击。他们中最忠诚的人全留在后方督阵。对我们来说，这就是打击其指挥力量的好机会。$B$B沿焦痕平原游走过去，击垮那些暮光战地头领。我们要把他们从棋盘上扫出去！
text.completion: Terrific! Twilight's Hammer will no doubt try to re-take the mountain, but they'll have to do so without the leadership of those fat-for-brains thugs.
text.completed: Return to Captain Irontree at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Pressing the Advantage
english.objectives: Slay 4 Twilight Field Captains.
english.description: It looks like most of the Twilight's Hammer has fallen back to regroup for another assault. Their most dedicated are staying behind to hold the line. This is our chance to whittle away at their leadership.$B$BRange out along the Scorched Plain and crush the Twilight Field Captains. We'll remove them from the equation!
english.completion: Terrific! Twilight's Hammer will no doubt try to re-take the mountain, but they'll have to do so without the leadership of those fat-for-brains thugs.
english.completed: Return to Captain Irontree at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 毁灭的苏醒
text.objectives: 使用示意宝珠驯服一头饥饿的巨鲨，然后指挥它消灭关押所内的12只金加塔尔纳迦。
text.description: 我们的时间所剩无几。想要揭露他们的阴谋，就必须寻找纳迦俘虏的踪迹。$b$b在进行下一步行动之前，我希望彻底摧毁关押所的运作！$b$b虽然纳迦的数量庞大，但是我有个完美的法子，说不定能达到势均力敌的效果。$b$b洞穴外有一群饥饿的巨鲨，它们是被纳迦驱赶到这里的。$b$b鲨鱼在处于虚弱状态时，是很服从指挥的。使用这颗宝珠驯服鲨鱼，然后指挥它对付我们的敌人。
text.completion: It is as it should be. Now the way is clear to deal these naga a crippling blow.
text.completed: Speak to Erunak at Deepmist Grotto.

english.title: Wake of Destruction
english.objectives: Use the Orb of Suggestion to subdue a Famished Great Shark, then use it to destroy 12 Zin'jatar at The Clutch.
english.description: Our time here draws to a close. I must somehow follow the trail of these naga captives if we are to discover their purposes in this region.$b$bBut before I move on, I would see the destruction of this operation!$b$bNevermind their numbers, I have a plan that has the potential to even the odds.$b$bOutside this cave, famished great sharks, displaced by these naga, seek food.$b$bIn their weakened state, they will be susceptible to suggestion. Use this orb to subdue them, then direct them against our enemy.
english.completion: It is as it should be. Now the way is clear to deal these naga a crippling blow.
english.completed: Speak to Erunak at Deepmist Grotto.

text.title: 减压
text.objectives: 对关押所的被禁锢的卫兵使用莫安纳的气息之石，搭救10名卫兵。
text.description: 一想到那么多士兵都被纳迦关押起来，我就气不打一处来。$b$b我们一定要想办法搭救他们！$b$b试试这个吧，$n。它可以让牢笼漂浮起来。$b$b如果能将他们送至水面，至少还有获救的机会。
text.completion: Let us hope for the safety of those released prisoners. In return for your noble efforts, please accept this gift.
text.completed: Speak with Moanah in Deepmist Grotto.

english.title: Decompression
english.objectives: Use Moanah's Breathstone on 10 Imprisoned Soldiers in The Clutch.
english.description: I simply cannot bear the thought of so many others like this soldier imprisoned, surrounded by naga.$b$bSomething must be done to rescue them!$b$bTry this, $n. Use  it on the prison cells to make them buoyant.$b$bIf we can get them to the surface, at least they stand a chance at being rescued.
english.completion: Let us hope for the safety of those released prisoners. In return for your noble efforts, please accept this gift.
english.completed: Speak with Moanah in Deepmist Grotto.

text.title: 救救孩子们！
text.objectives: 用萨达拉大师的角鹰兽营救萨达拉营地的5名无助的年轻德鲁伊。
text.description: 我那些可怜又无力自保的年轻学生们被困在了萨达拉林地。战斗遍布战痕谷，他们无法逃出生天。我们必须在部落投掷炸弹之前把孩子们救出来！$B$B骑上我的角鹰兽，去营救萨达拉林地的年轻德鲁伊。把他们带到镇子里的角鹰兽飞行点来。$B$B把他们都救出来，$n！你真的是我们唯一的希望了。
text.completion: Praise you, $n. The hero we have been searching for has finally arrived, and not a moment too soon.
text.completed: Return to Master Thal'darah at Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Save the Children!
english.objectives: Use Master Thal'darah's Hippogryph to rescue 5 Helpless Young Druids from Thal'darah Grove.
english.description: My poor, defenseless young students are stranded at Thal'darah Grove. With the battle raging across Battlescar Valley, they have no means of escaping. We must save the children before the Horde drops their bomb!$B$BTake my hippogryph and use it to rescue the young druids of Thal'darah Grove. Drop them off at the hippogryph post here in town.$B$BSave them all, $n! You truly are our only hope.
english.completion: Praise you, $n. The hero we have been searching for has finally arrived, and not a moment too soon.
english.completed: Return to Master Thal'darah at Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains.

objectiveDetails.description: 营救无助的年轻德鲁伊

text.title: 奈瑟匹拉
text.objectives: 进入奈瑟匹拉的西北入口，然后找到与其交流的方法。
text.description: 现在，我已经很明确地知道接下来要怎么办了，$n。$b$b纳迦只可能从一个特定的来源采集这些珍珠：奈瑟匹拉，生活在这座洞穴外面的古老的甲壳生物。不过，为什么奈瑟匹拉会屈服于纳迦，这就不是我能想明白的了。$b$b我们可以通过这座洞穴出口附近的一个小管道进入奈瑟匹拉的体腔。我得先去接我的导师，然后咱们在里面会合，地点就选在奈瑟匹拉的西北入口处吧。
text.completion: Erunak trusts this task to me?  Very well, let's see what we can learn from the ancient one.
text.end: 找到与奈瑟匹拉联系的办法
text.completed: 与瓦丝琪尔奈瑟匹拉里面的大地治愈者达鲁交谈。

english.title: Nespirah
english.objectives: Enter Nespirah's northwestern entrance, then find a way to communicate with it.
english.description: It is clear to me at this point what must be done, $n.$b$bThe naga can only be obtaining these pearls from one place: Nespirah, the ancient, shelled creature that rests outside of this cave.  Why Nespirah would submit to the naga, however, is beyond my understanding.$b$bWe can enter Nespirah's body cavity through a small tube near the exit to this cave.  I must first fetch my master, then we can meet you on the inside.  We will convene in Nespirah's northwestern entrance.
english.completion: Erunak trusts this task to me?  Very well, let's see what we can learn from the ancient one.
english.end: Find a way to communicate with Nespirah
english.completed: Speak with Earthmender Duarn inside Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 孤注一掷
text.objectives: 帮助萨达拉大师寻找在萨达拉林地掉队的德鲁伊。
text.description: 部落鸣金收兵了。现在你看，他们从战场上撤走——这是灾难的预兆。$B$B我们必须做最后一次尝试，冲入萨达拉林地。要是有任何年轻的德鲁伊被落在那里，我会终生难安的。$B$B帮助我，英雄。我来操缰绳，你就寻找任何可能掉队的德鲁伊。$B$B你准备好了我们就出发。
text.completion: Do you know why the Horde destroys? The Horde destroys because they cannot comprehend beauty. They fear it and that which they fear they must destroy. Why else would they destroy Thal'darah Grove? Together, we will make them understand. They will know that what they do comes at a great cost.
text.completed: 跟石爪山脉萨达拉瞭望塔的萨拉达大师谈一谈。

english.title: Last Ditch Effort
english.objectives: Assist Master Thal'darah in search of any druids left behind at Thal'darah Grove.
english.description: The Horde have signaled a retreat. Look now, they fall back from the field of battle - portends of disaster.$B$BWe must make one final descent into Thal'darah Grove. I could not live with myself if any of our young druids were left behind.$B$BAssist me, hero. I will take the reins. You search for any druids that might be left behind.$B$BWe will go when you are ready.
english.completion: Do you know why the Horde destroys? The Horde destroys because they cannot comprehend beauty. They fear it and that which they fear they must destroy. Why else would they destroy Thal'darah Grove? Together, we will make them understand. They will know that what they do comes at a great cost.
english.completed: Speak with Master Thal'darah at Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 失地
text.objectives: 使用波涛语者瓦罗伦的海马去找瓦丝琪尔废墟南部平台下的德沃雷克将军。
text.description: 你稍后再向我汇报吧。现在，我们得趁纳迦反扑之前离开这里。先返回下层前哨站。$B$B骑上我的海马，稍后我们再碰头。
text.completion: You made it! After the attack at the forward post, I thought we might be the only ones left. I'm very glad to see you.
text.completed: Retreat to the Tranquil Wash.

english.title: Losing Ground
english.objectives: Use Wavespeaker Valoren's sea horse to return to Admiral Dvorek under the southern terrace in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.
english.description: You'll have to catch me up more later. Right now, we need to get out of here before more naga push in. Make your way back to the forward post on the level below us.$B$BTake my sea horse. We will meet you back there shortly.
english.completion: You made it! After the attack at the forward post, I thought we might be the only ones left. I'm very glad to see you.
english.completed: Retreat to the Tranquil Wash.

text.title: 绝望的计划
text.objectives: 去贝耶拉兰山找工程师“洗衣桶”。
text.description: 约尔兰和“洗衣桶”想办法去搬援兵了。贸易航线离这儿不远，那里可能会有一线生机，但我不敢给人们过高的期望。$B$B事实上，也没有别的办法。我们撑不了多久了，纳迦最终还是会找到我们，然后……然后……你也知道他们有多少人马。$B$B你可以到东南方的贝耶拉兰山找到他们俩，我在这里尽量保证大家的安全。
text.completion: Impeccable timing. Like clockwork! Trouble comes. You come. Save the day.  Clockwork! We've devised our brilliant plan. Gloriously simple, barring the hostility of local life. Simpler yet with a you available!

english.title: Desperate Plan
english.objectives: Meet with Engineer Hexascrub on Biel'aran Ridge.
english.description: Jorlan and Hexascrub left to find a way to contact help. The trade lanes aren't far, so there might be a chance of success, but I'm wary to let anyone get their hopes up.$B$BIn truth, we don't have any other options. We're not likely to last much longer here. The naga will find us eventually, and... well... you saw how many of them there were.$B$BYou should go find the two of them on Biel'aran Ridge to the southeast. I'll keep everyone here safe as long as I can.
english.completion: Impeccable timing. Like clockwork! Trouble comes. You come. Save the day.  Clockwork! We've devised our brilliant plan. Gloriously simple, barring the hostility of local life. Simpler yet with a you available!

text.title: 敌对水域
text.objectives: 消灭10名污皮拾荒者。
text.description: “洗衣桶”拿了一个好像是从我们的船里抢救出来的气球来。他打算把它放上去来着，可那些污皮拾荒者突然冒了出来，一拥而上。$B$B他打算再放一枚气球，不过我们得保证不能重蹈覆辙。我要你把那些长鳃的地精干掉。至少也得让他们小心着点我们才是。
text.completion: Less gill goblins is good! I'm glad that they're so primitive. I don't think I'd want to be dealing with a race of aquatic tech-freaks right now. Not at all.
text.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub on Biel'aran Ridge.

english.title: Hostile Waters
english.objectives: Kill 10 Muckskin Scroungers.
english.description: Hexascrub came out here with a balloon of some sort that he retrieved from one of our ships. He tried to float it to the top, but those Muckskin Scroungers came out of nowhere and swarmed the thing.$B$BHe's got an idea for another balloon, but we need to make sure that the past doesn't repeat itself. I need you to kill off those gill goblins. Or at the very least, enough of them to make them a bit more wary of us.
english.completion: Less gill goblins is good! I'm glad that they're so primitive. I don't think I'd want to be dealing with a race of aquatic tech-freaks right now. Not at all.
english.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub on Biel'aran Ridge.

text.title: 有备而来
text.objectives: 回收联盟救生箱。
text.description: 我们必须随时准备着。准备好装备，准备好计划，准备好装备计划！$B$B联盟所有的舰队里所有的船只都配有救生箱。我们的许多工具就是救生箱里的。我的气球也是！但现在它没了。我还需要一个救生箱！$B$B东南方有艘船，但愿那些幸存者够笨没能带上救生箱。咱们就有得多了！
text.progress: A whole big box of amazing! That's what it is. I need more amazing in my life. Don't worry, I'll share.
text.completion: Let me see, let me see... flare gun... balloon... no rope. Never any rope. Terribly impractical if you do ask me. Rope should be mandatory.
text.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub on Biel'aran Ridge.

english.title: Come Prepared
english.objectives: Retrieve an Alliance Survival Kit.
english.description: We must always come prepared. Prepared with gear. Prepared with plans. Prepared with gear plans!$B$BAll of the ships in all of the Alliance fleets stow a survival kit. A lot of our tools came from a survival kit. My balloon came from a survival kit too! But now it's gone. I need another survival kit!$B$BThere's a ship to the southeastish. Let's hope that the survivors were dumb and didn't take the survival kit. More survival kit for us!
english.progress: A whole big box of amazing! That's what it is. I need more amazing in my life. Don't worry, I'll share.
english.completion: Let me see, let me see... flare gun... balloon... no rope. Never any rope. Terribly impractical if you do ask me. Rope should be mandatory.
english.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub on Biel'aran Ridge.

text.title: 集合虔诚者
text.objectives: 在北部台阶的中途找到深渊召唤者阿泽拉夏，在废墟上部找到6名希拉柯丝海潮女祭司，指示她们回到神殿。$B$B这个任务是纳兹夏尔女武士幻像的一部分。如有需要，可以使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃在时间焦点处返回幻像。
text.description: 啊，女武士。你代表着我们女王的话语和意志。我或许要请你帮一个忙……$B$B我需要深渊召唤者阿泽拉夏和我的海潮祭司都回来，以便开始仪式。你能不能也帮我传达？你可以在神殿的平台和阶梯上找到她们。阿泽拉夏在北边的台阶上。
text.completion: The Kvaldir have proved a greater threat than we anticipated, but our plans are not hindered in the least. As our allies arrive, we will have a force more than sufficient to usurp the Tidehunter.$B$BAll that remains is to ensure that the ritual of summoning is completed.
text.completed: Return to Lady Sira'kess within the Temple of Quel'Dormir.

english.title: Devout Assembly
english.objectives: Seek out Fathom-Caller Azrajar midway down the northern stairs and 6 Sira'kess Tide Priestesses on the upper portion of the ruins, and instruct them to return to the temple.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: Ah, Battlemaiden. You carry with you the word and the will of our Lady. I might ask a favor of you...$B$BI need Fathom-Caller Azrajar and my Tide Priestesses to return so that we can begin the ritual. Can you carry my will to them as such? You should find them spread upon the temple terrace. Azrajar will be at the stairs to the north.
english.completion: The Kvaldir have proved a greater threat than we anticipated, but our plans are not hindered in the least. As our allies arrive, we will have a force more than sufficient to usurp the Tidehunter.$B$BAll that remains is to ensure that the ritual of summoning is completed.
english.completed: Return to Lady Sira'kess within the Temple of Quel'Dormir.

objectiveDetails.description: 集合希拉柯丝海潮女祭司
集合深渊召唤者阿泽拉夏

text.title: 展开计划
text.objectives: 收集8根克瓦迪尔套索。
text.description: 救生箱里永远没有绳子的。根本就是胡扯淡！胡扯淡你懂吧。$B$B我打赌那些克瓦迪尔人有绳子。他们整天开着船晃悠，打绳结啊，披纱戴网的。去跟他们拿点绳子来！没绳子我们的计划就没法进行。没法儿进行。
text.progress: The rope ties the whole plan together!
text.completion: This is great! I love it. It should work per... ewww! Is this stuff braided with hair? Doesn't matter. Almost done. This thing will be ready in the twist of a rope.
text.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub on Biel'aran Ridge.

english.title: Unfurling Plan
english.objectives: Collect 8 Coils of Kvaldir Rope.
english.description: Survival kits never have any rope. It makes no sense! No sense at all.$B$BI bet those Kvaldir have rope. They're always riding around in boats, tying knots, dressing in nets. Go take some rope from them! I must have it for our plan to work. Absolutely must.
english.progress: The rope ties the whole plan together!
english.completion: This is great! I love it. It should work per... ewww! Is this stuff braided with hair? Doesn't matter. Almost done. This thing will be ready in the twist of a rope.
english.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub on Biel'aran Ridge.

text.title: 荣幸与特权
text.objectives: 游上水面，拿到信号枪，朝联盟船只发射信号弹。
text.description: 都好了！我有信心它准能行。而且这次也没有拾荒者来把它扎个窟窿。$B$B约尔兰已经游上去接了。他说你该享有这个荣幸。约尔兰多好啊。$B$B把气球带上去，带上箱子里的信号枪，在地平线上找找联盟船只的影子。一旦有所发现，就朝他们发射信号弹。就这样！就是这么简单。$B$B游上去。浮起来。发射信号。得救啦！我最喜欢最后一段了。
text.completion: Perfect! There's no way they missed that, fighting or not.
text.completed: Speak to Jorlan Trueblade on the surface above Biel'aran Ridge.

english.title: Honor and Privilege
english.objectives: Swim to the surface, retrieve the flare gun, and fire a rescue flare towards the Alliance Ships.
english.description: All done! I'm confident it will work. And not a scrounger in sight to pop a hole in it this time! Fortuitous.$B$BJorlan already swam up to catch it. Swam up and stopped to wait for it. He said you'd get the honors though. Jorlan's nice like that.$B$BGo to the top with the balloon, take the flare gun from the crate, and scan the horizon for Alliance ships. If you see any, fire the flare towards them. That's it! All there is to it.$B$BSwim. Float. Flare. Rescue! That last part's my favorite.
english.completion: Perfect! There's no way they missed that, fighting or not.
english.completed: Speak to Jorlan Trueblade on the surface above Biel'aran Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 游到水面上的救援气球去
朝联盟船只发射信号弹

text.title: 突破
text.objectives: 消灭10名暮光灼炎主宰。
text.description: 火焰大军在山上给我们造成了那么大的麻烦，现在他们都撤到东面去了，只有灼炎主宰还留在战场上。要是我们能把他们的战线撕一个口子，就能同铁木队长汇合，对方的整个攻势就会崩溃。$B$B$C，我已经没法继续战斗了，但你看上去还能来几下子。杀掉那些灼炎主宰，去和铁木队长汇合！
text.completion: You killed how many? Well, well. Quite a show. I guess my men don't have any more excuses.
text.completed: Speak with Captain Irontree at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Breakthrough
english.objectives: Slay 10 Twilight Scorchlords.
english.description: The fiery army that caused so much devastation up the hill has retreated east of here. Only the Scorchlords remain in action. If we can punch a hole through their lines to regroup with Captain Irontree's forces, the whole offensive may collapse.$B$B$C, I'm in no shape to continue fighting, but you look like you can do some damage. Slay those Scorchlords and regroup with Captain Irontree!
english.completion: You killed how many? Well, well. Quite a show. I guess my men don't have any more excuses.
english.completed: Speak with Captain Irontree at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 尝试交流
text.objectives: 在大地治愈者达鲁尝试与奈瑟匹拉进行交流时，在一旁观察。
text.description: 我无法相信奈瑟匹拉会自愿地允许那些纳迦进入她的外壳。依我看来，只有两种可能：要么是他们说服了她，要么是他们设法使她变得非常虚弱，无法还击。无论哪一种都很糟糕。$b$b在这个腔室中，我应该可以直接跟奈瑟匹拉交流。我们自己来找出原因吧。等你准备好了之后就告诉我，$c。
text.completion: That didn't go well.  For some reason, the beast won't speak back to me.$b$b<Duarn is clearly frustrated.>$b$bIf only Erunak had not left us!  He would know what to do.
text.end: 同大地治愈者达鲁交谈
text.completed: 去找瓦丝琪尔奈瑟匹拉里面的大地治愈者达鲁。

english.title: Making Contact
english.objectives: Observe as Earthmender Duarn attempts to communicate with Nespirah.
english.description: I can't believe that Nespirah would willingly allow these naga to take residence inside her shell.  As I see it, one of two things has happened: they have convinced her to willingly join their cause, or they have weakened her to a point where she cannot fight back.  Either one is bad.$b$bHere in this chamber, I should be able to communicate directly with Nespirah.  Let us find out for ourselves.  Speak to me when you are prepared, $c.
english.completion: That didn't go well.  For some reason, the beast won't speak back to me.$b$b<Duarn is clearly frustrated.>$b$bIf only Erunak had not left us!  He would know what to do.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 海加尔回收计划
text.objectives: 收集15支监护者之箭。
text.description: 是援军！我以为我们要战至最后一兵一卒呢。$B$B海加尔守护者只有小部分还活着，我们的补给也快见底了。阵地外的战场上一定废弃着不少还能用的箭矢。$B$B我知道这是大材小用，但你能不能帮我们收集一些弹药来？这是我们补充给养的唯一办法了！
text.progress: Warden's arrows are crafted of living oak, blessed in the moonwells, and tipped with obsidian arrowheads scrawled with runes invoking the blessings of nature. They're not cheap.
text.completion: Wonderful! Still sharp. A little blood on the fletching, but they'll fly true. Thank you, $n. Our defense of Hyjal can continue.
text.completed: Take the arrows to Logram at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Hyjal Recycling Program
english.objectives: Gather 15 Warden's Arrows.
english.description: Reinforcements! I thought we were going to fight this out to the bitter end.$B$BVery few of the Guardians of Hyjal remain, and our supplies are running out. The battlefield around our holdout here must be littered with serviceable arrows.$B$BI know it's beneath your abilities, but can you gather up our spent ammunition? It's the only way we can replenish our supplies!
english.progress: Warden's arrows are crafted of living oak, blessed in the moonwells, and tipped with obsidian arrowheads scrawled with runes invoking the blessings of nature. They're not cheap.
english.completion: Wonderful! Still sharp. A little blood on the fletching, but they'll fly true. Thank you, $n. Our defense of Hyjal can continue.
english.completed: Take the arrows to Logram at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: It's Hot and it Might Explode

english.title: It's Hot and it Might Explode

text.title: 锤子和钥匙
text.objectives: 消灭一名暮光战地头领，并且拿到开启雕文。
text.description: 我的涅墨西斯。还活着。$B火焰的奴仆依然会来。$B我们必须追捕。到他们的老巢里去。$B$B食人魔知道路。$B杀死战地头领。$B拿到开启雕文。$B$B路就通了。
text.progress: The glyph. Show it to me.
text.completion: This power is ancient. Primitive. Easy. We will use it against them.
text.completed: Take the glyph to Tortolla at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: The Hammer and the Key
english.objectives: Kill a Twilight Field Captain and recover the Glyph of Opening.
english.description: My Nemesis. Still lives.$BThe servants of fire still come.$BWe must pursue. Into their den.$B$BThe ogres know the way.$BSlay the Field Captains.$BRecover the Glyph of Opening.$B$BThis is the way.
english.progress: The glyph. Show it to me.
english.completion: This power is ancient. Primitive. Easy. We will use it against them.
english.completed: Take the glyph to Tortolla at the Scorched Plain in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 山羊大潜逃
text.objectives: 用/whistle从冻土岭找回6头被偷走的山羊。
text.description: 长年以来，我们在冻石农场饲养和训练的山羊，都是丹莫罗巡山人的坐骑首选。没错，这儿是有几个他们的人，可没法守护我的家人和所有的动物。$B$B一些胆大的霜鬃袭击者趁着夜色把我们的山羊偷走了几只，带到南边的冻土岭去了。你愿意帮忙把它们找回来吗？你得靠它们非常近，然后响亮地吹一声口哨吸引它们的注意。接来下它们就会按训练的那样自己回来了。
text.completion: The rams you rescued have made their way back into the pen. I've got members of the family on a day and night watch now. Those trolls won't take us by surprise again!
text.completed: Return to Veron Amberstill at Amberstill Ranch.

english.title: Rams on the Lam
english.objectives: Recover 6 Stolen Rams from the Tundrid Hills by using /whistle.
english.description: The rams we raise and train here at Amberstill ranch have long been the mounts of choice for Dun Morogh's mountaineers. Aye, there're a few here, but not enough to guard my family and all the animals.$B$BA few brave Frostmane raiders have taken to stealing our rams under the cover of night, taking them south into the Tundrid Hills. Would you be willing to help return them? You'll need to get fairly close to them and give a sharp whistle to get their attention. Their training will take over from there.
english.completion: The rams you rescued have made their way back into the pen. I've got members of the family on a day and night watch now. Those trolls won't take us by surprise again!
english.completed: Return to Veron Amberstill at Amberstill Ranch.

text.title: 第三道火焰之门
text.objectives: 穿过焦痕平原的火焰之门找到里面的加仑达·山峰。
text.description: 记住雕文。$B将它铭刻在心。$B$B在火焰之门前面的地上画出来。$B从这里往东。$B进入火焰之地。$B$B我无法和你一同前往。$B但我的孩子们在里面。等待。$B$B去那烈焰的领域找加仑达·山峰。
text.completion: You were sent by the turtle god? Bless his almighty shell! I thought I was trapped down here forever.
text.completed: 穿过焦痕平原的传送门去找里面的加仑达·山峰。

english.title: The Third Flamegate
english.objectives: Travel through the flamegate in the Scorched Plain and locate Garunda Mountainpeak within.
english.description: Memorize the glyph.$BTake it within yourself.$B$BDraw it on the ground before the flamegate.$BEast of here.$BEnter the Firelands.$B$BI cannot come with you.$BBut my children await. Inside.$B$BFind Garunda Mountainpeak within the realm of flame.
english.completion: You were sent by the turtle god? Bless his almighty shell! I thought I was trapped down here forever.
english.completed: Travel through the flamegate in the Scorched Plain and locate Garunda Mountainpeak within.

text.title: 奴隶劳工
text.objectives: 使用达鲁的绳子营救8个被奴役的采珠人。
text.description: 我要花一点时间才能突破屏障，与奈瑟匹拉进行交流。与此同时，你可以到下面的深坑里去，解救一些被纳迦当做奴隶使唤的人。$b$b<达鲁从袍子里拿出一根长绳来。>$b$b这个应该很有用。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n... although I'm afraid I haven't been nearly as productive as you have.
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Slave Labor
english.objectives: Use Duarn's Rope to save 8 Enslaved Pearl Miners.
english.description: It will take me some time to break through this barrier and communicate with Nespirah.  In the meantime, you can save some of those men that the naga have enslaved in the pits below.$b$b<Duarn produces a length of rope from within his robes.>$b$bThis should come in handy.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n... although I'm afraid I haven't been nearly as productive as you have.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 忍无可忍
text.objectives: 杀死7个埃卓凯丝哨兵和7个埃卓凯丝导魔师。
text.description: 也许我无法直接跟巨兽奈瑟匹拉进行交流，但我仍然可以间接地感觉到一些东西。比如说，我可以清晰地感觉到奈瑟匹拉对这里的纳迦非常不满。$b$b我们刚刚进入奈瑟匹拉的身体时，我看到一批哨兵和导魔师在中间的腔室巡逻。如果你能去除掉一些纳迦的话，也许这个古代生物的痛苦可以减轻一些。
text.completion: Can you sense it?  If you have an ounce of shaman's blood in you, you must feel the sense of relief in the air.$b$bNespirah is pleased.  Perhaps she will finally speak with us.
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Stick it to Them
english.objectives: Kill 7 Idra'kess Sentinels and 7 Idra'kess Enchantresses.
english.description: I may be unable to communicate directly with the beast Nespirah, but I can still feel some things indirectly.  For example, I can clearly sense that Nespirah is not happy about the naga's presence here.$b$bWhen we first entered Nespirah's body, I saw dozens of sentinels and enchantresses patrolling the central chamber floor.  Perhaps some of the ancient one's pain will be alleviated if you remove them.
english.completion: Can you sense it?  If you have an ounce of shaman's blood in you, you must feel the sense of relief in the air.$b$bNespirah is pleased.  Perhaps she will finally speak with us.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 抓螃蟹
text.objectives: 在奈瑟匹拉体内，使用达鲁的网捕捉一只深渊猎手蟹。
text.description: 我的整个身心都能感觉到奈瑟匹拉正在试图与我交流，但我就是听不到她的声音。也许纳迦对她的声音动了什么手脚。$b$b<达鲁思考了一会。>$b$b奈瑟匹拉的声音也许是被压制了……也就是说……我们要为她找到发声的办法！$b$b我知道了！埃卓凯丝纳迦经常训练深渊猎手蟹作为战斗宠物。用这张网去捉一只螃蟹，把它给我带来。你可以在这间腔室的外缘找到它们。
text.progress: I hope this works.  My skills as a shaman are limited, and I fear that this task may be too much for us.
text.completion: It doesn't look very impressive, does it?
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Capture the Crab
english.objectives: Use Duarn's Net to capture a Deepseeker Crab inside of Nespirah.
english.description: Everything in my body tells me that Nespirah is trying to speak with me, but I cannot hear her.  Perhaps the naga have done something to her voice.$b$b<Duarn thinks to himself for a moment.>$b$bNespirah's voice may be suppressed... that means... we need to find a voice for her!$b$bI've got it!  The Idra'kess have been known to train deepseeker crabs as battle companions.  Use this net to capture a crab, and bring it to me.  You will likely find them prowling the chamber's outer edges.
english.progress: I hope this works.  My skills as a shaman are limited, and I fear that this task may be too much for us.
english.completion: It doesn't look very impressive, does it?
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 慈悲的时间过去了
text.objectives: 消灭10名熔岩折磨者和4名影焰主宰。
text.description: 这个山洞令人憎恶，$n。里面充斥着地底来的恐怖生物。$B$B我可不想让这些……东西……穿过传送门来到外面的世界。把它们都杀光！
text.completion: So it is done. Knowing that Twilight's Hammer is in league with creatures of malice such as these... it really curdles the blood.
text.completed: Return to Garunda Mountainpeak within the Crucible.

english.title: The Time for Mercy has Passed
english.objectives: Slay 10 Molten Tormentors and 4 Shadowflame Masters.
english.description: This cavern is an abomination, $n. And it's filled with horrors from the depths.$B$BI don't want any of these - things - getting through the portal to the outside world. Slay everything!
english.completion: So it is done. Knowing that Twilight's Hammer is in league with creatures of malice such as these... it really curdles the blood.
english.completed: Return to Garunda Mountainpeak within the Crucible.

text.title: 好消息
text.objectives: 去找静谧海滩的泰勒上尉。
text.description: 他们可能会派艘舢板过来，多半会花点时间。我留在这里同他们接触。$B$B你要马上返回洞穴，让他们知道救兵来了。只能但愿纳迦还没有发现他们。$B$B去吧。快些游，$n。
text.completion: That is the best news I've heard in what seems like an eternity. We'll get the survivors moving over there to the surface as soon as possible. Perhaps we can forget that this whole nightmare ever happened. Thank you, $n. I'm not sure there's anything I can do to repay you for everything you've managed to accomplish in this ocean, but I will try to find a way. You should consider meeting us at the ships later, when you finish saying your goodbyes to the naga.

english.title: Welcome News
english.objectives: Return to Captain Taylor at the Tranquil Wash.
english.description: They'll probably send a skiff over, which may take a bit. I'll stay here to make contact.$B$BYou need to return to the cave immediately and let them know that rescue is on its way. We can only hope that the naga have not found them yet.$B$BGo. Swim fast, $n.
english.completion: That is the best news I've heard in what seems like an eternity. We'll get the survivors moving over there to the surface as soon as possible. Perhaps we can forget that this whole nightmare ever happened. Thank you, $n. I'm not sure there's anything I can do to repay you for everything you've managed to accomplish in this ocean, but I will try to find a way. You should consider meeting us at the ships later, when you finish saying your goodbyes to the naga.

text.title: 那些美好的日子
text.objectives: 找到长者莎瑞丝娜的草稿本。
text.description: 世界在我们面前土崩瓦解，$n。一面是往日的宿敌要消灭我们，一面是远古的军队虎视眈眈。$B$B<长者莎瑞丝娜叹了一口气。>$B$B我见过更为美好的日子——光明的日子，我怀念它们……$B$B翻过石爪峰，就是我们旧哨所的废墟——现在为黑暗所控制。要是你碰巧经过，能不能帮我找找我的草稿本？它里面有我许多美好的回忆。我会好好奖励你的。
text.progress: Have you found my sketch book?
text.completion: You've found it! Elune bless you, child! Perhaps this book will give me the strength to carry on.
text.completed: Return to Elder Sareth'na at Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Seen Better Days
english.objectives: Find Elder Sareth'na's Sketch Book.
english.description: The world is unraveling around us, $n. Old enemies seek to destroy us from one end, while ancient forces close in on the other.$B$B<Elder Sareth'na sighs.>$B$BI have seen better days - brighter days, and I long for them...$B$BAcross Stonetalon Peak lies the ruins of our old outpost - now overrun with darkness. If you happen to go that way, could you search for my sketch book? It holds many happy memories. I would reward you well for its return.
english.progress: Have you found my sketch book?
english.completion: You've found it! Elune bless you, child! Perhaps this book will give me the strength to carry on.
english.completed: Return to Elder Sareth'na at Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 让她们安息
text.objectives: 收集8把哨兵的战刃。
text.description: 部落进军石爪山的时候，我注意到有些哨兵变得不正常起来。不久以后，她们的举止行为就开始怪异。当第一根触须从地面爆发出来后，这些病态的哨兵就开始攻击我们。我们很快就丢失了前哨……$B$B如今石爪峰上的哨兵们只是一具空壳——一些罪恶之极的行尸走肉。我要你去让这些哨兵安息，把她们的阔刃刀拿回来。每把阔刃刀都意味着一个牺牲的姐妹。
text.progress: Recover the sentinel's glaives, $n. Each glaive is unique to a sentinel.
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Each glaive has the name of the sentinel it belonged to imprinted upon its blade. We can now send word to their families and put their souls to rest.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Mistress Geleneth at Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Putting Them to Rest
english.objectives: Recover 8 Sentinel's Glaives.
english.description: As the Horde were marching upon Stonetalon, I noticed that some of the sentinels had fallen ill. Not long after, they started acting strangely. When the first tentacle burst from the ground the ill sentinels began attacking us. We lost the outpost shortly after...$B$BThe sentinels in the peak are now nothing more than shells - husks for something far more sinister. I want you to put the sentinels to rest and retrieve their glaives. Each glaive returned can identify a fallen sister.
english.progress: Recover the sentinel's glaives, $n. Each glaive is unique to a sentinel.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. Each glaive has the name of the sentinel it belonged to imprinted upon its blade. We can now send word to their families and put their souls to rest.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Mistress Geleneth at Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 回到地底去！
text.objectives: 消灭预言者阿菲拉斯和10条入侵的触须。
text.description: 深渊触须从地底暴发出来，祸害着石爪峰。我的哨兵们几乎难以清除它们。$B$B我认为在石爪峰心脏地带，有股力量控制着触须。也许我们阻止那股力量，触须就会回到地底去！
text.completion: I'm afraid that the death of Harbinger Aph'lass has not ceased the tendril attacks. You've done all that you can, $n, and for that I thank you.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Mistress Geleneth at Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Back to the Depths!
english.objectives: Kill Harbinger Aph'lass and 10 Invading Tentacles.
english.description: Tendrils are bursting forth from the earth and terrorizing Stonetalon Peak. My sentinels are hardly making a dent in their numbers.$B$BI suspect that there is a force at the heart of Stonetalon Peak that controls the tendrils. Perhaps if we can put a stop to that force, the tendrils will return to the depths from whence they came!
english.completion: I'm afraid that the death of Harbinger Aph'lass has not ceased the tendril attacks. You've done all that you can, $n, and for that I thank you.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Mistress Geleneth at Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 托尔托拉的力量
text.objectives: 护送托尔托拉之子去找涅墨西斯水晶。若是失去了同伴就去找加仑达·山峰。
text.description: 海加尔山的大火退却时，黑暗篡神者涅墨西斯逃到了这里。我们还没有足够的力量来打败他，$n，但我们可以借用他的力量来对付他自己。$B$B我会派一名托尔托拉之子与你同行，他也是你从暮光的腐化中营救出来的。$B$B到洞穴深处找一颗涅墨西斯水晶，让年轻的幼龟去检查一下。$B$B要是你失去了同伴，就来找我！
text.completion: Ah yes, yes... the secret strength of Nemesis, unearthed here in these caverns. We know all that we need to know, $n. It is time to finish this.
text.completed: Return to Garunda Mountainpeak within the Crucible.

english.title: The Strength of Tortolla
english.objectives: Escort a Child of Tortolla to a Nemesis Crystal. See Garunda Mountainpeak if you lose your companion.
english.description: The dark usurper Nemesis fled here when the fires of Hyjal receded. We are not yet strong enough to defeat Nemesis, $n, but we may be able to turn his own strength against him.$B$BI will send a child of Tortolla with you, one of the children you freed earlier from the Twilight's corruption.$B$BSearch the depths of this cave for a Nemesis Crystal, and allow the young turtle to examine it.$B$BSee me if you lose your companion!
english.completion: Ah yes, yes... the secret strength of Nemesis, unearthed here in these caverns. We know all that we need to know, $n. It is time to finish this.
english.completed: Return to Garunda Mountainpeak within the Crucible.

text.title: 冲破障碍
text.objectives: 在大地治愈者达鲁尝试与奈瑟匹拉交谈时，在一旁观察。
text.description: 训练有素的萨满祭司可以与四种元素交流——大地，火焰，空气和水。这是众所周知的。$b$b但是，不那么众所周知的一件事是，其实还有第五种元素。这种元素的表述不像其它四种那么清晰，它与所有生物都具备的某种共性相关。$b$b我的想法是，既然这只螃蟹是海洋生物，那么它与奈瑟匹拉就有很相似的地方。借助元素的影响，我们可以说服它给奈瑟匹拉当传声筒。
text.completion: I had assumed that the naga were only here for those pearls.  No, this makes much more sense.  If they had Nespirah's power under their control, the amount of damage the naga could do would be catastrophic! Something must be done.
text.end: 与大地治愈者达鲁交谈
text.completed: 去找瓦丝琪尔奈瑟匹拉里面的大地治愈者达鲁。

english.title: Breaking Through
english.objectives: Observe as Earthmender Duarn attempts to speak with Nespirah.
english.description: A trained shaman has the ability to communicate with the four elements of earth, fire, air and water.  This is known.$b$bWhat is not as widely known, however, is the presence of a fifth element.  This element is not as clearly described as the other four, but it has to do with the shared... commonality between all living creatures.$b$bMy theory is that the crab, as a creature of the sea, is close enough to Nespirah that, with the elements' coaxing, we can convince it to act as Nespirah's mouthpiece.
english.completion: I had assumed that the naga were only here for those pearls.  No, this makes much more sense.  If they had Nespirah's power under their control, the amount of damage the naga could do would be catastrophic! Something must be done.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 我们并不孤单
text.objectives: 在瓦丝琪尔的奈瑟匹拉内部找到联盟的幸存者。
text.description: <达鲁闭上眼睛，停顿了一下，然后点了点头。>$b$b奈瑟匹拉刚刚告诉我说，在这片巨壳里面战斗的并不只有我们。有一小队联盟奴隶刚刚逃了出来，正在巨壳的另一边跟纳迦交战。他们的位置在一处可以俯瞰奈瑟匹拉之心的高台上。$b$b去找到他们，$n，看看他们能帮我们什么忙。有了他们的帮助，我们也许就能唤醒奈瑟匹拉了。$b$b如果你需要我的帮助，随时可以回来找我。
text.completion: $N…是你吗？！我以为你和其他人一起死了！$B$B是的，你一直很强，就算当初在赤脊山的时候你就已经很强了。$B$B我们的战斗还未结束，$N。他们曾经攻击过我的家乡。我来到这里就是为了确保这种事情不再发生。$B$B如果你还能像那天一样的战斗，那么就加入我的行列。你可以从南方的雏龙丘陵开始，杀死他们的驭龙者和刚刚孵化的黑龙。$B$B这就像是旧日时光重现。

english.title: We Are Not Alone
english.objectives: Find the Alliance survivors inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.
english.description: <Duarn closes his eyes, pauses, and nods.>$b$bNespirah has just informed me that we are not the only people fighting inside of this shell.  A small group of Alliance slaves has escaped and is currently fighting off the naga on the other side of the shell, up on the ledge that overlooks Nespirah's heart.$b$bGo find them, $n, and see what help they can lend us.  With their aid, we may be able to rouse Nespirah from her torpor.$b$bI will remain here, should you need anything.
english.completion: $n... is that you?

text.title: 手无寸铁
text.objectives: 从奈瑟匹拉里面的武器架上收集4支被盗的长矛。
text.description: 说实话，我都不知道我们是如何撑这么久的。纳迦拿走了我的护甲和武器，只给我留了几件破衣服和一把采矿锄……而且那把锄早就断了。$B$B如果我们还想扳回局面的话，我就需要一些武器装备……我的伙伴们也一样，不过可能他们不太愿意承认这一点。$b$b我在附近的纳迦库房见过武器架。虽然我对三叉戟不是很熟，但用它总比用我自己的拳头好。
text.progress: In my youth, I was given some training on spearfighting. "Stick them with the pointy end," I think it was.
text.completion: Oh, I'm sorry.  I was just imagining what these will look like with little bits of naga stuck to the ends of them.  Thank you, $n.  We'll put these to good use.
text.completed: Return to Admiral Dvorek inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Hopelessly Gearless
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Purloined Polearms from the weapon racks inside of Nespirah.
english.description: I honestly don't know how we've survived this long.  The naga took my armor and weapons, and left me with rags and a mining pick... and THAT snapped in half long ago.$b$bIf we're to stand any hope of turning the tide, I'm going to need something to fight with... as will my companions, though they may be too proud to admit it.$b$bI've seen weapon racks in the naga storage areas nearby.  I'm not accustomed to fighting with a trident, but it'll sure be better than fighting with my fists.
english.progress: In my youth, I was given some training on spearfighting. "Stick them with the pointy end," I think it was.
english.completion: Oh, I'm sorry.  I was just imagining what these will look like with little bits of naga stuck to the ends of them.  Thank you, $n.  We'll put these to good use.
english.completed: Return to Admiral Dvorek inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 刺痛躯体
text.objectives: 在奈瑟匹拉的体腔内的墙上攻击7处奈瑟匹拉脓肿。
text.description: <泰勒上尉仔细听你叙述了达鲁和奈瑟匹拉交谈的经过。>$b$b我明白了。这头巨兽需要我们帮忙唤醒它，对吧？$b$b数以百计的奴隶整天从它体内撬珍珠，它还睡得昏昏沉沉的。不过也许你真的能成功呢。$b$b我的建议？在它露出来的肉上找一处弱点。也许你的武器可以让它的软肉感觉到疼痛，强迫它醒来。
text.completion: Hopefully we made some progress.  I'm not sure how we'll know when the creature wakes up, but something tells me that it will be pretty obvious when it does.
text.completed: Return to Captain Taylor inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Body Blows
english.objectives: Attack 7 Nespirah Abscesses along the walls of Nespirah's body chamber.
english.description: <Captain Taylor listens intently to your recount of Duarn and Nespirah's conversation.>$b$bI see.  So the creature wants our help waking it up, is that it?$b$bWith hundreds of slaves already picking away at her pearls, the beast seems to be a pretty heavy sleeper.  You might have better luck, though.$b$bMy suggestion?  Look around the creature's flesh for signs of weakness.  Maybe that weapon of yours will find a ticklish spot and force the beast to come to its senses.
english.completion: Hopefully we made some progress.  I'm not sure how we'll know when the creature wakes up, but something tells me that it will be pretty obvious when it does.
english.completed: Return to Captain Taylor inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 仍有价值
text.objectives: 从奈瑟匹拉里面的埃卓凯丝督军和埃卓凯丝先知手中夺取5颗神秘的珍珠。
text.description: 被困在珍珠采掘场的短暂日子，使我对纳迦的真正目的感到好奇。对，现在我知道纳迦想要把奈瑟匹拉当成无坚不摧的战争机器，不过如果只有这么简单的话，为什么还要把我们绑去采珍珠？$b$b假如我们能逃出去的话，我倒是很想研究一下这些珍珠。我们在采掘场里找到的珍珠都太大了，搬都没法搬，不过我见过那些督军和先知随身带着小珍珠。
text.progress: The naga must have some ulterior motive with these pearls.  If I had time to study them, I'm certain I could figure it out.
text.completion: Brilliant work! Now I just need you and Captain Taylor to get me safely out of here.  I can handle the studies from there on.
text.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Valoren inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Still Valuable
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Mysterious Pearls from Idra'kess Warlords and Idra'kess Prophets inside of Nespirah.
english.description: My time in the pearl pits, however short, has made me curious about the naga's goals.  Yes, I now know that the naga want to use Nespirah as an engine of war, but if that's the case, then why are they enslaving men to mine her pearls?$b$bAssuming we escape this creature's hull, I would very much like to study these objects.  The pearls we found in the pits were much too large to carry, but I've seen the warlords and prophets occasionally carrying around smaller ones.
english.progress: The naga must have some ulterior motive with these pearls.  If I had time to study them, I'm certain I could figure it out.
english.completion: Brilliant work! Now I just need you and Captain Taylor to get me safely out of here.  I can handle the studies from there on.
english.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Valoren inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 监督者埃卓凯丝
text.objectives: 前往奈瑟匹拉的顶部，杀死监督者埃卓凯丝。
text.description: 我们快要撑不住了，$n。恐怕我们没法再顶住这些纳迦的攻势。有了埃卓凯丝的武器和奈瑟匹拉的珍珠，我们应该可以逃出这里。$b$b沿着东南方的墙走，寻找一条通往上层腔室的坡道。没准那里就是他们的头目的所在地，或者唤醒奈瑟匹拉的关键所在。希望两样都是。$b$b如果你觉得自己够强的话，就到巨壳的顶部去寻找答案吧。
text.completion: No need to bring me up to speed... Nespirah has been narrating your adventures as they happened, and Captain Taylor filled me in on the rest. Nespirah says that she is quite grateful, and that she has a small surprise ready for the naga.
text.completed: Report to Earthmender Duarn near Nespirah's brain in Vashj'ir.
text.giverWindow: 奈瑟匹拉的亵渎者

english.title: Overseer Idra'kess
english.objectives: Head to the top of Nespirah and slay Overseer Idra'kess.
english.description: My men are flagging, $n.  We won't last much longer against these naga, I'm afraid.  With the Idra'kess' weapons, and Nespirah's pearls, we should be ready to bust out of here.$b$bFollow the wall to the southeast, and look for a ramp to the upper chamber.  I assume their leader is in there, or perhaps the key to Nespirah's awakening.  Hopefully both.$b$bIf you feel strong enough, head up to the top of the shell and look for some answers.
english.completion: No need to bring me up to speed... Nespirah has been narrating your adventures as they happened, and Captain Taylor filled me in on the rest. Nespirah says that she is quite grateful, and that she has a small surprise ready for the naga.
english.completed: Report to Earthmender Duarn near Nespirah's brain in Vashj'ir.
english.giverWindow: Desecrator of Nespirah.

text.title: 唤醒巨兽
text.objectives: 与奈瑟匹拉里面的大地治愈者达鲁交谈，激活奈瑟匹拉的生物防御机制，然后逃离奈瑟匹拉的身体。
text.description: 感谢你和泰勒上尉，奈瑟匹拉已经完全控制了自己的身体……但是大部分纳迦还毫不知情呢。等我们逃出去之后，她就会启动自己体内的防御机制，把那些纳迦全都抹掉。$b$b准备好了……我这就让奈瑟匹拉开始倒计时。
text.completion: It appears that I owe you my life, yet again.  Thank the Light that you found me before you and your shaman activated those bio-defenses.
text.completed: Report to Captain Taylor at Tranquil Wash in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Waking the Beast
english.objectives: Speak with Earthmender Duarn inside of Nespirah to activate her bio-defenses, then escape from Nespirah's body.
english.description: Thanks to you and the Captain, Nespirah has full control of her body... but most of the naga don't know this yet.  Once we make our escape, she will activate her biological defenses and destroy the naga from within.$b$bMake yourself ready... I will now tell Nespirah to begin the countdown.
english.completion: It appears that I owe you my life, yet again.  Thank the Light that you found me before you and your shaman activated those bio-defenses.
english.completed: Report to Captain Taylor at Tranquil Wash in Vashj'ir.

objectiveDetails.description: 听达鲁与奈瑟匹拉谈话
乘坐埃鲁纳克的海马逃走

text.title: 消灭涅墨西斯
text.objectives: 使用托尔托拉图腾，在托尔托拉之子的帮助下打败涅墨西斯。若是失去了乌龟同伴就去找加仑达·山峰。
text.description: 你的乌龟同伴可以用这新习得的力量，让你们俩短时间内进入无敌状态。你可以“龟缩”起来，以躲开涅墨西斯最可怕的招数。做起来很简单，只要使用这根图腾就可以了。$B$B我能为你做的就这些了。你和托尔托拉之子一起，一定要永远地消灭涅墨西斯。除掉这个篡神者！$B$B如果你失去了乌龟朋友，就来找我。
text.completion: The usurper has perished! Twilight's Hammer dreamed of creating their own pantheon of twisted ancients to rule over the land, sea, and air. With your help, they've all been executed. We must tell Tortolla at once!
text.completed: Return to Garunda Mountainpeak within the Crucible.
text.giverWindow: 使用你的图腾和乌龟伙伴来抵挡他的喷吐攻击。这个伪神必须被消灭！
text.giverTarget: 篡位的复仇之神，涅墨西斯

english.title: Finish Nemesis
english.objectives: Use the Totem of Tortolla and the help of a Child of Tortolla to defeat Nemesis. See Garunda Mountainpeak if you lose your turtle companion.
english.description: Your turtle companion can use this newfound power to render the two of you invulnerable for a short period of time. You can "turtle up" to avoid the worst of Nemesis and his fury. To do so, simply invoke this totem.$B$BThis is all I can do for you. Together, you and a Child of Tortolla must defeat Nemesis, once and for all. Finish the Usurper!$B$BReturn to me if you lose your turtle friend.
english.completion: The usurper has perished! Twilight's Hammer dreamed of creating their own pantheon of twisted ancients to rule over the land, sea, and air. With your help, they've all been executed. We must tell Tortolla at once!
english.completed: Return to Garunda Mountainpeak within the Crucible.
english.giverWindow: Use your totem and turtle companion to withstand his eruption attack. The false God must be destroyed!

text.title: 使命召唤
text.objectives: 乘坐雇佣船只参加战斗。
text.description: 听好了，$r！$b$b一块新的陆地出现在了东部王国的海岸边！一场争夺这座岛屿控制权的战斗已经爆发。$B$B如果能在这场战斗中获胜，暴风城就将门户洞开！$b$b这正是发动进攻的好机会！$b$b立即到码头上去报到，准备搭乘运输船参加战斗。$b$b所有的战舰都已经离港参战了，所以你要乘坐雇来的运输船前往目的地，那艘船可是酋长亲自委任的。
text.completion: Not exactly the battle you had anticipated, I'll wager. But a battle nonetheless, as you shall soon see....
text.end: 乘坐雇佣船只前往瓦丝琪尔
text.completed: Speak with Erunak in The Immortal Coil.

english.title: Call of Duty
english.objectives: Ride the mercenary ship to battle.
english.description: Listen up, $r!$b$bA new landmass has emerged off the coast of Eastern Kingdoms and we are engaged in a critical battle for control of the island!$b$bVictory there will leave Stormwind completely defenseless!$b$bNow is the time to strike!$b$bReport to the docks at once for transport to the battle.$b$bEvery warship is engaged, so you'll be boarding a mercenary vessel commissioned by the Warchief himself.
english.completion: Not exactly the battle you had anticipated, I'll wager. But a battle nonetheless, as you shall soon see....
english.end: Ride the mercenary ship to Vashj'ir
english.completed: Speak with Erunak in The Immortal Coil.

objectiveDetails.description: 乘坐雇佣船只前往瓦丝琪尔

text.title: 萨达拉的复仇
text.objectives: 在战痕谷杀死20名部落战士，摧毁3台克罗姆加攻城车。
text.description: 我们必须同南边的远望角建立联系。我们的达纳苏斯投刃车听你调遣，$n。用它们在不断推进的部落大军中杀出一条通往远望角的血路来。$B$B我只希望我们不要到得太晚。要是远望角还没有被摧毁，就去找圣职者玛莱克，把我们的情况告诉他。
text.completion: We witnessed the detonation of the bomb. Terrible, terrible destruction... Farwatcher Glen, for better or for worse, is still intact. Unfortunately we've nowhere to run.
text.completed: Report to Hierophant Malyk at Farwatcher Glen in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Thal'darah's Vengeance
english.objectives: Kill 20 Horde soldiers and destroy 3 Krom'gar Demolishers in Battlescar Valley.
english.description: We must attempt to establish communication with Farwatcher Glen, to the south. Our Darnassian glaive throwers are at your disposal, $n. Use them to cut a swath through the encroaching Horde forces and clear a path to Farwatcher Glen.$B$BI only hope we're not too late to save the Glen. Should Farwatcher Glen be intact, find Hierophant Malyk and inform him of our status.
english.completion: We witnessed the detonation of the bomb. Terrible, terrible destruction... Farwatcher Glen, for better or for worse, is still intact. Unfortunately we've nowhere to run.
english.completed: Report to Hierophant Malyk at Farwatcher Glen in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 深陷仇恨
text.objectives: 杀掉10头腐败的沼泽兽。
text.description: 西边的沼泽兽并非我的同胞……他们是大地失调的症兆，是腐烂污秽的外在表现。$B$B你不会明白的……它们占据我族的形体，用腐败的孢子侵蚀内部，排挤沼泽繁荣的生命。它们消蚀一切，只留下朽坏。什么都不剩，什么都不剩！$B$B抚慰我的心灵，$r。杀掉那些沼泽兽，清洁这片大地，或许我的心灵才能得以平静。
text.completion: Ahhh... yes. The swamp suffers less now. More threats, though. More lurk. I can see them!
text.completed: Return to Rethiel the Greenwarden at Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands.

english.title: Mired in Hatred
english.objectives: Kill 10 Mouldering Mirebeasts.
english.description: The mirebeasts to the west are not my brethren... they are symptoms of the earth's disturbance, a foulness of rot given form.$B$BYou would not understand... they take the shape of my kind, infested within with decaying spores, forcing out flourished life in the swamp. They take all and leave only rot. Nothing left, nothing left!$B$BSoothe my mind, $r. Slay the mirebeasts, cleanse the land, and perhaps my mind will settle.
english.completion: Ahhh... yes. The swamp suffers less now. More threats, though. More lurk. I can see them!
english.completed: Return to Rethiel the Greenwarden at Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands.

text.title: 火焰的威胁
text.objectives: 摧毁8只狂暴火元素。
text.description: 火焰已经威胁了我太久了……太久了……不再是星星火苗，不再是无足轻重……$B$B土地在燃烧！山丘和高地在嘶号，$r，在嘶号。元素给这里的生命带来的只有毁灭。$B$B他们不能这样，不能这样。阻止它们。阻止他们！摧毁这些火焰使者……
text.completion: Yes... the flames die. There is peace now. Peace for the land.
text.completed: Return to Rethiel the Greenwarden at Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands.

english.title: The Threat of Flame
english.objectives: Kill 8 Rampant Fire Elementals.
english.description: Flame has threatened me for far too long... far too long... but it is no longer the little ones, no longer mere gnats...$B$BThe fields burn! The hills and highlands scream, $r, they scream. The elementals brought here consume all life in their wake.$B$BThey cannot stand, they cannot stand. Stop them. STOP THEM! Destroy the bringers of flame...
english.completion: Yes... the flames die. There is peace now. Peace for the land.
english.completed: Return to Rethiel the Greenwarden at Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands.

text.title: 托尔托拉的胜利
text.objectives: 用火焰之门回到海加尔山焦痕平原的托尔托拉那里。
text.description: 我会把托尔托拉之子送出去，然后封闭这被诅咒的传送门。$B$B把捷报递给托尔托拉的事情就交给你了。穿过火焰之门就可以回去。古神一定会非常高兴的！
text.completion: You've been to the firelands? Nemesis is dead? So it is finished. Thank you.
text.completed: 穿过火焰之门回到海加尔山焦痕平原，去找托尔托拉。

english.title: Tortolla's Triumph
english.objectives: Step back through the flamegate and return to Tortolla at the Scorched Plain in Hyjal.
english.description: I'll escort the children of Tortolla out of here and seal up this accursed portal.$B$BI'll leave it to you to inform Tortolla of our victory. Simply step back through the flamegate. The ancient will be pleased!
english.completion: You've been to the firelands? Nemesis is dead? So it is finished. Thank you.
english.completed: Step back through the flamegate and return to Tortolla at the Scorched Plain in Hyjal.

text.title: 告别晕船
text.objectives: 收集3条咸水海星，并从军团之劫带回1个海螺壳。
text.description: 幸会，$c。$b$b我是埃鲁纳克，是这艘大船的幸存者。$b$b你要经历的艰难才刚刚开始。纳迦一直在这片水域里搜寻，攻击那些一息尚存的士兵。$b$b虽然以你现在这身装备，很难在这里存活，但是我可以帮助你改进。$b$b这里附近生活着一种奇特的海星。将它们以及一个海螺壳带回来给我。这样我就能施展法术，让你尽快适应这里的环境。
text.progress: Were you able to gather the items I requested, $r?
text.completion: Here you are, $c. With this you should find maneuvering in the sea to be nearly effortless. Now we must get to work. There is much to be done in little time.
text.completed: Speak with Erunak at The Immortal Coil.

english.title: Sea Legs
english.objectives: Collect 3 Saltwater Starfish and a Conch Shell from the Sea Floor at Legion's Fate.
english.description: Greetings, $c. I am Erunak, a fellow survivor of this savagery.$b$bI'm afraid your travails have only just begun. The naga have been scouring these waters, attacking anyone that still lives.$b$bYou are not yet equipped to survive here, but I can remedy that.$b$bJust outside this ship live a special breed of starfish. Bring me some of them along with a conch shell. I'll prepare an enchantment that should help you grow accustomed to your environment.
english.progress: Were you able to gather the items I requested, $r?
english.completion: Here you are, $c. With this you should find maneuvering in the sea to be nearly effortless. Now we must get to work. There is much to be done in little time.
english.completed: Speak with Erunak at The Immortal Coil.

text.title: 飞上山谷
text.objectives: 使用沙尔斯巴里的火箭包飞到焦炭谷的火山上。
text.description: 我听说在地壳大变动之前，焦炭谷曾是一道溪谷，通往大海。现在只要朝南边看一看，就能明白焦炭谷不再是什么溪谷，事实上已经变成了一个火山活跃地区。$B$B沙尔斯巴里准备了一个装置，可以让我们飞上火山。用它前往山顶，评估一下事态。$B$B我会用这个侏儒通讯器和你保持联络，它也是好心的沙尔斯巴里送给我的。
text.completion: I say, are you there, $n? It would appear that you are in the center of a dragon's lair.

english.title: Ascending the Vale
english.objectives: Use Salsbury's Rocket Pack to ascend the Charred Vale's volcano.
english.description: I am told that before the great upheaval the Charred Vale was a valley, closed off to the sea. One has merely to look to the south to see that the Charred Vale is no longer a valley and in fact has become an area of great volcanic activity.$B$BSalsbury here has configured a device that will allow us to ascend the volcano. Use it to get to the top and assess the goings on.$B$BI will keep in touch with this Gnomecorder device, which Salsbury has so kindly gifted upon me.
english.completion: I say, are you there, $n? It would appear that you are in the center of a dragon's lair.

text.title: 瑟达利亚的子嗣
text.objectives: 破坏5枚瑟达利亚的卵。
text.description: <侏儒通讯器嗡嗡地响着。>$B$B要非常小心，$n。你可不想惊动黑龙。$B$B现在，四下看看。假如你能找到一座巢穴，那附近就一定会有黑龙蛋。寻找那些可能存在的蛋，看见一个砸一个。$B$B等你找到并摧毁瑟达利亚的卵后，就回来找我。$B$B愿戈德林眷顾你。
text.completion: A smashing success! Perhaps only a minor victory against the brood of Deathwing, but a victory nonetheless!
text.completed: Return to Hierophant Malyk at Farwatcher's Glen in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.giverWindow: 登山时务必小心。一旦失足跌落，后果不堪设想。

english.title: Brood of Seldarria
english.objectives: Destroy 5 of Seldarria's Eggs.
english.description: <The Gnomecorder buzzes.>$B$BBe very careful, $n. You do not want to rouse that black dragon.$B$BNow, look around you. If this is a nest then there must be black dragon eggs nearby. Search the premises for eggs and destroy any that you see.$B$BReturn to me should you find and destroy Seldarria's eggs.$B$BGoldrinn watch over you.
english.completion: A smashing success! Perhaps only a minor victory against the brood of Deathwing, but a victory nonetheless!
english.completed: Return to Hierophant Malyk at Farwatcher's Glen in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.giverWindow: Maintain caution.  A misstep here could be disastrous.

text.title: 每天晚上都来袭
text.objectives: 帮助火锤中士和他的巡山人防御冻石农场，抵挡住霜鬃袭击者的进攻。
text.description: 我送给萨兰恩队长的报告并不能完全表述霜鬃巨魔对我们造成的麻烦。你对村子的进攻已经开始减轻我们的压力。袭击还是很频繁，但巨魔们的数量明显不如以往。$B$B即便如此，我的人还是精疲力竭，士气低迷。你能不能帮我们看着点霜鬃袭击者？他们随时都可能出现。
text.completion: With your help, we've managed to weaken the raiders considerably. They haven't suffered such losses since the raids began. Now is the time to press our advantage.

english.title: It's Raid Night Every Night
english.objectives: Help Sergeant Flinthammer and his mountaineers defend Amberstill Ranch from Frostmane Raiders.
english.description: The reports I'm sending Captain Tharran can't really convey the amount of trouble the Frostmanes have created for us. Your assault on the village has started to relieve some of the pressure. The raids are still frequent, but the trolls don't have the numbers they once did.$B$BEven so, my men are tired and their morale is flagging. Would you help us keep watch for the Frostmane raiders? They could turn up at any time.
english.completion: With your help, we've managed to weaken the raiders considerably. They haven't suffered such losses since the raids began. Now is the time to press our advantage.

text.title: 支援采石场
text.objectives: 跟古博拉采掘场的工头乔尼·石眉谈一谈。
text.description: 再次谢谢你的帮助，$n。$B$B我有个表亲本是古博拉采掘场的矿工，自从石腭怪霸占了采石场后，他也就没法作业了。采掘场以及矿工营地就在农场的东南方。你可以去那里跟工头了解一下情况，看看能不能帮上忙吗？
text.completion: Sergeant Flinthammer? I'm not familiar with the name, but, aye, there is a Flinthammer among the miners. He's one of the ones lucky enough to make it out of the mine, but most of my men are still trapped down there.

english.title: Help for the Quarry
english.objectives: Speak to Foreman Stonebrow at the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
english.description: Thank you again for all your help here, $n.$B$BI have a cousin who used to work in the mines beneath the Gol'Bolar Quarry, but he hasn't been able to work since troggs flooded into the mines and took control. The quarry and its camp are just to the southeast of the ranch. Would you be willing to check in with the foreman there and see if there's anything to be done?
english.completion: Sergeant Flinthammer? I'm not familiar with the name, but, aye, there is a Flinthammer among the miners. He's one of the ones lucky enough to make it out of the mine, but most of my men are still trapped down there.

text.title: 世界首位：狼侏儒
text.objectives: 收集1颗燃焰之心。
text.description: 你好啊，公民，请允许我自我介绍一下。我叫沙尔斯巴里，很快就将成为世界上第一个狼侏儒。玛莱克保证只要我完成工作，他就将狼人的天赋赐予我。$B$B介绍就进行到这里，我有个请求！$B$B在南边的焦炭谷里，游荡着新生的火元素。我迫切需要从这些魔鬼身上获得一颗燃焰之心。帮我去弄一颗来，你就让我在前往狼侏儒之路上更进了一步！
text.progress: Have you recovered the blazing heart of fire?
text.completion: Excellent. This will allow me to finish my last task and hopefully gain the form of the wolf!
text.completed: Return to Salsbury the ï¿½Helpï¿½ at Farwatcher's Glen in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: World First: Gnomegen
english.objectives: Collect 1 Blazing Heart of Fire.
english.description: Good day, citizen, allow me to introduce myself. I am Salsbury, soon to be the world's first gnomegen. Malyk has assured me that as soon as my work here is complete he will grant me the gift of the worgen.$B$BSo with the introduction out of the way, I've a request!$B$BWithin the Charred Vale, south of here, roam newly created fire elementals. I desperately need a rare blazing heart of fire from one of the fiends. Get it for me and you bring me one step closer to becoming a gnomegen!
english.progress: Have you recovered the blazing heart of fire?
english.completion: Excellent. This will allow me to finish my last task and hopefully gain the form of the wolf!
english.completed: Return to Salsbury the ï¿½Helpï¿½ at Farwatcher's Glen in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 饥饿的小狗
text.objectives: 收集6块黑龙幼兽肉片。
text.description: 啊，一个新来的！很高兴你能来，$g小伙子:姑娘;！小狗们都饿了，我们根本没吃的。$B$B还好他们喜欢龙肉，碰巧这在南边的焦炭谷还真不缺。$B$B做个好孩子，给我搞几磅黑龙幼兽肉片来。
text.progress: Hurry, $n, the pups are hungry!
text.completion: Excellent. The dogs will be well fed and ready to defend our outpost for weeks!
text.completed: Return to Houndmaster Jonathan at Farwatcher's Glen in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Hungry Pups
english.objectives: Collect 6 Black Dragon Whelp Filets.
english.description: Ah, a new arrival! Good that you're here $g lad:lass;! The pups are hungry and we're completely out of food.$B$BThankfully they love dragon meat, which fortuitously exists in abundance within the Charred Vale, south of here.$B$BBe a good $g boy:girl; and fetch me several pounds of black dragon whelp filet.
english.progress: Hurry, $n, the pups are hungry!
english.completion: Excellent. The dogs will be well fed and ready to defend our outpost for weeks!
english.completed: Return to Houndmaster Jonathan at Farwatcher's Glen in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 回馈恩情
text.objectives: 使用附魔海螺壳营救6名溺水的战士。
text.description: 现在你可以在水域里自由行动，也不用担心被淹死了。$b$b那么开始做正事吧。$b$b首先，很多士兵都面临溺亡的危险。我救了你，你也应该向他们伸出援手。$b$b我在这个海螺壳上施加了法术。用它来搭救你的朋友吧。$b$b快点！
text.completion: While you were away, I was able to revive some of the fallen warriors. We'll need every hand if we are to survive here.
text.completed: Speak to Erunak in The Immortal Coil.

english.title: Pay It Forward
english.objectives: Use the Enchanted Conch to rescue 6 Drowning Warriors.
english.description: You are now able to move about this realm more freely and without fear of drowning.$b$bThis is where our work begins.$b$bFirst, you have many allies nearby who are drowning as we speak. As I saved you, you must save them.$b$bI have enchanted the shell you brought me. Use it to rescue your friends.$b$bHurry now!
english.completion: While you were away, I was able to revive some of the fallen warriors. We'll need every hand if we are to survive here.
english.completed: Speak to Erunak in The Immortal Coil.

text.title: 无价之宝
text.objectives: 从古博拉采掘场矿洞里获得8个冰封的圣物。
text.description: 你知道，采矿并不是采掘场里唯一的工作。我正带领一队探险者协会挖掘者发掘无价的上古圣物。$B$B我成功地逃了出来，但是我的同事们位于矿洞更深的地方，他们在穴居人的第一波攻击时就丧生了。$B$B他们以自己的工作为荣，为了了解我们的历史赌上了性命。如果你要到矿洞里去的话，带上这把锹，看你是不是能在勘察员开挖的地方找到些什么。
text.progress: Were you able to find any artifacts down there?
text.completion: Thank you for recovering these artifacts. I will see to it that they are displayed in the Ironforge museum along with the story of those who died to recover them.
text.completed: Return to Prospector Drugan at the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

english.title: Priceless Treasures
english.objectives: Recover 8 Frozen Artifacts from inside the Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine.
english.description: Mining wasn't the only thing going on in the quarry, you know.
