Kill Queen Silith and her little spiderlings? For Darn? For Darn's mate!$B$BWebwinder Hollow is northwest of here, up the path. Go!
english.completion: Darn still not very happy, but Darn will reward you for what you have done.
english.completed: Return to Darn Talongrip at the Horde blockade in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 为了他们的肚子而战
text.objectives: 收集8枚卡利姆多鹰蛋。
text.description: 部队都饿了，$n。补给线被掐，我们逐渐弹尽粮绝。只要你给我找到食材，我就能给士兵们煮一顿盛宴。$B$B到西边的林子里找卡利姆多鹰巢，把蛋偷来给我。
text.progress: I need eggs!
text.completion: Thank you, $n. These eggs should get us through the week.
text.completed: Return to Denni'ka at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Fight On Their Stomachs
english.objectives: Collect 8 Kalimdor Eagle Eggs.
english.description: The troops are hungry, $n. With our supply lines cut off, we're steadily running out of food. I can cook the soldiers a feast if you can get me some ingredients.$B$BHead into the woods west of here and look for Kalimdor eagle nests. Steal the eggs from the nests and bring them back to me.
english.progress: I need eggs!
english.completion: Thank you, $n. These eggs should get us through the week.
english.completed: Return to Denni'ka at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 释放维尔哈伊
text.objectives: 杀死所有的恐怖触须，释放维尔哈伊。
text.description: 从深渊中伸出的恐怖触须将那只可怜的野兽困住了。$n，你可以杀死它们，挽救困兽吗？$B$B救救维尔哈伊吧。$B$B来，带上我的图腾，将它插在触须附近。图腾催生的寒流可以让这些怪物剧烈地收缩，然后你就能轻松地干掉它们了。
text.completion: Thank you, $n.$B$BThese nightmarish creatures that rise from below give me pause. I fear that our efforts will be for nothing.
text.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Valoren at the Nightmare Depths in Vashj'ir.
text.giverWindow: 释放维尔哈伊

english.title: Free Wil'hai
english.objectives: Slay all of the Tentacle Horrors to free Wil'hai.
english.description: Those tentacle horrors rising from the depths have trapped that poor beast. Please, $n, can you save it by destroying those things?$B$BWill you free Wil'hai?$B$BHere, take my totem and plant it near the tentacles. The cold it emanates will cause major shrinkage on those monsters and then you'll be able to destroy them.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.$B$BThese nightmarish creatures that rise from below give me pause. I fear that our efforts will be for nothing.
english.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Valoren at the Nightmare Depths in Vashj'ir.
english.giverWindow: Free Wil'hai

text.title: 援兵……
text.objectives: 用征服者德沃的鞭子抽服6名滚岩狗头人。
text.description: 我们似乎没有又大又蠢的兽人可以往战场上派了。这是一个问题。好在，我也许有办法解决。$B$B拿上这根鞭子到西边的滚岩洞穴里去，你可以找到一座脏兮兮的狗头人巢穴。用我的鞭子把那些畜生打服帖。一旦被征服，我们说什么他们就得做什么。$B$B你召集一支狗头人大军后就回来找我。
text.completion: In times of crisis, a desperate act may be all that is needed to secure victory. Sending a swarm of kobolds at the enemy may be the edge that we need to win.
text.completed: Return to Subjugator Devo at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Reinforcements...
english.objectives: Use Subjugator Devo's Whip to Subdue 6 Boulderslide Kobolds.
english.description: It would appear as if we are running out of big, stupid orcs to send at the enemy. This is a problem. Thankfully, I may have a solution.$B$BTake this whip and head west to Boulderslide Cavern. Within the cave you will find a filthy nest of kobolds. Use my whip to subdue the beasts. Once subdued they will do whatever we ask them to do.$B$BReturn to me when you have amassed a sizable army of kobolds.
english.completion: In times of crisis, a desperate act may be all that is needed to secure victory. Sending a swarm of kobolds at the enemy may be the edge that we need to win.
english.completed: Return to Subjugator Devo at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 金吉尔的祝福
text.objectives: 使用金吉尔的巫毒棒在12名克罗姆加掠夺者身上施下巫毒。
text.description: 啊，完成了！现在做一下测试。$B$B到巨木谷主战场去，在与恐怖图腾交战的克罗姆加掠夺者身上使用我的巫毒棒。我的巫毒魔法可以重振他们的勇气，让他们将敌人碾碎！$B$B立刻出发，$n！
text.completion: Victory, at last! Though it stands to reason that without a stable supply line this victory will be short lived. Enjoy it while it lasts, $n.
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Jin'Zil's Blessing
english.objectives: Use Jin'Zil's Voodoo Stick to infuse 12 Krom'gar Marauders with Voodoo.
english.description: Ah, it is done! Now to test it out.$B$BTravel to the main point of conflict within Greatwood Vale and use my voodoo stick on the Krom'gar marauders battling the Grimtotem. My voodoo magic should renew their vigor and allow them to crush our enemies!$B$BGo now, $n!
english.completion: Victory, at last! Though it stands to reason that without a stable supply line this victory will be short lived. Enjoy it while it lasts, $n.
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 狗头人之怒！
text.objectives: 在不毛之地的部落军旗旁使用狗头人战争号角，释放狗头人大军！
text.description: 现在石爪山狗头人军队听我们的指挥！听上去还挺可观。听上去是的。$B$B<德沃叹了口气。>$B$B联盟在北边的营地严防死守，几乎难以攻破，把守着东北不毛之地的要冲。带上这只狗头人战争号角，到不毛之地去。从东边杀进去，$n！到达我在你地图上所标记的位置后，就朝西走。用这只号角将狗头人之怒释放在联盟头上！
text.completion: Fascinating tale, friend. It would seem that our newfound kobold allies might be somewhat useful after all!
text.completed: 去找石爪山脉玛拉卡金的征服者德沃。

english.title: Kobold Fury!
english.objectives: Use the Kobold War Horn near the Horde Banner at the Unearthed Grounds to unleash the Kobold Army!
english.description: We now command the kobold armies of Stonetalon! It almost sounds impressive. Almost.$B$B<Devo sighs.>$B$BThe Alliance base camp north of here is tightly guarded. It is nigh impregnable, save for the entry point by the Unearthed Grounds, northeast of here. Take this kobold war horn and head towards the Unearthed Grounds. Enter from the east, $n! Once there, head west until you arrive at the location I have marked upon your map. Use the horn there to unleash kobold fury upon the Alliance!
english.completion: Fascinating tale, friend. It would seem that our newfound kobold allies might be somewhat useful after all!
english.completed: Return to Subjugator Devo at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 探路者鲁娜
text.objectives: 去找南贫瘠之地高地之路的探路者鲁娜
text.description: 南贫瘠之地正遭到联盟的攻打。牛头人派人来求救，我们不能置之不理。部落所有还具备战斗力的士兵都要前去增援。$B$B你要是想帮忙，从村子里上高地之路，去找探路者鲁娜。
text.completion: The situation is grim, $r. We need all of the help that we can get!

english.title: Nura Pathfinder
english.objectives: Report to Nura Pathfinder on the High Road in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Southern Barrens is under attack by the Alliance. The tauren have sent out a call for help that we simply cannot ignore. All able bodied soldiers of the Horde should assist.$B$BIf you wish to help, take the path to the High Road, located in the village. Seek out Nura Pathfinder.
english.completion: The situation is grim, $r. We need all of the help that we can get!

text.title: 清理被腐蚀的生物
text.objectives: 杀死任意8只碾压巨鳗、深海鮣魚或是海沟猎手。
text.description: 大地之环的朋友希望我们能伸出援手。火烟海沟里的无面者恶魔正在腐蚀海洋里的生物。$B$B能帮我除掉它们吗？
text.completion: Good enough for me. Don't get too complacent, $n. The hard part's about to come.
text.completed: Return to Captain Taylor atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Clearing the Defiled
english.objectives: Slay any 8 Crushing Eels, Deep Remoras, or Chasm Stalkers.
english.description: Our Earthen Ring friends here are wondering if we can lend them a hand. There are faceless down below in the Scalding Chasm that are defiling all of the wildlife.$B$BCan you take care of that for me?
english.completion: Good enough for me. Don't get too complacent, $n. The hard part's about to come.
english.completed: Return to Captain Taylor atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

objectiveDetails.description: 被污染的火烟海沟生物

text.title: 清理被腐蚀的生物
text.objectives: 杀死任意8只碾压巨鳗、深海鮣魚或是海沟猎手。
text.description: 大地之环的朋友希望我们能帮忙清理祸患。火烟海沟里的无面者恶魔正在腐蚀海洋里的生物。$B$B游下去，帮我除掉它们。
text.completion: Well done.$B$BDon't get too full of yourself, $n. The hard part's about to come.
text.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Clearing the Defiled
english.objectives: Slay any 8 Crushing Eels, Deep Remoras, or Chasm Stalkers.
english.description: These Earthen Ring want us to do their killing for them. There are faceless down below in the Scalding Chasm that are defiling all of the wildlife.$B$BSwim down there and take care of it.
english.completion: Well done.$B$BDon't get too full of yourself, $n. The hard part's about to come.
english.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

objectiveDetails.description: 被污染的火烟海沟生物

text.title: 图腾的威力
text.objectives: 在限制图腾的范围内消灭5个腐蚀无面者。
text.description: 带上我的图腾潜入火烟海沟。消灭无面者，并使用图腾汲取它们的能量。图腾会防止它们回流到远处。$B$B吸满能量后，将图腾带回来给我。我们可以借助它引诱出藏匿在海底的无面者首领。
text.completion: Yes, $r, can you feel them seething with a desire to break free and destroy us?$B$BThis is good! They will be the perfect lure for their leader.
text.completed: Return to Erunak Stonespeaker atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Into the Totem
english.objectives: Slay 5 Faceless Defilers while they are within range of the Confinement Totem.
english.description: You must take my totem down into the Scalding Chasm. Use it to capture the energies of the faceless as they die. The totem will keep them from returning from whence they came.$B$BWhen the totem is full, bring it back to me and we will use it to lure their leader up from deep down below.
english.completion: Yes, $r, can you feel them seething with a desire to break free and destroy us?$B$BThis is good! They will be the perfect lure for their leader.
english.completed: Return to Erunak Stonespeaker atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

objectiveDetails.description: 限制腐蚀无面者的能量

text.title: 南线无战事
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉克罗姆加壁垒的克罗姆加大王。
text.description: 现在回到克罗姆加大王那边去，$n。告诉他我们的战况，以及你为保卫玛拉卡金不致失陷所做的一切。$B$B为这些我们感谢你。也许不久有一天你将会有自己的属地。
text.completion: Lok'tar ogar! You are the embodiment of what it means to be a Horde soldier, $n. If only we had more like you, this war would be over and Kalimdor would belong to the Horde - UNCONTESTED! Rise now as a champion of Krom'gar!

english.title: All's Quiet on the Southern Front
english.objectives: Report to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Return now to Overlord Krom'gar, $n. Inform him of our status and of what you have done to ensure that Malaka'jin does not fall.$B$BWe thank you for all that you have done. Perhaps some day soon you will have your own region to command.
english.completion: Lok'tar ogar! You are the embodiment of what it means to be a Horde soldier, $n. If only we had more like you, this war would be over and Kalimdor would belong to the Horde - UNCONTESTED! Rise now as a champion of Krom'gar!

text.title: 终结的开始
text.objectives: 护送克罗姆加热气球前往石爪山脉的油污潭。
text.description: 勇士，我们有了一个新目标。我们在战痕谷的斥候报告说，暗夜精灵正在准备他们的大规模杀伤性武器，并将它藏在一棵古树中。绝对不能让他们有机会对我们使用这件武器。$B$B你要护送炸弹前往油污潭进行加油，然后到峭壁行者哨站，我们将在那里引爆炸弹，杀掉所有的敌人。$B$B现在出发，$n。抵达油污潭之后就去找吉卜力·拉吉特。
text.completion: Krom'gar has sent his champion! Well you haven't a thing to worry about, Champion. We'll get the balloon all fueled up in no time. How about you lend a hand around here while you wait?
text.completed: Report to Jibbly Rakit at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Beginning of the End
english.objectives: Take the Krom'gar Hot Air Balloon to the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Champion, we have acquired a new target. Our scouts in Battlescar Valley report that the night elves are preparing their own weapon of mass destruction and hiding it within an ancient tree. They will never be given the chance to use their weapon against us.$B$BYou are to escort the bomb to the Sludgewerks for refueling and then to Cliffwalker Post, from which we will detonate the bomb and kill all of our enemies.$B$BGo now, $n. Report to Jibbly Rakit when you arrive at the Sludgewerks.
english.completion: Krom'gar has sent his champion! Well you haven't a thing to worry about, Champion. We'll get the balloon all fueled up in no time. How about you lend a hand around here while you wait?
english.completed: Report to Jibbly Rakit at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.

objectiveDetails.description: 安全护送克罗姆加热气球到油污潭

text.title: 粪便问题
text.objectives: 消灭任意6头巨翼双足飞龙。
text.description: 我们有个小麻烦……$B$B<吉卜力指着覆盖基地的巨大粪便说。>$B$B我们把油污潭建得离飞龙栖息地太近了。如今我们在重新起草油污潭的蓝图，以便不打扰这些显然对牛头人和兽人来说十分神圣的野兽。你知道对我来说什么是神圣的吗？别把屎拉在头上，这就是！$B$B天知地知你知我知，飞龙一定得死！
text.completion: I sure hope you didn't miss any. I don't think I can take much more of this!
text.completed: Return to Jibbly Rakit at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: The Turd Problem
english.objectives: Kill any 6 Pridewing Wyvern.
english.description: We have a little problem...$B$B<Jibbly points to the large turds covering the base.>$B$BWe built the Sludgewerks near a wyvern habitat. Now our initial blueprints for the Sludgewerks were drawn up so as not to disturb the wyvern habitat as the beasts are apparently sacred to tauren and orcs. Do you know what's sacred to me? Not getting pooped on, that's what!$B$BBetween you, me and the wall, the wyvern must die!
english.completion: I sure hope you didn't miss any. I don't think I can take much more of this!
english.completed: Return to Jibbly Rakit at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 间谍横行
text.objectives: 杀死8名联盟间谍。用吉卜力的气弹找到他们！
text.description: 我们有了另一个麻烦，$n。联盟间谍到处都是！你没看见吗？那是因为他们藏起来了！隐身了！我有个办法，但需要像你这样的打手来执行。$B$B用这气弹来暴露隐身的间谍。一旦他们显形，就送他们上西天。$B$B你可以从空气中的扭曲发现这些匿踪的间谍。瞧仔细些！
text.completion: And they called me crazy. I knew this place was crawling with spies. Poop too.
text.completed: Return to Jibbly Rakit at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Spy Infestation
english.objectives: Kill 8 Alliance Spies. Use Jibbly's Gas Bomb to uncloak the spies!
english.description: We've got another problem, $n. Alliance spies are all over the place! You haven't seen any? That's because they're invisible! Cloaked! I have a solution, but I need muscle like you to go out there and follow through with my plan.$B$BUse this gas bomb on the cloaked spies and it will reveal them. Once revealed, send them back to their maker.$B$BYou'll know a cloaked spy by the effect they leave in the air. Look closely!
english.completion: And they called me crazy. I knew this place was crawling with spies. Poop too.
english.completed: Return to Jibbly Rakit at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 最后交货
text.objectives: 将克罗姆加热气球驶往石爪山脉的峭壁行者哨站。
text.description: 克罗姆加大王从大本营送话过来了。你得回到克罗姆加热气球上，把它开到峭壁行者哨站去。计划是在那里将炸弹投放到战痕谷的联盟头上。$B$B你最好赶紧出发，$n，让克罗姆加久等可不是好主意。$B$B抵达目的地后，就跟格雷勃将军谈谈。他可以给你介绍下一阶段的行动。
text.completion: Chieftain Cliffwalker and his tauren seek to commit treason against the Horde! They claim that the ancient tree at the heart of Battlescar Valley is merely a school for druids. They are blind to the fact that desperate measures are taken during war time. My scouts have assured me that the night elves hide a weapon of great power within that tree. We're going to end this now!
text.completed: Report to General Grebo at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Final Delivery
english.objectives: Take the Krom'gar Hot Air Balloon to Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Overlord Krom'gar sends word from the base. You are to get back on the Krom'gar hot air balloon and take it to Cliffwalker Post. From there, the plan is to unleash the payload on the Alliance at Battlescar Valley.$B$BYou better get going, $n. It's not wise to keep Krom'gar waiting.$B$BSpeak to General Grebo when you arrive at your destination. He'll be able to brief you on the next course of action.
english.completion: Chieftain Cliffwalker and his tauren seek to commit treason against the Horde! They claim that the ancient tree at the heart of Battlescar Valley is merely a school for druids. They are blind to the fact that desperate measures are taken during war time. My scouts have assured me that the night elves hide a weapon of great power within that tree. We're going to end this now!
english.completed: Report to General Grebo at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

objectiveDetails.description: 将克罗姆加热气球驶往峭壁行者哨站

text.title: 灭火
text.objectives: 使用灭火装置，扑灭铁炉堡飞行器机坪的6处大火。
text.description: 黑铁矮人出其不意地偷袭了我们。黑铁破坏者摧毁了不少飞行器、蒸汽坦克以及物资储备。我们好不容易才保住了几架轰炸机。$B$B所有的技师、新兵和守卫都上了战场，想要尽快修理被破坏的地面以及空中装置。步兵团也坚持不了多久了。带上这件装置，帮助我们扑灭大火吧。
text.progress: We need to hurry and get those bombers airborne!
text.completion: Well done! My men are working hard on getting our flying machines and steam tanks back into the fight.
text.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

english.title: Extinguish the Fires
english.objectives: Using the Firefighting Equipment, extinguish 6 fires at the Ironforge Airfield.
english.description: The Dark Iron attack took us by surprise. Their saboteurs managed to damage most of our aircraft, steam tanks, and supplies. We were only able to get a few of our bombers airborne.$B$BEvery technician, recruit, and guard I can spare is  scrambling to get the others repaired and flight-ready. Our infantry can only hold out for so long. Take this equipment and help extinguish the burning bombers.
english.progress: We need to hurry and get those bombers airborne!
english.completion: Well done! My men are working hard on getting our flying machines and steam tanks back into the fight.
english.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

text.title: 通缉！奥图和法库雷斯特
text.objectives: 把奥图的徽记和法库雷斯特的徽记交给避难谷地的尼艾丝队长。
text.description: 激流堡民兵团重金悬赏法库雷斯特公爵和他的保镖奥图。法库雷斯特是辛迪加在阿拉希地区的主要领导者，他的死将使该组织在这一地区的活动陷入瘫痪。$B$B他的保镖奥图不是我们的战略目标，但他生性凶残，已经杀死了许多我们的防御者。$B$B赏金请到尼艾丝队长处领取。
text.progress: 你好。有什麽事要报告吗?
text.completion: 法库雷斯特和奥图?太好了!$B$B这是对你的奖赏，$N。我代表激流堡民兵团感谢你。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 他的护卫想必十分严密。谨慎行事。

english.title: Wanted!  Otto and Falconcrest
english.objectives: Bring Otto's Head and Falconcrest's Head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
english.description: The Stromgarde Militia has placed bounties on the heads of Lord Falconcrest, and his bodyguard Otto.  Falconcrest heads the Syndicate's efforts in the Arathi Highlands, and his death would cause a major disruption in those efforts.$B$BHis bodyguard Otto, although not a strategic target, is a fierce opponent and has killed dozens of our defenders.$B$BTheir bounties may be collected from Captain Nials.
english.progress: Hello.  Do you have a report to submit?
english.completion: Falconcrest and Otto?  Wonderful! Here is your reward, $n.  I am happy to pay it.
english.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: He will be well-protected.  Go with caution.

text.title: 最后的请求
text.objectives: 将掘歌的鲜鱼与便笺包交给驱暗海窟的格罗瓦船长。
text.description: $n，我要你将这个包裹交给格罗瓦船长。以我目前的状态，恐怕要花上一周才能返回驱暗海窟，但是我们的时间不多了。
text.progress: Have you found Oskar and Humphrey?
text.completion: I see.  Yes, I am rememberink now... Humphrey and Oskar vere not the strongest svimmers. The reconnaissance is helpful, and the extra fish look very tasty.  If you are seeink Mister Digsong before he returns, please send him my thanks.

english.title: One Last Favor
english.objectives: Deliver Digsong's Fish and Tips to Captain Glovaal at Darkbreak Cove.
english.description: $n, I'm gonna need ya to bring this back to Captain Glovaal.  With my condition, it'll take me a week to get back to Darkbreak Cove, and we don't have any time to waste.
english.progress: Have you found Oskar and Humphrey?
english.completion: I see.  Yes, I am rememberink now... Humphrey and Oskar vere not the strongest svimmers. The reconnaissance is helpful, and the extra fish look very tasty.  If you are seeink Mister Digsong before he returns, please send him my thanks.

text.title: 阿莉娜的奖赏
text.objectives: 跟黑暗游侠奥丽娜谈一谈。
text.description: 托卡拉尔的传说就到这里结束了。它将以黑暗女王的名义，成为一件为生者带来死亡的武器。$B$B现在退下吧，$n。我的任务是要再一度守护这把宝剑。把你的胜利告诉奥丽娜，我肯定她会大大奖赏你的。
text.progress: 干得好!马林一定会为你感到高兴的。
text.completion: The news of your victory satisfies me, $c... a rare sensation. The Dark Lady herself has mused that our conquest of Lordaeron may be the only way the Forsaken can find true satisfaction, and pehaps even relief. But it matters not. Our victory is inevitable. For your loyal service to the Forsaken, I award you in the name of Sylvanas.

english.title: Alina's Reward
english.objectives: Speak to Dark Ranger Alina.
english.description: The tale of Trol'kalar ends here, then. It will be a weapon to bring death to the living, in the name of the Dark Lady.$B$BLeave me now, $n. My job is once again to guard the blade. Tell Alina of your victory, I'm sure she will have a reward for you.
english.progress: You do this, an' I'm sure Malin'll be more than pleased with you.
english.completion: The news of your victory satisfies me, $c... a rare sensation. The Dark Lady herself has mused that our conquest of Lordaeron may be the only way the Forsaken can find true satisfaction, and pehaps even relief. But it matters not. Our victory is inevitable. For your loyal service to the Forsaken, I award you in the name of Sylvanas.

text.title: 去战痕谷！
text.objectives: 用克罗姆加攻城车摧毁战痕谷的5辆达纳苏斯投刃车和20名联盟士兵。
text.description: 我会再给这个老蠢货宽限一点时间。他向我保证，会将暗夜精灵没有藏匿大规模杀伤性武器的证据带来。我们等着瞧。$B$B在这段时间内，你要协助我们部署在谷里的军队。我们为此准备了大量的攻城坦克。攻城车也已准备就绪。$B$B坐升降机到哨站的底部去，操纵一台克罗姆加攻城车。用它消灭战痕谷的敌人。
text.completion: You possess quite a talent for destruction, $n. Whatever Alliance remain after your rampage across Battlescar Valley will be dealt with by the bomb.
text.completed: Report to General Grebo at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: To Battlescar!
english.objectives: Use the Krom'gar Demolisher to destroy 5 Darnassian Glaive Throwers and any 20 Alliance soldiers in Battlescar Valley.
english.description: I will allow this old fool time to plead his case. He has assured me that he will bring back proof that the night elves do not harbor a weapon of mass destruction. We shall see.$B$BWhile we await this proof, you will assist our army in the valley. We have prepared a large number of siege tanks for this purpose. Our demolishers are poised for attack.$B$BTake the elevator down to the base of the outpost and take control of a Krom'gar demolisher. Use it to lay waste to our enemies in Battlescar Valley.
english.completion: You possess quite a talent for destruction, $n. Whatever Alliance remain after your rampage across Battlescar Valley will be dealt with by the bomb.
english.completed: Report to General Grebo at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭战痕谷的联盟士兵

text.title: 你好鲁鲁
text.objectives: 在法迪尔海湾的瞭望台上找到鲁鲁。
text.description: 痛肠被派来侦察。看好多东西。大冒险！$B$B痛肠发现了秘密的海盗船。海盗都害怕，逃跑了。但食人魔鲁鲁不跑。鲁鲁和痛肠做朋友！$B$B痛肠必须得走了，但是想鲁鲁。你去替痛肠跟鲁鲁问好。
text.completion: You friends with Goutgut! Him weird ogre. Smell funny.

english.title: Hello Lolo
english.objectives: Find Lolo the Lookout at Faldir's Cove.
english.description: Goutgut get sent scouting. Look at many things. Big adventure!$B$BGoutgut found secret pirate ship. Pirates all scared, run away. But ogre Lolo not run. Lolo make friend with Goutgut!$B$BGoutgut have to leave, but miss Lolo. You go say hello to Lolo for Goutgut.
english.completion: You friends with Goutgut! Him weird ogre. Smell funny.

text.title: 落锤镇
text.objectives: 去找阿拉希高地落锤镇的戈穆尔。
text.description: 你为我们干得很不错，$n。如今我们已经初有成就，征服计划的下一个阶段尚需从长计议。$B$B我们还有很多工作要做，但我不会让你在这里虚度时光，空等我们修筑防御工事。到东边的落锤镇去。那里的兽人无疑用得着你的帮助。
text.completion: Throm'ka, $c. If your deeds for the undead are as great as you claim, I am honored to help you serve the Horde.

english.title: Hammerfall
english.objectives: Report to Gor'mul at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: You have served us well here, $n. Now that we've made our mark, the next phase of our conquest will occur over months rather than minutes.$B$BThere is much work yet to be done, and I will spare you the tedium of waiting for our fortifications to trickle in. Travel to the east, to Hammerfall. The orcs there will no doubt have use of your aid.
english.completion: Throm'ka, $c. If your deeds for the undead are as great as you claim, I am honored to help you serve the Horde.

text.title: 鼓舞防御者
text.objectives: 在铁炉堡飞行器机坪的松散的雪堆上插上8面铁炉堡旗帜。
text.description: 在工程师修理轰炸机的同时，铁炉堡守卫和巡山人仍然在抵御入侵者。$B$B攻击行动开始后，他们就一直在奋战在最前线，连小憩和吃饭的时间都没有。铁炉堡拥有艾泽拉斯最优秀的防御者，但是他们的体能也是有极限的。$B$B带上这些旗帜，将它们插在雪堆上。向防御者们昭示为铁炉堡而战的荣耀，并鼓舞他们的士气。
text.completion: The men are finding hidden reserves of strength and courage to deal with the Dark Iron onslaught. The airfield will not fall on our watch!
text.completed: Return to Captain Stonebreaker at the Ironforge Airfield.

english.title: Rallying the Defenders
english.objectives: Plant 8 Ironforge Banners in mounds of Loose Snow throughout the Ironforge Airfield.
english.description: While our engineers work on getting the bombers ready to fly again, our guards and mountaineers continue to fight the invaders.$B$BThey've been out there since the incursion began, without so much as a chance to catch some sleep or have a meal. Ironforge's defenders are among the best on Azeroth, but even they have limits.$B$BTake these banners and plant them in banks of loose snow. Remind the men what they are fighting for and help keep their morale high.
english.completion: The men are finding hidden reserves of strength and courage to deal with the Dark Iron onslaught. The airfield will not fall on our watch!
english.completed: Return to Captain Stonebreaker at the Ironforge Airfield.

text.title: 欧纳柯
text.objectives: 前往瓦丝琪尔的光渊海峡，向欧纳柯报到。
text.description: <凡尔纳船长低头看了看他的怀表。>$b$b那个猎人在哪里？我派欧纳柯到光渊海峡去准备一份侦察报告，那是一星期前的事了！当然了，他确实很糟糕，没了他也无所谓，但是我需要他的报告。$b$b嘿，你叫什么来着？$n？你能去找找他吗？派一个$c去找一个猎人有点奇怪，不过我没别的选择了。
text.completion: Gah!  These fish are impossible to hit!$b$b<Orako looks at you.>$b$bMy wolf got eaten by a fish, and I'm not going back until I find her.

english.title: Orako
english.objectives: Report to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.
english.description: <Captain Verne looks down at his watch.>$b$bWhere is that hunter?  I sent Orako to Underlight Canyon to prepare a recon report a week ago!  Sure, he's a handful, and I didn't mind getting him out of my hair, but I need his report.$b$bSay, what's your name?  $n?  Would you be willing to go track him down?  It seems strange to send a $c to find a hunter, but I'm running out of options.
english.completion: Gah!  These fish are impossible to hit!$b$b<Orako looks at you.>$b$bMy wolf got eaten by a fish, and I'm not going back until I find her.

text.title: 发光的浓汁
text.objectives: 从光渊海峡的赤壳凿孔蟹和光鳞石斑鱼身上收集6份发光的浓汁。
text.description: 在桶里抓鱼当然简单了。在海里捕鱼就麻烦一点。$b$b你看见光渊海峡的鱼人了吗，$c？他们根本用不着开枪！这些鱼人的头部长着发光的小球，可以吸引小鱼游过来。嗨，我们应该来试试！$b$b去南边杀死光渊海峡的螃蟹和石斑鱼。它们的皮肤中有发光的浓汁。我看到过！
text.progress: We need lots and lots of glow-juice.
text.completion: Hey, look at how glowy it is!$b$b<Orako looks wistfully off into the distance.>$b$bMy wolf loved things that were glowy...
text.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

english.title: "Glow-Juice"
english.objectives: Obtain 6 gobs of Glow-Juice from Pyreshell Scuttlers and Luxscale Groupers in Underlight Canyon.
english.description: Shooting fish in a barrel is easy.  Shooting fish in an ocean is a little harder.$b$bHave you seen the murlocs down in the canyon, $c?  They don't shoot at all!  They have little balls full of glow-juice on their heads that make the fish come to THEM.  Hey, we should try that!$b$bGo south, and kill the crabs and groupers in the canyon.  They have lots of glow-juice in their skin.  I've seen it!
english.progress: We need lots and lots of glow-juice.
english.completion: Hey, look at how glowy it is!$b$b<Orako looks wistfully off into the distance.>$b$bMy wolf loved things that were glowy...
english.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 小鱼儿，来吧来吧
text.objectives: 戴上捕鱼帽，游过光渊海峡的海藻丛，吸引30条光渊利齿鱼。
text.description: <欧纳柯将发光的浓汁注入到球体中，将其附着在一件他花了好长时间才做好的装置上。>$b$b给，这顶帽子上的发光体可以吸引鱼群。就像鱼人的那招！$b$b鱼人们喜欢在光渊海峡的珊瑚礁一带活动。如果你戴上帽子去那里游上一圈，肯定会抓到不少小鱼的。
text.progress: How many did you catch?
text.completion: Hmm... you got a lot of fish, but none of these are the ones that ate my wolf.  I think it was probably a bigger fish.
text.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Here Fishie Fishie
english.objectives: Put on the Fish Hat, then swim through the coral in Underlight Canyon to attract 30 Underlight Nibblers.
english.description: <Orako rolls the glow-juice into a ball, then attaches it to a device that he's clearly been working on for a long time.>$b$bHere, I got you this hat.  It has a light on it, and it will make fish follow you.  Just like the murlocs!$b$bThe murlocs like to hunt in the kelp and coral along the sides of the canyon.  If you put on this hat and swim in that kelp, you might catch some fish like they do.
english.progress: How many did you catch?
english.completion: Hmm... you got a lot of fish, but none of these are the ones that ate my wolf.  I think it was probably a bigger fish.
english.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 死吧，鱼人！
text.objectives: 杀死4个寒光猎手和4个寒光智者。
text.description: 有一条鱼吃了我的狼，而鱼人看起来跟鱼差不多。我要让那些鱼人付出代价！$b$b回到光渊海峡里去，干掉那些鱼人！为我的狼复仇！
text.completion: I know, murlocs aren't fish.  I thought that killing them would make me feel better, but I still feel sad about my wolf.$b$b<Orako sighs.>
text.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Die Fishman Die
english.objectives: Kill 4 Coldlight Hunters and 4 Coldlight Oracles.
english.description: A fish ate my wolf, and murlocs look like fish.  I'm going to make those murlocs pay!$b$bHead back down to the canyon and kill the fishmen!  My wolf will be avenged!
english.completion: I know, murlocs aren't fish.  I thought that killing them would make me feel better, but I still feel sad about my wolf.$b$b<Orako sighs.>
english.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 这枚卵交给你
text.objectives: 将巨大的鳗鱼卵交给瓦丝琪尔光渊海峡底部的欧纳柯。
text.description: <这像是光渊海峡中扭曲的巨海鳗的卵。说不定欧纳柯会对此感兴趣呢。>
text.progress: <Blam!>$b$bYou brought me something?
text.completion: That is a big egg.$b$b<Orako sniffs it.>$b$bIt is big, and it smells like fish.  Maybe the big fish that made this egg is the big fish that ate my wolf!

english.title: I Brought You This Egg
english.objectives: Deliver the Enormous Eel Egg to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.
english.description: <This appears to be an egg from one of the devious great-eels that float up above the canyon.  You wonder whether or not Orako might be interested in something like this.>
english.progress: <Blam!>$b$bYou brought me something?
english.completion: That is a big egg.$b$b<Orako sniffs it.>$b$bIt is big, and it smells like fish.  Maybe the big fish that made this egg is the big fish that ate my wolf!

text.title: 鱼儿鱼儿看过来2：鳗鱼卵大爆炸
text.objectives: 在光渊海峡的扭曲的巨海鳗附近使用鳗鱼爆破装置，然后击败被削弱的巨鳗。
text.description: <欧纳柯从包里掏出一套爆炸陷阱来，把它附在了鱼卵外面。>$b$b这样就可以使鱼卵爆炸了。把这枚卵放在某条巨海鳗旁边，然后等它们靠近。一旦鱼卵爆炸，巨海鳗多半会被炸得奄奄一息，然后你就过去杀了它。$b$b救救我的狼！有这枚鱼卵在手，你一定行的。
text.completion: <Orako is busy playing with Wolf.>$b$bOh, thank you, $n!  I knew Wolf was alive!$b$bHere, take one of these.  I don't need them anymore.
text.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.
text.giverWindow: 帮我找到我的狼！

english.title: Here Fishie Fishie 2: Eel-Egg-Trick Boogaloo
english.objectives: Use the Eel-splosive Device near a Devious Great-eel in Underlight Canyon, then defeat the Weakened Great-Eel.
english.description: <Orako removes an explosive trap from his sack and shoves it through the egg's outer membrane.>$b$bThis will make the egg explode.  Place the egg down next to one of those giant eels, and wait for them to come close.  When the egg explodes, the big fish will be almost dead, and you can finish killing it.$b$bSave my wolf!  With this egg, you can do it.
english.completion: <Orako is busy playing with Wolf.>$b$bOh, thank you, $n!  I knew Wolf was alive!$b$bHere, take one of these.  I don't need them anymore.
english.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.
english.giverWindow: Help me find my wolf!

objectiveDetails.description: 对扭曲的巨海鳗使用鳗鱼爆破装置

text.title: 欧纳柯的报告
text.objectives: 将欧纳柯的报告交给阴暗洞穴的凡尔纳·“珍宝”船长。
text.description: <你提醒欧纳柯给凡尔纳船长送去一份报告。>$b$b没错，一份报告。我在这里看到的只有鱼群而已。许多许多的鱼。$b$b<欧纳柯看着你带回的那袋子海鱼。>$b$b把它交给船长吧。这就是我的报告。
text.progress: Where was he?  What happened?
text.completion: This is his report?!  That idiot...$b$bI suppose we can use the food.  Thanks, $n.  You've done as well as can be expected.

english.title: Orako's Report
english.objectives: Deliver Orako's Report to Captain "Jewels" Verne in Tenebrous Cavern.
english.description: <You remind Orako that he was supposed to send a report back to Captain Verne.>$b$bRight, a report.  All that I've seen here is fish.  Lots and lots of fish.$b$b<Orako looks over at the sack of fish that you brought for him.>$b$bBring this back to the captain.  This is my report.
english.progress: Where was he?  What happened?
english.completion: This is his report?!  That idiot...$b$bI suppose we can use the food.  Thanks, $n.  You've done as well as can be expected.

text.title: 诺斯弗德农场
text.objectives: 在诺斯弗德农场杀死10名辛迪加雇佣兵。
text.description: 我们正在为激流堡而战，然而我们却逐渐落入下风。我们、食人魔以及辛迪加分别控制着这座城市的一部分，现在我们这三方势力陷入了整日互相征战却毫无突破的僵局。$B$B然而，当敌人们力量开始逐渐增强的时候，我们却在慢慢地变弱。$B$B尽管南海镇陷落了，我们还是不能让任何一寸土地落到敌人手中。$B$B到辛迪加在诺斯弗德农场的基地去干掉他们，我们必须在部落能够挺进之前收复失地。
text.completion: Very good, $n.  The last thing we need with the undead looming is a gang of common thieves distracting us.
text.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Northfold Manor
english.objectives: Kill 10 Syndicate members at Northfold Manor.
english.description: We are fighting a war for Stromgarde, and we are losing.  The ogres, the Syndicate and we have divided our once great city, and each faction battles the other into a bloody stalemate.$B$BBut our forces dwindle while our enemy grows.$B$BThough Southshore has fallen, we must not let any further ground be yielded to our enemies.$B$BGo to the Syndicate base in Northfold Manor and slay them. We must reclaim the land for ourselves before the Horde has a chance to creep further.
english.completion: Very good, $n.  The last thing we need with the undead looming is a gang of common thieves distracting us.
english.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 反击
text.objectives: 登上修复的轰炸机，使用铁锤炸弹杀死30名黑铁矮人。铁炉堡飞行器机坪上的任何黑铁矮人以及他们的盟友都算。
text.description: 首席工程师修好了一架轰炸机，说是可以正常飞行了。带上这些炸弹，去跑道起点处找到那架修好的轰炸机。$B$B起飞后，瞄准黑铁矮人投弹吧。有传闻说他们在此次攻击行动中派出了一批新研制的作战傀儡。我要你多多留意，作战傀儡是最优先的投弹目标。
text.completion: The momentum is starting to shift, $n, largely due to your efforts. Now, it is time to strike at the Dark Iron leadership.
text.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

english.title: Striking Back
english.objectives: Board the Repaired Bomber and use the Iron Hammer Bomb to kill 30 Dark Iron attackers. You may kill any of the Dark Iron dwarves or their allies at the Ironforge Airfield.
english.description: My chief engineer tells me that he's managed to get one of the bombers repaired and airworthy. Take these bombs with you, and look for the repaired bomber at the start of the runway.$B$BOnce you're airborne, use the bombs to do as much damage to the attacking Dark Iron dwarves as you can. I've heard rumors that they're preparing to deploy a new kind of war golem. Keep your eyes peeled for those golems and make them your highest priority targets.
english.completion: The momentum is starting to shift, $n, largely due to your efforts. Now, it is time to strike at the Dark Iron leadership.
english.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

text.title: 激流堡徽章
text.objectives: 从激流堡的敌人身上获得7枚激流堡徽章。
text.description: 我们的民兵分队正在和激流堡的辛迪加成员激战。为了刺激他们那群乌合之众与我们作战，辛迪加的头目们使出了重金悬赏的手段，只要有人能杀死我们的民兵，并从他们身上缴获激流堡徽章，辛迪加都会给予金钱奖励。$B$B我们必须夺回那些徽章——决不能让刽子手们用我们的战士的性命来换取金钱！$B$B到激流堡城内的辛迪加控制区去杀掉那些歹徒，取回我们的徽章。
text.progress: $N，你取必了激流堡徽章了吗?要让辛迪加明白，他们绝对没法从我们阵亡的士兵那里得到任何好处。
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。我们会将这些战士的死讯通知他们的家属。$B$B这是很残酷的消息，但总比不能确定心爱的人是死是活要好得多。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Stromgarde Badges
english.objectives: Collect 7 Stromgarde Badges from Syndicate enemies in Stromgarde Keep.
english.description: The Syndicate in Stromgarde do battle with our contingent of militia there. In order to urge the rabble to fight our more disciplined troops, the Syndicate leaders have placed a bounty on our soldiers, awarding gold for each Stromgarde Badge gathered off killed militiamen.$B$BWe want those badges retrieved - we cannot allow the cutthroats to take trophies from our brave fallen!$B$BEnter the Syndicate-controlled area of Stromgarde and hunt them for our badges.
english.progress: Have you retrieved any Stromgarde Badges, $n?  The Syndicate must learn they cannot profit from our dead.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  We will inform the families of these fallen soldiers that they were killed in battle. It will be grim news to bear, but it is better than the uncertainty of a missing loved one.
english.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 烫灼之菇
text.objectives: 收集5颗烫灼之菇。
text.description: 我们倒是用得着无悯者，你洞里的朋友给我们带来的。不过我需要一份防腐剂。$B$B火烟海沟里生长着某种奇特的蘑菇。摘一些回来给我，我就可以自己试着做做看。
text.progress: I heard that you had an unpleasant encounter with putting one of the demons on your head. I can assure you that they are now all quite dead.
text.completion: I will use the mushrooms as a reagent to treat the corpses. We will have one ready for you soon.
text.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Tulra atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Scalding Shrooms
english.objectives: Collect 5 Scalding Shrooms.
english.description: We think that we have a use for the merciless ones that your friend from the cave delivered to us. But I need a preservative for it.$B$BDown below in the Scalding Chasm are some mushrooms with the properties that I need. Bring some back up to me and I'll see what I can do.
english.progress: I heard that you had an unpleasant encounter with putting one of the demons on your head. I can assure you that they are now all quite dead.
english.completion: I will use the mushrooms as a reagent to treat the corpses. We will have one ready for you soon.
english.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Tulra atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 谎言的证明
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉萨达拉林地的奥修斯。
text.description: 在战痕谷中央矗立着一株古树——那是一颗历时悠久，几代人奉为和平与学识之地的大树。自我记事起，我的同胞就和暗夜精灵一道，在那林地里研习德鲁伊之道。现在要我相信那棵树里藏着联盟的大规模杀伤性武器？$B$B克罗姆加搞错了，我会证明给他看的！$B$B我已经派我的儿子奥修斯前往萨达拉林地寻找那武器。去那里跟他会合吧。
text.completion: Orthus is dead. He is clutching something in his hand.

english.title: Proof of Lies
english.objectives: Find Orthus at Thal'darah Grove in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: At the heart of Battlescar Valley stands an ancient tree - a tree that has withstood the force of ages and has served as a place of peace and learning for generations. My kin have studied druidism at the grove, alongside the night elves, for as long as I can recall. Now I am to believe that the tree holds within it an Alliance weapon of mass destruction?$B$BKrom'gar is wrong and I will prove it!$B$BI have sent my son, Orthus, to Thal'darah Grove in search of this weapon. Go there now and meet him.
english.completion: Orthus is dead. He is clutching something in his hand.

text.title: 林地里的背叛
text.objectives: 把克罗姆加将军的徽章带给石爪山脉峭壁行者哨站的峭壁行者族长。
text.description: 房间里遍布德鲁伊的尸体。感觉有点不对劲，因为你没有发现挣扎的痕迹。血迹从门廊那里延伸进来。$B$B你掰开奥修斯僵直的手，在里面发现了一件令人不安的东西：克罗姆加将军的徽章。$B$B把克罗姆加将军的徽章给峭壁行者族长带去。
text.progress: He... My child is dead?
text.completion: <High Chieftain Cliffwalker takes the insignia from you.>$B$B<High Chieftain Cliffwalker cries out in anger.>

english.title: Betrayal at the Grove
english.objectives: Take the Krom'gar General's Insignia back to High Chieftain Cliffwalker at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Druid corpses litter the room. Something seems amiss, as you see no signs of a struggle.  Bloody drag marks lead in from the doorway.$B$BYou pry Orthus' death grip open to find something disturbing in his hand: a Krom'gar General's insignia.$B$BTake the Krom'gar General's insignia back to High Chieftain Cliffwalker.
english.progress: He... My child is dead?
english.completion: <High Chieftain Cliffwalker takes the insignia from you.>$B$B<High Chieftain Cliffwalker cries out in anger.>

text.title: 这是正义吗？
text.objectives: 自卫。
text.description: 他是个好孩子，$n。年轻，博爱。他绝不会杀害任何一名年轻的德鲁伊。他们是他的朋友！不……不是奥修斯。$B$B将军必须为这罪行做出回答。我呼唤正义的审判！
text.completion: You saw with your own eyes, $n. General Grebo attacked us! Now what will we do? Surely the Warchief will have us all executed for treason.
text.completed: 跟石爪山脉峭壁行者哨站的玛莎·峭壁行者谈一谈。

english.title: Is This Justice?
english.objectives: Defend yourself.
english.description: He was a good boy, $n. Young, loving. He would have never killed any of the young druids. They were his friends! No... Not Orthus.$B$BThe General must be called to answer for this crime. I will have justice!
english.completion: You saw with your own eyes, $n. General Grebo attacked us! Now what will we do? Surely the Warchief will have us all executed for treason.
english.completed: Speak with Masha Cliffwalker at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 将军死了
text.objectives: 跟石爪山脉克罗姆加壁垒的克罗姆加大王谈一谈。
text.description: 也许你该跟克罗姆加大王谈一谈，$n。说不定他肯听你的呢？毕竟，你是大军里的勇士。你什么都看到了。请帮帮我们，$n。我们只是想安然无恙就好。$B$B跟克罗姆加大王谈谈，让他明白所发生的这一切并非我们本愿。
text.completion: WHAT? My General has been killed by the tauren? This is treason! HIGH TREASON! They will pay for this grievous error.

english.title: The General is Dead
english.objectives: Speak to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Perhaps if you spoke to Overlord Krom'gar, $n. Maybe he would listen to what you had to say? You are a Champion in his army, after all. You saw everything. Please help us, $n. We simply wish to be left alone - in peace.$B$BTalk to Overlord Krom'gar and try to help him see that we did not mean for any of this to happen.
english.completion: WHAT? My General has been killed by the tauren? This is treason! HIGH TREASON! They will pay for this grievous error.

text.title: 力量才是正义
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉峭壁行者哨站的克罗姆加大王。
text.description: 你能举报这一罪行，干得非常好。这些忤逆之徒将受到严惩，他们要血债血偿。$B$B格雷勃死了，我们需要一个新将军。你来顶替他的位置。$B$B到峭壁行者哨站来见我，将军。我们一起把这场闹剧结束掉。
text.completion: The traitorous tauren will now stand by as we destroy his precious grove and burn his village to the ground!

english.title: Might Makes Right
english.objectives: Meet Overlord Krom'gar at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: You have done well to report this crime. The perpetrators of this heinous act will be punished. There will be blood.$B$BI will need a new General now that Grebo is dead. You shall take his place.$B$BMeet me at Cliffwalker Post, General. Together we will end this nonsense.
english.completion: The traitorous tauren will now stand by as we destroy his precious grove and burn his village to the ground!

text.title: 恐斧的末日
text.objectives: 杀死铁炉堡飞行器机坪的恐斧将军。
text.description: 在你的指引下，我们重挫了黑铁矮人的突袭计划。黑铁矮人的首领恐斧将军正在南面结冰的湖泊处重新集结军队，那里就是他们的指挥中心。$B$B恐斧站在一只新研制的作战傀儡头上，对士兵们发号施令。如果他成功地组织起新的军队，其兵力很可能会超过我们。你必须阻止他，$n。摧毁他的傀儡守卫，然后杀死恐斧将军。他是我们获胜的关键人物。
text.completion: We've done it! Without your help, Ironforge Airfield would surely be occupied by the enemy and the Dark Irons would have a clear road to Ironforge itself. The Council of Three Hammers must be informed of what happened here.
text.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

english.title: Grimaxe's Demise
english.objectives: Kill General Grimaxe at the Ironforge Airfield.
english.description: With you leading the way, we've finally broken the momentum of the Dark Iron attack. General Grimaxe, the Dark Iron leader, is attempting to rally his troops from the center of their lines on the frozen lake to the south.$B$BHe stands atop one of their new dark iron golems, shouting orders to his men. If he succeeds in rallying them, they may still be able to overpower us. You must prevent that, $n. Destroy the golem guarding him, then kill General Grimaxe himself. He is the key to our victory.
english.completion: We've done it! Without your help, Ironforge Airfield would surely be occupied by the enemy and the Dark Irons would have a clear road to Ironforge itself. The Council of Three Hammers must be informed of what happened here.
english.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

text.title: 生物燃料
text.objectives: 前往库图恩之末，对画笔海岭潜水龟、亮腹鮣魚和脊鳞锤头鲨的尸体使用油脂吸收泵，收集4份龟油、4份鮣魚油和4份锤头鲨鱼油。
text.description: 潜水艇燃料是很贵的！$b$b诺莫瑞根的有关部门非常慷慨，给我们送来了好几桶燃料，但我们消耗的速度比预期的更快。也就是说，我们需要赶紧补充燃料储备。$b$b众所周知，海洋生物富含各种乱七八糟的化学成分……比如油。把这件设备拿到库图恩之末去，从海龟、鮣魚、锤头鲨之类的海洋生物尸体上提取油料。如果潜水艇燃料补给跟不上，它们的油就是我们唯一的希望了。
text.progress: How did the device work, $n?
text.completion: Yes, I think this will do.
text.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Bio-Fuel
english.objectives: Use the Oil Extrusion Pump on the corpses of Seabrush Terrapins, Scourgut Remoras, and Spinescale Hammerheads in Kothrun's End to obtain 4 Terrapin Oil, 4 Remora Oil, and 4 Hammerhead Oil.
english.description: Submarine fuel is expensive!$b$bThe powers-that-be in Gnomeregan were generous enough to deliver several fuel barrels, but we're burning through it faster than expected.  That means we're going to need to improvise.$b$bIt's a well-known fact that sea creatures are full of all kinds of interesting chemicals... like oil.  Take this device up to Kothrun's End and stick it into the corpses of terrapins, remoras, and hammerhead sharks.  If we don't get more submarine fuel, their oil might be our only hope.
english.progress: How did the device work, $n?
english.completion: Yes, I think this will do.
english.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 海中的邻居
text.objectives: 在库图恩之末台柱顶端的海藻丛附近使用海马套索，捕获5只惊慌的海马。
text.description: 祝你好运。$B$B援军已经到了，他们还带来了食物和坐骑。可是我们的坐骑完全不能下水啊。$B$B洞穴正上方的高柱顶端生长着红色的海藻。海马就藏身在那些海藻丛中。抛出套索，捕获一些海底坐骑来。
text.completed: Return to Captain Glovaal at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Our Aquatic Neigh-Bors
english.objectives: Use the Seahorse Lasso near the kelp atop the pillars in Korthun's End to capture 5 Panicked Seahorses.
english.description: Good fortune to you, comrade.$b$bThe reinforcements are here, and they are bringink food, and men, and fresh mounts.  The problem is that our mounts are highly immobile when placed under the water.$b$bDirectly above this cave, you vill find tall pillars with red, leafy kelp on their tops.  Seahorses hide in the kelp.  Throw this lasso into the kelp and catch us some mounts for usink in the water.
english.completed: Return to Captain Glovaal at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 保卫库图恩之末
text.objectives: 在库图恩之末击败7名地狱咆哮水兵。
text.description: 部落在这一区域部署了间谍？附近就是驱暗海窟，里面停泊着扳钳X2号！绝对不能让部落接近它！$b$b得把部落入侵这事告诉洞穴里的某人……等你干掉那些肮脏的部落间谍之后就去报告一下吧。
text.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Horde attacks right now.  The Pincer X2 has plenty of firepower at sea, but in the back of this cave, she is exceptionally vulnerable.
text.completed: Report to Jorlan Trueblade at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Claim Korthun's End
english.objectives: Kill 7 Hellscream Seadogs in Korthun's End.
english.description: The Horde has spies in this area?  Darkbreak Cove is nearby, and inside lies the Pincer X2!  The Horde must not be allowed anywhere nearby!$b$bSomeone in Darkbreak Cove will want to hear of this... after you finish slaying some more of these dirty Horde spies.
english.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Horde attacks right now.  The Pincer X2 has plenty of firepower at sea, but in the back of this cave, she is exceptionally vulnerable.
english.completed: Report to Jorlan Trueblade at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 初级燃料学
text.objectives: 使用驱暗海窟的燃料采样站制造完美的生物燃料。
text.description: 你对燃料学了解多少呢，$n？要制造出完美的燃料是相当费神的，有很多因素要平衡：过氧化态参数、混合燃烧变量以及速燃标准……只是随便举些例子。$b$b希望你取回的样本可以以适当的比例混合，制造出……完美的生物燃料。使用那边的台子，试着做出一些样品来！完成任务后告诉我结果。
text.completion: Have you considered a career in science, $n?  If you ever get tired of this $c nonsense, come see me!  I could use an assistant with your devotion to experimentation and the scientific method.
text.completed: 去找瓦丝琪尔驱暗海窟的工程师“洗衣桶”。

english.title: Fuel-ology 101
english.objectives: Use the Fuel Sampling Station in Darkbreak Cove to create the perfect bio-fuel.
english.description: How much do you know about fuel, $n?  Constructing the perfect fuel is a tricky job, as there's plenty of factors to balance: chrono-pyroxidation parameters, tempero-incendiary variables, conflagrational siltification criteria... and that's only naming a few.$b$bHopefully the samples you brought me can be combined in the right proportions to create... the perfect bio-fuel.  Use that table over there and try combining some samples!  Bring the result to me when you're done.
english.completion: Have you considered a career in science, $n?  If you ever get tired of this $c nonsense, come see me!  I could use an assistant with your devotion to experimentation and the scientific method.
english.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 振奋精神
text.objectives: 从高地阔步龙和高地长尾龙身上取得10个高地迅猛龙的眼球。
text.description: 我们族人的萨满祝福令我从多年的沮丧中苏醒了过来。如今我为所有人提供祝福，将赋予我的新生力量同样赐福给他们。$B$B高地迅猛龙是一种狡诈而凶猛的野兽。它们的精神可以给予战士们无比的力量。给我带些迅猛龙的眼球来，我好按照托尔甘传授的方法制作一些护符。
text.progress: The fierceness in the eyes of the raptors will be matched by those of our warriors.
text.completion: The lethargy that overcame me even after the camps fell was so strong, I refused this gift when it was first given to me. Now, I am proud to do my part in the name of the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Gor'mul at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Raising Spirits
english.objectives: Collect 10 Highland Raptor Eyes from Highland Striders or Highland Thrashers.
english.description: Our race's gift of shamanism stirred me from a years-long lethargy. Now I provide for all here, crafting the same boons that gave me newfound strength.$B$BThe Highland raptors are cunning and fierce beasts. Their spirits can grant our warriors great strength. Bring me raptor eyes, so I may make the amulets as Tor'gan taught me.
english.progress: The fierceness in the eyes of the raptors will be matched by those of our warriors.
english.completion: The lethargy that overcame me even after the camps fell was so strong, I refused this gift when it was first given to me. Now, I am proud to do my part in the name of the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Gor'mul at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 迅猛龙的狡诈
text.objectives: 从高地猎兽龙身上获取12颗迅猛龙的心脏。
text.description: 南部的高地猎兽龙比其同类要更为凶猛。它们不仅力量过人，也狡诈非凡。$B$B当我沉浸在昏聩中时，即便是力量护符我也不为所动。但托尔甘用猎兽龙的心脏激起了我的精神，打消了我的疑虑，解放了我的心灵。$B$B我们的战士应该也拥有迅猛龙的狡诈。去帮我收集一些猎兽龙的心脏来，$n。
text.progress: My preparations are made, all I need are the raptor hearts.
text.completion: As Tor'gan taught me, I transfer the power and the spirit of the raptors into this orb. It will imbue our warriors with the fiery strength and intelligence of the raptor. The guile of the raptor is yours now as well, $c. Take it with pride, for the Horde!
text.completed: Return to Gor'mul at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Guile of the Raptor
english.objectives: Collect 12 Raptor Hearts from Highland Fleshstalkers.
english.description: The highland fleshstalkers to the south are even fiercer than the others of their kind. They possess not just strength, but true cunning.$B$BWhen I was trapped by lethargy, even the amulets of strength failed to move me. But Tor'gan used the hearts of the fleshstalkers to imbue me with spirits that conquered my doubt, freeing me.$B$BOur soldiers deserve the guile of the raptor. Collect the fleshstalker hearts for me, $n.
english.progress: My preparations are made, all I need are the raptor hearts.
english.completion: As Tor'gan taught me, I transfer the power and the spirit of the raptors into this orb. It will imbue our warriors with the fiery strength and intelligence of the raptor. The guile of the raptor is yours now as well, $c. Take it with pride, for the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Gor'mul at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 法迪尔海湾
text.objectives: 跟阿拉希高地法迪尔海湾的奥布里船长谈一谈。
text.description: 鲁鲁看见了一个小$R！鲁鲁总是待在哨所上！$B$B欢迎来到法迪尔海湾。奥布里船长说过，我们在这里待不了多久。我们只要搜集宝藏然后返回藏宝海湾就行了。$B$B但是鲁鲁认为我们要在这儿待很长很长的时间，我们失去了两艘船。可怜的银松之魂号和处女号！她们长眠在海底！$B$B鲁鲁说，如果你想在这逗留的话，就去和奥布里船长谈谈吧。

english.title: Land Ho!
english.objectives: Talk to Captain O'Breen at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: Lolo sees a tiny $r! Always on the lookout, Lolo is!$b$bWelcome to Faldir's Cove.  Captain O'Breen said we'd only be here for a few hours.  Just long enough to gather the treasure and get back to Booty Bay.$b$bBut Lolo thinks we're going to be here a lot longer than that.  We lost the other two ships from our formation.  Poor Spirit of Silverpine and Maiden's Folly.  On the bottom of the sea they rest now!$b$bLolo suggests you talk to Captain O'Breen if you plan on sticking around here.

text.title: 就像以前
text.objectives: 从被遗忘者信使身上拿到密封的信件。
text.description: 有意思。阿基和我风风雨雨都过来了，结果发现大家都又回到了阿拉希，就像多年以前。$B$B我们曾挫败过一个试图在这里制造新瘟疫的阴谋，就她和我俩人。看来部落不知道吸取教训，因为他们又涌进农场里了。$B$B他们的亡灵信使就在光天化日之下四处晃悠。要是你打算帮忙的话，找到信使，把他们身上的情报带回来。
text.progress: 感谢你帮我们找到了那个信差，$N。$B$B你走了以後，基恩洛看见有一个药剂师走出那间房子朝南边去了。我确信他们不会是在做什麽好事─但是我可不想草率行动，所以首先，我们得有一些确切的证据。$B$B怎麽样，你要不要帮忙?
text.completion: Apothecaries yet again. You think they'd get the message. Let's see what it is this time...
text.completed: Return to Quae at the Go'shek Farm in Arathi Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 在路上找到她。

english.title: Just Like Old Times
english.objectives: Collect the Sealed Folder from the Forsaken Courier.
english.description: It's funny. Kin and I have been through so much together, and here we find ourselves back in Arathi, like so many years ago.$B$BWe broke up a plot to create a new plague right here, her and I. It doesn't look like the horde learned their lesson, because they're all over this farm yet again.$B$BTheir undead courier is shuffling around as obvious as daylight. If you want to help, find the courier and bring back whatever they're carrying.
english.progress: We appreciate your help in looking for that courier, $n.$B$BWhile you were gone, Kin saw an apothecary come out of that same house to the south of here. I'm confident that they're up to no good--I just need proof of it before we go off and do something rash.$B$BHave you had any luck yet?
english.completion: Apothecaries yet again. You think they'd get the message. Let's see what it is this time...
english.completed: Return to Quae at the Go'shek Farm in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Find her on the road.

text.title: ……它会现身的
text.objectives: 取得不可估量者的触须。
text.description: 现在，我要将腐蚀无面者的能量注入你的体内。$B$B游往插在东北方海沟里的引诱图腾。通过它释放出你体内的能量。将无面者首领的触须取回来。$B$B召唤不可估量者埃库塞斯吧……它会现身的。
text.progress: Do you have it, $n?$B$BWith the Unfathomable's brain, we still may yet be able to communicate with L'ghorek, the dying ancient one in front of us.
text.completion: And now we will see if we can get you into L'ghorek to speak with it before it dies.
text.completed: Return to Erunak Stonespeaker atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.
text.giverWindow: 你需要它的触须！

english.title: ... It Will Come
english.objectives: Obtain the Brain of the Unfathomable.
english.description: I now imbue you with the energies of the corrupting faceless.$B$BSwim down to my luring totem in the trench to the northeast. Release the energies through it. Bring back the brain of their leader.$B$BCall forth to Ick'thys the Unfathomable... it will come!
english.progress: Do you have it, $n?$B$BWith the Unfathomable's brain, we still may yet be able to communicate with L'ghorek, the dying ancient one in front of us.
english.completion: And now we will see if we can get you into L'ghorek to speak with it before it dies.
english.completed: Return to Erunak Stonespeaker atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.
english.giverWindow: You need its brain!

text.title: 寻求答案
text.objectives: 将碎石的报告交给铁炉堡王座厅的茉艾拉·铜须。
text.description: 为什么这些黑铁战士会跑来铁炉堡的大门口撒野，还妄想攻击我们的主城？$B$B尊敬的三锤议会成员茉艾拉“女皇”难道不是黑铁矮人的统治者吗？如果没有她的首肯，又怎么可能发生攻击事件呢。这帮敌人显然不是乌合之众，而是精心组织装备精良的军队啊。$B$B我准备了一份关于飞行器机坪突袭战的报告。将它带去铁炉堡的王座厅，当面质问艾茉拉！
text.progress: What is the meaning of this intrusion?
text.completion: And just what is this? This is impossible!
text.completed: 将碎石的报告交给铁炉堡王座厅的茉艾拉·铜须。

english.title: Demanding Answers
english.objectives: Take Stonebreaker's Report to Moira Thaurissan in Ironforge's High Seat.
english.description: So just how did all those Dark Iron warriors end up here, on the doorstep of Ironforge, on the verge of invading our city?$B$BDoes not 'Empress' Moira, a member of our esteemed Council of Three Hammers, rule the Dark Iron? This cannot have happened without her knowledge and consent. This was no ragtag band of rebel dwarves, but a well-organized and fully equipped invasion force.$B$BI have prepared a report on the battle for the airfield. Take it to Ironforge, to the High Seat and confront her!
english.progress: What is the meaning of this intrusion?
english.completion: And just what is this? This is impossible!
english.completed: Take Stonebreaker's Report to Moira Thaurissan in Ironforge's High Seat.

text.title: 奎艾和基恩洛
text.objectives: 在俯瞰格沙克农场的山丘上找到奎艾。
text.description: 部落占据东边的格沙克农场已经很久了，同我们其它的麻烦相比它还不算很严重。但现在有报告说那里有亡灵活动。$B$B只要是比迟钝的苦工更有威胁性的事情就值得调查。亡灵已经不止一次在农场里搞阴谋了，所以我已经派最好的斥候去侦察了。去找奎艾和基恩洛，他们会让你上阵的。
text.completion: Refuge Pointe sent you? Good to know they're still there. We've got some interesting things to check into here, $c.

english.title: Quae and Kinelory
english.objectives: Find Quae on the hill overlooking Go'shek Farm.
english.description: The Horde have held Go'shek farm to the east for a long time; it's never been of much concern compared to the rest of our problems here. But there's been reports of undead activity in the area.$B$BAnything more alarming than shuffling peons over there warrants investigation. This isn't the first time the undead have been up to no good at the farm, so I've sent my best scouts there to check it out. Report to Quae and Kinelory and they'll fill you in.
english.completion: Refuge Pointe sent you? Good to know they're still there. We've got some interesting things to check into here, $c.

text.title: 奎艾信任你
text.objectives: 跟阿拉希高地格沙克农场的基恩洛谈一谈。
text.description: <奎艾开始通读信件。>$B$B扩张……控制领土……这些亡灵还是老一套，不过他们打算侵吞的是阿拉希。咱们得粉碎他们的计划。$B$B我在这里把守，你和阿基去，拿到那些入侵计划。我们不能让那些行尸知道日子。$B$B记得保护她的安全，你听见了吗？
text.completion: The plague took our friends and family, but it was the Forsaken that took Phin. They're just as bad as the Scourge. I'll destroy every one of them with my own hands if I have to. When you're prepared, come let me know. We'll get started right away.

english.title: Quae Trusts You
english.objectives: Speak to Kinelory near Go'Shek Farm in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: <Quae begins to go through the folder.>$B$BExpansion...control of territory... these undead aren't cooking up anything new, but they're planning to roll over all of Arathi. We need to disrupt their plans.$B$BI'll keep a lookout from up here. You go with Kin, and get those invasion plans. We're not going to let these walking corpses even know what day it is out here.$B$BAnd keep her safe, you hear me?
english.completion: The plague took our friends and family, but it was the Forsaken that took Phin. They're just as bad as the Scourge. I'll destroy every one of them with my own hands if I have to. When you're prepared, come let me know. We'll get started right away.

text.title: 成为部落……
text.objectives: 了解加入部落意味着什么。
text.description: 站在我身边，$n，看着我们的强大武器是如何摧毁敌人的！$B$B了解一下加入部落意味着什么！
text.completion: Now you truly know what it means to be a member of the Horde, $n.
text.completed: Speak with High Chieftain Cliffwalker at Cliffwalker Post.

english.title: To Be Horde...
english.objectives: Learn what it means to be Horde.
english.description: Stand by me, $n, and watch as our mighty weapon destroys our enemies!$B$BLearn what it means to be Horde!
english.completion: Now you truly know what it means to be a member of the Horde, $n.
english.completed: Speak with High Chieftain Cliffwalker at Cliffwalker Post.

objectiveDetails.description: 了解加入部落意味着什么

text.title: 基恩洛出击
text.objectives: 保护基恩洛直到她回到奎艾处。
text.description: 好的，$n。你准备好了我也没问题。$B$B可以了吗？
text.completion: 你帮了我们的大忙，$N，谢谢你。$B$B但愿基恩洛刚才的凶狠善战没有吓到你。她对朋友很和善，但是对於敌人，她决不会有半点怜悯之心。$B$B
text.completed: 去找阿拉希高地的奎艾。

english.title: Kinelory Strikes
english.objectives: Protect Kinelory until she returns to Quae.
english.description: All right, $n. I'm ready if you are.$B$BShall we?
english.completion: You've done a great service for us, $n. Thank you. I hope Kin wasn't too much of a handful down there. She's very friendly, but can be just as deadly when you're her enemy.
english.completed: Return to Quae in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 为了南海镇
text.objectives: 去找避难谷地的阿玛伦指挥官。
text.description: 基恩洛在酒馆里待了一整晚出来时可比现在还糟。你显然出色地保护了她。$B$B避难谷地会愿意听到我们的喜讯的。我会和阿基留在这里，让她歇口气。你可以先走。
text.completion: I admit I'm impressed, $c. It's a small comfort amidst all that's happened here. You have fought the undead, struck back against the Horde, and honored the memory of the victims of Southshore. On behalf of the kingdom of Stromgarde, I present you with an official commendation, and this reward.

english.title: For Southshore
english.objectives: Return to Commander Amaren at Refuge Pointe.
english.description: I've seen Kinelory look way worse after a night in the tavern than she does now. You obviously did a good job protecting her.$B$BRefuge Pointe will want to know of our success. I'm going to stay here with Kin and let her catch her breath. Go on ahead without us.
english.completion: I admit I'm impressed, $c. It's a small comfort amidst all that's happened here. You have fought the undead, struck back against the Horde, and honored the memory of the victims of Southshore. On behalf of the kingdom of Stromgarde, I present you with an official commendation, and this reward.

text.title: 逮捕大使
text.objectives: 找到黑铁大使馆，使用坚实的镣铐逮捕熔锤大使。
text.description: 大使的背叛行为令我难以释怀。你必须逮捕他，否则他会制造更大的麻烦，甚至可能逃离铁炉堡并策划下一场进攻行动。有熔锤大使在的一天，铁炉堡就不安全。$B$B带上这些镣铐，找到黑铁大使馆。就在王座厅以北，大熔炉旁边。逮捕熔锤大使，带他来见我。
text.completion: The ambassador will trouble us no more. He is not the only Dark Iron $r whose heart still belongs to Twilight's Hammer. We must remember that and remain vigilant against their schemes, else my son will inherit only ruins and ashes.
text.end: 逮捕熔锤大使并将他带至王座厅
text.completed: 去找铁炉堡王座厅的茉艾拉·铜须。

english.title: Seize the Ambassador
english.objectives: Go to the Dark Iron Embassy and use the Sturdy Manacles to arrest Ambassador Slaghammer.
english.description: The ambassador's betrayal will long haunt me. You must arrest him before he can do further harm, or worse, before he can escape and start planning the next attack. Ironforge is not safe with Ambassador Slaghammer free inside the city.$B$BTake these manacles and go to the Dark Iron embassy. It's just to the north of the High Seat, around the rim of the Great Forge. Arrest Ambassador Slaghammer and return with him.
english.completion: The ambassador will trouble us no more. He is not the only Dark Iron $r whose heart still belongs to Twilight's Hammer. We must remember that and remain vigilant against their schemes, else my son will inherit only ruins and ashes.
english.end: Arrest Ambassador Slaghammer and bring him to the High Seat
english.completed: Return to Moira Bronzebeard at the High Seat in Ironforge.

text.title: 疯狂的龙喉
text.objectives: 杀死12名龙喉偷猎者。
text.description: 附近的龙喉兽人变得越来越烦人了。他们对林子发动的自杀性攻击无关痛痒，正好给我们的哨兵提供必要的训练。$B$B然而我的斥候发现他们在用网子抓捕黑龙幼崽。这块土地也不允许残忍的驯龙活动再度冒头。打到东边去，$c，打倒那些偷猎者，确保他们的愚行得以制止。
text.completion: The orcs will know better than to press further west now. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Huntress Iczelia at Greenwarden's Grove in Wetlands.

english.title: The Crazed Dragonmaw
english.objectives: Kill 12 Dragonmaw Whelpstealers.
english.description: The Dragonmaw orcs nearby are fast becoming a nuisance. Their suicidal attacks on the grove are merely annoying, though they provide my sentinels with some needed practice.$B$BMy scouts, however, have seen them rounding up black dragon whelps in nets. The last thing these lands need is a crude revival of dragon-taming. Strike out to the east, $c, and cut down the whelpstealers; make sure their folly does not come back to haunt us later.
english.completion: The orcs will know better than to press further west now. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Huntress Iczelia at Greenwarden's Grove in Wetlands.

text.title: 保卫库图恩之末
text.objectives: 在库图恩之末杀死7名地狱咆哮水兵。
text.description: 你在上面看到了间谍？这可真不妙……非常糟糕，同志。$B$B回到库图恩之末去干掉他们吧，我的朋友。
text.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Horde attacks right now.  The Pincer X2 has plenty of firepower at sea, but in the back of this cave, she is exceptionally vulnerable.
text.completed: Report to Jorlan Trueblade at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Claim Korthun's End
english.objectives: Kill 7 Hellscream Seadogs in Korthun's End.
english.description: You are seeink spies up above?  This is not good... not good at all, comrade.$b$bReturn to Korthun's End and destroy them, my friend.
english.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Horde attacks right now.  The Pincer X2 has plenty of firepower at sea, but in the back of this cave, she is exceptionally vulnerable.
english.completed: Report to Jorlan Trueblade at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 环保意识
text.objectives: 前往画笔海岭，对画笔海岭潜水龟、亮腹鮣魚和脊鳞锤头鲨的尸体使用油脂吸收泵，收集4份龟油、4份鮣魚油和4份锤头鲨鱼油。
text.description: 你有没有闻过潜水艇燃料的味道，$n？那真是臭不可闻。不幸的是，我们必须大量消耗这种燃料才能驱动凡尔纳号，所以它不但是臭气熏天，而且还严重破坏生态环境。我们必须更要有环境保护的责任心才对。$b$b附近的海洋生物体内含有大量的油质。把这件设备带到画笔海岭去——就在这座洞穴上面——从海龟、鮣魚、锤头鲨之类的海洋生物尸体上提取油料。它们提供的油料可以拯救数以百计的其它海洋生物。
text.progress: Please... don't tell the other goblins that I'm an environmentalist!  I don't think I can take the mocking!
text.completion: <Fiasco sticks a finger into each sample and sniffs it.>$b$bYes, I think this will do.
text.completed: Return to Fiasco Sizzlegrin at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Environmental Awareness
english.objectives: Use the Oil Extrusion Pump on the corpses of Seabrush Terrapins, Scourgut Remoras, and Spinescale Hammerheads in Seabrush to obtain 4 Terrapin Oil, 4 Remora Oil, and 4 Hammerhead Oil.
english.description: Have you ever smelled submarine fuel, $n?  It's nasty stuff.  Unfortunately, we need to burn huge amounts of it to get the Verne to move, and it's both bad-smelling AND deadly to the local wildlife.  We need to be more environmentally conscious.$b$bThe sea creatures nearby have particularly oily flesh.  Take this device up to Seabrush - just above this cave - and use it on the corpses of terrapins, remoras, and hammerhead sharks.  Their oil might save the lives of hundreds of other sea creatures.
english.progress: Please... don't tell the other goblins that I'm an environmentalist!  I don't think I can take the mocking!
english.completion: <Fiasco sticks a finger into each sample and sniffs it.>$b$bYes, I think this will do.
english.completed: Return to Fiasco Sizzlegrin at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.title: When in Vashj'ir...
text.objectives: Use the Seahorse Lasso near the kelp atop the pillars in Seabrush to capture 5 Panicked Seahorses.
text.description: Welcome, friend!$b$bReinforcements have arrived, and they've brought food, orcs, and fresh mounts.  Wait a minute... mounts?!$b$bHow are we supposed to get around underwater on WOLFBACK?!$b$b<Captain Verne sighs.>$b$bDirectly above this cave, in Seabrush, you will find tall pillars with red, leafy kelp on their tops.  Seahorses hide in the kelp.  Throw this lasso into the kelp and catch us some USEFUL mounts.
text.completed: Return to Captain "Jewels" Verne at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

english.title: When in Vashj'ir...
english.objectives: Use the Seahorse Lasso near the kelp atop the pillars in Seabrush to capture 5 Panicked Seahorses.
english.description: Welcome, friend!$b$bReinforcements have arrived, and they've brought food, orcs, and fresh mounts.  Wait a minute... mounts?!$b$bHow are we supposed to get around underwater on WOLFBACK?!$b$b<Captain Verne sighs.>$b$bDirectly above this cave, in Seabrush, you will find tall pillars with red, leafy kelp on their tops.  Seahorses hide in the kelp.  Throw this lasso into the kelp and catch us some USEFUL mounts.
english.completed: Return to Captain "Jewels" Verne at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 保卫画笔海岭
text.objectives: 在画笔海岭击败7名联盟海军斥候。
text.description: 联盟在这一区域部署了间谍？附近就是阴暗洞穴，里面停泊着部落的新潜艇，凡尔纳号！绝对不能让联盟接近它！$b$b得把联盟入侵这事告诉洞穴里的某人……等你干掉那些图谋不轨的联盟间谍之后就去报告一下吧。
text.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Alliance attacks right now.  The Verne's got plenty of firepower out at sea, but in the back of this cave, she's far too vulnerable.
text.completed: Report to Bloodguard Toldrek at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Secure Seabrush
english.objectives: Kill 7 Alliance Sea-Scouts in Seabrush.
english.description: The Alliance has spies in this area?  Tenebrous Cavern is nearby, and inside lies the Horde's new submarine, the Verne!  The Alliance must not be allowed anywhere nearby!$b$bSomeone in the cavern will want to hear of this incursion... after you finish slaying some more of these scheming Alliance spies.
english.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Alliance attacks right now.  The Verne's got plenty of firepower out at sea, but in the back of this cave, she's far too vulnerable.
english.completed: Report to Bloodguard Toldrek at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 保卫画笔海岭
text.objectives: 在画笔海岭杀死7名联盟海军斥候。
text.description: 你在上面看到了间谍？这可真不妙……不能放任他们不管。$B$B回到画笔海岭去，在他们潜入我们的藏身之地前除掉他们。
text.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Alliance attacks right now.  The Verne's got plenty of firepower out at sea, but in the back of this cave, she's far too vulnerable.
text.completed: Report to Bloodguard Toldrek at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Secure Seabrush
english.objectives: Kill 7 Alliance Sea-Scouts in Seabrush.
english.description: You saw spies up above?  This is not good... I won't have it.$b$bReturn to Seabrush and get rid of them before they start trickling into our hideout.
english.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Alliance attacks right now.  The Verne's got plenty of firepower out at sea, but in the back of this cave, she's far too vulnerable.
english.completed: Report to Bloodguard Toldrek at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 完美的燃料
text.objectives: 使用阴暗洞穴的燃料采样站制造完美的生物燃料。
text.description: 你对燃料学了解多少呢，$n？要制造出完美的燃料是相当费神的，有很多因素要平衡：过氧化态参数、混合燃烧变量以及速燃标准……只是随便举些例子。$B$B希望你取回的样本可以以适当的比例混合，制造出……完美的生物燃料。使用那边的台子，试着做出一些样品来！完成任务后告诉我结果。
text.completion: That's it.  Starting today, I'm shifting the Verne over to bio-fuel.  I'll send some men up to harvest more oil.$b$bThink of all the sea creatures that we've saved today, $n!
text.completed: 去瓦丝琪尔的阴暗洞穴找菲亚斯科·尖笑。

english.title: The Perfect Fuel
english.objectives: Use the Fuel Sampling Station in Tenebrous Cavern to create the perfect bio-fuel.
english.description: How much do you know about fuel, $n?  Constructing the perfect fuel is a tricky job, as there's plenty of factors to balance: chrono-pyroxidation parameters, tempero-incendiary variables, conflagrational siltification criteria... and that's only naming a few.$b$bHopefully the samples you brought me can be combined in the right proportions to create... the perfect bio-fuel.  Use that table over there and try combining some samples!  Bring the result to me when you're done.
english.completion: That's it.  Starting today, I'm shifting the Verne over to bio-fuel.  I'll send some men up to harvest more oil.$b$bThink of all the sea creatures that we've saved today, $n!
english.completed: Return to Fiasco Sizzlegrin at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 发现暮光之锤
text.objectives: 杀掉丹莫德的12名暮光之锤成员。
text.description: 我和所有人一样以为他们只是没安什么好心的黑铁矮人，没想到这些疯子是正儿八经的邪教徒！$B$B暮光之锤除了毁灭整个世界什么都不想。他们同死亡之翼和拉格纳罗斯共进退，同黑铁矮人也有过一段历史。$B$B他们是谁不重要，重要的是他们身现丹莫德，而且必须被赶出去！我不会放任何人过去的，你赶紧进去杀它个翻天覆地！
text.completion: Good show, lad, but we've no time to celebrate. Thandol Span's in danger!
text.completed: Return to Thargas Anvilmar at Dun Modr in the Wetlands.

english.title: The Twilight's Hammer Revealed
english.objectives: Kill 12 Twilight's Hammer members in Dun Modr.
english.description: I and everyone else thought these fools were just Dark Iron up to no good, but these nutters are fullblown cultists!$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer wants nothing short of the destruction of the entire world. They've thrown their lot in with Deathwing and Ragnaros, and they've got a history with the Dark Iron.$B$BBut it doesn't matter who they are, what matters is they're in Dun Modr and they need to get out! I'll not let any past here. You get in there and crack some skulls!
english.completion: Good show, lad, but we've no time to celebrate. Thandol Span's in danger!
english.completed: Return to Thargas Anvilmar at Dun Modr in the Wetlands.

text.title: 萨多尔大桥之战
text.objectives: 击败萨多尔大桥的卡拉莫斯·烬须。
text.description: 我在这里保卫萨多尔大桥，以免黑铁矮人把它摧毁。我的父亲，还有我父亲的父亲，都曾守护这座大桥……$B$B只有一个黑铁矮人趁我不备溜了过去，直冲大桥。有什么不对劲，我打赌咱们赶到的时候，等着我们的一定是肮脏的陷阱。$B$B你能帮上忙，$n，为了铁炉堡。你干不干？
text.completion: And good riddance! Thandol Span's safe thanks to you, $n, and hopefully Calamoth is down for good this time.
text.completed: Return to Thargas Anvilmar at Dun Modr in the Wetlands.

english.title: The Battle of Thandol Span
english.objectives: Defeat Calamoth Ashbeard at the Thandol Span.
english.description: I've defended the Thandol Span from being destroyed before, against the Dark Iron themselves. And so did my father, and his father before him...$B$BThe only Dark Iron that managed to give me the slip ran straight for the bridge. Something's amiss, and I'm betting when we get there we'll be waltzing right into an ugly trap.$B$BI could use your help, $n, for Ironforge. Are you with me?
english.completion: And good riddance! Thandol Span's safe thanks to you, $n, and hopefully Calamoth is down for good this time.
english.completed: Return to Thargas Anvilmar at Dun Modr in the Wetlands.

text.title: 兄弟情深
text.objectives: 跟吉尔尼斯城军事区的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 听着，$n。内战以来，这是我首次与格雷迈恩达成一致意见。我们应该放下争端，共同御敌。$B$B这些野兽根本就不关心谁是叛徒谁是忠良。$B$B请替我转告格雷迈恩，我和我的臣民愿与他携手。$B$B不远处就是约书亚的地窖，我派人在那里存储了一些军械。$B$B现在，这些物资就交给国王支配吧。
text.completion: Rebel arsenals?  In my own city? What in the bloody hell was Crowley up to?

english.title: Brothers In Arms
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane at the Military District in Gilneas City.
english.description: Listen, $n.  For the first time since the civil war I agree with Greymane.  Now is the time to put aside our quarrel.$B$BIt sure doesn't look like these beasts care much whether you're a rebel or a royal.$B$BSend word back to Greymane.  My men will join his.$B$BThere's a safehouse not far from here, in Josiah's cellar.  My lads stashed some heavy artillery there.$B$BTell our king that my arsenals are now at his disposal.
english.completion: Rebel arsenals?  In my own city? What in the bloody hell was Crowley up to?

text.title: 帮助拉葛雷克摆脱束缚
text.objectives: 杀死乌尔高兹、斯库布和尼伏拉辛。
text.description: 上古生物拉葛雷克在对面的海床上沉睡。它被某种力量操控了。我们脚下似乎有什么可怕的东西，正在缓慢地吞噬它的生命能量。$B$B在拉葛雷克下方有一处名叫海底巨蚌的洞穴。三名强大的食人魔法师通过一种神秘的仪式，将那个东西和上古之灵连接起来。你必须杀死他们，帮助拉葛雷克摆脱束缚。
text.completion: Now that you have unplugged L'ghorek, we must attempt to make contact with it. I can sense that the ancient yet lives, but only barely.
text.completed: Return to Erunak Stonespeaker atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Unplug L'ghorek
english.objectives: Slay Ur'Goz, Sku'Bu, and Neph'Lahim.
english.description: L'ghorek is the ancient that rests upon the shelf across from us. It is being controlled and its life energies slowly consumed by something immense beneath us.$B$BThere is a cave known as the Undershell down below L'ghorek. In that cave are three powerful ogre magi that are maintaining a ritual connecting the thing below with the ancient. You must kill these three to disconnect L'ghorek.
english.completion: Now that you have unplugged L'ghorek, we must attempt to make contact with it. I can sense that the ancient yet lives, but only barely.
english.completed: Return to Erunak Stonespeaker atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 洛克莫丹的援军
text.objectives: 跟大熔炉的格莱斯·瑟登谈一谈，飞往洛克莫丹。抵达目的地后跟驾驶员塞克·锤足谈一谈。
text.description: 我一直在等议会的召见，希望他们能聆听我的请求。已经过去好几个小时了，事情的进展并不顺利。茉艾拉最大的愿望似乎是阻止议会行权。$B$B与此同时，洛克莫丹仍在磨难中煎熬。敌军的数量众多，而我们可用的资源却非常稀少。求你了，$n。议会拒绝我的请求，希望你能聆听。跟铁炉堡的狮鹫管理员格莱斯·瑟登谈一谈。他就在大熔炉的东边。他会免费让你飞往南门小径。抵达目的地后，向驾驶员塞克·锤足报到吧。
text.completion: You don't know how glad I am to see fresh faces from Ironforge. Perhaps sending Mountaineer Barleybrew wasn't a waste after all.
text.completed: Speak to Pilot Hammerfoot at South Gate Outpost.

english.title: Reinforcements for Loch Modan
english.objectives: Speak to Gryth Thurden at the Great Forge for a flight to Loch Modan. Speak with Pilot Hammerfoot when you arrive.
english.description: I've been waiting for the council to hear my plea for hours, and it's not looking good. Moira's greatest desire seems to be to paralyze the council.$B$BMeanwhile, Loch Modan suffers. Our enemies are many and our resources are few. Please, $n, perhaps you will hear me if the council will not. Speak to Gryth Thurden, Ironforge's gryphon master. He's in the eastern part of the Great Forge. He'll provide a free flight to the South Gate Pass. Introduce yourself to Pilot Hammerfoot once you arrive.
english.completion: You don't know how glad I am to see fresh faces from Ironforge. Perhaps sending Mountaineer Barleybrew wasn't a waste after all.
english.completed: Speak to Pilot Hammerfoot at South Gate Outpost.

text.title: 来自虚空世界的恶魔
text.objectives: 杀死8只虚空恶魔。
text.description: 海底巨蚌中的食人魔法师召唤出来自虚空世界的血肉恶魔，保护他们的仪式不受干扰。$B$B这些异形随后很可能被用来攻击我们，我们不能承受这样的风险。我要你前往海底巨蚌，尽可能多地杀死这些生物。
text.completion: The last thing we needed was a bunch of summoned creatures swarming our forces during the final assault.
text.completed: Return to Captain Taylor atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Fiends from the Netherworld
english.objectives: Slay 8 Nether Fiends.
english.description: The ogre magi within the Undershell have summoned protectors for themselves: fleshling fiends from the netherworld.$B$BWe cannot risk these aberrations from being later used against our forces. While you are in there, I want you to destroy as many of those things as you can.
english.completion: The last thing we needed was a bunch of summoned creatures swarming our forces during the final assault.
english.completed: Return to Captain Taylor atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 来自虚空世界的恶魔
text.objectives: 杀死8只虚空恶魔。
text.description: 海底巨蚌中的食人魔法师召唤出来自虚空世界的血肉恶魔，保护他们的仪式不受干扰。$B$B我可不希望这些异形被用来对付我们。我要你前往海底巨蚌，将它们统统杀掉！
text.completion: That's one less thing we need to think about during the final assault.
text.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Fiends from the Netherworld
english.objectives: Slay 8 Nether Fiends.
english.description: Those ogre magi inside the Undershell have summoned defenders: fleshling fiends from the netherworld.$B$BI do not want to see these aberrations used against our forces. While you are in there, destroy all of them!
english.completion: That's one less thing we need to think about during the final assault.
english.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 人非事休
text.objectives: 跟凄凉之地塔迪萨兰的弗瑞恩谈一谈。
