text.description: 这里已经没什么留给你的了，$n。至于我，我要让玛莎入土为安。之后我会到爆炸点去，让大地重生。也许有一天，一片新的林地会绽放——一片被我的孩子和年轻暗夜精灵的灵魂所浇灌的林地。$B$B如果你想到凄凉之地去，我听说有个叫做弗瑞恩的血精灵正在寻找旅伴。或许你可以去找他。$B$B再会了，朋友，我永远不会忘记你。
text.completion: <Furien groans.>

english.title: Nothing Left for You Here
english.objectives: Speak to Furien at Tethris Aran in Desolace.
english.description: There is nothing left for you here, $n. As for me, I must lay Masha's body to rest. Once I have done that I will go to the bombing site and begin the process of regrowth. Perhaps one day a new grove will bloom - a grove infused with the spirit of my child and the fallen night elf youths.$B$BIf you wish to travel to Desolace, I hear word of a blood elf named Furien seeking adventuring partners. Perhaps you should seek him out.$B$BFarewell, friend, I will never forget you.
english.completion: <Furien groans.>

text.title: 过去的影像：自深渊崛起
text.objectives: 在奎尔多米尔神殿某处使用女武士的断剑来目睹她最后的经历。
text.description: 你之前告诉我关于纳迦的事情一直萦绕在我的脑海里。他们召唤的盟友到底是谁？他们真的认为自己可以击败猎潮者吗？$B$B逃出洞穴让人松了一口气，但我们在这里还有未竟的事情。我希望你能最后一次从女武士那里寻得答案。$B$B我想他们只可能把神器带到一个地方去——废墟顶部的神殿。显然那里会有重兵把守。小心行事。
text.completion: Minions of the Old God? Two very potent foes have joined forces then. Their hope to defeat the Tidehunter may not be so foolish after all.$B$B$n, we can't let that happen. If Azshara defeats the Tidehunter and takes his power for herself, I'm not sure any number of us could ever hope to oppose her on the seas.$B$BThe first step is clear at least - we need to hunt down the fiend that destroyed our ships. The navy was confident enough to bring in a new fleet, perhaps they have a plan.
text.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Tulra in Legion's Rest.

english.title: Visions of the Past: Rise from the Deep
english.objectives: Witness the concluding story of the Battlemaiden by using her broken blade somewhere in the Temple of Quel'Dormir.
english.description: What you told me of the naga before has been plaguing my mind. Who are these allies they're summoning? Do they really think they can defeat the Tidehunter?$B$BEscaping this cave brings a degree of relief, but our purpose here remains. I'm hoping you will be willing to seek answers from the Battlemaiden one last time.$B$BThere's only one place that I can think of where they would have taken the artifact - the temple atop the ruins. It's sure to be well guarded. Proceed carefully.
english.completion: Minions of the Old God? Two very potent foes have joined forces then. Their hope to defeat the Tidehunter may not be so foolish after all.$B$B$n, we can't let that happen. If Azshara defeats the Tidehunter and takes his power for herself, I'm not sure any number of us could ever hope to oppose her on the seas.$B$BThe first step is clear at least - we need to hunt down the fiend that destroyed our ships. The navy was confident enough to bring in a new fleet, perhaps they have a plan.
english.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Tulra in Legion's Rest.

objectiveDetails.description: 目睹女武士最后的经历

text.title: 小子们情况如何
text.objectives: 到湿地去同丹奥加兹附近的巡山人拉伦谈一谈。
text.description: 我相信你已经看到洛克湖的情况有多糟了。恐怕糟糕的局面还会进一步扩大。所有这些水总得有地方去，那地方就是湿地。$B$B那儿有不少出色的矮人正在进行抗洪，但他们需要资源补给。这就是为什么我派了两个巡山人押着一桶啤酒沿着路前往湿地的原因。$B$B自从他们出发前往丹奥加兹后，我就没有他们的消息了。你介不介意去看看他们的情况？
text.completion: Ah, well met, $c. Stormpike sent you? About the keg? Hoo boy...

english.title: Checking on the Boys
english.objectives: Travel to the Wetlands and speak to Mountaineer Rharen near Dun Algaz.
english.description: I'm sure you've seen just how bad the damage to the Loch is by now. The damage spreads further than that, I'm afraid; all that water had to go somewhere, and it went down into the Wetlands.$B$BThere's a lot of fine dwarves down there trying to help out, and they need supplies. That's why I sent two of my mountaineers ahead with a cask of ale along the path into the Wetlands.$B$BI haven't heard back from them since they set off down the road to Dun Algaz. Would you mind checking up on them?
english.completion: Ah, well met, $c. Stormpike sent you? About the keg? Hoo boy...

text.title: 费里隆·叶生
text.objectives: 到绿色守卫者林地去找费里隆·叶生。
text.description: 有群暗夜精灵最近来湿地定居，一些是从卡利姆多坐船过来研究这儿的风土，瞧瞧植物什么的，就是类似的事情啦。$B$B有个叫作费里隆的德鲁伊前阵子来这儿待下了。人还不错，帮我们处理了迅猛龙的事儿，他提到过想要人帮忙。$B$B要是你有空，可以去东北边他们叫做绿色守卫者林地的地方找他。

english.title: Ferilon Leafborn
english.objectives: Find Ferilon Leafborn at Greenwarden's Grove.
english.description: There's a group of night elves that call the wetlands home now. A bunch of them shipped in from Kalimdor to study the land here, look at the plants, that sort of stuff.$B$BOne of the druids by the name of Ferilon stopped by here a while back. He was nice enough to give us a hand with some raptors, and he mentioned something about needing more folk to help out with his duties.$B$BIf you've got the time, you'll find him at the place they call Greenwarden's Grove, to the northeast.

text.title: 进入阿拉希
text.objectives: 去阿拉希高地跟避难谷地的尼艾丝队长谈一谈。
text.description: 你必须去警告大桥另一头的人，$n。$B$B在桥的北边就是避难谷地，联盟在阿拉希的要塞。告诉尼艾丝队长当心那些暮光之锤的家伙。
text.completion: I suppose I owe Thargas a favor for sending such a bold hero my way. Or perhaps he just wanted to keep all the clean-up for himself. Regardless, you'll find much to do here for the Alliance.

english.title: Into Arathi
english.objectives: Travel to Arathi Highlands and speak with Captain Nials in Refuge Pointe.
english.description: You should go on ahead and warn the other side of the span about this, $n.$B$BOver the bridge to the north you'll find Refuge Pointe, the stronghold of the Alliance in Arathi. Tell Captain Nials to keep an eye out for these Twilight's Hammer curs.
english.completion: I suppose I owe Thargas a favor for sending such a bold hero my way. Or perhaps he just wanted to keep all the clean-up for himself. Regardless, you'll find much to do here for the Alliance.

text.title: 与上古生物交流
text.objectives: 将不可估量者的触须交给瓦丝琪尔拉葛雷克脑室的拉葛雷克。
text.description: 将死去的无悯怪放在头顶，冒充成奴隶的样子。$B$B进入拉葛雷克。与上古之灵交流。
text.progress: I SENSE... SOMETHING. COME CLOSER....
text.completion: WISE OF... YOUR ERUNAK TO... HAVE... YOU USE... THE FACELESS' BRAIN. I SEE... YOU NOW.$B$BI WILL DIE. THERE IS NO... STOPPING... THE INEVITABLE.$B$BBUT... YOU WILL HELP... ME DEAL WITH... THESE PARASITES FIRST.

english.title: Communing with the Ancient
english.objectives: Deliver the Brain of the Unfathomable to L'ghorek in the Cerebrillum inside of L'ghorek in Vashj'ir.
english.description: Place the dead merciless one upon your head to pose as one of their slaves.$B$BEnter L'ghorek. Commune with the ancient.
english.progress: I SENSE... SOMETHING. COME CLOSER....
english.completion: WISE OF... YOUR ERUNAK TO... HAVE... YOU USE... THE FACELESS' BRAIN. I SEE... YOU NOW.$B$BI WILL DIE. THERE IS NO... STOPPING... THE INEVITABLE.$B$BBUT... YOU WILL HELP... ME DEAL WITH... THESE PARASITES FIRST.

text.title: 禁锢符文石
text.objectives: 收集7块禁锢符文石。
text.description: 房间的……另一端……是……候选的……升腾者。$B$B需要……找到……他们的……禁锢符文石……才能……控制……被禁锢的元素生物。
text.progress: DO... YOU HAVE... ALL THAT IS... REQUIRED?
text.completion: WE WILL USE... THESE... RUNESTONES TO ALLOW... YOU TO POSSESS... ONE OF... THE WATER ELEMENTALS.
text.completed: Return to L'ghorek in the Cerebrillum inside of L'ghorek in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Runestones of Binding
english.objectives: Collect 7 Runestones of Binding.
english.description: ON THE OTHER... SIDE OF... MY CHAMBER THERE... ARE... CANDIDATES FOR ASCENSION.$B$BWE WILL NEED... THEIR... RUNESTONES OF BINDING... TO CREATE A... MEANS OF CONTROLLING... A BOUND ELEMENTAL.
english.progress: DO... YOU HAVE... ALL THAT IS... REQUIRED?
english.completion: WE WILL USE... THESE... RUNESTONES TO ALLOW... YOU TO POSSESS... ONE OF... THE WATER ELEMENTALS.
english.completed: Return to L'ghorek in the Cerebrillum inside of L'ghorek in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 阻止升腾仪式！
text.objectives: 摧毁5根上古导管。
text.description: 要阻止……他们的……升腾仪式……必须摧毁……上古导管。$B$B他们利用……这种导管……汲取……我的能量……并成为……升腾者。$B$B与耐普图隆的……激战……迫在眉睫。必须……消灭……暮光之锤。
text.completion: THEY SHALL ASCEND... NO MORE!
text.completed: Return to L'ghorek in the Cerebrillum inside of L'ghorek in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Ascend No More!
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Ancient Conduits.
english.description: TO STOP... THEIR... RITUALS OF ASCENSION... YOU MUST DESTROY... THE ANCIENT CONDUITS.$B$BTHEY USE... THE CONDUITS TO... SIPHON... MY ENERGIES AWAY... AND MAKE... ASCENDANTS.$B$BA FIGHT WITH... NEPTULON IS IMMINENT. THE TWILIGHT'S HAMMER... MUST BE DENIED... THESE CREATURES.
english.completion: THEY SHALL ASCEND... NO MORE!
english.completed: Return to L'ghorek in the Cerebrillum inside of L'ghorek in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 升腾者
text.objectives: 杀死升腾者海纳泽尔。
text.description: <你的脑海里回荡着上古生灵的声音。>$B$B你……已经……偷取了……信徒们的……能量，进入……神殿……消灭……升腾者海纳泽尔！
text.completion: YOU HAVE DONE... MYSELF AND... THE TIDEHUNTER GREAT... SERVICE.
text.completed: Return to L'ghorek in the Cerebrillum inside of L'ghorek in Vashj'ir.
text.giverWindow: 使用被占据的奔流杀死升腾者海纳泽尔。

english.title: All that Rises
english.objectives: Slay Hallazeal the Ascended.
english.description: <The voice of the ancient presses against your mind.>$B$BNOW THAT... YOU HAVE STOLEN... THE ENERGIES OF... THE FAITHFUL, ENTER... THE TEMPLE AND... DESTROY... HALLAZEAL THE ASCENDED!
english.completion: YOU HAVE DONE... MYSELF AND... THE TIDEHUNTER GREAT... SERVICE.
english.completed: Return to L'ghorek in the Cerebrillum inside of L'ghorek in Vashj'ir.
english.giverWindow: Use the possessed torrent to slay this thing and put an end to the Ascended in Vashj'ir!

text.title: 囚徒
text.objectives: 营救5名联盟囚犯。
text.description: 你在暮光教徒身上找到了这枚钥匙。用它营救被关押在拉葛雷克里的联盟囚犯。$B$B快点，不然他们就会变成供下面的未知怪物享用的祭品！

english.title: Prisoners
english.objectives: Rescue 5 Alliance Prisoners.
english.description: The Twilight cultist dropped this key. Use it to free the Alliance prisoners in the cages inside of L'ghorek.$B$BHurry before the prisoners become sacrifices to whatever lurks below!

text.title: 穴居人的威胁
text.objectives: 收集8颗穴居人的石牙。
text.description: $C，不知你注意到没有，穴居人的威胁正在矮人领土周围显现。铁炉堡预备部队被征召到了联盟前线，我们兵力不足，后防空虚。我的团受命驻守在镇里，为了以防入侵，无法离开岗位。$b$b但我们要给潜伏在山上的那些该死的穴居人施加压力。如果你打算担负起这个任务，就对穴居人发动攻击。给我带8颗穴居人的石牙来作为证据。
text.progress: Do you have eight trogg stone teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $n.
text.completion: 我很满意，$N。你保卫了我们矮人的领土，给我们帮了大忙。国王麦格尼·铜须陛下会为你骄傲的!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Cobbleflint at the Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.

english.title: The Trogg Threat
english.objectives: Collect 8 Trogg Stone Teeth.
english.description: $C, you may or may not be aware of the trogg threat looming over dwarven lands.  With the Ironforge Reserve called up to the Alliance Front, we're left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe.  My regiment is assigned to watch over the town here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.$b$bBut we need some pressure put on those damned troggs lurking in the hills.  If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the troggs.  Bring me back eight trogg stone teeth as proof.
english.progress: Do you have eight trogg stone teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $n.
english.completion: I am quite impressed, $n.  You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands.  King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Cobbleflint at the Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.

text.title: 为了保卫国王的领土
text.objectives: 杀死12只碎石穴居人或碎石怪斥候。
text.description: 我们要保护洛克湖，$n！那么多国王的士兵都在远方英勇作战，我们在家乡的战线却遭到了压制。穴居人正从每一个岩缝中挖通道出来！他们是铁炉堡最大的威胁。$b$b我们需要你，勇敢的冒险者，去把穴居人的威胁铲除。杀掉12个碎石穴居人，然后回来。
text.progress: Loch Modan is under siege, $n! We need every able-bodied member of the Alliance to aid our cause. Have you killed those troggs yet?
text.completion: Well done, $n!  You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield.  Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours.  You have served King Magni well.
text.completed: Return to Captain Rugelfuss at the Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.

english.title: In Defense of the King's Lands
english.objectives: Kill 12 Stonesplinter Troggs or Stonesplinter Scouts.
english.description: We need to protect the Loch, $n! With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front. Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice! The trogg infestation poses the largest threat to Ironforge.$b$bWe need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the trogg threat. Slay twelve Stonesplinter troggs and venture back.
english.progress: Loch Modan is under siege, $n! We need every able-bodied member of the Alliance to aid our cause. Have you killed those troggs yet?
english.completion: Well done, $n!  You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield.  Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours.  You have served King Magni well.
english.completed: Return to Captain Rugelfuss at the Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.

text.title: 更大更丑
text.objectives: 杀死8名碎石怪萨满祭司和8名碎石怪断骨者。
text.description: 巡山人都说你既勇敢又能干，$n。我们这里就需要一个像你这样的$r。穴居人的问题并没有好转。保卫军被召到前线去了，只留下我们在这里。但现在我们有了一个熟练的$c，让我们看看你都有什么能耐。$b$b去杀掉8名碎石怪萨满祭司和8名碎石怪断骨者。他们就遍布在南部山脉洞穴的里里外外。$B$B让我们看看你是否名副其实的穴居人杀手。
text.completion: I knew the second I laid eyes on you, $n, that you would make Ironforge proud.  You have served our people well. I salute you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Wallbang at the Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.

english.title: Bigger and Uglier
english.objectives: Kill 8 Stonesplinter Shaman and 8 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.
english.description: The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, $n.  We need a $r like you around here.  The Trogg problem isn't getting any better.  The reserves have been called to the front and we're all alone out here.  But now that we have a seasoned $c here, let's see what you can do.$b$bGo out and kill 8 Stonesplinter Shaman and 8 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers. You should find them in and around the caves in the southern mountains.$B$BLet's see if you live up to your reputation, Trogg-Slayer.
english.completion: I knew the second I laid eyes on you, $n, that you would make Ironforge proud.  You have served our people well. I salute you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Wallbang at the Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.

text.title: 决定性的一击
text.objectives: 杀掉格劳姆格。
text.description: 貌似洛克莫丹的这些畜生都在听从一个叫做格劳姆格的酋长指挥。他是所有穴居人里最大的一个，深深地潜伏在北边洞穴的黑暗之中。$b$b如果你觉得自己是这块料，$n，我就想让你来指挥暗杀格劳姆格的任务。
text.progress: Your mission is not complete until Grawmug has been brought to death. Khaz Modan is counting on you, $n.
text.completion: 干得很出色，$N!你为洛克莫丹带来了希望。格劳姆格一死，我们就更有希望把穴居人从这片土地上彻底消灭掉。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Rugelfuss at the Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.
text.giverWindow: 击败他！

english.title: A Decisive Strike
english.objectives: Kill Grawmug.
english.description: It appears that these beasts in Loch Modan are following the lead of a chieftain named Grawmug. He's the biggest of all the troggs here, lurking deep within the darkness of the caves to the north.$b$bIf you feel yourself worthy, $n, I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug.
english.progress: Your mission is not complete until Grawmug has been brought to death. Khaz Modan is counting on you, $n.
english.completion: Most excellent, $n! You have brought hope to Loch Modan. With Grawmug dead, we stand a better chance of seeing the Troggs eliminated from the land.
english.completed: Return to Captain Rugelfuss at the Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.
english.giverWindow: Kill him!

text.title: 囚徒
text.objectives: 营救5名部落囚犯。
text.description: 你在暮光教徒身上找到了这枚钥匙。用它营救被关押在拉葛雷克的部落囚犯。$B$B快点，不然他们就会变成供下面的未知怪物享用的祭品！
text.completion: A job well done. Now you don't need to worry about what would have happened to them if you hadn't been around.$B$BThe last one was even appreciative enough to give you a reward they'd kept hidden on their person.

english.title: Prisoners
english.objectives: Rescue 5 Horde Prisoners.
english.description: The Twilight cultist dropped this key. Use it to free the Horde prisoners in the cages inside of L'ghorek.$B$BHurry before the prisoners become sacrifices to whatever lurks below!
english.completion: A job well done. Now you don't need to worry about what would have happened to them if you hadn't been around.$B$BThe last one was even appreciative enough to give you a reward they'd kept hidden on their person.

text.title: 拜访梅贝尔
text.objectives: 与艾尔文森林马科伦农场的梅贝尔·马科伦交谈。
text.description: 你看上去挺靠谱的，$n。能帮我这个老头子一个忙吗？$B$B上次我去马科伦农场的时候，听到梅贝尔在她的小屋里哭泣。你能去看看她出了什么事吗？我有点担心她。
text.completion: William sent you? Bless his soul. I... I'm ok... It's just... Well...

english.title: A Visit With Maybell
english.objectives: Speak to Maybell Maclure at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: You seem like the helpful type, $n. How about doing an old man a favor?$B$BThe last time I was over at the Maclure Vineyards I overheard Maybell crying in her cottage. Would you be so kind as to go check up on her? I'm a little worried.
english.completion: William sent you? Bless his soul. I... I'm ok... It's just... Well...

text.title: 黑色信件
text.objectives: 阅读这封黑色信件，然后与北郡山谷墓地中的杜希拉·拉萨雷交谈。
text.description: 有人把这封信交给我，说是等你从狗头人营地回来之后立即交给你，$N。信封上盖着虚空的印记——肯定是这里的术士训练师写给你的。如果我是你的话肯定会毫不犹豫的先看看这信里写了些什么。

english.title: Dark Letter
english.objectives: Read the Dark Letter and speak to Drusilla La Salle at the graveyard in Northshire Valley.
english.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of the void - no doubt a message from our local warlock trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

text.title: 通缉：詹姆斯·克拉克
text.objectives: 杀死詹姆斯·克拉克，并取走詹姆斯·克拉克的徽记。
text.description: 根据暴风城军队的判决，在此悬赏詹姆斯·克拉克。$B$B克拉克犯有抢劫罪、盗窃罪、纵火罪和谋杀罪。他还涉嫌绑架布莱克威尔家的获奖名猪，“公主”。$B$B最后一次有人目击詹姆斯·克拉克的行踪是在东谷伐木场。$B$B将詹姆斯·克拉克正法，然后向东谷伐木场的治安官帕特尔森汇报。
text.progress: Turning in a bounty?
text.completion: 正义得以伸张！
text.completed: Take James Clark's Head to Marshal McCree at Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Wanted: James Clark
english.objectives: Kill James Clark and take James Clark's Head.
english.description: By decree of the Stormwind Army, a bounty has been placed on the head of James Clark.$B$BClark is wanted for robbery, burglary, arson, and murder. He is also a suspect in the kidnapping and disappearance of the Brackwell's prized pig, Princess.$B$BJames Clark was last seen heading towards Eastvale Logging Camp.$B$BBring James Clark to justice and report to Marshal McCree at Eastvale Logging Camp.
english.progress: Turning in a bounty?
english.completion: And justice is served!
english.completed: Take James Clark's Head to Marshal McCree at Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 潘妮的南瓜饼
text.objectives: 收集6个暴风城南瓜，把它们交给暴风城的罗比·弗雷。
text.description: 我女儿潘妮很喜欢南瓜饼，但是上个季度的霜冻使得艾尔文森林的南瓜产量锐减。听说暴风城北边有一片新的南瓜田，也许那里还有成熟的南瓜。去帮我采集一些成熟的南瓜，我来把它们做成美味佳肴。
text.progress: 你收集完南瓜了嗎？
text.completion: 做得好，$n！潘妮看到明天的早餐一定會很興奮的！
text.completed: Return to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

english.title: Penny's Pumpkin Pancakes
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Stormwind Pumpkins.  Deliver them to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.
english.description: My daughter Penny loves pumpkin pancakes but we have had a shortage of pumpkins here in Elwynn from the frostbite last season.  I have heard of a new pumpkin patch north of Stormwind that might be ripe for the picking now though.  Head out and harvest a few of those ripe pumpkins for me and let's see what we can do.
english.progress: Have you finished collecting the pumpkins?
english.completion: Nice job, $n! Penny will be very excited for breakfast tomorrow!
english.completed: Return to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

text.title: 暮光大扫除
text.objectives: 占据一个束缚奔流，然后杀死50名暮光狂信者和10名无面监督者。
text.description: 使用……调合过的……符文石……占据……中央神殿中的……一个……束缚奔流。他们就不会……注意到你了。$B$B利用……元素的力量……偷取……能量……然后消灭……暮光狂信者……以及……他们的……无面监督者。
text.completion: THEIR DEVOTIONS ARE... SILENCED.$B$BNOW THAT... YOU HAVE... THEIR POWER... YOU MUST DESTROY... THEIR LEADER.

english.title: Twilight Extermination
english.objectives: Possess a Bound Torrent and then slay 50 Twilight Devotees and 10 Faceless Overseers.
english.description: NOW, TAKE... THE ATTUNED RUNESTONE... AND USE... IT TO POSSESS... ONE OF... THE BOUND TORRENTS... AT... THE CENTRAL TEMPLE. THEY WILL IGNORE... YOU. YOU ARE BENEATH... THEIR NOTICE.$B$BUSE... THE ELEMENTAL'S POWERS... TO DESTROY... THE TWILIGHT DEVOTEES... AND... THEIR... FACELESS OVERSEERS.
english.completion: THEIR DEVOTIONS ARE... SILENCED.$B$BNOW THAT... YOU HAVE... THEIR POWER... YOU MUST DESTROY... THEIR LEADER.

text.title: A Dark Threat, Remembered
text.objectives: Obtain the Stonewrought Schematics from the Dark Iron in the center of The Loch.`
text.description: Years ago, the Dark Iron tried to destroy the Stonewrought Dam. Moira may be parked in Ironforge's fancy new senate, but I'm not about to forget the past, not when a whole field trip of them are milling about here in the Loch.$B$BI need you to get in there and find out what they're really up to. Find their real plans. They'll no doubt be in the center of their camp.$B$BTry not to be seen... but if you are, defend yourself, $n. I'd hate to lose a good $r out there.
text.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk at the Mo'grosh Camp in Loch Modan.

english.title: A Dark Threat, Remembered
english.objectives: Obtain the Stonewrought Schematics from the Dark Iron in the center of The Loch.`
english.description: Years ago, the Dark Iron tried to destroy the Stonewrought Dam. Moira may be parked in Ironforge's fancy new senate, but I'm not about to forget the past, not when a whole field trip of them are milling about here in the Loch.$B$BI need you to get in there and find out what they're really up to. Find their real plans. They'll no doubt be in the center of their camp.$B$BTry not to be seen... but if you are, defend yourself, $n. I'd hate to lose a good $r out there.
english.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk at the Mo'grosh Camp in Loch Modan.

text.title: All The King's Men
text.objectives: Kill 6 Dark Iron Sappers.
text.description: The Stonewrought Dam may already be broken, $n, but it holds back more than just water. The whole thing's hanging by a thread. With the land already destabilized, if they blow the remaining part of the dam...$B$B...half of Loch Modan could collapse! The damage would be even more catastrophic. We'll be standing on a giant sinkhole if we don't act fast.$B$BGet to the Stonewrought Dam and stop those Dark Iron Sappers. Make sure none of them get away!
text.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk at the Mo'grosh Camp in Loch Modan.

english.title: All The King's Men
english.objectives: Kill 6 Dark Iron Sappers.
english.description: The Stonewrought Dam may already be broken, $n, but it holds back more than just water. The whole thing's hanging by a thread. With the land already destabilized, if they blow the remaining part of the dam...$B$B...half of Loch Modan could collapse! The damage would be even more catastrophic. We'll be standing on a giant sinkhole if we don't act fast.$B$BGet to the Stonewrought Dam and stop those Dark Iron Sappers. Make sure none of them get away!
english.completed: Return to Ashlan Stonesmirk at the Mo'grosh Camp in Loch Modan.

text.title: 卡西姆·夏利姆
text.objectives: 向诅咒之地盘蛇谷深处的卡西姆·夏利姆报到。
text.description: 我要你去帮我传个话。$b$b卡西姆·夏利姆是个对诅咒之地的恶魔了如指掌的老血法师。虽然外表看不出来，但他确实很老，而且很强大……还有点古怪。最近，他在盘蛇谷的深处打发时间，那座洞穴距离你杀死那些教徒的地方不远。$b$b请你把这张便笺交给他，他会知道怎么办的。
text.progress: I don't know you.
text.completion: Hah!  You Nethergarde nincompoops are always two steps behind me, and I'm nowhere near as fast as I used to be. I don't need Mahar's note to know what's going on.  Why do you think I'm cooped up in the back of this cave?  What I do need, however, is a strong $r like you.
text.giverWindow: 血巫师，古怪的隐士

english.title: Kasim Sharim
english.objectives: Report to Kasim Sharim in the back of the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: I need you to pass on a message for me.$b$bKasim Sharim is an old blood mage that knows a great deal about the demons of the Blasted Lands.  Though you wouldn't know from looking at him, he's quite old, and very powerful... if a little eccentric.  As of late, he spends his days in the back of the Serpent's Coil, a cave not far from where you killed those cultists.$b$bPlease, deliver this message to him.  He will know what it means.
english.progress: I don't know you.
english.completion: Hah!  You Nethergarde nincompoops are always two steps behind me, and I'm nowhere near as fast as I used to be. I don't need Mahar's note to know what's going on.  Why do you think I'm cooped up in the back of this cave?  What I do need, however, is a strong $r like you.
english.giverWindow: Blood wizard and eccentric recluse

text.title: 血石同调
text.objectives: 与盘蛇谷的血石传送器进行同调。
text.description: 一路打回来的感觉还好吧？我承认，我没有选择……最合适的地点来进行研究，特别是在路过的冒险者想要随意进出的情况下。$b$b不过，我可以让你和我的血石传送器进行同调。只要把你的手放在角落里的那块石头上，就可以传送到洞穴外面了。如果你想回来的话，可以用洞外的石头再传送回来！
text.completion: Excellent!  You've managed to complete the simplest of tasks without dying.  Now that that's out of the way...
text.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Attune the Bloodstone
english.objectives: Attune yourself to the Bloodstone Teleporters in the Serpent's Coil.
english.description: Did you have fun fighting your way to the back of this cave?  I admit, I haven't picked the most... convenient of spots to perform my studies, especially for passing adventurers who wish to enter and leave at will.$b$bHowever, I can allow you to attune yourself to my bloodstone teleporters.  Simply place your hands on the stone in the back corner, and you will be teleported outside of the cave.  Then use the stone outside to teleport back!
english.completion: Excellent!  You've managed to complete the simplest of tasks without dying.  Now that that's out of the way...
english.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 第一步
text.objectives: 收集9瓶弯牙土狼的血液和9瓶红石蜥蜴的血。
text.description: 像所有优秀的血法师一样，我用血来引导魔法。所有的血液都各有特色，而诅咒之地出产一些特别的血液，如果你知道该去哪里找的话。$B$B对于我们来说，需要等量的蜥蜴血和土狼血，而且要许多。到西边去，在诅咒之地的中心地带找找。另外别忘了……你可以使用那个传送器！
text.progress: Do you have it?
text.completion: More than enough, and still warm!  Now, let's get this ritual started, shall we?
text.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The First Step
english.objectives: Obtain 9 vials of Snickerfang Hyena Blood and 9 vials of Redstone Basilisk Blood.
english.description: Like any good bloodmage, I perform my magic with blood.  All blood is different, and the Blasted Lands has several useful flavors, if you know where to look.$b$bFor our purposes?  Basilisks and hyenas, even amounts.  We're going to need plenty of it.  Head west, to the center of the Blasted Lands.  And don't forget... you can use that teleporter!
english.progress: Do you have it?
english.completion: More than enough, and still warm!  Now, let's get this ritual started, shall we?
english.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 鲜血仪祭
text.objectives: 与卡西姆·夏利姆交谈，开始鲜血仪祭。
text.description: 我想，你希望搞清楚我们在做什么。那么我就长话短说——这方面我可是专家：$b$b魔誓教徒想要把恶魔拉瑟莱克再次召唤到诅咒之地来。我们可不能让他们得逞。所以呢，我们要自己来召唤他，然后把他杀掉。这件事说起来容易做起来难……$b$b等你准备好开始鲜血仪祭了，就告诉我一声，然后站远点。
text.progress: The ritual is not yet complete.
text.completion: The blood ritual was a success; I can clearly see where we are going next. I'm sorry, I misspoke.  What I meant to say is, I can see where YOU are going next...
text.end: 与卡西姆·夏利姆交谈，开始鲜血仪祭
text.completed: 去找诅咒之地盘蛇谷的卡西姆·夏利姆。

english.title: Blood Ritual
english.objectives: Speak with Kasim Sharim to begin the blood ritual.
english.description: I suppose you want to know what we're doing.  Here's the short version - a version at which I happen to be an expert:$b$bThe Shadowsworn cultists wish to summon the demon, Razelikh, back to the Blasted Lands.  We cannot allow this to happen.  So we're going to summon him ourselves, and then kill him.  A task not as simple as it sounds...$b$bLet me know when you are ready to begin the blood ritual, and then stand back.
english.progress: The ritual is not yet complete.
english.completion: The blood ritual was a success; I can clearly see where we are going next. I'm sorry, I misspoke.  What I meant to say is, I can see where YOU are going next...
english.end: Speak with Kasim Sharim to begin the blood ritual
english.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 特别的尸体
text.objectives: 找到洛拉姆斯的头颅、洛拉姆斯的躯干和洛拉姆斯的腿。
text.description: 我们需要恶魔猎手洛拉姆斯·萨里比迪斯，他知道拉瑟莱克的真名。你应该也明白，如果你知道一个恶魔的真名，它对你来说就是小菜一碟。问题是，洛拉姆斯早就被杀了，而且还被分了尸。$b$b如果你能把他的躯体凑起来，我们也许还有办法。尸体的三部分都在西边……巨槌食人魔把它们藏在洞穴里。快一点行动吧，跟格雷米奥一样，洛拉姆斯也欠我的债……
text.progress: Trust me... whatever happened to Loramus, we can fix.  The limits of blood magic are still undefined.
text.completion: I see... yes, I can work with this. Loramus Thalipedes, demon hunter.  I look forward to our reunion.
text.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.
text.giverWindow: 恶魔猎手还活着时的模样。

english.title: Not Just Any Body
english.objectives: Find Loramus' Head, Loramus' Torso, and Loramus' Legs.
english.description: We need Loramus Thalipedes, the demon hunter.  He knows Razelikh's true name, and as you know: if you know the name of the demon, you have power over it.  The problem is that Loramus has been killed, and his body torn apart.$b$bIf you bring me the pieces, we still have a recourse.  All three pieces are in the west... the Dreadmaul ogres hide them in their caves.  Move quickly, for much like Grimeo, Loramus also owes me a debt...
english.progress: Trust me... whatever happened to Loramus, we can fix.  The limits of blood magic are still undefined.
english.completion: I see... yes, I can work with this. Loramus Thalipedes, demon hunter.  I look forward to our reunion.
english.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.
english.giverWindow: The demon hunter in life.

text.title: 风暴祭坛
text.objectives: 将洛拉姆斯的躯体带到风暴祭坛去，然后在仪式进行期间保护它。
text.description: 西边的断崖上有一座祭坛。那是一座威力强大的恶魔祭坛，虽然是由教徒保护着，但它本身也是非常强大的。如果你能到祭坛上去，就可以用它来将洛拉姆斯带回我们身边。$B$B祭坛很可能会抵抗你的法术，因此你必须在仪式进行期间保护洛拉姆斯的躯体。结束之后，把这位恶魔猎手带到我这里来。
text.completion: You... you fool!  What have you done?
text.completed: Return to Loramus Thalipedes at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The Altar of Storms
english.objectives: Bring Loramus' Body to the Altar of Storms, then protect it while the ritual completes.
english.description: Up on the bluffs to the west lies a powerful altar.  A powerful DEMONIC altar, guarded by cultists, but powerful nonetheless.  If you can reach it, you can use it to bring Loramus back to us.$b$bThe altar will likely resist your efforts, so you'll have to protect Loramus' body while the ritual completes.  Bring the demon hunter back to me afterwards.
english.completion: You... you fool!  What have you done?
english.completed: Return to Loramus Thalipedes at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 时间紧迫
text.objectives: 将不谐符文交给诅咒之地黑暗之门的观察者格雷米奥。
text.description: 拉瑟莱克想要重返诅咒之地，并指挥他的恶魔征服艾泽拉斯。眼下，他正在准备召唤他的军团把我们全部消灭。有了这三个护符，我们就可以召唤他……但仍然没办法毁灭它。$B$B<侏儒迅速在空中画了一个符文，然后把它交给了你。>$B$B把这个交给黑暗之门那里的格雷米奥，他就在东南边。他会告诉你该怎么做的。快一点！时间紧迫！
text.progress: Do I know you, good $r?
text.completion: No, no, no... not Kasim again!  This is madness! Please, remain quiet.  If my commander learns that I still work for the short one, do you know how quickly I will be removed from the watch? I see you speak the truth.  Let us begin our business quickly, so that it may end even quicker.

english.title: Time is Short
english.objectives: Deliver the Discordant Rune to Watcher Grimeo at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: Razelikh plans to return to the Blasted Lands and overwhelm Azeroth with his demons.  Even now, he is preparing to summon his legions to eliminate us.  With these three amulets, we have the method to summon him... but no way to destroy him.$b$b<The gnome quickly draws a rune in the air, then hands it to you.>$b$bDeliver this to Grimeo at the Dark Portal, to the southeast.  He will guide you.  Quickly!  Time is short!  And so am I!
english.progress: Do I know you, good $r?
english.completion: No, no, no... not Kasim again!  This is madness! Please, remain quiet.  If my commander learns that I still work for the short one, do you know how quickly I will be removed from the watch? I see you speak the truth.  Let us begin our business quickly, so that it may end even quicker.

text.title: 黑暗之门的焦黑花岗岩
text.objectives: 收集24块焦黑的花岗岩片。
text.description: 卡西姆想让你从黑暗之门周围的岩石上挖一些花岗岩片。我不知道他要石头干什么，但我有自己的猜测，而且还不是好的方向。$b$b拿着这把锄头，到黑暗之门的爆炸范围边缘去找一找露出地面的岩石吧。
text.progress: Please, lower your voice.
text.completion: I hope this is what the gnome wanted.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Grimeo at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands

english.title: The Charred Granite of the Dark Portal
english.objectives: Obtain 24 Charred Granite Chips.
english.description: Kasim wants you to gather granite chips from these chunks of rock around the Dark Portal.  I don't know what he'd want rocks for, but I have my suspicions, and they're not pleasant ones.$b$bUse this pick and look for small outcroppings of rock along the edge of the portal's blast radius.
english.progress: Please, lower your voice.
english.completion: I hope this is what the gnome wanted.
english.completed: Return to Watcher Grimeo at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands

text.title: 邪能魔化之血
text.objectives: 收集7瓶邪能魔化之血。
text.description: 夏利姆需要恶魔的血。依我看，那玩意简直不能说是血——更像是脓液——不过这不重要。$b$b你很幸运，黑暗之门周围满地都是恶魔。地狱火啦，恶魔犬啦，恶魔卫士啦……它们身上都有你要的东西，量非常足。
text.progress: Ugh, what's that smell?  Is that you, or the blood?
text.completion: There is no doubt about it, you have found demon blood. Kasim's requests aside, I am sure that my Watch Commander is thankful for your efforts.  They have been struggling to deal with these demon distractions for some time now.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Grimeo at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The Vile Blood of Demons
english.objectives: Obtain 7 bottles of Vile Demonic Blood.
english.description: Sharim wants demon blood.  Speaking personally, the stuff does not even seem like blood to me - more like liquid rot - but that is of no consequence.$b$bLuckily for you, the area around the Dark Portal is crawling with demons.  Infernals, felhounds, felguards... they've all got what you need, in copious, pustulent amounts.
english.progress: Ugh, what's that smell?  Is that you, or the blood?
english.completion: There is no doubt about it, you have found demon blood. Kasim's requests aside, I am sure that my Watch Commander is thankful for your efforts.  They have been struggling to deal with these demon distractions for some time now.
english.completed: Return to Watcher Grimeo at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 强化石头
text.objectives: 将格雷米奥的包裹交给诅咒之地盘蛇谷的卡西姆·夏利姆。
text.description: <格雷米奥把材料仔细地放在一个包裹里。>$b$b这就是那个侏儒要的所有东西啦。当你见到他的时候，一定要告诉他这下我就不欠他的了。我不用再忍受他的各种要求了。
text.progress: You've returned, $c.
text.completion: This is sufficient.  If you see Grimeo again, you may tell him that he performed satisfactorily, but no... his debt is not yet cleared.  I will get to work on fashioning the stone knife of sealing.  There is no need for questions now.  All will be revealed in time. While I work, I have another task for you to complete. Don't look so upset!  This task will be fun... it involves collecting body parts.

english.title: Enhancing the Stone
english.objectives: Bring Grimeo's Package to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: <Grimeo finishes packing the materials up in a neatly-wrapped package.>$b$bThat's all that the gnome asked of us.  When you see him, make sure you let him know that this task ends my debt.  I will not suffer his requests any longer.
english.progress: You've returned, $c.
english.completion: This is sufficient.  If you see Grimeo again, you may tell him that he performed satisfactorily, but no... his debt is not yet cleared.  I will get to work on fashioning the stone knife of sealing.  There is no need for questions now.  All will be revealed in time. While I work, I have another task for you to complete. Don't look so upset!  This task will be fun... it involves collecting body parts.

text.title: 奥利斯塔的护符
text.objectives: 在诅咒之地的盘蛇谷获得奥利斯塔的护符。
text.description: 要召唤这位恶魔，我们就需要三枚护符，其中的第一枚是奥利斯塔的护符。$B$B奥利斯塔已经死了，但是他将自己的护符藏在了这座洞穴中的一只箱子里。把这些护符合在一起的话，我们就可以前往拉瑟莱克的高台。$b$b<卡西姆聚精会神了一阵子。>$b$b护符就在入口附近。我建议你使用传送器。
text.progress: Allistarj left a piece of himself in that amulet.  Even now, I can sense his evil.
text.completion: He was an archmage, I can feel it.  I will hold the amulet for you while you collect the rest.
text.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The Amulet of Allistarj
english.objectives: Obtain the Amulet of Allistarj from the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: To summon our demon, we need three amulets, and the first is the Amulet of Allistarj.$b$bAllistarj himself is dead, but he locked his amulet up in a trove inside this very cave.  Along with the other amulets, this relic will give us access to Razelikh's perch.$b$b<Kasim concentrates for a moment.>$b$bThe amulet is close to the entrance.  I recommend using the teleporter.
english.progress: Allistarj left a piece of himself in that amulet.  Even now, I can sense his evil.
english.completion: He was an archmage, I can feel it.  I will hold the amulet for you while you collect the rest.
english.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 瑟温妮的护符
text.objectives: 从诅咒之地破碎海岸附近的盐腮手中夺取瑟温妮的护符。
text.description: 第二枚护符，瑟温妮的护符，在一只鱼人的手里。他在遥远的南方，一处可以俯瞰破碎海岸的岩架上。这东西是怎么跑到鱼人手里去的，我也不知道，不过我敢肯定的是，你可以在那里找到它。$B$B把她的护符和另外两枚护符都拿来给我。
text.progress: Sevine's amulet... along with the others, we can summon the Defiler.
text.completion: A warlock... and a powerful one at that.  I will hold onto this until the time is right.
text.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The Amulet of Sevine
english.objectives: Obtain the Amulet of Sevine from Salt-Flop near the Shattershore in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: The second amulet, Sevine's amulet, is in the hands of a murloc, far to the south, on a shelf that overlooks the Shattershore.  How it ended up in that murloc's possession, I cannot say, but I can state with certainty that you will find it there.$b$bBring her amulet to me, along with the rest.
english.progress: Sevine's amulet... along with the others, we can summon the Defiler.
english.completion: A warlock... and a powerful one at that.  I will hold onto this until the time is right.
english.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 戈洛尔的护符
text.objectives: 在诅咒之地的破碎海岸获得戈洛尔的护符。
text.description: 戈洛尔……那个食人魔。$b$b<卡西姆笑了。>$b$b看样子戈洛尔已经不在那些食人魔那里了。他的尸体和他的护符，都在东边的破碎海岸上的一艘破船里。他的护符是最后一枚……把这三枚护符合起来之后，我们就可以找到拉瑟莱克，并阻止他的疯狂计划。
text.progress: The third amulet, from Razelikh's third lieutenant.
text.completion: He was a powerful warrior, this one.  I will keep the amulet until we are ready to proceed.
text.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: The Amulet of Grol
english.objectives: Obtain Grol's Amulet from the Shattershore in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: Grol... the ogre.$b$b<Kasim laughs.>$b$bIt would seem that Grol's body no longer rests with the ogres.  His body, along with his amulet of power, is in a wrecked ship off the Shattershore, to the east.  His amulet is the last... once combined, the three will give us access to Razelikh, and therein lies our chance to stop his madness.
english.progress: The third amulet, from Razelikh's third lieutenant.
english.completion: He was a powerful warrior, this one.  I will keep the amulet until we are ready to proceed.
english.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim at the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 最后的仪式
text.objectives: 与卡西姆·夏利姆交谈，参与他的仪式。
text.description: 匕首已经准备好了。洛拉姆斯就在这里，他很清楚自己要做些什么。我要使用这三枚护符的力量，使你得以接触它们的创造者——拉瑟莱克。$b$b我已经准备好为你和洛拉姆斯进行这个仪式了。等你们都准备好之后，就告诉我一声。
text.completion: It would seem that we are prepared to face our demon, $n.  We have the amulet's blessing, we have the stone knife, and I alone know the demon's true name: Rakh'likh.  Together, this may be enough to defeat the Defiler.
text.end: 参与卡西姆·夏利姆的仪式
text.completed: 去找诅咒之地盘蛇谷的洛拉姆斯·萨里比迪斯。

english.title: The Final Ritual
english.objectives: Speak with Kasim Sharim and participate in his ritual.
english.description: The knife is ready.  Loramus is present, and he knows what he must do.  I must now take the three amulets and use their enchantment to grant you access to Razelikh, the amulets' creator.$b$bI am prepared to perform the ritual on you and Loramus.  Speak with me when you are both ready.
english.completion: It would seem that we are prepared to face our demon, $n.  We have the amulet's blessing, we have the stone knife, and I alone know the demon's true name: Rakh'likh.  Together, this may be enough to defeat the Defiler.
english.completed: Speak with Loramus Thalipedes in the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 恶魔拉瑟莱克
text.objectives: 与污染者高地北面的乌舍尔交谈。抵达高地顶端之后，摧毁拉瑟莱克的躯体，然后用封印石匕禁锢他的灵魂。
text.description: 英雄，仔细听好了。$b$b首先，我们必须去找乌舍尔，他就在污染者高地的北边山脚下等着我们，那处高地在我们的西北方。乌舍尔会把我们送到高地顶端去。到那里之后，你要帮助我击败拉瑟莱克，恐怕我一个人是无法战胜他的。$b$b最关键的是，我要你拿着封印石匕，等到我告诉你用它的时候，你再用它。匕首会把拉瑟莱克的灵魂禁锢在一个新的、永恒的牢笼中。$B$B如果我们成功了，就去告诉德莱尼人格雷米奥。
text.completion: Loramus, resurrected!?  And then he trapped the demon inside his own body... by the Light... I see.  So this was Kasim's plan all along.  I suspected correctly, but I suppose I refused to believe it. Ah, one last thing!  Kasim left one more instruction for me within his rune.  I did not understand it at first, but given the events that have taken place today, it now makes much more sense: He asked me to let you choose from one of these.
text.completed: Report Loramus' fate to Watcher Grimeo at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.
text.giverWindow: 你了解他的真名，这将给他带来灭顶之灾。

english.title: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
english.objectives: Speak with the Deathly Usher north of the Rise of the Defiler.  Once atop the Rise, destroy Razelikh's body, then use the Stone Knife of Sealing to imprison his soul.
english.description: Hero, listen well.$b$bFirst, we must travel to the Deathly Usher, who waits at the northern foot of the Rise of the Defiler, to our northwest.  The usher will take us to the top of the rise.  Once there, you will help me defeat Razelikh, for I fear I am not strong enough to defeat him alone.$b$bMost importantly, I need you to hold the stone knife, and do not use it until I tell you to.  The knife will trap Razelikh's soul within its new, eternal prison.$b$bIf we succeed, speak with Grimeo, the draenei.
english.completion: Loramus, resurrected!?  And then he trapped the demon inside his own body... by the Light... I see.  So this was Kasim's plan all along.  I suspected correctly, but I suppose I refused to believe it. Ah, one last thing!  Kasim left one more instruction for me within his rune.  I did not understand it at first, but given the events that have taken place today, it now makes much more sense: He asked me to let you choose from one of these.
english.completed: Report Loramus' fate to Watcher Grimeo at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.
english.giverWindow: Your knowledge of his true name shall prove to be his undoing.

text.title: 血法师也要吃饭啊
text.objectives: 从诅咒之地的灰鬃野猪身上收集5块灰鬃肉排。
text.description: 与人们的常见观念不同，古老而强大的血法师并不啜饮鲜血。我们和其他人一样，吃普通的食品——而这种东西在一座敌对教徒的要塞里是很难搞到的。$b$b诅咒之地中部峡谷中的灰鬃野猪别的没什么好，就一个优点：吃起来很方便，因为它们的肉不需要额外的烹制环节。你能去猎杀一些野猪，帮我补充一下越来越捉襟见肘的食物储备吗？
text.progress: I'm famished!  If you don't hurry, I might actually resort to drinking our reagents.
text.completion: These are perfect, $n.  I will eat well for the next several days.
text.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim in the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: A Bloodmage's Gotta Eat Too
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Ashmane Steaks from Ashmane Boars in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: Contrary to popular belief, ancient and powerful bloodmages do NOT drink blood.  We eat normal food like everybody else - something which can be hard to come by in the recesses of a hostile cultist stronghold.$b$bThe ashmane boars in the central valley of the Blasted Lands are, if nothing else, convenient for eating, as their meat does not require any cooking.  Would you hunt these boars and help me replenish my ever-dwindling foodstores?
english.progress: I'm famished!  If you don't hurry, I might actually resort to drinking our reagents.
english.completion: These are perfect, $n.  I will eat well for the next several days.
english.completed: Return to Kasim Sharim in the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 保护后方
text.objectives: 杀死伽罗克·裂翼、莎罕达娜和格姆加兹。
text.description: 你能看到我跟部落士兵站在一起的唯一理由，就是我们的职责超越了彼此之间的敌意……不过只有一点点而已。我们的职责是阻止未经许可穿越黑暗之门的行为，而在最近的大灾变之后，我们更有可能受到攻击了。这一带据说已经有黑龙活动的迹象了……$b$b我的部队把注意力全都放在了自己的职责上，所以我们需要别人帮忙，确保这一地区的恶魔在控制中。在传送门周围，你可以找到三个恶魔军官，去杀掉他们。
text.completion: Your work is appreciated, soldier. $r... if you're still interested, I have one more small task for you...
text.completed: Return to Watch Commander Relthorn Netherwane at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Protecting Our Rear
english.objectives: Kill Jarroc Torn-Wing, Shahandana, and Gomegaz.
english.description: The only reason you see me standing aside Horde soldiers is because our duty outweighs our enmity... however slightly.  We have been charged with protecting the Dark Portal from unauthorized travel, and with the recent cataclysm, we are particularly susceptible to an attack.  We've already heard reports of black dragons in the area...$b$bWith my men focused on their duty, we need someone to keep the area demons in check.  Around the portal you will find three demon lieutenants.  Slay them.
english.completion: Your work is appreciated, soldier. $r... if you're still interested, I have one more small task for you...
english.completed: Return to Watch Commander Relthorn Netherwane at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

starters.name: 守望堡指挥官雷索恩·奈瑟维

enders.name: 守望堡指挥官雷索恩·奈瑟维

text.title: 留个心眼
text.objectives: 在不被发现的情况下，查阅黑暗之门的部落计划书。
text.description: <守望堡指挥官雷索恩·奈瑟维悄悄地说。>$b$b我收到了来自……上峰的命令，你正是合适的人选。我隔段时间就会听部落的人提及那边桶上的一叠文件。我要你去看看那些文件，搞明白他们到底在策划什么阴谋。我的职责和身份使我不便执行这样可疑的任务，但是像你这样的新人也许不会引起他们的注意……
text.completion: You're certain nobody saw you?  Good. Hmph... fairly harmless stuff.  Either the Horde are foolish enough to NOT be planning something against us... or they're hiding their information better than I expected.  Either way, well done, soldier.
text.completed: Return to Watch Commander Relthorn Netherwane the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Watching Our Back
english.objectives: Examine the Horde Plans at the Dark Portal without getting caught.
english.description: <Watch Commander Relthorn Netherwane speaks in hushed tones.>$b$bI have orders from... higher up... that you would be suitable for.  I've seen the Horde periodically referring to a stack of papers on that barrel over there.  I'd like you to take a look at those papers and find out what it is that they're plotting.  My duty and station prevent me from such a questionable task, but a newcomer like you might be able to slip in unnoticed...
english.completion: You're certain nobody saw you?  Good. Hmph... fairly harmless stuff.  Either the Horde are foolish enough to NOT be planning something against us... or they're hiding their information better than I expected.  Either way, well done, soldier.
english.completed: Return to Watch Commander Relthorn Netherwane the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

starters.name: 守望堡指挥官雷索恩·奈瑟维

enders.name: 守望堡指挥官雷索恩·奈瑟维

text.title: 瑟维奇
text.objectives: 去找诅咒之地瑟维奇的查尔顿·康宁斯伯镇长。
text.description: 除了你所见到的响动之外，黑暗之门静得出奇。恐怕，我有很多工作可以给你。$b$b如果你想找麻烦，可以到西南边的吉尔尼斯渔村去碰碰运气。瑟维奇，我想是这个名字。$b$b我知道我们该和吉尔尼斯人交朋友，可当真吗？和狼人？光让我习惯德莱尼人就够受的了。
text.completion: Welcome to Surwich, $r.  Please, have a look around.

english.title: Surwich
english.objectives: Report to Mayor Charlton Connisport at Surwich in Blasted Lands.
english.description: Other than what you've seen, the Portal's been surprisingly quiet.  There isn't much more work I can give to you, I'm afraid.$b$bIf you're looking for trouble, you might try the Gilnean fishing village to the southwest.  Surwich, I think it was.$b$bI know we're supposed to be friends with the Gilneans, but really?  Worgen?  I had enough trouble getting used to the draenei.
english.completion: Welcome to Surwich, $r.  Please, have a look around.

starters.name: 守望堡指挥官雷索恩·奈瑟维

text.title: 前往塞尔萨玛
text.objectives: 将拉格弗斯上尉的进度报告交给塞尔萨玛的巡山人卡德雷尔。
text.description: 你已经帮了我们不少忙。如果你要离开，我得让你把这份进度报告带到塞尔萨玛去。$B$B沿着路一直往北，你一定会找到的。巡山人卡德雷尔需要这份报告。
text.progress: 我能帮你做什么吗？
text.completion: Glad to hear you've been clearing out the troggs. Let's have a look at this report, and... ...Is that a beer stain?

english.title: Onward to Thelsamar
english.objectives: Deliver Captain Rugelfuss's Status Report to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar.
english.description: You've helped us quite a bit here. If you're leaving, I'd ask you to take this status report up to Thelsamar.$B$BFollow the road just north, and you can't miss it. Mountaineer Kadrell will want the report.
english.progress: What can I do for you?
english.completion: Glad to hear you've been clearing out the troggs. Let's have a look at this report, and... ...Is that a beer stain?

text.title: 捕捉螃蟹
text.objectives: 捕捉6只运河蟹，把它们交给暴风城的罗比·弗雷。
text.description: 新鲜的螃蟹腿一直是国王最喜欢的美食之一。这几周来，我们都是从运河里抓螃蟹的。你能不能帮我个忙，去抓些螃蟹给我？记得要抓活的，死螃蟹味道不好，而国王要品尝的是我们能抓到的最新鲜的螃蟹！
text.progress: 你一定有雙快手!我不敢相信你這麼快就抓了這些螃蟹來!
text.completion: 這些螃蟹看起來很讚!我會把牠們清洗乾淨，並把你的貢獻告訴國王。謝啦!
text.completed: Return to to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

english.title: Feeling Crabby?
english.objectives: Collect 10 Canal Crabs. Deliver them to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.
english.description: Fresh crab legs have always been one of the King's favorite foods.  We have had good luck catching fresh crabs in the canals over the past few weeks.  Do you think you can lend me a hand and catch a few of them for me?  Be sure to catch them alive, they are no good to me dead, the King requires the freshest catch we can muster.
english.progress: You must have fast hands!  I can't believe you caught all those crabs so quickly!
english.completion: These crabs look great!  I will clean these up and make sure that the King hears about your contribution.  Thanks!
english.completed: Return to to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

text.title: 未来的种子
text.objectives: 收集12只飘雪林地幼崽，把它们交给莫亚基港口的猎手莫伊。
text.description: 如果我们想要生存下去，就必须对狼獾人采取果断行动了。但我担心我们的狂热会导致残酷的屠杀。$B$B飘雪林地的狼獾人和我们一样拥有生存的权利。我们要确保他们能得到生存下去的机会。$B$B就算长者库纳尼现在还没有提出，迟早他也会让你去解决他们的。当你前往北面的林地时，请你把他们的幼崽带回来。
text.completed: Return to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

english.title: Planning for the Future
english.objectives: Collect 12 Snowfall Glade Pups. Deliver them to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor.
english.description: We must move decisively against the wolvar if we're to have a chance of survival. However, I worry that in our zeal, too many of them will be slain.$B$BThe Snowfall Glade wolvar have as much right to exist as do we. You and I will see to it that they get that chance.$B$BIf Elder Ko'nani hasn't asked you already, he will ask you to deal with them.  While you're upon the glade to the north, I'd like you to bag up their pups and bring them back to me.
english.completed: Return to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

text.title: 风险投资公司
text.objectives: 血蹄村的摩林·云行者要你去杀死7个风险投资公司工人。
text.description: 这就解释了为什么风险投资公司在不断往莫高雷地区增派职员和设备。这些地精……他们的公司扩张得太快了。就像他们自己所说的那样，只要给地精一点甜头，你就能听到他们打算盘的声音。$b$b这些小东西实在是太贪婪了。不过我们牛头人决不会让他们在我们的领土上为所欲为。到他们的矿洞去，给他们点颜色看看，那个矿洞就在被破坏的货车的东北方。
text.completion: 他们应该不会误解或是忽视我们发出的信号，对不对?风险投资公司很快就会知道牛头人是不可轻视的，他们也不能如此傲慢地以为我们会对他们这种大肆掠夺的行为不闻不问。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Morin Cloudstalker in Mulgore.

english.title: The Venture Co.
english.objectives: Kill 7 Venture Co. Workers for Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
english.description: This explains the buildup of Venture Co. employees and equipment we've seen in Mulgore. Those goblins... their company is expanding too quickly for their own good. It's how they say, show a goblin something, and you can hear the scales in the background.$b$bGreedy little things, they are. Unfortunately for their business enterprise, we tauren cannot allow them to conduct their operations in our lands. Go to their mine northeast of the ravaged caravan and send them a message.
english.completion: I don't think there could be too much misinterpreting or ignoring of that signal, hm? The Venture Co. will know not to take the $r lightly, or to be so arrogant as to believe we would allow them to steal the natural resources around us without protest.
english.completed: Return to Morin Cloudstalker in Mulgore.

text.title: 菲兹普罗克主管
text.objectives: 杀掉菲兹普罗克主管，拿到菲兹普罗克的笔记板。
text.description: 根据你从箱子里拿来的文件可以看出，风险投资公司已经制定了很多把我们从这儿赶走的计划，然后他们就能随心所欲地掠夺我们的土地了。$b$b他们为了利润居然可以堕落到这种程度，这简直让我感到厌恶和惊骇。我们要除掉这个阴谋的策划者，他就是菲兹普罗克主管。你可以在被破坏的货车以东的风险投资公司矿洞里找到他，把他的笔记板带给我，让我们看看有没有什么有价值的东西。
text.progress: 风险投资公司居然为了利益就准备对我们采取这些行动，这让我非常恼火。
text.completion: 听到菲兹普罗克主管死了的消息，我的怒气平息了一些。我可以从他的笔记板里找找看风险投资公司都有些什麽更长远的计画。谢谢你的帮助，$N。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Morin Cloudstalker in Mulgore.
text.giverWindow: 拿到他的笔记板。

english.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket
english.objectives: Kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and collect Fizsprocket's Clipboard.
english.description: According to the documents you salvaged from the caravan, the Venture Co. created many plans to attempt to drive us from our lands here, so that they could have free reign to plunder our lands.$b$bThe depths that they would sink to accomplish their goals disgusts and appalls me. I want the mastermind behind their plans killed. His name is Supervisor Fizsprocket, you will find him at the Venture Co. mine east of the ravaged caravan. Bring me his clipboard, we shall see if we find out anything useful.
english.progress: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
english.completion: My anger is somewhat lessened at the news that the villain Fizsprocket is dead. I will go through his personal effects and see if there is any additional information about what the Venture Co. has planned for the future. Thank you for your efforts, $n.
english.completed: Return to Morin Cloudstalker in Mulgore.
english.giverWindow: Get his clipboard.

text.title: 返回驱暗海窟
text.objectives: 跟瓦丝琪尔驱暗海窟的石语者埃鲁纳克谈一谈。
text.description: 你必须……返回……驱暗海窟。石语者埃鲁纳克在那里……等你。$B$B我的生命……结束了……
text.completion: Hello again, $c. I felt L'ghorek die. A shame that such a magnificent being is gone. If we do not assist Neptulon, we will all meet the same fate.

english.title: Back to Darkbreak Cove
english.objectives: Speak with Erunak Stonespeaker at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.
english.description: YOU MUST RETURN... TO... THE DARKBREAK COVE. ERUNAK STONESPEAKER AWAITS... YOU WITHIN.$B$BI DIE NOW....
english.completion: Hello again, $c. I felt L'ghorek die. A shame that such a magnificent being is gone. If we do not assist Neptulon, we will all meet the same fate.

text.title: 返回阴暗洞穴
text.objectives: 跟瓦丝琪尔阴暗洞穴的石语者埃鲁纳克谈一谈。
text.description: 你必须……返回……阴暗洞穴。石语者埃鲁纳克在那里……等你。$B$B我的生命……结束了……
text.completion: Hello again, $c.$B$BI felt L'ghorek die. A shame that such a magnificent being is gone.$B$BIf we do not assist Neptulon, we will all meet the same fate.

english.title: Back to the Tenebrous Cavern
english.objectives: Speak with Erunak Stonespeaker at the Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.
english.description: YOU MUST RETURN... TO... THE TENEBROUS CAVERN. ERUNAK STONESPEAKER AWAITS... YOU WITHIN.$B$BI DIE NOW....
english.completion: Hello again, $c.$B$BI felt L'ghorek die. A shame that such a magnificent being is gone.$B$BIf we do not assist Neptulon, we will all meet the same fate.

text.title: 国王的苹果酒
text.objectives: 收集12只多汁的苹果，把它们交给暴风城的罗比·弗雷。
text.description: 国王为我们做了那么多，我永远都记着他的恩惠。我可以为他做一些力所能及的事情，比如酿制他最喜欢的饮料！幸运的是，暴风城里就能找到酿制这种美酒的原料。城中的每个区域都有苹果树，要从高高的树冠上采摘苹果可不太容易，但是许多熟透的苹果掉到了地上，一弯腰就可以捡到。
text.progress: Were you able to find enough Juicy Apples?
text.completion: These will do nicely $n.  I will get to work right away on the cider.
text.completed: Return to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

english.title: The King's Cider
english.objectives: Obtain 12 Juicy Apples.  Deliver the fruit to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.
english.description: I am forever in debt to our King for all that he has done for us.  One thing I can do for him is make his favorite drink!  Lucky for us, the ingredients we need to make this wonderful drink are located right here in Stormwind City.  Apple trees can be found in every district of Stormwind.  These trees are too tall to pick the fruit from, but lucky for us the apples have fallen to the ground and are easy to retrieve.
english.progress: Were you able to find enough Juicy Apples?
english.completion: These will do nicely $n.  I will get to work right away on the cider.
english.completed: Return to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

text.title: 虫棘的梦境
text.objectives: 在腐烂森林里杀死5个末日守卫毁灭者、5个恐惧魔王污染者、5个堕落的黑木树人和3个邪孢沼泽领主。
text.description: 一点都不奇怪，我们瑟维奇的大部分居民都不是奔着诅咒之地的好天气来的。他们追随着一位理想主义的德鲁伊——玛尔·虫棘的梦境。虫棘认为腐烂之痕可以被治愈，并尝试使它恢复生机。$b$b看样子他大错特错了。他确实弄出了一片森林，但恶魔仍然肆虐在这片土地上，而他的巨树已经扭曲腐蚀了。$b$b我仍然怀有一丝希望。也许，如果我们能进入腐烂森林，清理一些污染的话……
text.completion: You say the demons were all worshipping the tree? It is as I feared, then.
text.completed: Return to Mayor Charlton Connisport at Surwich in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Wormthorn's Dream
english.objectives: Kill 5 Doomguard Destroyers, 5 Dreadlord Defilers, 5 Corrupted Darkwood Treants, and 3 Felspore Bog Lords in the Tainted Forest.
english.description: Not surprisingly, most of our citizens in Surwich did not come to the Blasted Lands for the pleasant atmosphere.  They came following the dream of an idealistic druid: Marl Wormthorn.  Wormthorn believed that the Tainted Scar could be healed, and attempted to grow it back.$b$bIt looks like he was wrong.  He grew his forest, but the land is still plagued by demons, and his great-tree is twisted and gnarled.$b$bI'm still hopeful.  Maybe if we head into the Tainted Forest and clear out some of the taint...
english.completion: You say the demons were all worshipping the tree? It is as I feared, then.
english.completed: Return to Mayor Charlton Connisport at Surwich in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 塞纳里奥议会的建议
text.objectives: 向诅咒之地瑟维奇的塞纳里奥观察者莎雅娜报到。
text.description: 看来诅咒之地的污染终于侵蚀了我的朋友虫棘。他的实验失败了，他的巨树也变成了吸引恶魔从四面八方汇集而来的焦点。$b$b我们必须除掉那棵树，并除掉虫棘。去跟镇子另一边的塞纳里奥观察者谈谈，她应该有些想法。$b$b$n：我们所做的一切都不能让瑟维奇的镇民知道。士气已经够低了。
text.completion: While I'm surprised that Connisport is willing to go forward with his plan, I'm also relieved.  I've seen the demons rallying around Maldraz, and I share his fears.

english.title: Advice from the Cenarion Circle
english.objectives: Report to Cenarion Observer Shayana at the Surwich in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: I believe that the taint of the Blasted Lands has finally exerted its influence over my friend Wormthorn.  His experiment has failed, and his great-tree now only serves as a focus for the demons to rally around.$b$bThe tree must come down, and Wormthorn with it.  Speak with the Cenarion Observer on the other side of town; she should have some idea how to proceed.$b$b$n: the act we are about to commit must not be made known to the townspeople of Surwich.  Morale is low enough as-is.
english.completion: While I'm surprised that Connisport is willing to go forward with his plan, I'm also relieved.  I've seen the demons rallying around Maldraz, and I share his fears.

enders.name: 塞纳里奥观察者莎雅娜

text.title: 魔能容器
text.objectives: 在腐烂森林里杀死腐烂的黑熊、腐烂的夜行蜘蛛和腐烂的尖啸蝙蝠，并将它们的肢体组合成魔能容器。
text.description: 我们要想办法吸引虫棘的注意力，某种打断他的沉睡的办法，某种一定会奏效的办法。$b$b能在腐烂森林生存的少数几种野生动物无疑受到了这里能量的影响。你的任务就是收集它们的肢体，想办法把它们组合成一具容器。如果虫棘的沉睡是德鲁伊式的，甚至是恶魔式的，一个足够大的、由腐蚀的动物躯体组成的容器就足以打破它。
text.progress: Shayana's plan is a good one.  Do you have the vessel, $n?
text.completion: Very well, $n.  We have what we need to break Marl's trance and put an end to both him and his experiment.
text.completed: Return to Mayor Charlton Connisport at Surwich in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Demoniac Vessel
english.objectives: Kill the Tainted Black Bears, Tainted Nightstalkers, and Tainted Screechers in the Tainted Forest, and try to assemble their parts into a Demoniac Vessel.
english.description: We need a way to get Wormthorn's attention.  Something to break him out of his trance.  Something that's guaranteed to work.$b$bThe few types of wildlife that managed to make a foothold in the Tainted Forest are, without a doubt, affected by the land's latent energies.  Your task is to collect their body parts and find a way to combine them into a vessel.  If Wormthorn's trance is druidic, or even if it is demonic, a large enough vessel of tainted animal flesh should be able to break it.
english.progress: Shayana's plan is a good one.  Do you have the vessel, $n?
english.completion: Very well, $n.  We have what we need to break Marl's trance and put an end to both him and his experiment.
english.completed: Return to Mayor Charlton Connisport at Surwich in the Blasted Lands.

starters.name: 塞纳里奥观察者莎雅娜

text.title: 玛尔·虫棘之死
text.objectives: 在诅咒之地的玛尔卓斯杀死玛尔·虫棘。你可以使用魔能容器打断他的沉睡。
text.description: 当瑟维奇的居民得知我们所做的事情之后……真不知道他们会做何反应。他们是如此相信虫棘的梦……$B$B……但是，我们必须这么做。拿着魔能容器，对玛尔·虫棘使用，将他从梦境中拽出来。解决掉他之后再回来找我。
text.completion: Thank you, $n.  I, and the people of Surwich, are in your debt. Feel free to take one of these.  While we haven't got much, we're happy to reward those that protect us.
text.completed: Return to Mayor Charlton Connisport at Surwich in the Blasted Lands.
text.giverWindow: 当恶魔夺走了他的理智，一切希望都破灭了。

english.title: The Downfall of Marl Wormthorn
english.objectives: Kill Marl Wormthorn at Maldraz in the Blasted Lands.  You can use the Demoniac Vessel to pull him out of his trance.
english.description: When word gets out about what we've done... there's no saying what the citizens of Surwich will do.  They cling so closely to Wormthorn's dream...$b$b...but still, it must be done.  Take the demoniac vessel and use it on Marl Wormthorn to pull him from his trance.  Return to me when he is no more.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  I, and the people of Surwich, are in your debt. Feel free to take one of these.  While we haven't got much, we're happy to reward those that protect us.
english.completed: Return to Mayor Charlton Connisport at Surwich in the Blasted Lands.
english.giverWindow: When the demons took his mind, all hope was lost.

text.title: 马兹拉纳其
text.objectives: 把一根平原狮的腿骨交给血蹄村的茂尔·祈雨。
text.description: 我的祖父常跟我说故事，关于他是如何跟一头叫做马兹拉纳其的陆行鸟战斗的。他告诉我它有着恶魔般血红的眼睛，剃刀般锋利的爪子，撕咬中含着毒液。$b$b也是天注定，我穿过平原的时候碰到了它，被它在肩膀上狠狠咬了一口。他跟我祖父所描述得一样可怕。为了治好自己，我找来了配制解药的所有材料……除了平原狮的腿骨。$B$B我越来越虚弱了……求求你，救救我。
text.progress:
My fever grows worse and I find my mind drifting into delirious nightmares... I should have known that I wouldn't be able to handle a beast my grandfather was unable to defeat...

Do you have the ingredients for the remedy? I fear if I do not clean the infection soon, it will be the death of me.
text.completion: 啊，谢谢你，$N。用你拿来的这些东西做成的解药可以制止毒素的扩散，最终令伤口痊癒。谢谢你，是你救了我一命。$B$B不过我永远无法忘记马兹拉纳其向我扑过来的时候……它发出的那种刺耳的叫声和它那利刃一样的爪子……$B$B你碰到它的时候也要多加小心啊。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

english.title: Mazzranache
english.objectives: Bring a Flatland Cougar Femur to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village.
english.description: My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.$b$bAs fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I have gathered all the parts of the remedy I need to cure myself... except a flatland cougar femur.$B$BI grow weaker by the moment... please, help me.
english.progress:
My fever grows worse and I find my mind drifting into delirious nightmares... I should have known that I wouldn't be able to handle a beast my grandfather was unable to defeat...

Do you have the ingredients for the remedy? I fear if I do not clean the infection soon, it will be the death of me.
english.completion:
Ah, thank you, $n. Using the items you brought me, I will be able to create the remedy I need to stop the spread of the infection and, eventually, cure it completely. I owe you my life in thanks.

But I'll never forget that screeching call when Mazzranache came upon me, the blaze of color as its beak descended...

Be wary on your travels.
english.completed: Return to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

text.title: 怒牙的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死怒牙营地的戈尔弗克·怒牙以及16名龙喉兽人。
text.description: 我们为了躲避迅猛龙逃到这里来，却发现旁边就是大量的龙喉兽人！$B$B我在米奈希尔听说过，龙喉兽人是比其他兽人还要粗鄙的野蛮人，以及他们是如何空手扼死黑龙的……我不知道有多少是真的，但我知道不能让他们就这么待在山上。$B$B你得去把他们都砍翻，$n。到东边怒牙营地去，处理一下那些兽人，别把他们的头领给忘了！
text.completion: Good to see you back in one piece, $n! You're quite a piece of work. I'll be tellin' Captain Stoutfist how you took care of those orcs!
text.completed: Return to Prospector Whelgar at Whelgar's Retreat in the Wetlands.
text.giverWindow: 怒牙龙喉氏族的酋长

english.title: The Angerfang Menace
english.objectives: Slay Gorfax Angerfang and 16 Dragonmaw Orcs in the Angerfang Encampment.
english.description: When we hauled up here to get away from the raptors, we put ourselves right next to a whole slew of Dragonmaw orcs!$B$BI've heard the stories in Menethil, how the Dragonmaw are even cruder barbarians than other orcs, how they strangle black dragons with their bare hands... I don't know how much of it's true, but I know we can't just let 'em sit up here in the hills.$B$BYou've got the chops for it, $n. Head east to the Angerfang Encampment, take care of those orcs, and make sure you get their leader!
english.completion: Good to see you back in one piece, $n! You're quite a piece of work. I'll be tellin' Captain Stoutfist how you took care of those orcs!
english.completed: Return to Prospector Whelgar at Whelgar's Retreat in the Wetlands.
english.giverWindow: Chief of the Angerfang Dragonmaw

text.title: 渔夫的美餐
text.objectives: 收集5条巨大的鲶鱼，把它们交给暴风城的罗比·弗雷。
text.description: 如果说国王只喜欢一道菜，那肯定是新鲜的鲶鱼。烹饪鲶鱼很容易，但抓它们可就不那么容易了。体现你的价值的机会来了！暴风城的河水中有许多巨大的鲶鱼，但我们没多少钱雇人去抓鱼。我希望你能找到某种办法，为我们的国王“弄来”一些上等的鲶鱼。你可以在城里的运河码头上找到渔夫，剩下的事情你应该很清楚了吧？
text.progress: Were you able to steal the fish?
text.completion: Thank you, $n.  I will get to work scaling these for the King right away.
text.completed: Return to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

english.title: A Fisherman's Feast
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Gigantic Catfish.  Deliver the fish to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.
english.description: If there is one meal I know the King likes, it's fresh catfish.  Catfish are easy to prepare but hard to catch.  That's where you come in!  We have a good population of Gigantic Catfish here in the waters of Stormwind but the competition to catch them is intense to say the least.  I need you to figure out a way to "acquire" some of these fine catfish for our King.  You will find fisherman at the small canal docks around town.  You should be able to figure out the rest of the plan on your own.
english.progress: Were you able to steal the fish?
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  I will get to work scaling these for the King right away.
english.completed: Return to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

text.title: 我等功业之大成
text.completion: With every day, more warriors arrive at Azshara's command. Soon, Neptulon the Tidehunter will hear of our preparations, but too late to stop what we have set in motion. Our numbers will be too great and our allies too powerful. Victory is only a matter of time.$B$BIn Azshara's name.

english.title: The Culmination of Our Efforts
english.completion: With every day, more warriors arrive at Azshara's command. Soon, Neptulon the Tidehunter will hear of our preparations, but too late to stop what we have set in motion. Our numbers will be too great and our allies too powerful. Victory is only a matter of time.$B$BIn Azshara's name.

text.title: 孤儿也喜欢点心！
text.objectives: 收集4袋精制细砂糖，把它们交给暴风城的罗比·弗雷。
text.description: 暴风城的孤儿们常常被人遗忘，但今天不同了，我的朋友。国王特别要求我们制作一些点心，然后尽快给孤儿院送去。最后一批点心就快要做好了，但不巧的是精制细砂糖正好用光了。你能去帮我弄一些回来吗？暴风城里所有的杂货店和旅店都有出售。
text.progress: 你有找到製作甜點用的糖嗎？
text.completion: These sacks look like just enough, $n.  Can't wait to see the smiles on the orphans faces.
text.completed: Return to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

english.title: Orphans Like Cookies Too!
english.objectives: Obtain 4 sacks of Confectioners' Sugar.  Deliver the sugar to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.
english.description: The orphans of Stormwind are often forgotten, but not today my friend.  The king has requested a special batch of cookies be baked and sent immediately over to the orphanage.  I was almost finished with the final batch when I ran out of confectioners' sugar.  Can you run out and get some more for me?  You should be able to find it at any of the general stores or inns inside of Stormwind.
english.progress: Were you able to find the Confectioner's Sugar?
english.completion: These sacks look like just enough, $n.  Can't wait to see the smiles on the orphans faces.
english.completed: Return to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

text.title: 保卫深渊裂口
text.objectives: 在深渊裂口消灭任意15只纳迦。
text.description: 元素的低语声充斥着我的思绪，$n……$B$B潮汐王座遭到攻击！$B$B我绝不能眼睁睁地看着纳迦侵犯耐普图隆的领地。我们必须想办法与他联手抗敌。$B$B泰勒上尉会护送我前往深渊直接与耐普图隆沟通。$b$b所以我必须请你采取更激烈的手段，吸引敌军的注意力，直到我安全抵达潮汐王座的入口处。$b$b愿万灵指引我们前进，$n。
text.completion: NO! This is NOT over!
text.completed: Speak with Captain Taylor at the rim of the Abyssal Breach.

english.title: Defending the Rift
english.objectives: Speak to Erunak in Darkbreak Cove to enter the battle for the Abyssal Breach.
english.description: The whispers of the elements are crowding my thoughts, $n...$b$bThe Throne of Tides is under siege!$b$bWe cannot stand idly by while the naga threaten Neptulon's realm.$b$bMake ready! With this submarine and its armaments, perhaps we can make a difference.$b$bSpeak to me when you are prepared for battle.
english.completion: NO! This is NOT over!
english.completed: Speak with Captain Taylor at the rim of the Abyssal Breach.

objectiveDetails.description: 在深渊裂口消灭15只纳迦

text.title: 保卫深渊裂口
text.objectives: 在深渊裂口消灭任意15只纳迦。
text.description: 元素的低语声充斥着我的思绪，$n……$B$B潮汐王座遭到攻击！$B$B我绝不能眼睁睁地看着纳迦侵犯耐普图隆的领地。我们必须想办法与他联手抗敌。$B$B纳兹戈林会护送我前往深渊直接与耐普图隆沟通。$b$b所以我必须请你采取更激烈的手段，吸引敌军的注意力，直到我安全抵达潮汐王座的入口处。$b$b愿万灵指引我们前进，$n。
text.completion: They may think they've won, but my axe and I have something to say about that!
text.completed: Speak with Legionnairre Nazgrim at the rim of the Abyssal Breach.
