english.completed: Return to Barnil Stonepot at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 我们感激不尽
text.objectives: 同西部荒野萨丁农场的萨尔玛·萨丁交谈。
text.description: 已经有很多年没有人向我们伸出援手了，$n。要不是你来了，说不定我们捱不过即将到来的冬天。你真是一个无私的人，一个让人信任的人。要是你有什么需要的我能给得了就好了。$B$B我这儿没有什么能帮你将法布隆凶案的罪犯绳之以法的线索，但我的妻子说不定能帮上忙。走之前去屋子里和萨尔玛谈谈吧，看她是不是能告诉你些什么。
text.completion: Of course, dear. Our little girl works at Sentinel Hill and is very close with the homeless of Westfall. Perhaps she has overheard something. Before you go, let me wrap up the Westfall Stew and tell you a little bit about our dear little girl.

english.title: You Have Our Thanks
english.objectives: Speak with Salma Saldean at the Saldean's Farm in Westfall.
english.description: It's been many years since anyone has offered to lend us aid, $n. Had you not come along, we might not have made it through the coming winter. You have proven yourself to be a selfless individual - a person that we can trust. I only wish we had something of value to offer you.$B$BWhile I have no information to assist you in your crusade to bring the Furlbrow's murderer to justice, perhaps my wife can help. Speak to Salma inside and she will tell you what you need to know before you leave.
english.completion: Of course, dear. Our little girl works at Sentinel Hill and is very close with the homeless of Westfall. Perhaps she has overheard something. Before you go, let me wrap up the Westfall Stew and tell you a little bit about our dear little girl.

text.title: 养活饥饿与无助者
text.objectives: 把杂味炖肉分给西部荒野哨兵岭的20个无家可归者。
text.description: 是的，法布隆谋杀案我听说了。真是悲剧，但这同样也是西部荒野生活的一部分。还有好多人仅仅连活下去的理由和意愿都没有了。他们放弃了希望。你知道绝望地被丢在一旁等死意味着什么吗？我们必须让这些人知道还是有希望的，好日子会随着第二天的黎明一块到来。$B$B把我妈的杂味炖肉拿上，分给哨兵岭无家可归的人们。
text.completion: You have a kind heart, $n. You have done a good thing, today, and that act will reflect back upon you when judgment day comes.
text.completed: Return to Hope Saldean at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

english.title: Feeding the Hungry and the Hopeless
english.objectives: Use the Westfall Stew to feed 20 Homeless People around Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
english.description: Yes, I heard about the Furlbrow murders. It is very tragic, but such tragedy is a way of life in Westfall. There are many people here who simply no longer have the means or inclination to keep themselves fed. They have given up hope. Do you understand what it means to be left so hopeless as to stop caring about life? We must work together to show them that there is hope. That with the dawning day a better life comes.$B$BTake my mother's Westfall stew and help feed the homeless around Sentinel Hill.
english.completion: You have a kind heart, $n. You have done a good thing, today, and that act will reflect back upon you when judgment day comes.
english.completed: Return to Hope Saldean at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

objectiveDetails.description: 给西部荒野无家可归者分发食物

text.title: 暗矛的崛起
text.objectives: 与暗矛训练场中的沃德雷卡谈谈。
text.description: 很久以来，暗矛部族一直都是受害者和流亡者。我们一直在逃离家园……但是这一次，我们并不是为了逃亡而来到这里的。$B$B沃金以他的智慧引领着我们，使我们生存到了今天。现在，这种智慧使我们察觉到了，在加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的领导下，部落将会有怎样黑暗而混乱的未来。$B$B不，这一次我们不再逃亡了。这一次，我们要为了可以长期定居下去的家园而战。$B$B是时候开始你的训练了，$n。去跟东边的沃德雷卡谈谈吧。
text.completion: Anotha newblood, eh? Ya actually have an intense look about ya though. Fiery eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c. Lets not waste anymore time 'den.

english.title: The Rise of the Darkspear
english.objectives: Meet with Voldreka in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
english.description: Tha Darkspear tribe have long been victims. Outcasts. We found ourselves fleein' our homes time 'n time again... but dis time, it's not fleein' dat drives us here.$B$BVol'jin has offered us leadership through wisdom, and it has kept us alive dis long. Now dat same wisdom offers portents of a chaotic future for tha Horde unda Garrosh Hellscream.$B$BNo, dis time we not fleein'. Dis time, we are fightin' for a home dat will last.$B$BIt's time to begin ya trainin', $n. Speak with Voldreka to the east.
english.completion: Anotha newblood, eh? Ya actually have an intense look about ya though. Fiery eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c. Lets not waste anymore time 'den.

text.title: 基础教程：攻击目标
text.objectives: 摧毁6个蒂基面具假人。
text.description: 好了，伙计，我们先从简单的开始。首先我得确认你知道如何运用黑暗的力量。$B$B去拿那些蒂基面具假人练练手，慢点来，自然一点。我会观察你的表现，然后决定下一步要怎么做。
text.progress: Strength isn't da end all of defeating ya enemy, and it most certainly isn't tha end all of stayin' alive. Fightin' is about balance. Everytin has its time and place.
text.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a deep power in ya spells - you may have a talent for dis. Some rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.
text.completed: Return to Voldreka at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: The Basics: Hitting Things
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Tiki Targets.
english.description: Alright, mon. We start simple. I need ta know dat you know the basics of the dark arts.$B$BGo thrash dose tiki targets. Take it slowly. Natural-like. I'll watch how you form your casts and we'll go from dere.
english.progress: Strength isn't da end all of defeating ya enemy, and it most certainly isn't tha end all of stayin' alive. Fightin' is about balance. Everytin has its time and place.
english.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a deep power in ya spells - you may have a talent for dis. Some rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.
english.completed: Return to Voldreka at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 术士的技艺
text.objectives: Reach Level 3 to Learn Corruption. Practice using Corruption 5 times against a Tiki Target.
text.description: I tink I have something I should let ya know.$B$BAs ya' get more powahful, yo' gonna staht hearin' da voices - teachin' you new tings, new spells.$B$BGo, get some more experience, 'den come back an show me what ya learned.
text.completion: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.
text.completed: Return to Voldreka at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: The Arts of a Warlock
english.objectives: Reach Level 3 to Learn Corruption. Practice using Corruption 5 times against a Tiki Target.
english.description: I tink I have something I should let ya know.$B$BAs ya' get more powahful, yo' gonna staht hearin' da voices - teachin' you new tings, new spells.$B$BGo, get some more experience, 'den come back an show me what ya learned.
english.completion: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.
english.completed: Return to Voldreka at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 粗暴的开始
text.objectives: 收集6块蛮鬃豹皮。
text.description: 咱们来给你找点事做吧。先从简单的开始，伙计。$B$B岛上的豹子在猎杀我们的野猪。跟它们分享食物可不成！如果你今晚还想填饱肚子的话，就得想办法保证那些野猪还活着。$B$B岛上到处都是豹子。去把它们的毛皮给我拿来。
text.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
text.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, boy. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.
text.completed: Return to Voldreka at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: A Rough Start
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Wildmane Cat Pelts.
english.description: Lets put dose skills ta use. I'll start ya off easy, mon.$B$BThere be cats killing our boars. Dat food ain't for sharin'. Dose boars are gonna need ta be alive if ya be wanting food tonight.$B$BDey're all over the island. Bring me some cat pelts.
english.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
english.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, boy. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.
english.completed: Return to Voldreka at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 试炼场
text.objectives: 同暗矛狱卒交谈，然后进入试炼场，杀死一名恶鳞斥候俘虏。
text.description: 你干得很不错，$c。我还可以再教你一些手段，但我不会再让你对着假人浪费时间了。$B$B现在我给你安排最后一项考验吧，伙计。到这个区域中间的试炼场去，跟一个真正的敌人交手——对方对你可是毫不留情的哟。等你准备好了，告诉那边的狱卒一声就行了。
text.progress: All $rs gotta prove demselves before we let them move past da training grounds.
text.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.
text.completed: Return to Voldreka at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: Proving Pit
english.objectives: Speak to a Darkspear Jailor, then enter the proving pit and kill a Captive Spitescale Scout.
english.description: Ya done quite well for ya'self, $c. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.$B$Bl put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.
english.progress: All $rs gotta prove demselves before we let them move past da training grounds.
english.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.
english.completed: Return to Voldreka at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 喜出望外
text.objectives: 向暗矛要塞中的沃金报到。
text.description: 你真是令我们喜出望外，伙计。我敢说，你的天赋对我们肯定是大有帮助。你不用再跟这些新兵蛋子混在一起啦。$B$B到东南边的村子里去吧，闯出你自己的天地来。到处帮帮忙，我相信你很快就会出人头地的。
text.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

english.title: More Than Expected
english.objectives: Report to Vol'jin at Darkspear Hold.
english.description: Ya definitely more den expected, mon. I'm sure dere's more important stuff we can be usin' ya talents on now. Ya don't need ta hang out with da newbloods no more.$B$BHead down to da village to da southeast and make yaself known. Lend a hand here and there and I'm sure ya make yer way up to sometin' more prestigious quick enough.
english.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

text.title: 保卫格罗姆高：迅猛龙危机
text.objectives: 破坏12枚鞭尾龙蛋。
text.description: Throm'ka，$c！$b$b你的到来可真及时，真的。我们在格罗姆高的任务，是保障斯通纳德的补给线安全。但是我们遭到了当地的原生物种的妨碍。$b$b我把消灭迅猛龙的事情就交给你了，它们就在格罗姆高外面的北边。别管那些迅猛龙……讨嫌的奈辛瓦里猎人会解决掉它们。$b$b我要你去破坏的，是它们的蛋。
text.completion: Keep up the good work, $c.  Hellscream's eyes are upon you.
text.completed: Return to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Defense of Grom'gol: Raptor Risk
english.objectives: Destroy 12 Lashtail Eggs.
english.description: Throm'ka, $c!$b$bYour arrival at Grom'gol is timely, indeed.  Our mission to provide a safe chain of supply to Stonard is being hampered by some of the local inhabitants.$b$bI am putting you in charge of eliminating the raptor population outside of Grom'gol, just to the north.  Don't worry about the raptors themselves... those wretched Nesingwary hunters will take care of them.$b$bI want you to destroy their eggs.
english.completion: Keep up the good work, $c.  Hellscream's eyes are upon you.
english.completed: Return to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 保卫格罗姆高：压制食人魔
text.objectives: 杀死4名莫什奥格蛮兵和4名莫什奥格巫医。
text.description: 我们刚来这片丛林时，并不打算和当地的部族们开战。我们的第一要务是补给斯通纳德。但情况有些复杂，当地的一撮食人魔占领了格罗姆高东南方的米扎废墟。他们无视警告，不断地偷袭我们的补给队。$b$b我要你去对付这些不听话的食人魔。$b$b到废墟去把他们从这里赶走。至少这也可以作为一次严正警告。
text.completion: I see you are good for more than simple egg-smashing duty.  Good.  The Horde can use a capable $r like you.
text.completed: Return to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Defense of Grom'gol: Ogre Oppression
english.objectives: Kill 4 Mosh'ogg Brutes and 4 Mosh'ogg Witch Doctors.
english.description: When we first arrived in this jungle we did not intend to wage war on the local tribes.  Our mission to supply Stonard is of the highest priority.  But complications have arisen.  A local band of ogres has occupied the Mizjah Ruins to the southeast of Grom'gol.  Despite warnings, they continue to ambush our supply caravans.$b$bI am putting you in charge of dealing with these uncooperative ogres.$b$bTravel to the ruins and attempt to drive them from the area.  At the very least it will send a firm message.
english.completion: I see you are good for more than simple egg-smashing duty.  Good.  The Horde can use a capable $r like you.
english.completed: Return to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 保卫格罗姆高：鱼人大屠杀
text.objectives: 杀死15名黑鳃鱼人。
text.description: 盐鳞鱼人把黑鳃鱼人赶出了海洋，后者只能到东北方的卡莱废墟寻求庇护。以前倒无所谓，但现在这样不行。$b$b离开了海洋，黑鳃鱼人变得躁动不安，还经常派出强盗来攻击我的补给队。告诉他们：这种行为是不为地狱咆哮的部落所容忍的。
text.completion: Excellent work. Hopefully the raids will stop for now. I have one more task for you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Defense of Grom'gol: Murloc Menace
english.objectives: Slay 15 Murkgill murlocs.
english.description: The Murkgill murlocs have been pushed out of the ocean by the Saltscale murlocs, so they make their refuge in the Kal'ai ruins to our northeast.  This was acceptable in the past, but no longer.$b$bSeparated from the sea, the Murkgill have grown restless, and they send their foragers to attack my supply caravans.  Send them a message: this behavior will NOT be tolerated by Hellscream's Horde.
english.completion: Excellent work. Hopefully the raids will stop for now. I have one more task for you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 保卫格罗姆高：巨魔盗窃案
text.objectives: 从巴拉尔废墟拿回格罗姆高口粮。
text.description: 格罗姆高的巨魔没有给我们惹什么麻烦。大部分巨魔都知道一旦惹恼部落，他们就会如蝼蚁般被碾死，荆棘谷的巨魔也不例外。$b$b但是，血顶部落最近却十分活跃。就在上个星期，他们派了一伙人到格罗姆高来，偷走了几箱子口粮。$b$b偷粮食其实还是可以原谅的，但我依然不能允许自己的辖下有这种事。去北边巴拉尔废墟，把我们的财产夺回来。
text.progress: Pity has no place under my command.  The trolls can find food elsewhere.  It's a big jungle.
text.completion: The Horde thanks you, $n.  Grom'gol is protected, if only for today.
text.completed: Return to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Defense of Grom'gol: Trollish Thievery
english.objectives: Obtain the Grom'gol Rations from the Bal'lal ruins.
english.description: The trolls leave us well enough alone here in Grom'gol.  Most trolls know that the Horde can easily crush them when angered, and the trolls here in Stranglethorn are no exception.$b$bThe Bloodscalp have been more active lately, however.  As lately as last week, they sent a party into Grom'gol and stole several cases of rations.$b$bStealing food is the most forgivable type of theft, but I still can't let it happen under my watch.  Head north, to the Bal'lal ruins, and return our property.
english.progress: Pity has no place under my command.  The trolls can find food elsewhere.  It's a big jungle.
english.completion: The Horde thanks you, $n.  Grom'gol is protected, if only for today.
english.completed: Return to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 泥浆怪之母
text.objectives: 从一只恐泥怪身上获得恐泥怪样本。
text.description: 我对居住在隐匿石的泥浆怪十分感兴趣。不管把它们除掉多少次，它们总会回来，尽管看起来它们不像是能从单个泥浆怪增殖出来的样子。$B$B我想有什么东西长在里面。所有泥浆怪的来源，我想研究它。找到这个来源，带一份样本给我。
text.progress: Well? What did you find?
text.completion:
Fascinating... How large did you say it was? I wonder if others could be found intact...

This sample is excellent. I'll be sharing it with my fellow researchers.
text.completed: Return to Malcom Fendelson at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: 尽量别靠得太近了…谁知道这玩意儿到底有什么能耐呢？

english.title: Prime Slime
english.objectives: Collect a Direglob Sample from The Direglob.
english.description: I've become very interested in the slimes inhabiting Skulk Rock. No matter how many times they're cleared out, they seem to return, yet it doesn't seem they're capable of reproducing from a single slime.$B$BI think something's growing in there. There's a source where all the slimes come from, and I want to study it. Find this source, and bring me back a sample.
english.progress: Well? What did you find?
english.completion:
Fascinating... How large did you say it was? I wonder if others could be found intact...

This sample is excellent. I'll be sharing it with my fellow researchers.
english.completed: Return to Malcom Fendelson at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: Try not to get too close... Who knows what this thing is capable of?

text.title: 失踪的士兵
text.objectives: 从霜鬃巨魔要塞的牢笼里释放6名被俘的爆破师。
text.description: 像这样的活，我通常把一整队的爆破师都带上。多些人手设置火药、炸药，还有其他的装备，工作可以完成得更快。$B$B那些该死的穴居人把我的人关在霜鬃巨魔要塞各处的牢笼里。现在就剩我一个人，没有人手，没法完成工作。$B$B然而，你看来是个能干的$c。你能不能找到被穴居人俘虏的爆破师，把他们从牢笼里放出来？
text.completion: You have me own thanks and th' thanks of th' men you rescued. I've already had th' boys start setting up the gear down inside the cave. It should be ready to go soon.
text.completed: Return to Jessup McCree at Frostmane Hold.

english.title: Missing in Action
english.objectives: Free 6 Captured Demolitionists from their cages around Frostmane Hold.
english.description: Fer a job like this, I normally bring me whole crew o' demolitionists. With some help in settin' up th' powder, th' charges, and th' rest o' th' gear, the job gets done a lot faster.$B$BThose blasted troggs have me men caged all around Frostmane Hold. Now I'm 'ere all alone without th' personnel I need to finish th' job.$B$BYou look like a capable $c, though. Would you find th' demolitionists th' troggs captured and break them out o' their cages?
english.completion: You have me own thanks and th' thanks of th' men you rescued. I've already had th' boys start setting up the gear down inside the cave. It should be ready to go soon.
english.completed: Return to Jessup McCree at Frostmane Hold.

text.title: 把我的炸药还回来！
text.objectives: 从霜鬃巨魔要塞的石腭拾骨者或石腭袭击者身上夺回7只被偷走的火药桶。
text.description: 需要大量的火药才能让那些洞窟塌方。我不晓得那些该死的穴居人是怎么知道这一点的，它们偷了我的补给，还绑架了我的爆破师！但结果是一样的。$B$B除非把我的火药找回来，不然我什么都炸不成。$B$B到霜鬃巨魔要塞南边，杀掉你看到的所有穴居人。我的火药桶肯定就在其中一个身上。
text.progress: Well, did you recover me missing supplies?
text.completion: Well, now, that's more like it. We may get around to blowin' up somethin' after all.
text.completed: Return to Jessup McCree at Frostmane Hold.

english.title: Get Me Explosives Back!
english.objectives: Recover 7 Stolen Powder Kegs from Rockjaw Bonepickers or Rockjaw Marauders at Frostmane Hold.
english.description: It's gonna take a lot of powder ta collapse those caves. I don't know whether th' damnable troggs understood that when they stole me supplies and kidnapped me demolitionists! But th' outcome's th' same.$B$BAin't gonna be able ta blow nothin' up until I've got that powder back.$B$BGo south to Frostmane Hold and kill any o' those troggs you find. Any one o' 'em could be carryin' me kegs o' powder.
english.progress: Well, did you recover me missing supplies?
english.completion: Well, now, that's more like it. We may get around to blowin' up somethin' after all.
english.completed: Return to Jessup McCree at Frostmane Hold.

text.title: 保卫西部荒野
text.objectives: 缴获豺狼人攻击命令。
text.description: 在灰熊丘陵的任期结束后，我回到了西部荒野，发现这里的情况比我离开时更糟糕。$B$B我们的战争让成千上万平民百姓流离失所。他们现在来这里逃难，群聚在荒废的农舍和镇子里。$B$B更要命的是，我们受到了豺狼人的进攻。月溪旅需要你的帮助，$n。杀掉来犯的豺狼人，把他们的军令搜出来。有人在背后指使，我们得知道是谁！
text.progress: Have you recovered the attack orders?
text.completion: Helix? I've heard that name before. Recently as a matter of fact, but who is this admiral?
text.completed: Return to Marshal Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

english.title: In Defense of Westfall
english.objectives: Recover the Gnoll Attack Orders.
english.description: After my tour of duty was over in Grizzly Hills, I returned to Westfall, only to find the land in worse condition than when I left.$B$BThe price of our war left thousands of citizens homeless. They now migrate here and squat upon the deserted farmhouses and towns of the region.$B$BTo make matters worse, we are now under attack by the gnolls. The Westfall Brigade needs your help, $n. Slay the attacking gnolls and recover their orders. Someone is pulling their strings and we need to find out whom!
english.progress: Have you recovered the attack orders?
english.completion: Helix? I've heard that name before. Recently as a matter of fact, but who is this admiral?
english.completed: Return to Marshal Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: 月溪旅
text.objectives: 杀掉12只袭击哨兵岭的河爪豺狼人。
text.description: 我们一度被人们称作人民军。不过，现如今，有安度因·乌瑞恩国王的全面支持，我们为暴风城而战。我们在西部荒野有许多目标要完成：收拾迪菲亚留下来的烂摊子，扩大联盟的影响并维护秩序。目前我们各方面做的都不理想。$B$B如今的年景还不如迪菲亚横行那会儿呢。现在就连豺狼人土著都起来造反了，我们可算是被逼上死路啦。帮帮我们，$n！
text.completion: Well done, $n. You have provided us a temporary reprieve from the onslaught of gnolls, but there is more work to be done.
text.completed: Return to Captain Danuvin at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

english.title: The Westfall Brigade
english.objectives: Slay any 12 Riverpaw Gnolls attacking Sentinel Hill.
english.description: We were once known as the People's Militia. These days, though, we fight under the banner of Stormwind, with the full support of King Varian Wrynn. Our goals here in Westfall are many: to clean up the mess left behind by the Defias, to expand the reach of the Alliance and to maintain order. So far we are failing on all fronts.$B$BTimes are worse now than when the Defias ran amok. Now with the indigenous gnolls of the region up in arms, we find ourselves backed into a corner. Help us, $n!
english.completion: Well done, $n. You have provided us a temporary reprieve from the onslaught of gnolls, but there is more work to be done.
english.completed: Return to Captain Danuvin at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀掉进犯的河爪豺狼人

text.title: 詹格·斑皮
text.objectives: 杀掉5名河爪秘法师，5名河爪监工，以及詹格·斑皮。
text.description: 西部荒野打这儿往南有块地方叫做尘埃平原的，据我们所知豺狼人已经将那里作为大本营。既然是大本营，那么就肯定有压阵的头领。要想解决他们的来犯，我们就要找到管事的把他干掉。$B$B朝尘埃平原进发，找到豺狼人的首领詹格·斑皮，杀掉他。路上要是有豺狼人敢挡你的去路，一并干掉。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. It will take the Riverpaw weeks to recover from the blow you just dealt. Please take an item of your choosing as a reward for what you have done.
text.completed: Return to Captain Danuvin at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

english.title: Jango Spothide
english.objectives: Slay 5 Riverpaw Mystics, 5 Riverpaw Taskmasters and Jango Spothide.
english.description: South of here is an area of Westfall known as the Dust Plains. From what we know the gnolls of the region have made the Dust Plains their unofficial capital. As with any capital, there exists a leader at the heart. If we are to put an end to these attacks, we must track down the gnoll in charge and end him.$B$BVenture forth into the Dust Plains, find the gnoll leader, Jango Spothide, and kill him. Take out any other gnolls that get in your way.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. It will take the Riverpaw weeks to recover from the blow you just dealt. Please take an item of your choosing as a reward for what you have done.
english.completed: Return to Captain Danuvin at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: 寻找密探吉尔妮
text.objectives: 寻找密探吉尔妮。
text.description: 自从赫利克斯·破甲两星期前进入联盟领地以来军情七处就一直在监控他。我从马迪亚斯·肖尔那儿收到的信表明他派了一个名叫吉尔妮的密探去盯梢赫利克斯。找到密探吉尔妮，你就找到了赫利克斯·破甲。$B$B吉尔妮两天前来镇里拿过补给，她曾提到自己会在摩特维克之塔一带，就在东南方向尘埃平原上。$B$B去吧，$n。
text.completion: Helix is the one responsible for the gnoll attacks? He's inside. He's been there for days. I've just been waiting for an excuse to bust him.

english.title: Find Agent Kearnen
english.objectives: Find Agent Kearnen.
english.description: SI: 7 has been tracking Helix Gearbreaker since he entered Alliance territory two weeks ago. The letter I received from Mathias Shaw explained that he sent an agent by the name of Kearnen to Westfall to shadow Helix. Find Agent Kearnen and you'll find Helix Gearbreaker.$B$BKearnen came into town for supplies two days ago. She mentioned that she would be near Mortwake's Tower, southeast of here, on the Dust Plains.$B$BGet going, $n.
english.completion: Helix is the one responsible for the gnoll attacks? He's inside. He's been there for days. I've just been waiting for an excuse to bust him.

text.title: 高塔的秘密
text.objectives: 进入摩特维克之塔找到赫利克斯·破甲。
text.description: 赫利克斯固守在曾经的克拉文·摩特维克之塔里。跟你明说了吧，$n，那儿防卫森严。光在外面我就瞧见了六名武装佣兵。你单枪匹马绝不可能进得去。算你走运，有克莱尔和我在。$B$B<吉尔妮拍了拍她的狙击步枪。>$B$B我来掩护你们进去。$B$B拿上这瓶遮罩药水，在里面你会用得上。进去以后直奔楼上，不管赫利克斯在那儿藏了什么，都把它找出来！
text.completion: What could possibly be going on in Moonbrook? I don't like this one bit, $n.
text.completed: 回到西部荒野尘埃平原的密探吉尔妮那里。

english.title: Secrets of the Tower
english.objectives: Enter Mortwake's Tower and find Helix Gearbreaker.
english.description: Helix has got himself holed up inside Klaven Mortwake's old tower. I won't lie to you, $n, it's heavily guarded. I count six armed mercenaries just on the outside. There's no way you're getting inside that tower by yourself. Lucky for you, Claire and I are here.$B$B<Kearnen pats her sniper rifle.>$B$BI'll cover your entry.$B$BTake this shrouding potion, you'll need it once you get inside. Use it as soon as you enter the tower and head upstairs. Find out what Helix is hiding up there!
english.completion: What could possibly be going on in Moonbrook? I don't like this one bit, $n.
english.completed: Return to Agent Kearnen at the Dust Plains in Westfall.

text.title: 月溪镇的大麻烦
text.objectives: 把你的发现报告给西部荒野哨兵岭的治安官格里安·斯托曼。
text.description: 我把报告写好，一会儿就要回暴风城了。军情七处肯定已经收到了西部荒野的消息。我建议你也去向格里安报告。
text.completion: Who IS this Shadowy Figure? We have to get to Moonbrook.

english.title: Big Trouble in Moonbrook
english.objectives: Report your findings to Marshal Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
english.description: I'll be filling out my report and heading back to Stormwind shortly. SI: 7 must be informed of the happenings in Westfall. I would recommend you do the same and report back to Gryan.
english.completion: Who IS this Shadowy Figure? We have to get to Moonbrook.

text.title: 到月溪镇去！
text.objectives: 向西部荒野月溪镇的阿尔佩上尉报告。
text.description: 我们在月溪镇附近设立营地已经有一阵子了，$n。我最好的一个手下在一连哨兵岭步兵协同下负责这一块。立刻去向阿尔佩上尉报告，看他有没有月溪镇的消息。$B$B我的另一个朋友也在月溪镇营地。他的名字叫做索拉留斯。我还是在诺森德于瓦加德任职的时候遇见他的。他是一个足智多谋的萨满。也许他有能力帮我们解决目前的谜团。
text.completion: The natives are restless, $n. I don't know what's going on, but homeless activity in this area has quadrupled in the past two days. If I didn't know any better I'd say they were planning something...

english.title: To Moonbrook!
english.objectives: Report to Captain Alpert at Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.description: We have had a camp near Moonbrook for quite some time now, $n. One of my best soldiers works the area along with a company of Sentinel Hill troopers. Report to Captain Alpert now and find out if he has any news about the happenings in Moonbrook.$B$BAnother ally of mine is also at the Moonbrook camp. His name is Thoralius. I met Thoralius in Northrend during my time in Valgarde. He is a wise and powerful shaman. Perhaps his abilities could help us solve this mystery.
english.completion: The natives are restless, $n. I don't know what's going on, but homeless activity in this area has quadrupled in the past two days. If I didn't know any better I'd say they were planning something...

text.title: 战争机器
text.objectives: 同奥格瑞玛后门里的工头格里布斯交谈。
text.description:
“灭世者”就藏在东边那遥远的暮光高地里。我们必须终结他们的威胁，为此要出动史上最强大的军队！

我们的地精新盟友正在打造新式战争机器，可我听说工程存在质量问题。我们可不能用破铜烂铁跟敌人交战。找工头格里布斯谈一谈，确保战争机器可以上战场。
text.completion: Busy now. Go away. Wait, what? Hellscream sent you? What - uh - what can I do for you? Him? Us?
text.completed: 同奥格瑞玛后门里的工头格里布斯交谈。

english.title: Machines of War
english.objectives: Talk to Foreman Glibbs just inside the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Orgrimmar.
english.description: The "Worldbreakers" hide in a highland wilderness, squatting behind the Alliance kingdoms in the east. We will crush them, and we will do so with the mightiest army ever assembled since our victories in Northrend.$B$BI tasked our new goblin allies with the assembly of a host of war machines. Reports from the field reveal that their workmanship is sometimes... lacking.$B$BI will not go to battle with faulty machines. See Foreman Glibbs here in Orgrimmar and ensure my war machines are battle-ready!
english.completion: Busy now. Go away. Wait, what? Hellscream sent you? What - uh - what can I do for you? Him? Us?
english.completed: Talk to Foreman Glibbs just inside the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 大规模失常性武器
text.objectives: 检查地狱咆哮攻城车，直到你发现一台不良品，然后给首席工程师上一课。
text.description: <格里布斯拿一块油腻的手帕擦了擦额头上的汗。>$B$B萨鲁法尔不满意我们的工作？那可不妙。我的小子们该加把劲了。$B$B或许你可以帮忙来个小惩大诫。有一批地狱咆哮攻城车刚刚下线等候复检。全面测试一下，要是你发现什么问题，就教训首席工程师一顿。提醒他们部落可全指望他们了！
text.completion: Instilled a little discipline in them, did you? Good, good! Everyone pulls their weight in my Horde, from the smallest peon to the proudest warrior. I tolerate nothing less. Our preparations for the invasion are almost complete.
text.completed: Return to Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Weapons of Mass Dysfunction
english.objectives: Inspect Hellscream Demolishers until you find a faulty one, then teach its Chief Engineer a lesson.
english.description: <Glibbs mops sweat from his brow with a greasy handkerchief.>$B$BHellscream isn't happy with our work? Oh - we even NAMED the "Hellscream Demolisher" after him. This is very bad. My boys need to step it up.$B$BMaybe you can help set an example. A set of Hellscream Demolishers just rolled off the blocks and are ready for inspection. Give them a thorough going-over, and if you find any problems, give the Chief Engineer a good thrashing. Remind them that the eyes of Hellscream are upon them!
english.completion: Instilled a little discipline in them, did you? Good, good! Everyone pulls their weight in my Horde, from the smallest peon to the proudest warrior. I tolerate nothing less. Our preparations for the invasion are almost complete.
english.completed: Return to Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 宣传
text.objectives: 收集一份情报手册，一份秘密日记，一期月溪镇时报和一本神秘的宣传书。
text.description: 我们注意到这里流浪汉的暴力活动有所抬头。有什么或是有人在煽动他们。不管是谁在背后指使，他都非常有组织。就在最近一伙流氓窜了进来，到处散发小册子。$B$B到月溪镇找点证据来。宣传册、传单，随便啥，都带些给我。也许我们能通过笔迹找到线索。
text.progress: 找到了吗?
text.completion: V? The only V I know is VanCleef, but he died many years ago.
text.completed: Return to Captain Alpert at Moonbrook in Westfall.

english.title: Propaganda
english.objectives: Recover an Informational Pamphlet, Secret Journal, an Issue of the Moonbrook Times and Mysterious Propaganda.
english.description: We've noticed a rise in violent acts amongst the homeless of the area. Something or someone is getting them all riled up. Now whoever is behind all this is getting more organized. Just recently a group of thugs came through here handing out pamphlets.$B$BEnter Moonbrook and look for evidence. Propaganda, leaflets, whatever... Bring whatever you find back to me. Maybe we can find the source through the writings.
english.progress: Any luck?
english.completion: V? The only V I know is VanCleef, but he died many years ago.
english.completed: Return to Captain Alpert at Moonbrook in Westfall.

text.title: 搜证
text.objectives: 收集6根红头巾。
text.description: 这根头巾的质地同法布隆凶案现场发现的吻合。你应该收集更多的红头巾作为证据，给阿尔佩上尉带回去。
text.progress: Red bandanas?!
text.completion: I haven't seen a red bandana in five years. Could this shadowy figure be attempting to reform the Defias Brotherhood?
text.completed: Return to Captain Alpert at Moonbrook in Westfall.

english.title: Evidence Collection
english.objectives: Collect 6 Red Bandanas.
english.description: The material of this bandana is identical to the material found at the Furlbrow murder scene. You should collect more red bandanas as evidence and return what you find to Captain Alpert.
english.progress: Red bandanas?!
english.completion: I haven't seen a red bandana in five years. Could this shadowy figure be attempting to reform the Defias Brotherhood?
english.completed: Return to Captain Alpert at Moonbrook in Westfall.

text.title: 崭新的一天
text.objectives: 从月溪镇集会上收集情报。
text.description: 看来阴暗的人影所说的会议就要开始了。无家可归者们正在动员。我要你参加他们的集会，收集情报，$n。$B$B到月溪镇中心去旁听他们的集会。有什么发现就回来告诉我。
text.completion: I could hear the cheers from here. It seems as if we've got a huge problem on our hands, $n.  We have to discover the identity of this shadowy menace before we enlist the aid of Stormwind. Perhaps there is another way...
text.completed: Return to Captain Alpert at Moonbrook in Westfall.

english.title: The Dawning of a New Day
english.objectives: Gather information from the Moonbrook Rally.
english.description: It looks like the meeting the shadowy figure spoke of is starting soon. The homeless are starting to mobilize. I need you to attend the rally and gather information, $n.$B$BGo to the center of Moonbrook and listen in on the rally. Return to me with whatever you find out.
english.completion: I could hear the cheers from here. It seems as if we've got a huge problem on our hands, $n.  We have to discover the identity of this shadowy menace before we enlist the aid of Stormwind. Perhaps there is another way...
english.completed: Return to Captain Alpert at Moonbrook in Westfall.

objectiveDetails.description: 收集月溪镇集会的情报

text.title: 为耶尼库而杀
text.objectives: 从巴拉尔废墟的血顶巨魔身上获得6颗血顶獠牙。
text.description: 注定完了。我们酋长的幼子，耶尼库，肯定是完了。依照我们的习俗，他被送给祖尔格拉布的古拉巴什巨魔作人质。但我们暗矛部族随兽人酋长萨尔出走后，我们就失去了可怜的耶尼库的消息。我从遥远的奥格瑞玛回到荆棘谷寻找酋长的儿子。$B$B我相信他在血顶巨魔手上。$B$B你要是想帮我，就去猎杀血顶巨魔。你可以在北边找到他们，把他们的獠牙带来给我。
text.progress: $C。给我血顶部族的獠牙，以此来证明你确实猎杀了他们。$B$B快把你的战利品给我看看。
text.completion: 这些獠牙的品质证明你杀的都是健康强壮的家伙，$N。通过对血顶部族的猎杀，你已经证明了自己的能力。$B$B这很好，因为你还要为我们继续做些别的事。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Hunt for Yenniku
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Bloodscalp Tusks from Bloodscalp trolls in the Bal'lal Ruins.
english.description: A doom, there is.  A doom on my chief's youngest son, Yenniku.  As is a custom with our people, he was given to the Gurubashi Trolls of Zul'Gurub, but after my tribe, the Darkspear tribe, left with the orc Thrall, poor Yenniku was lost to us.  I was sent from distant Orgrimmar, back to Stranglethorn, to search for my chief's son.$B$BAnd I believe the Bloodscalp tribe has him.$B$BIf you would help me, then hunt the Bloodscalps.  You may find them to the north.  Gather their tusks and return to me.
english.progress: $c.  Show me you have made prey of the Bloodscalp tribe. Show me your trophies.
english.completion: These are good tusks, $n.  You prove that you have the strength to hunt the Bloodscalps. And that is good, because you are not done hunting them.
english.completed: Return to Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 猎头
text.objectives: 从祖丹亚废墟的血顶巨魔那里获得25个皱缩的徽记。
text.description: 我们必须弄清楚耶尼库是不是死了。$B$B杀掉祖丹亚的血顶巨魔，把他们身上皱缩的徽记拿来。你必须收集大量、大量的徽记，这样我才能知道耶尼库的是不是也在里面。$B$B要是耶尼库被血顶戕害，就愿600年的诅咒降临在他们酋长甘祖拉恩的灵魂上！$B$B去吧，$n。沿着海岸朝北，你可以在祖丹亚废墟那里找到徽记。
text.progress: $N。我一直在担心着我们酋长的儿子。你收集了多少个皱缩头颅供我检查?
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。我会仔细检查这些首级，希望可怜的耶尼库没有被那帮猎头者杀害。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Headhunting
english.objectives: Obtain 25 Shrunken Heads from Bloodscalp trolls at the Zuuldaia Ruins.
english.description: We must find if Yenniku is dead.$B$BSlay the Bloodscalps of Zuuldaia and take from them their shrunken heads.  You must gather many, many heads, and I will inspect them to make sure Yenniku's head is not among them.$B$BAnd if Yenniku was killed by the Bloodscalps, then may a 600-year curse fall on the spirit of their chief, Gan'zulah!$B$BGo, $n.  You will find the heads at the ruins of Zuuldaia, along the coast to the north.
english.progress: $n.  I fear for our chief's son.  Do you have the shrunken heads so I may inspect them?
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  I will inspect these heads to ensure poor Yenniku was spared the headhunter's axe.
english.completed: Return to Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 奈兹里奥克知道
text.objectives: 从祖昆达可怕的奈兹里奥克那里获得奈兹里奥克的徽记。
text.description: 感谢蛇神，耶尼库不在这里。但我们还是没有他的眉目。$B$B我们必须知道实情，恐怕只有血顶巫医才知道。他是暗矛的敌人，不会轻易开口，因此我们必须从他的尸体上套出话来！$B$B把奈兹里奥克的徽记带来，放到这口锅里。$B$B他就在祖昆达深处。把徽记拿来……我们会让它开口的。
text.progress: 冒泡的大锅中装着满满一锅绿色的肉汤。
text.completion: You place the head of Nezzliok within the cauldron...
text.completed: Return to Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 血顶的首席巫医就在祖昆达深处。

english.title: Nezzliok Will Know
english.objectives: Obtain Nezzliok's Head from Nezzliok the Dire in Zul'Kunda.
english.description: Yenniku was not among the heads, and I thank the Great Serpent for it.  But we are no closer to finding him.$B$BWe must know the truth, and I fear that only the Bloodscalp witchdoctor will know it.  He is an enemy of the Darkspear tribe and will not speak freely, so we must force the truth from his dead lips!$B$BBring me the head of Nezzliok the Dire and place it within this cauldron.$B$BHe is deep within Zul'Kunda.  Bring his head...we will then make it talk.
english.progress: The greenish broth within the cauldron bubbles.
english.completion: You place the head of Nezzliok within the cauldron...
english.completed: Return to Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: The Bloodscalps' chief witch doctor will be deep within Zul'Kunda.

text.title: 同奈兹里奥克交谈
text.objectives: 从北荆棘谷的劈颅废墟里获得巴里亚曼战利品和赞塔加战利品。
text.description: <奈兹里奥克的徽记开口了。>$B$B没错，我知道暗矛之子的所在。你们将我拿住，缚住了我的灵魂，但我在得到满足之前，是不会开口的！$B$B血顶同劈颅水火不容。你要赢得我的好感，就得从东边河对岸的劈颅巨魔那里，把他们最宝贵的战利品偷两件来。将它们和我放在一起，这样我在虚空冥界也好有下人使唤。战利品一个是从巴里亚曼拿到，另一个则在赞塔加。
text.progress: 我等着你拿来那些头颅……
text.completion: Yes.  These will serve me well.  When my spirit is freed, I will enter the Nether with some fine servants indeed! You are a credit to your $r clan, and you have appeased me.
text.completed: Return to Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Speaking with Nezzliok
english.objectives: Obtain a Balia'mah Trophy and a Ziata'jai Trophy from the Skullsplitter ruins in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: <The head of Nezzliok speaks.>$B$BIt is true.  I know where the child of the Darkspears was taken.  You have bested me and bound my spirit, but I will say nothing without appeasement!$B$BThe Bloodscalps war with the Skullsplitters.  To gain my favor, steal two of their most-prized trophy skulls from the Skullsplitters across the river to the east.  Place them here with us, so that my spirit will have slaves in the Nether.  One skull must be from their trophy pile in Balia'mah, the other from Ziata'jai.
english.progress: I await the skulls...
english.completion: Yes.  These will serve me well.  When my spirit is freed, I will enter the Nether with some fine servants indeed! You are a credit to your $r clan, and you have appeased me.
english.completed: Return to Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 追逐耶尼库的命运
text.objectives: 跟邦巴拉的肯维雷谈一谈。
text.description: <奈兹里奥克开口说话了。>$B$B你令我和我的酋长满意，我也会告诉你所寻之人下落……$B$B年轻的耶尼库已经不在我族这里了。$B$B带他走的乃是流亡者赞吉尔。如今赞吉尔将他的身心都控制了，只有最强力的魔法才能将他解放。$B$B这魔法你是没有的，$c。$B$B也许你在东边邦巴拉的暗矛朋友们有一线希望，能让耶尼库获得救赎。不过这一点，我很是怀疑。
text.completion: Zanzil the Outcast?? If Yenniku is held by that troll, a vile and powerful witchdoctor, then I fear that only a faint hope remains.  Faint.  And tiny as the smallest insect. Fortunately, I have some suspicions of my own.  Suspicions which may lead to Yenniku's salvation.
text.completed: 跟北荆棘谷邦巴拉的肯维雷谈一谈。

english.title: Chasing Yenniku's Fate
english.objectives: Speak with Kin'weelay at Bambala.
english.description: <Nezzliok speaks.>$B$BYou have appeased myself and my chief, so I will tell you that which you seek to discover...$B$BYoung Yenniku is lost to his clan.$B$BHe was taken by the witchdoctor Zanzil the Outcast.  Now Zanzil controls him, body and soul, and only the most potent magic could set him free.$B$BA magic that you do not have, $c.$B$BPerhaps your Darkspear allies at Bambala in the east can offer a hope of Yenniku's salvation.  But that, I doubt.
english.completion: Zanzil the Outcast?? If Yenniku is held by that troll, a vile and powerful witchdoctor, then I fear that only a faint hope remains.  Faint.  And tiny as the smallest insect. Fortunately, I have some suspicions of my own.  Suspicions which may lead to Yenniku's salvation.
english.completed: Speak with Kin'weelay at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 心灵之眼
text.objectives: 从麦佐斯那里获得心灵之眼。
text.description: 南边莫什奥格食人魔山里，一名食人魔法师掌握着心灵之眼。他的名字叫做麦佐斯。自从暗矛在荆棘谷定居的时候我就认识他了——不但邪恶，而且魔法强大。$B$B既然他手里有心灵之眼，那么他的魔法就更是如虎添翼了。$B$B你必须挑战麦佐斯，抢下心灵之眼。这是一个十分凶险的任务，但它也是我们救回耶尼库的唯一希望。
text.progress: 你好，$N。自我将你决定去对付麦佐斯的事情告诉了丛林之灵後，他们一直在歌颂着你的英勇与无畏。$B$B你拿到心灵之眼了吗?
text.completion: You retrieved the eye!  Your might is the stuff of legends, $n! And in getting the Eye, you must have defeated Mai'Zoth and sent him to the Nether.  That is why the spirits would not mention him before. It is good that he is gone from the world of flesh and bone, but now that he is in the realm of spirits...I fear he will begin a new reign. But that is a worry for another time.
text.completed: Return to Kin'weelay at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Mind's Eye
english.objectives: Obtain the Mind's Eye from Mai'Zoth.
english.description: The Mind's Eye is held by an ogre mage, in the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound just to the south.  His name is Mai'Zoth.  I know him from when the Darkspears dwelt in Stranglethorn - he is vicious, and his magic is strong.$B$BAnd if he has the Mind's Eye, then his magic will be stronger still.$B$BYou must face Mai'Zoth and wrest from him the Mind's Eye.  It is a perilous task, but it is the only hope we have of saving Yenniku.
english.progress: Greetings, $n.  The spirits sing praise of your bravery, yet they tell me no tales of your quest against Mai'Zoth. Do you have the Eye?
english.completion: You retrieved the eye!  Your might is the stuff of legends, $n! And in getting the Eye, you must have defeated Mai'Zoth and sent him to the Nether.  That is why the spirits would not mention him before. It is good that he is gone from the world of flesh and bone, but now that he is in the realm of spirits...I fear he will begin a new reign. But that is a worry for another time.
english.completed: Return to Kin'weelay at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 丛林之夜
text.objectives: 扑灭北荆棘谷祖玛维的8个祖玛维火盆。
text.description: 一年前，我的母亲——也就是照顾我的巨魔——被祖玛维的劈颅部族掳了去。年少气盛的我想去把她抢回来，却只看到她被众多战士推入燃烧的火盆中。我藏在树后，看着他们把她抓住，然后……然后……$b$b<基尔卡利尔扭过头去。>$b$b在晚上，他们火盆中的光亮映在树梢上，让我夜不能眠。求你了，$n……到南边的祖玛维去把它们扑灭。
text.completion: My mother's spirit rests well tonight, $n. As will I.
text.completed: Return to Kil'karil at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Nighttime in the Jungle
english.objectives: Put out 8 Zul'Mamwe Braziers at Zul'Mamwe in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: One year ago, my mother - that is, the troll who took care of me - was taken by the Skullsplitters of Zul'Mamwe.  Young and headstrong, I ran in after her, only to see her being pushed toward a burning brazier by a dozen of their warriors.  I hid behind a tree and watched as they grabbed her and... and...$b$b<Kil'karil looks away.>$b$bAt nighttime, the lights from their braziers reflect off the treetops and keep me awake.  Please, $n... travel south into Zul'Mamwe and put them out.
english.completion: My mother's spirit rests well tonight, $n. As will I.
english.completed: Return to Kil'karil at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 拯救耶尼库
text.objectives: 将装满的灵魂宝石带给尼姆布亚。
text.description: 我将心灵之眼制成了一颗灵魂宝石。它有两重目的：你必须用它来击晕耶尼库，然后把它放在他的头上，困住他的灵魂。$B$B我之前提到的疑虑是正确的：万灵告诉我耶尼库并没有与流亡者赞吉尔同在，而是在西南边的祖玛维废墟里。一旦你将耶尼库的灵魂解放，就到格罗姆高去找尼姆布亚。
text.progress: $N。肯维雷告诉我你已经出发去对付耶尼库了。$B$B这是真的吗?你抓到他了吗?
text.completion: You've done it!  You freed Yenniku from the will of Zanzil and the tyranny of the Skullsplitter, and completed the mission I had thought was so hopeless.  Zanzil still looms a threat in the Cape of Stranglethorn, but for now, I at least know that the soul of my chief's son is free. Our tribe will remember your name in songs, $n, and we will etch your tale in stone so that it will live forever.
text.completed: Return to Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 他经历了那么多……是时候让他的灵魂解放了。

english.title: Saving Yenniku
english.objectives: Bring the Filled Soul Gem to Nimboya.
english.description: I have reshaped the Mind's Eye into a Soul Gem.  Its purpose is twofold: you must use it to stun Yenniku, and once stunned place it upon his head to entrap his soul.$B$BMy suspicions that I spoke of earlier were correct: the spirits tell me that Yenniku dwells not with Zanzil the Outcast, but within the Ruins of Zul'Mamwe, to the southwest.  Once you have freed Yenniku's spirit, return to Nimboya at Grom'gol.
english.progress: $n.  Kin'weelay told me you set out to capture Yenniku. Is it true?  Do you have him?
english.completion: You've done it!  You freed Yenniku from the will of Zanzil and the tyranny of the Skullsplitter, and completed the mission I had thought was so hopeless.  Zanzil still looms a threat in the Cape of Stranglethorn, but for now, I at least know that the soul of my chief's son is free. Our tribe will remember your name in songs, $n, and we will etch your tale in stone so that it will live forever.
english.completed: Return to Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: He's gone through so much... it's time to set his soul free.

text.title: 讨回血债
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗杀死5名邪枝巫医和5名邪枝猎头者。
text.description: 今天我们对邪枝部族的心脏展开第一次攻击。不要留情，$n。这已经不是巨魔间的摩擦了。恶齿巨魔的每一次胜利都是部落的胜利！$B$B邪枝猎头者和巫医将是第一批目标。到下层平台去让你的武器沾满他们的血，把战果汇报给我。
text.completion: Well done, $n! Let the Vilebranch flee in terror from the sight of you!
text.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Start Taking Back
english.objectives: Kill 5 Vilebranch Witch Doctors and 5 Vilebranch Headhunters in Jintha'Alor.
english.description: Today we make the first strike at the heart of the savage Vilebranch tribe. Show no mercy, $n; this is no longer just a spat between trolls. Every victory of the Revantusk is a victory for the Horde!$B$BThe Vilebranch headhunters and witch doctors will be the first to go. Make your strike against the lower terraces and report back to me with blood on your weapons.
english.completion: Well done, $n! Let the Vilebranch flee in terror from the sight of you!
english.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 邪枝之死
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗杀死5名邪枝狂战士和5名邪枝暗影法师。
text.description: 我们不会给他们反应的机会。你必须再次进入辛萨罗，一路冲上顶端。$B$B邪枝狂战士和邪枝暗影法师是危险的敌人，$n。当其他人看到他们的尸体被抛过城墙后，他们就知道我们是认真的。$B$B一个邪枝巨魔都不要放过！
text.completion: It won't be long until we're the only trolls left breathing on these walls.
text.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Death to the Vilebranch
english.objectives: Kill 5 Vilebranch Berserkers and 5 Vilebranch Shadowcasters in Jintha'Alor.
english.description: We won't give them a chance to react. You must re-enter Jintha'Alor and charge all the way to the upper tiers.$B$BThe Vilebranch berserkers and shadowcasters are dangerous enemies, $n. When the others see their bodies thrown across the walls, they'll know we mean business.$B$BDon't leave any Vilebranch hearts beating!
english.completion: It won't be long until we're the only trolls left breathing on these walls.
english.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 现在它是我们的了
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗杀死5名邪枝饮血者和5名邪枝噬魂者。
text.description: 现在只剩最强大和最邪恶的邪枝巨魔了。噬魂者和饮血者，都是邪神哈卡卑鄙的崇拜者。$B$B他们都是蠢货！紧抓着过时、被打败的信仰。我不再会容忍他们对恶齿巨魔犯下的罪行了。$B$B做出最后一击。为了恶齿巨魔占领辛萨罗……为了部落拿下它！
text.completion:
There are none left to oppose the Revantusk! Any stragglers will be quickly taken care of.

You've done my people a great honor, $n.
text.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: It's Ours Now
english.objectives: Kill 5 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers and 5 Vilebranch Soul Eaters in Jintha'Alor.
english.description: Only the strongest and foulest Vilebranch are left now. The soul eaters and blood drinkers, foul worshippers of the evil god Hakkar.$B$BThey are FOOLS! They cling to old, defeated beliefs. I won't tolerate their crimes against the Revantusk any longer.$B$BStrike the final blow. Claim Jintha'Alor for the Revantusk... claim it for the Horde!
english.completion:
There are none left to oppose the Revantusk! Any stragglers will be quickly taken care of.

You've done my people a great honor, $n.
english.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 黑暗容器
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗收集5份腐化之血。
text.description: 邪枝巨魔常常会饮用哈卡的堕落之血来获取力量。他们在喝之前会将其放到这粗糙的罐子里煮沸。那是充满着邪恶力量的容器。$B$B当然，哈卡很久以前就被杀掉了。但有意思的是……我还能看见一些锅子在冒泡。给我带几罐来，我们看看他们在煮些什么。
text.progress: Be careful near those cauldrons, $c. The Vilebranch won't let you take their treats without a fight.
text.completion:
First the spiders and now this. I can smell the venom in this blood... it's the same as the skitterlings, but stronger.

The Vilebranch and spiders... there's some potential here.
text.completed: Return to Eliza Darkgrin at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Dark Vessels
english.objectives: Collect 5 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor.
english.description: The Vilebranch trolls here used to drink the corrupted blood of the god Hakkar himself for power. They boiled it in crude pots before drinking, dark vessels full of unholy strength.$B$BHakkar was killed long ago, of course. But the interesting thing... I still see some cauldrons bubbling up there. Bring me back a few and we'll see just what they've got cooking.
english.progress: Be careful near those cauldrons, $c. The Vilebranch won't let you take their treats without a fight.
english.completion:
First the spiders and now this. I can smell the venom in this blood... it's the same as the skitterlings, but stronger.

The Vilebranch and spiders... there's some potential here.
english.completed: Return to Eliza Darkgrin at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 那些小东西们
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗抓8只迅捷小蜘蛛。
text.description: 稍微耽搁一下，$c……$b$b我有几个中间人，对强力毒剂十分感兴趣。我注意到附近有些蜘蛛在窜来窜去……不是那些巨型的，它们大概只有你的手掌一般大小。$B$B这些敏捷的小东西是我以前在这一地区所没见过的。你能不能帮我弄几只回来？
text.progress: How many did you get?
text.completion:
Oh yes... I was wise to ask you to get these. How fascinating.

Come here, my pretties. Into the bag you go.
text.completed: Return to Eliza Darkgrin at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: All That Skitters
english.objectives: Collect 8 Skittering Spiderlings in Jintha'Alor.
english.description: A moment if you're going up there, $c...$b$bI've got a few brokers quite interested in potent toxins. I couldn't help but notice the spiders scurrying around near here... not giant ones, about the size of your hand.$B$BThe skitterlings are a hue I've never seen before in this area. Could you collect a few for me and bring them back?
english.progress: How many did you get?
english.completion:
Oh yes... I was wise to ask you to get these. How fascinating.

Come here, my pretties. Into the bag you go.
english.completed: Return to Eliza Darkgrin at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 未知水域
text.objectives: 在奥格瑞玛荣誉谷的飞龙之尾旅店找到西雷泽戈·火牙，并拿到暮光高地海岸图。
text.description: 酋长计划对暮光高地发动全面突袭。一旦到地方，我们希望能和龙喉兽人联手。$B$B根据我自己的情报，一名龙喉兽人就定居在奥格瑞玛这里。他名叫西雷泽戈·火牙，一度指挥过众多战士。$B$B他的内部情报对我们来说十分宝贵。找到火牙，替我们弄张暮光高地的水路图来。$B$B我听到的最新消息是，火牙在荣誉谷的一间酒吧里醉成烂泥……
text.progress: Ah, $c, you return. What have you discovered?
text.completion: Twilight Assassins followed you to the bar? Here, in Orgrimmar? The Warchief won't be happy about this. Continue your preparations for the invasion and I will investigate.
text.completed: Bring the chart to Sauranok the Mystic at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Unfamiliar Waters
english.objectives: Locate Herezegor Flametusk at the Wyvern's Tail inn within the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar, and obtain a Twilight Highlands Coastal Chart.
english.description: The Warchief has designs to launch an all-out assault on the Twilight Highlands. Once there we hope to ally with the Dragonmaw orcs.$B$BThrough my own sources I've discovered that a Dragonmaw orc resides here, in Orgrimmar. He is known as Herezegor Flametusk, and once he commanded legions of their warriors.$B$BHis insider knowledge is precious to us. Find Flametusk and obtain for us a chart of the Twilight Highlands waterways.$B$BLast I hear, Flametusk was washed up at a bar in the Valley of Honor...
english.progress: Ah, $c, you return. What have you discovered?
english.completion: Twilight Assassins followed you to the bar? Here, in Orgrimmar? The Warchief won't be happy about this. Continue your preparations for the invasion and I will investigate.
english.completed: Bring the chart to Sauranok the Mystic at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 破碎的防御
text.objectives: 帮助陶恩·冬崖、风暴召唤者米尔拉和哈尔格斯·黯刃打败他们的敌人。
text.description: 当进攻开始时，我们就立刻挺进占领阵地。它们的兵力无穷无尽……我们低估敌人了。现在我们最好的几名萨满滞留在外面，身心俱疲，远离我们的防御阵线。$B$B上战场帮我们受困的兄弟们分担些压力。哪怕是能稍稍停下来歇口气对他们来说也是好的。$B$B动作要快，$c。
text.completion: Thank you, $c. Many Earthen Ring owe dere lives to ya dis day.
text.completed: Return to Earthcaller Torunscar west of the Temple of Earth.

english.title: Crumbling Defenses
english.objectives: Relieve Tawn Winterbluff, Stormcaller Mylra, and Hargoth Dimblaze by helping them to defeat their opponents.
english.description: When da attack started, we pushed out to take da field as quickly as we could. Dere forces were deep and endless... we underestimated dem. Now some of our best shaman be stranded out dere, exhausted, far from our defenses.$B$BMake your way out and take da pressure off of our stranded brothas. Even a small break in battle be a chance to get much needed room ta breathe.$B$BBe swift, $c.
english.completion: Thank you, $c. Many Earthen Ring owe dere lives to ya dis day.
english.completed: Return to Earthcaller Torunscar west of the Temple of Earth.

objectiveDetails.description: 解救风暴召唤者米尔拉

text.title: 麻烦的核心
text.objectives: 收集6颗奔岩土元素的核心
text.description: 元素通常都是混乱的，但这种有组织的进攻却有悖常理。尤其是考虑到它们在这里死后不可复原。我怀疑这是塞拉赞恩所为，但我得有把握才行。$B$B摧毁奔岩碾压者并将它们的核心带给我。假如这是石母的愤怒，恐怕我们就得重新评估下状况了。
text.progress: We've never been claimin' a great friendship with da  Elemental Lords, but we still be trustin' in a bit of security in da chaos. As long as dey be remainin' unorganized, we've been havin' little to fear.$B$BIf the Stonemother is truly rallyin' da earth against us, we be havin' a great deal more to be fearin'.
text.completion: Dese are in surprisingly good condition - good work, mon.
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Norsala west of the Temple of Earth.

english.title: Core of Our Troubles
english.objectives: Collect 6 Irestone Cores.
english.description: Elementals are chaotic by nature, but dis kind of organized aggression is out of character. More so down here where dere deaths be a bit more permanent. I suspect dis is Therazane the Stonemother's doin', but I have to be sure.$B$BDestroy da Irestone Rumblers and bring me their cores. We'll be settlin' here and now if dis is da Stonemother's hatred brought down on us.
english.progress: We've never been claimin' a great friendship with da  Elemental Lords, but we still be trustin' in a bit of security in da chaos. As long as dey be remainin' unorganized, we've been havin' little to fear.$B$BIf the Stonemother is truly rallyin' da earth against us, we be havin' a great deal more to be fearin'.
english.completion: Dese are in surprisingly good condition - good work, mon.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Norsala west of the Temple of Earth.

text.title: 在平地上
text.objectives: 使用源质绳钩绊倒3名塞拉赞恩的仆从。
text.description: 我们真走运，这些巨人准头不行。但他们总会有走运的一天。$B$B我们得把他们从战场上消灭，但我不认为硬碰硬会是个好主意。$B$B带上这根绳钩，抓牢他们的脚踝，朝后面这么一抽。一旦他们倒下来，就该容易对付得多了。
text.completion: Dat will slow their assault a bit while Norsala be findin' a way to calm'm. We've no desire ta be remainin' enemies of Therazane the Stonemother.
text.completed: Return to Earthcaller Torunscar west of the Temple of Earth.

english.title: On Even Ground
english.objectives: Use the Elementium Grapple Line to pull 3 Servants of Therazane off of their feet.
english.description: We're fortunate dat those giants be havin' such bad aim. Luck is sure to be favorin' dem eventually though.$B$BWe need to get dem off da battlefield, but I don't tink takin' dem head on would be very smart.$B$BTake dis grapplin' line, get a good hold on one of their ankles and pull their legs out from under dem. Once dey are on da ground, dey should be easy ta be finishin' off.
english.completion: Dat will slow their assault a bit while Norsala be findin' a way to calm'm. We've no desire ta be remainin' enemies of Therazane the Stonemother.
english.completed: Return to Earthcaller Torunscar west of the Temple of Earth.

text.title: 堂堂面对
text.objectives: 将大地之环告文念给执行者博登听。
text.description: 你看见东北方远处时隐时现的巨人了吗？他是执行者博登，塞拉赞恩的石领主之一。$B$B我们不是很了解石领主，但博登显然不是他们中头脑冷静的那种。不幸的是，貌似就是他领导的这次进攻，所以我们必须面对他。$B$B拿上这份告文，代表大地之环在他面前高声宣读。我知道想通过文字手段来解决这事有点勉为其难，不过我们总得试试。要当心。
text.completion: Yeah, mon... dat's about the reaction we were expectin'.$B$BHe mentioned Diamant though? If da two don't get along, perhaps this Diamant be a bit less brash den Boden. At least it's somethin'.$B$BLet me see if I can get da earth to tell me where we might be findin' dis Diamant.
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Norsala west of the Temple of Earth.
text.giverWindow: 有时想不被人看低真是很难。

english.title: Imposing Confrontation
english.objectives: Read the Earthen Ring Proclamation to Boden the Imposing.
english.description: Have ya seen the looming giant in the distance to the northeast? Dat is Boden the Imposing, one of Therazane the Stonemother's Stone Lords.$B$BWe be knowin' little of da Stone Lords, but Boden is not known ta be very level-headed. Sadly, he seems to be da one leadin' dis assault, so he's the one we must be confrontin'.$B$BTake dis proclamation to him and read it aloud on behalf of da Earthen Ring. I know it be a bit of a stretch to think words will settle dis, but we have to try. Be cautious.
english.completion: Yeah, mon... dat's about the reaction we were expectin'.$B$BHe mentioned Diamant though? If da two don't get along, perhaps this Diamant be a bit less brash den Boden. At least it's somethin'.$B$BLet me see if I can get da earth to tell me where we might be findin' dis Diamant.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Norsala west of the Temple of Earth.
english.giverWindow: Sometimes it's hard not to be looked down upon.

objectiveDetails.description: 与执行者博登谋取和平

text.title: 卡马恩怎么了？
text.objectives: 去霜鬃巨魔要塞卡马恩·灰握的营地找他。
text.description: 大灾变把霜鬃巨魔要塞地下深处的洞穴撕开了一个口子，让穴居人从他们的窝点里蜂拥而出。他们成功地取代了曾经居住在这里的巨魔，如果我们不付诸行动的话，他们也会把我们赶出去的。$B$B大工匠梅卡托克雇了知名爆破专家卡马恩·灰握来关闭这些洞穴，阻止穴居人的前进。他是不是成功地制止了穴居人，就这一点我们一直没能收到消息。你能不能到霜鬃巨魔要塞附近他的营地去找他？那地方就在剧毒机场的南边。
text.completion: It won't be tough to collapse th' tunnel, but I'm goin' to need my team an' my equipment 'afore I can get to th' task.

english.title: What's Keeping Jessup?
english.objectives: Find Jessup McCree at his camp in Frostmane Hold.
english.description: The cataclysm tore open deep caves beneath Frostmane Hold and troggs flooded out of their warrens. They succeeded in displacing the trolls who used to live there and they stand to drive us out if we do not act.$B$BHigh Tinker Mekkatorque hired the renowned demolitionist, Jessup McCree, to close the caves and stem the trogg advance. We've received no word about whether he was able to stop the troggs. Would you look for him at his camp near Frostmane Hold, to the south beyond the Toxic Airfield?
english.completion: It won't be tough to collapse th' tunnel, but I'm goin' to need my team an' my equipment 'afore I can get to th' task.

text.title: 鞭尾幼龙
text.objectives: 将鞭尾幼龙带给格罗姆高营地的先知摩克萨尔丁。
text.description: 砸碎最后一颗鞭尾龙蛋后，你低头发现一条新生的幼龙正在抬头看你。你能看出它在研究你，记忆你的形象，模仿你的动作。$b$b鞭尾幼龙和你形成了联系。$b$b你本来的任务是要解决迅猛龙，但你破坏的龙蛋已经完成了定额，而这只是一个无辜的新生儿。也许格罗姆高营地有人知道该怎么养一条鞭尾幼龙。
text.completion: Yes, the little one seems to have taken a liking to you.  I suppose that one raptor alone and raised among orcs is much less deadly than a whole pack of them.  Keep her, $n... she may come in handy. In fact...
text.completed: 去找北荆棘谷格罗姆高营地的先知摩克萨尔丁。

english.title: A Lashtail Hatchling
english.objectives: Bring the Lashtail Hatchling to Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'gol Base Camp.
english.description: Upon dealing the final blow to the lashtail eggs, you look down to see a newborn hatchling looking back up at you.  You can see it studying you, learning your features and following your movements.$b$bThe lashtail hatchling has formed a bond with you.$b$bYour original assignment was to thin out the raptors, but you have fulfilled your egg quota, and this one is an innocent newborn.  Perhaps someone back at Grom'gol Base Camp will know what to do with a raptor hatchling.
english.completion: Yes, the little one seems to have taken a liking to you.  I suppose that one raptor alone and raised among orcs is much less deadly than a whole pack of them.  Keep her, $n... she may come in handy. In fact...
english.completed: Report to Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 致命一击
text.objectives: 在霜鬃巨魔要塞洞窟的深处，杀死穴居人头目布鲁戈，启动引爆装置，炸毁穴居人通道。
text.description: 我的部队已经把火药桶和引爆装置安设在霜鬃巨魔要塞西侧的洞穴深处了。你所要做的，就是下去启动引爆装置，点燃火药，炸塌那些通道。$B$B这样就能阻止穴居人从大地深处蜂拥而出。如果你能把他们的首领布鲁戈也干掉的话，梅卡托克对付起剩下的穴居人来也会方便许多。祝你好运，$n。
text.completion: I could feel th' explosion way up here! My boys did a fine job riggin' up that blast, but it wouldn't have happened without your help. It's only fair that I split my contract payment with you for helpin' me finish th' job.
text.completed: Return to Jessup McCree at his camp in Frostmane Hold.

english.title: Finishin' the Job
english.objectives: At the bottom of the cave in Frostmane Hold, kill Boss Bruggor and activate the Detonator to detonate the trogg tunnels.
english.description: My team has finished settin' up th' powder kegs and th' detonator at the bottom o' th' cave in th' western part of Frostmane Hold. All you need to do is venture down there and activate th' detonator to explode the powder and collapse those tunnels.$B$BThat'll stop th' flow of troggs from th' deep parts of th' earth. Mekkatorque'll have an easier time of dealin' with the remainin' troggs if you can take out their leader, who calls 'imself Boss Bruggor. Good luck, $n.
english.completion: I could feel th' explosion way up here! My boys did a fine job riggin' up that blast, but it wouldn't have happened without your help. It's only fair that I split my contract payment with you for helpin' me finish th' job.
english.completed: Return to Jessup McCree at his camp in Frostmane Hold.

text.title: 揭开秘密
text.objectives: 同西部荒野月溪镇的索拉留斯交谈。
text.description: 有个萨满，名叫索拉留斯的，说不定可以帮助我们。他是格里安的朋友，最近刚来西部荒野，为的是研究降临在我们身上的元素浩劫。$B$B同索拉留斯谈谈，看他有没有办法揪出阴暗的人影的身份。
text.completion: Hmm, yes, perhaps I could be of some assistance. When I was in Northrend I helped the people of Valgarde uncover some of the mysteries of the vrykul by delving into the spirit world. Perhaps the same could be done here.

english.title: Secrets Revealed
english.objectives: Speak with Thoralius the Wise at Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.description: There is a shaman here, Thoralius, who might be able to aid us. He is a friend of Gryan's who has recently come to Westfall to study the elemental devastation that has befallen us.$B$BSpeak to Thoralius and see if there is something that he can do to shed some light on the identity of this shadowy figure.
english.completion: Hmm, yes, perhaps I could be of some assistance. When I was in Northrend I helped the people of Valgarde uncover some of the mysteries of the vrykul by delving into the spirit world. Perhaps the same could be done here.

text.title: 过去的影像
text.objectives: 前往迪菲亚盗贼巢穴，跟着无家可归者进入死亡矿井副本，在里面使用焚香炉来看见过去。
text.description: 这束焚香会将你的身心置于一种深度冥想的状态。一旦通灵开始，你就会被拖入灵魂世界。不要抗拒，$n。让灵魂把他们所知道的展示给你。$B$B现在去吧，到死亡矿井去，我听说那里对西部荒野的历史来说意义非凡，在里面使用焚香。$B$B你可以从南边的旧农舍进入死亡矿井。跟着那些无家可归的人。$B$B有发现了就回去告诉格里安。
text.completion: WHAT? VanCleef had a daughter?
text.completed: 回到西部荒野哨兵岭的治安官格里安·斯托曼那里。

english.title: A Vision of the Past
english.objectives: Enter the Defias Hideout and follow the trail of homeless to the Deadmines dungeon. Enter the Deadmines dungeon and use the Incense Burner to see into the past.
english.description: This incense will put your body and mind in a deep meditative state. Once the trance begins you will be pulled into the spirit world. Do not fight the trance once it has begun, $n. Allow the spirits to show you what they know.$B$BYou must leave now. Go to the Deadmines, a place which I am told holds great significance in the history of Westfall. Once inside, use the incense.$B$BYou may enter the Deadmines through the old farmhouse south of here. Follow the homeless. $B$BReturn to Gryan with your discovery.
english.completion: WHAT? VanCleef had a daughter?
english.completed: Return to Marshal Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: 我想她饿了
text.objectives: 在北荆棘谷杀死黑鳃鱼人，让你的鞭尾迅猛龙吃40口。
text.description: 看起来你的小迅猛龙饿了。要是你打算养她的话，为什么不去给她找点吃的呢？鞭尾龙经常袭击北边的黑鳃鱼人营地。$b$b也许她还不够强壮，无法独自捕猎，但我肯定她不介意尝尝刚宰的鱼人肉什么味道。
text.completion: She looks bigger already!  You can see, these raptors grow quickly.  You are lucky to have found such a strong companion. Keep her by your side as long as you can, $n.  I'm sure she will prove to be an asset in the future.
text.completed: Return to Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: I Think She's Hungry
english.objectives: Kill Murkgill murlocs in Northern Stranglethorn, and let your Lashtail Raptor eat 40 bites of their meat.
english.description: It looks like your young raptor is hungry.  If you're looking to keep her, why don't you find something for her to eat?  The lashtail often attack the camp of the Murkgill murlocs, just to our north.$b$bShe probably isn't strong enough to hunt on her own yet, but I'm sure she will eat freshly killed murloc meat.
english.completion: She looks bigger already!  You can see, these raptors grow quickly.  You are lucky to have found such a strong companion. Keep her by your side as long as you can, $n.  I'm sure she will prove to be an asset in the future.
english.completed: Return to Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 兄弟会的崛起
text.objectives: 见证兄弟会的崛起。
text.description: 我根本不知道范克里夫有一个女儿，$n。要说那人有什么特别在行的，那就是保密。$B$B太可悲了。可怜的姑娘$B$B那是什么？你听见了吗？好像豺狼人正在撤退……我的警卫在那儿？$B$B保持警惕，$n！
text.completion: I will deploy a battalion of soldiers to Westfall at once! With the Defias Brotherhood reborn, an old threat to the kingdom is renewed.
text.completed: 向暴风城暴风要塞的杰塔瑞斯将军报告。

english.title: Rise of the Brotherhood
english.objectives: Bear witness to the rise of the Brotherhood.
english.description: I had no idea that VanCleef had a daughter, $n. If there was one thing that man was exceptionally skilled at, it was keeping secrets.$B$BHow tragic. Poor thing witnessed a horrible act. Had I only known.$B$BWhat was that? Did you hear something? It seems as if the gnolls are pulling back... where are my guards?$B$BON GUARD, $n!
english.completion: I will deploy a battalion of soldiers to Westfall at once! With the Defias Brotherhood reborn, an old threat to the kingdom is renewed.
english.completed: Report to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind.

text.title: 心爱的颅骨
text.objectives: 去找格罗姆高营地的尼姆布亚，把鞭尾幼龙的新颅骨给他看。
text.description: 你的迅猛龙宠物好像找到了一件新玩具：从附近巨魔的颅骨堆里弄来的一颗颅骨。$b$b这颗颅骨是怎么跑出来的，你并不清楚，但不知为何，她整天都攥着它。$b$b格罗姆高营地的尼姆布亚显然是这方面的专家，因为他有好大一堆颅骨的藏品。也许他知道这一颗有什么特别之处。
text.completion: What do we have here?  A young raptor, and her pet $r.  Hah! More importantly, what is that skull you have there?  This was no ordinary troll.  He was big... ... and strong, too.  Let's see what we can do with this one. Don't go anywhere.
text.completed: 去找北荆棘谷格罗姆高营地的尼姆布亚。

english.title: Favored Skull
english.objectives: Return to Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp and show him your Lashtail Hatchling's new skull.
english.description: Your pet raptor seems to have found a new toy: a skull, from a nearby troll skull pile.$b$bWhat sets this skull apart from the rest is beyond you, but for some reason, she won't put it down.$b$bNimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp seems to be somewhat of a skull expert, judging by the skull piles he keeps.  Maybe he'll have some idea what makes this one so special.
english.completion: What do we have here?  A young raptor, and her pet $r.  Hah! More importantly, what is that skull you have there?  This was no ordinary troll.  He was big... ... and strong, too.  Let's see what we can do with this one. Don't go anywhere.
english.completed: Return to Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 我的舰队在哪儿？
text.objectives: 同艾萨拉锈水港的督军克罗格交谈。
text.description:
高地是龙喉兽人的家园。要是能让他们见识我们的力量，他们就会跟我们结盟，一起对抗暮光之锤。我很确定！

舰队正在艾萨拉的锈水码头集结，但却传来了工期延误的报告。
你在监督地精工作的事情上表现不错，这次我需要你去发挥专长。
到艾萨拉找到督军克罗格，看看是什么在拖后腿。
text.completion: What, another message from Hellscream? His patience is thinner than calf's hide. Have you ever worked with goblins before? Everywhere is another hidden cost! Our ships lie half-assembled and the air fleet is scattered to the winds. If this invasion is going to happen, I'm going to need your help.
text.completed: 同艾萨拉锈水港的督军克罗格交谈。

english.title: Where Is My Warfleet?
english.objectives: Speak with Warlord Krogg at Bilgewater Port in Azshara.
english.description: We have a map of the Highland approaches. The plan is clear: we will show ourselves in force. The Dragonmaw orcs, on seeing the might of our combined forces on their shore, will have no choice but to ally with us in our crusade to destroy the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BThe fleet is assembling at Bilgewater Port in Azshara. I grow impatient with their progress.$B$B$C! You have a knack for greasing the wheels of my war machine. Seek out Warlord Krogg in Azshara and find out what's taking so long.
english.completion: What, another message from Hellscream? His patience is thinner than calf's hide. Have you ever worked with goblins before? Everywhere is another hidden cost! Our ships lie half-assembled and the air fleet is scattered to the winds. If this invasion is going to happen, I'm going to need your help.
english.completed: Speak with Warlord Krogg at Bilgewater Port in Azshara.

text.title: 鼻子就是干这个的
text.objectives: 让鞭尾幼龙嗅出8尊祖丹亚神像的所在。
text.description: <颅骨对你开口了。>$b$b我活了？不，我没有……但我可以。$b$b你的那头迅猛龙聪慧异常，从众多颅骨中就挑对了我这一颗。生前，我强大有力，是巨魔的领主。只要你帮忙，我就能再度成为主宰。$b$b祖丹亚的血顶巨魔保存着能够让我复原的魔法神像，他们把这些神器埋在沙子里。让你的幼龙把它们找出来，$n……然后把它们扔到大锅里来。
text.progress: How many did you find?
text.completion: Yes... yesss... My spirit is strong again, $r, and I am ready to return to the world.  Now I need a body.
text.completed: Return to the Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: A Nose for This Sort of Thing
english.objectives: Use your Lashtail Hatchling to sniff out 8 Zuuldaian Fetishes.
english.description: <The skull speaks to you.>$b$bI live?  No, I do not... but I can.$b$bThat raptor you have is wise to have found my skull among what must have been so many.  In life, I was strong, powerful, a lord among trolls.  With your help, I can be a lord once more.$b$bThe Bloodscalps at Zuuldaia hoard magical fetishes that can help me return.  They hide these artifacts under the sand.  Use your hatchling to find these artifacts, $n... then throw them in the pot.
english.progress: How many did you find?
english.completion: Yes... yesss... My spirit is strong again, $r, and I am ready to return to the world.  Now I need a body.
english.completed: Return to the Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 我们脚下的这片大地
text.objectives: 去崎石废土大地神殿的西北角找到唤地者托伦斯卡。
text.description: 只剩下一片世界之柱的碎片了，它就在石母本人的手里。更糟的是，神殿正遭元素和巨人的围攻。他们听命于她自然也不难想象。$B$B去西北的战场上会会那些元素，同托伦斯卡和诺莎拉想想办法，看能不能和他们的头领沟通，找到世界之柱。我们希望事情能和平解决，无论如何都要解决这场纷争。
text.completion: Hey, mon! Thank ya for comin'.$B$BWe weren't ready for dis kind of attack. We been expectin' da Twilight Cult, but not elementals... we've got no idea what upset dem so much that dey would turn on us like dis.$B$BYou haven't been out dere killin' them, have you?

english.title: The Very Earth Beneath Our Feet
english.objectives: Find Earthcaller Torunscar just northwest of the Temple of Earth, in the Jagged Wastes.
english.description: Only one piece of the World Pillar remains, and it is in the hands of the Stonemother herself. Worse, the temple has come under siege by elementals and giants. It's not a terrible leap of logic to assume they're acting by her will.$B$BGo out and meet the elementals in battle to the northwest. Work with Torunscar and Norsala to find a way to communicate with their leaders and seek out the World Pillar. We would prefer such be done peacefully, but we will do whatever we must to seal the rift.
english.completion: Hey, mon! Thank ya for comin'.$B$BWe weren't ready for dis kind of attack. We been expectin' da Twilight Cult, but not elementals... we've got no idea what upset dem so much that dey would turn on us like dis.$B$BYou haven't been out dere killin' them, have you?

text.title: 英雄安威玛尔
text.objectives: 同萨尔加斯·安威玛尔交谈。
text.description: 你就别把时间浪费在我这种人身上啦，$g小子:姑娘;。萨尔加斯·安威玛尔本人就在车队的另一头。$B$B想必你肯定听说过他吧？他曾和暴风城国王并肩作战保卫萨多尔大桥！他是铁炉堡最了不起的英雄之一。$B$B但现在，他身处险境！去帮他，让他知道你准备好了。不过要注意保持距离，他打起来可不长眼。
text.completion: Well met! If you've got a weapon on you, I'll take any help I can get clearing out these crazed fools!

english.title: Anvilmar the Hero
english.objectives: Talk to Thargas Anvilmar.
english.description: You don't want to waste your time talking to me right now, $glad:lass;. Thargas Anvilmar himself is just on the other side of these wagons.$B$BSurely you've heard of him? He fought to defend the Thandol Span from the Dark Iron alongside the King of Stormwind! He's one of the finest heroes of Ironforge.$B$BRight now though, he's in the thick of it! Go out there and let him know you're ready to help. Just keep a good distance, he swings wide.
english.completion: Well met! If you've got a weapon on you, I'll take any help I can get clearing out these crazed fools!

text.title: 磐石关系
text.objectives: 去找崎石废土的东南的耐心者岱亚曼塔。
text.description: <诺莎拉触摸地面想探究岱亚曼塔的位置所在，但不久却惊讶地跳了起来。>$B$B天呐！真没想到。岱亚曼塔根本就不远。当我寻找他时，他立刻回答，并且告诉了我去哪儿能找到他。朝崎石废土的东北角走——岱亚曼塔应该在那里等着你。$B$B$n，当心点。大地的造物虽说不大像是会设埋伏，可一开始这样围攻神殿也不是它们通常作为。
text.completion: Ah... you must be the $r that I was expecting.$B$BYou have come on behalf of the Earthen Ring then?

english.title: Rocky Relations
english.objectives: Find Diamant the Patient at the northeast edge of the Jagged Wastes.
english.description: <Norsala reaches to the ground in an attempt to discern Diamant's location, but jumps back in shock after a moment's contact.>$B$BMy! Dat was unexpected. Diamant ain't far at all. When I reached out ta him, he spoke back wit me and told me where we could be finin' him. Head towards tha northeastern edge of the Jagged Wastes - Diamant will be expectin' ya.$B$B$n, be careful. It may be unlike an earth bein' to lay an ambush, but it was unlike dem to siege the temple in da first place.
english.completion: Ah... you must be the $r that I was expecting.$B$BYou have come on behalf of the Earthen Ring then?

text.title: 还有一件事
text.objectives: 把卡马恩的报告书交给新工匠镇的大工匠梅卡托克。
text.description: 好的，现在是时候收拾收拾，接着干下一件工作了。总有别的东西等着要炸。某个地方，有座山要移走，或是需要弄一个峡谷出来。$B$B我想要不你再帮我一个忙？你能不能把这份报告交给新工匠镇的大工匠梅卡托克？最好让他知道，穴居人永远都不再会打扰他的人了。
text.progress: 欢迎回来，$N。
text.completion: Splendid news! With the troggs taken care of, we should be able to turn our attention to Crushcog's troublemaking.
text.completed: Bring Jessup's Report to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

english.title: One More Thing
english.objectives: Bring Jessup's Report to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.
english.description: Well, it's time to start packin' up and movin' on to the next job. There's always somethin' else to blow up out there. Somewhere, there's a mountain needs movin' or a gorge that needs carvin', and I'll be there to do it.$B$BI don't suppose you'd do me one more favor? Would you take this report back to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown? He needs to know that th' troggs won't be botherin' his people again anytime soon.
english.progress: Welcome back, $n.
english.completion: Splendid news! With the troggs taken care of, we should be able to turn our attention to Crushcog's troublemaking.
english.completed: Bring Jessup's Report to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 谁是大个子巨魔？
text.objectives: 到祖昆达获得甘祖拉恩的躯体。
text.description: <颅骨再度开口。>$b$b我的灵魂准备好了，但是我的身体还没有。血顶巨魔很久以前就把我的旧身毁坏了。他们在我身上施加的恐惧……我的灵魂看着他们把我的身体撕裂，然后，然后……我说不下去了。$b$b他们的酋长，甘祖拉恩，主持了这场可怕的暴行。事实上，要是我没记错的话，他也是个强大有力的巨魔……差不多和我一般大小。多妙的巧合啊。$b$b你知道该怎么做了，$r。动作快点。
text.progress: Gan'zulah...
text.completion: You have done well, $r.  Only one more step remains before I may return.
text.completed: Return to the Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 他是一个大巨魔。

english.title: Who's a Big Troll?
english.objectives: Obtain Gan'zulah's Body from Zul'Kunda.
english.description: <The skull speaks once more.>$b$bMy soul is ready, but my body is not.  The Bloodscalps desecrated my old body long ago.  The horrors that they inflicted upon me... my spirit watched on while they tore my body apart and, and... I can't go on.$b$bTheir chief, Gan'zulah, presided over the gruesome acts.  In fact, if memory serves, he was a strong, powerful troll... about the same size as I was.  What a fine coincidence.$b$bYou know what to do, $r.  Make it quick.
english.progress: Gan'zulah...
english.completion: You have done well, $r.  Only one more step remains before I may return.
english.completed: Return to the Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: HE'S a big troll.

text.title: 碎轮的爪牙
text.objectives: 在碎轮的军械库杀死8名碎轮的爪牙。你可以杀死被辐射的技师或碎轮机动战士。
text.description: 我们的宿敌瑟玛普拉格一直在尽全力阻挠我们完成对诺莫瑞根的重建和改造。他已经派最忠诚的狗腿子拉齐诺·碎轮，带着一支被辐射的侏儒大军来侵扰我们。$B$B他们在路北边占据了一所旧军械库，碎轮的技师正在修理那些武器。我们必须赶在他们让步行坦克重新启动之前阻止他们。到碎轮的军械库去，尽你所能把那些技师消灭掉。
text.completion: That should set back Crushcog's plans a bit, but we can't rest until he is defeated and Chill Breeze Valley is secure.
text.completed: Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

english.title: Crushcog's Minions
english.objectives: Kill 8 of Crushcog's Minions at Crushcog's Arsenal. You may kill Irradiated Technicians or Crushcog's Battle Suits.
english.description: Our old enemy, Thermaplugg, is doing his best to keep us from rebuilding and finishing our reclamation of Gnomeregan. He's sent one of his most loyal henchmen, Razlo Crushcog, and a force of irradiated gnomes to harry us.$B$BThey've taken over an old arsenal up the road to the north, and Crushcog's technicians are repairing those weapons. We have to stop them before they're able to get those mechano-tanks back online. Go to Crushcog's Arsenal and eliminate as many of the technicians as you can.
english.completion: That should set back Crushcog's plans a bit, but we can't rest until he is defeated and Chill Breeze Valley is secure.
english.completed: Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 劈颅巨魔的魔精
text.objectives: 从赞塔加废墟和巴里亚曼废墟里的劈颅巨魔那里获得6份劈颅巨魔的魔精。
text.description: <颅骨又开口了。>$b$b我有身体了，谢谢你，谢谢你的迅猛龙，还有甘祖拉恩。现在，假如我没记错的话，你和你的巫医朋友还需要魔精才能完成这仪式。$b$b血顶的魔精藏在祖昆达，但它太弱了。你们暗矛的魔精也用不上。不……你要拿的，是东边河对岸劈颅巨魔的魔精。$b$b快去快回，$r。我在这儿看着……
text.progress: <The large troll skull floats around within the cauldron.>
text.completion: Excellent work, $r.  You and your raptor have done a great thing.  Hakkar would be most pleased...
text.completed: Return to the Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Skullsplitter Mojo
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Skullsplitter Mojos from Skullsplitter trolls in the Ziata'jai Ruins and the Balia'mah Ruins.
english.description: <The skull speaks again.>$b$bI have my body, thanks to you, your raptor, and Gan'zulah.  Now, if I remember correctly, you and your witch doctor friend will need some mojo to complete this ritual.$b$bThe Bloodscalps keep mojo in Zul'Kunda, but it is weak.
