english.completion: You found the ring! Thank you, $n. Please take this as payment, and know that your deeds today will remain forever in my memory.
english.completed: Return to Talen at the Blackfathom Camp in Ashenvale.
english.giverWindow: She has the Ring of Zoram!

text.title: 身陷危险的树妖！
text.objectives: 去找灰谷萨维亚的安妮莉亚。
text.description: 听着，我不知道你是谁，但我需要你的帮助。我的姐妹们去从萨特那里取回塞纳留斯的树枝，她们说会很快回来，可是已经过去整整两天了！$B$B$n，你得赶快去找到我的姐妹们！她们到去西北边的萨维亚去寻找一个暗夜精灵的废墟了。我的脑海里是一片空白，不知道该干什么了……去找到安妮莉亚吧，她是这次搜寻行动的首领。
text.completion: 安妮莉亚身上伤痕累累，看来快要死了。$B$B

english.title: Vile Satyr! Dryads in Danger!
english.objectives: Find Anilia at Xavian in Ashenvale.
english.description: Listen, I don't know who you are, but I need your help. My sisters went to take back the Branch of Cenarius from the satyr. They said they'd be back soon, but it's been two whole days!$B$B$n, you have to find them! They were looking for the ruins of a night elf temple in Xavian to the northwest. I don't know what to think. Look for Anilia, she was leading them on the search.
english.completion: Judging by the gaping wound in her side, Anilia is on the verge of death.

text.title: 塞纳留斯的树枝
text.objectives: 获得塞纳留斯的树枝。
text.description: 安妮莉亚把手放在你的肩头上，慢慢地把你拉近她的身边。她艰难地喘着气，抬手指向北方的拱门。在她的气息渐渐变得微弱，眼睛慢慢地闭上之前，安妮莉亚留下了最后一句话：“被他夺走了……加萨里斯……”她临终时还在想着要让塞纳留斯的树枝回到树妖的手中。
text.progress: 你找到她们了吗?安妮莉亚有没有说什麽?她现在在哪儿?
text.completion: 安妮莉亚死了?不……那是不可能的!就在前几天，我们还在林中奔跑嬉戏。$B$B我想那些日子不会再有了……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Illiyana at Forest Song in Ashenvale.
text.giverWindow: 从他身上拿到塞纳留斯的树枝！

english.title: The Branch of Cenarius
english.objectives: Obtain the Branch of Cenarius.
english.description: Anilia puts her hands on your shoulders and draws you close. Gasping, she points towards the arch to the north, before her eyes close and her last wheezing breath leaves her body. "He has taken it... Geltharis..." You know in your heart that Anilia's dying wish is to see the Branch of Cenarius back in dryad hands.
english.progress: Have you found them? What did Anilia say? Where is she?
english.completion: Anilia died? No... that can't be! It was just yesterday that we were running and playing together in the woods. I guess those days are over...
english.completed: Return to Illiyana at Forest Song in Ashenvale.
english.giverWindow: Get the Branch of Cenarius from him!

text.title: 杀掉萨特！
text.objectives: 获得16个萨特的角。
text.description: 我无法相信安妮莉亚去了……我们曾经总是一起在森林里玩耍。我觉得好……伤心。$B$B我知道怎么能让我感觉好起来。拜托你，杀掉那些从我身边夺走安妮莉亚的萨特！把他们的角当做证据带来，我将永远感激你。
text.progress: 请帮我为安妮莉亚复仇!
text.completion: 谢谢你，亲爱的$R。你所做的这些应该会让她的灵魂感到欣慰的。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Illiyana at Forest Song in Ashenvale.

english.title: Satyr Slaying!
english.objectives: Obtain 16 Satyr Horns.
english.description: I can't believe that Anilia is gone... We used to play together in the forests all the time. I almost feel... sad.$B$BI know something that might make me feel better. Please, slay the satyrs that took Anilia from me! Bring me their horns as proof of your actions and you will forever have my gratitude.
english.progress: Please, help me avenge Anilia's death.
english.completion: Thank you, kind $r. My sister's spirit is gladdened by your efforts.
english.completed: Return to Illiyana at Forest Song in Ashenvale.

text.title: 收复密斯特拉湖
text.objectives: 消灭12个污浊的水元素以及泰德雷斯。
text.description: 要不是部落控制了我们部署在密斯特拉湖的水元素防御者，我们本可以轻松守住银风避难所。$B$B他们的一个萨满祭司把泰德雷斯召唤了出来，那是森林里一只古老而愤怒的水灵，它把我们的元素污染后，让它们反过来对付我们。湖水中倒戈的元素生物和部落一同发动攻势，我们不得已只好撤到高塔这里。$B$B到东边去把密斯特拉湖夺回来，这样有朝一日我们才能收复避难所。
text.completion: Well done, $n! With the befouled elemental numbers thinned and Tideress put back into the lake, we should be able to launch a counter-offensive on Silverwind Refuge. Just as soon as we're done with defending the spire....
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Velene Starstrike at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale.

english.title: Retaking Mystral Lake
english.objectives: Slay 12 Befouled Water Elementals and Tideress.
english.description: We could easily have held Silverwind Refuge from the Horde had they not taken control of our water elemental defenders on Mystral Lake.$B$BOne of their shaman summoned in Tideress, an old and angry water spirit of the forest who befouled our elementals and turned them against us. With the lake and the Horde pressing in on us, we had no choice but to retreat to the spire here.$B$BGo east. Take the lake back so that we will have a chance to retake the refuge some day.
english.completion: Well done, $n! With the befouled elemental numbers thinned and Tideress put back into the lake, we should be able to launch a counter-offensive on Silverwind Refuge. Just as soon as we're done with defending the spire....
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Velene Starstrike at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale.

text.title: 深渊中的知识
text.objectives: 把洛迦里斯手稿带给铁炉堡的葛利·硬骨。
text.description: 你也许知道，我喜欢收集各种知识：古老的知识，有用的知识，可以打开神秘通路的知识，可以唤醒沉睡之人的知识。$B$B据说有本古老的书卷叫做洛迦里斯手稿，它被藏在黑海岸的黑暗深渊底部。那里是往日死去的精灵安息的地方。那些精灵在他们的城市被毁灭之前都有着广博的知识。$B$B到黑暗深渊去找手稿吧，我不会忘记你为我做的事，即使到世界毁灭的那一天……

english.title: Knowledge in the Deeps
english.objectives: Bring the Lorgalis Manuscript to Sentinel-trainee Issara at the Blackfathom Camp.
english.description: It is my duty to collect lore. Old lore. Powerful lore. Lore that opens doorways, and lore that could awaken more of Those Who Sleep if it is mishandled.$B$BThere are rumors of an old piece of lore, the Lorgalis Manuscript, at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps in to the west. That place is the old dwelling of our long-dead ancestors. They held great knowledge before their city fell to ruin.$B$BSearch Blackfathom Deeps for the manuscript. Do this, and I will not forget it. Not even in these end days.

text.title: 疯狂的德鲁伊
text.objectives: 杀掉疯狂的德鲁伊：坦尼尔·黑木、尤希尔·唤月和玛沃里斯·裂云。
text.description: 德鲁伊都死了，是被他们的首领所杀——部落污染了森林之心，让他们陷入疯狂，他们才会干出这等事情来！我甚至在这里都能感受到腐化的气息，不能再继续前进了。$B$B我受制于灰谷和森林之心，但你……你可以进入兽穴，完成必须要做的事情。我已经在里面为你标记好了道路。$B$B虽然于心不忍，但我还是要你把那三名曾经是伟大领袖的德鲁伊杀死，他们是坦尼尔·黑木、尤希尔·唤月和玛沃里斯·裂云。
text.completion: Rest in peace, my friends. I felt the anguish of the Dor'danil Barrows lessen, and knew that you had completed your task. It was grim work that you did, $n, for the spirits you destroyed were merely victims of the Horde's evil. But with their destruction, let us hope the maddened spirits will finally find peace.
text.completed: Return to Gaivan Shadewalker, pacing outside the entrance to the Dor'Danil Barrow Den in Ashenvale.

english.title: Insane Druids
english.objectives: Slay the insane druids: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, and Mavoris Cloudsbreak.
english.description: The druids are dead, killed by their leaders who were driven insane by the Horde tainting the Forest Heart! I can feel the corruption even from here and I dare go no further.$B$BWhile I am too well attuned to Ashenvale and the Forest Heart, you... you could descend into the barrow den and do what must be done. I've laid down breadcrumbs for you in there.$B$BThough it tears me apart, I must ask that you put to rest the druids' once great leaders: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, and Mavoris Cloudsbreak.
english.completion: Rest in peace, my friends. I felt the anguish of the Dor'danil Barrows lessen, and knew that you had completed your task. It was grim work that you did, $n, for the spirits you destroyed were merely victims of the Horde's evil. But with their destruction, let us hope the maddened spirits will finally find peace.
english.completed: Return to Gaivan Shadewalker, pacing outside the entrance to the Dor'Danil Barrow Den in Ashenvale.

text.title: 巴斯兰的头发
text.objectives: 收集8束巴斯兰的头发。
text.description: 穿过大路往东，有一种植物长在巴斯兰鬼屋的古老废墟中。那种植物叫做巴斯兰的头发，以治愈灵魂疾病的疗效著称。$B$B现在部落为了他们的邪恶目的，正在那里收集这种植物。$B$B阿斯特兰纳有一个孩子病了，我们相信她的病痛不仅仅是身体上的。我向主人保证会找到治疗的方法，但我不是一个战士。$B$B你能不能去巴斯兰鬼屋收集一些植物来？
text.progress: Have you gathered the Bathran's Hair, $n?  The child's health grows weaker by the hour....
text.completion: Ah, you have the hair! This is a good first step. There are other ingredients that we will need, but the hair of the fallen Ancient could well be the most important. I only hope that whatever the Forsaken are devising from the plant will not be turned into a weapon. We simply do not have the numbers to remove them right now, especially with Maestra's Post under attack!
text.completed: Return to Evenar Stillwhisper at Orendil's Retreat in Ashenvale.

english.title: Bathran's Hair
english.objectives: Collect 8 Bathran's Hair.
english.description: There is a plant that grows in the old ruins of Bathran's Haunt across the road to the east. The plant is called Bathran's Hair and is known to cure ailments of the spirit.$B$BNow the Horde are there harvesting the plant for their own evil schemes.$B$BThere is a sick child in Astranaar, and we believe that her illness is more than just physical. I promised my master that I would help seek a cure, but I am no fighter.$B$BWill you go to Bathran's Haunt and gather the plants?
english.progress: Have you gathered the Bathran's Hair, $n?  The child's health grows weaker by the hour....
english.completion: Ah, you have the hair! This is a good first step. There are other ingredients that we will need, but the hair of the fallen Ancient could well be the most important. I only hope that whatever the Forsaken are devising from the plant will not be turned into a weapon. We simply do not have the numbers to remove them right now, especially with Maestra's Post under attack!
english.completed: Return to Evenar Stillwhisper at Orendil's Retreat in Ashenvale.

text.title: 奥雷迪尔的药剂
text.objectives: 将奥雷迪尔的药剂交给灰谷阿斯特拉纳的皮尔图拉斯·怀特姆恩。
text.description: $n，这药剂经过了艾露恩祝福之光的沐浴，我相信它足以救助那生病的孩子。请把它带到阿斯特兰纳，交给孩子的家长皮尔图拉斯·怀特姆恩。$B$B要前往阿斯特兰纳，你得沿着路往南，然后朝东走。不过如果你想快些到的话，可以跟哨兵阿瓦娜谈一谈。
text.progress: 很抱歉，我实在没有时间再和你聊天了。我的孩子蕾拉就快要病死了!
text.completion: This is from Orendil? His skill with herbs and healing is great! This cure gives me hope, when before I had little....

english.title: Orendil's Cure
english.objectives: Bring Orendil's Cure to Pelturas Whitemoon at Astranaar in Ashenvale.
english.description: $n, now that it has been bathed in Elune's blessed light, I believe that the concoction will help the afflicted child. Please, take it to Astranaar and give it to the child's parent, Pelturas Whitemoon.$B$BTo reach Astranaar, follow the road south and then east. However, if you'd like to get there more swiftly, speak with Sentinel Avana.
english.progress: I must apologize, for I have no time to speak. My child, Relara, is deathly ill!
english.completion: This is from Orendil? His skill with herbs and healing is great! This cure gives me hope, when before I had little....

text.title: 月神之泪
text.objectives: 拿到月神之泪。
text.description: 我也希望奥雷迪尔的药剂能治愈蕾拉，但恐怕它只能起到阻止疾病在她体内扩散的作用。我们必须找到更有效的解药！幸好，奥雷迪尔跟我说过，万一他的药剂失败，还有其他的方子。$B$B月神之泪是一种只能在伊瑞斯湖找到的石头，那地方就位于阿斯特兰纳的东北方，在雷鸣峰爆发的时候被毁掉了。奥雷德尔说那种石头可以清洗掉腐蚀的力量。$B$B求求你，$n，帮我把月神之泪带来，愿它能治好我孩子的病！
text.progress: $n, did you find the remains of the lake?  Do you have the Tear?
text.completion: Oh, you found it! Odd... it looks tarnished somehow. I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her. Thank you! Thank you, $n!
text.completed: Return to Pelturas Whitemoon at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

english.title: Elune's Tear
english.objectives: Collect Elune's Tear.
english.description: I'd hoped Orendil's cure would save Relara, but I fear it only slowed the disease running through her. We must find more powerful medicine! Thankfully, Orendil spoke to me of further remedies should his first one fail.$B$BElune's Tear is a type of stone that rests in only one place: the remains of Iris Lake, destroyed by the eruption of Thunder Peak, northeast of Astranaar. Orendil said the stone will wash away corruption.$B$BPlease, $n, bring me Elune's Tear and pray it will end my child's sickness!
english.progress: $n, did you find the remains of the lake?  Do you have the Tear?
english.completion: Oh, you found it! Odd... it looks tarnished somehow. I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her. Thank you! Thank you, $n!
english.completed: Return to Pelturas Whitemoon at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

text.title: 给树妖的货物
text.objectives: 将发光的宝石交给灰谷阿林中树塔的莎尔蒂恩。
text.description: 啊，你来了，$n。我已经悉心研读了泰洛尼斯的日志，看起来你的下一个行动目标，就是找到达图尔魔棒的其它部分。$B$B要我说的话，就先沿着路往东走，到林中树塔去。$B$B那里有一个名叫莎尔蒂恩的树妖，她可以更好地引导你。去找她吧。$B$B把这宝石带上——要想重制魔棒的话，莎尔蒂恩就用得着它。
text.progress: 嗨，你好吗?
text.completion: 哦，莱恩派你来的?问题一定很严重吧。我能帮你些什麽呢?$B$B

english.title: Dryad Delivery
english.objectives: Deliver the Glowing Gem to Shael'dryn at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale.
english.description: Ah, there you are, $n. I've pored over the notes Teronis has made and it sounds like your next course of action is to find the other pieces of Dartol's rod.$B$BI would start by heading east along the road to Raynewood Tower.$B$BA dryad there named Shael'dryn is better suited to guide you. Seek her out.$B$BKeep the gem with you--Shael'dryn will need it if she's to help you recreate the rod.
english.progress: Hello. How are you?
english.completion: Oh, Raene sent you? It must be serious indeed. What can I help you with?

text.title: 找树干
text.objectives: 找到木制钥匙，用它来获得达图尔魔棒的铁杆部分。
text.description: 你的消息稍有点滞后。$B$B莱恩是对的，我熟知达图尔的造物，还有这片区域里的树人——至少曾经是。但是他们现在堕落了，天性遭到了扭曲。$B$B你要拿到木制钥匙，打开箱子，才能找到魔棒的下一部分。$B$B东北方靠近费伍德森林边界的狼嚎谷里有一些树人，木制钥匙就在其中一名树人的身上。你拿到它以后，穿过谷里的通道去找一小块林地，箱子应该就藏在那儿附近。
text.progress: 树人的堕落让我感到十分不安，真希望我能为他们做些什麽。
text.completion: 很高兴见到你回来，$N。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Shael'dryn at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale.

english.title: Search the Bole
english.objectives: Find the Wooden Key and use it to obtain the Iron Shaft portion of Dartol's Rod.
english.description: I wish your tidings were better.$B$BRaene is correct, I know about Dartol's creation and the treants in the area--at least I did once. They've become corrupted now, their nature twisted.$B$BTo find the next piece of the rod, you'll have to find the key to open the chest it's in.$B$BThe wooden key is on one of the treants northeast of here near the Felwood border, at the Howling Vale. Once you have it, look for a small glade through the tunnel at the vale. The chest should be hidden around there.
english.progress: It upsets me so that the treants have become corrupt. I wish I could do more to help them.
english.completion: I'm pleased to see you're back, $n.
english.completed: Return to Shael'dryn at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale.

text.title: 装死
text.objectives: 获得达图尔魔棒的最后一部分，铁质柄头。
text.description: 魔棒的最后一部分在利爪德鲁伊手里。我曾要他们的首领奥索·棘痕把它给我，但他和他的守护者们差点把我给杀了！部落腐化了森林之心，显然他们也受到了影响。$B$B不过我有办法，可以让你到奥索的洞里将柄头拿到手。$B$B当我还是一只小鹿的时候，我就特别擅长装死。对熊来说这招极其管用！我可以教你！到东边的林荫小径去，要是他们打算抓你，就用我教你的招数来应付。
text.progress: Did you find the final piece of the rod, $n? How did my technique work?
text.completion: You got it? Wonderful for you... and for Raene! I guess we'll have to see about reassembling it, won't we?
text.completed: Return to Shael'dryn at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale.

english.title: Playing Possum
english.objectives: Obtain the final piece of Dartol's Rod, the Iron Pommel.
english.description: The last piece of the rod is held by druids of the claw. I asked their leader, Oso Bramblescar, to give it to me, but he and his guardians nearly killed me! Clearly they too were affected by the Horde's corruption of the Forest Heart.$B$BBut, I have an idea for how you can get into Oso's cave and grab the pommel.$B$BEver since I was a faun, I've been pretty good at playing possum. It works great against bears! I can teach you! Go east to the Shady Nook, and if they try to get you, just use my technique.
english.progress: Did you find the final piece of the rod, $n? How did my technique work?
english.completion: You got it? Wonderful for you... and for Raene! I guess we'll have to see about reassembling it, won't we?
english.completed: Return to Shael'dryn at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale.

text.title: 去找莱恩
text.objectives: 将达图尔魔棒交给灰谷阿斯特兰纳的莱恩·狼行者。
text.description: 我建议你去找莱恩，告诉她魔棒完成了。我相信她知道你的下一步该怎么走。$B$B要当心，我在这根魔棒上同时感应到了善与恶的强大力量。但愿你和莱恩知道你们在干什么。祝你好运，$n。
text.progress: Yes, $n? How go your efforts?
text.completion: You've recreated the rod Teronis had set out to find? That's wonderful to hear. Shael'dryn has been indispensible in her assistance. Teronis would be proud to see his quest is continuing even after his tragic passing. Now it is time for us to make use of its power to eliminate the enemies of Ashenvale!

english.title: Return to Raene
english.objectives: Deliver Dartol's Rod to Raene Wolfrunner at Astranaar in Ashenvale.
english.description: I suggest you find Raene and let her know the rod is finished. I'm sure she'll know what your next course should be.$B$BBe careful... I sense a great deal of power within it for both good and ill. I hope that you and Raene know what you are doing.$B$BGood luck, $n.
english.progress: Yes, $n? How go your efforts?
english.completion: You've recreated the rod Teronis had set out to find? That's wonderful to hear. Shael'dryn has been indispensible in her assistance. Teronis would be proud to see his quest is continuing even after his tragic passing. Now it is time for us to make use of its power to eliminate the enemies of Ashenvale!

text.title: 达图尔魔棒
text.objectives: 使用达图尔魔棒同灰谷克罗尔格的小屋的克罗尔格沟通。
text.description: 我不完全肯定泰洛尼斯接下来想怎么做，但假如他对魔棒的力量所言不虚，那你就应该能够变成另外一种形态，很可能是熊怪的样子。$B$B也许他想借此来接近他们，但若是不小心，即便是没有堕落的熊怪也会把他杀掉的。被魔棒变形后，达图尔就可以跟一个未堕落的熊怪交谈。$B$B要是我的话，就会先去找那个叫做克罗尔格的熊怪。他就在密斯特拉湖东南的小屋里。
text.completion: Yes, yes... you appear as one of my kind, but I care not what you truly are if you can help the furbolg. The night elves and now the orcs have visited many atrocities upon my people. Corruption runs through our veins, corruption brought down upon us by the prideful night elves and the warlike orcs. They are the ones who did this to our people... They are the ones I blame for being cast out of my tribe. At night I can still see the campfires burning in the darkness.

english.title: Dartol's Rod
english.objectives: Use Dartol's Rod to be able to communicate with Krolg at Krolg's Hut in Ashenvale.
english.description: I'm not completely certain what Teronis had in mind next, but if what he said was true about the rod's power, then it will allow you to take on another form altogether, presumably that of a furbolg.$B$BPerhaps he meant to use its powers to get closer to them, but even the uncorrupted creatures would slaughter him were he not careful. Transformed by the rod, Dartol would have to speak to a furbolg who was uncorrupted.$B$BI would start with one known as Krolg. Seek his hut southeast of Mystral Lake.
english.completion: Yes, yes... you appear as one of my kind, but I care not what you truly are if you can help the furbolg. The night elves and now the orcs have visited many atrocities upon my people. Corruption runs through our veins, corruption brought down upon us by the prideful night elves and the warlike orcs. They are the ones who did this to our people... They are the ones I blame for being cast out of my tribe. At night I can still see the campfires burning in the darkness.

text.title: 新装饰
text.objectives: 获得兰恩·血牙的徽记和达图尔魔棒。
text.description: 我相信早已死去的法师达图尔原本是打算用他的魔棒征服并毁灭我们，就像暗夜精灵和兽人所做的一样。但现在我认为，我们可以将这东西另作他用。$B$B兰恩·血牙是灰谷所有熊怪的王，他的血牙部族是最为强大的一支熊怪部族，在东边的营地里与世隔绝。$B$B把他们都杀掉，将他的徽记带来，看看我们是不是能充分地利用一下。
text.progress: Have you slain Ran yet, my friend? We must have his skull if you're to deliver my people from bondage.
text.completion: You have done well, my friend. Now quickly, hand me Ran's skull. While his essence yet taints it, we shall fashion it upon Dartol's Rod giving you the power to influence my brethren and deliver them from evil!
text.completed: Return to Krolg at Krolg's Hut in Ashenvale.
text.giverWindow: 获得兰恩·血牙的徽记。

english.title: A New Adornment
english.objectives: Obtain Ran Bloodtooth's Skull and Dartol's Rod.
english.description: I'm certain that the long-dead wizard, Dartol, intended to use his rod to subjugate and destroy us just as the night elves and orcs have, but I think now we'll put that thing to an unintended use.$B$BRan Bloodtooth is the king of all of the Ashenvale furbolg. His tribe, the Bloodtooth, are the most powerful and keep themselves secluded in a camp just to the east.$B$BKill them all and bring back his skull. Let us see if we can put it to good use.
english.progress: Have you slain Ran yet, my friend? We must have his skull if you're to deliver my people from bondage.
english.completion: You have done well, my friend. Now quickly, hand me Ran's skull. While his essence yet taints it, we shall fashion it upon Dartol's Rod giving you the power to influence my brethren and deliver them from evil!
english.completed: Return to Krolg at Krolg's Hut in Ashenvale.
english.giverWindow: Get Ran's skull.

text.title: 魔棒的真正力量
text.objectives: 使用达图尔魔棒跟奥塔·旺交谈。说服他起义对抗部落。然后将达图尔魔棒交给莱恩·狼行者。
text.description: 现在，带上魔棒，借助它的力量，跟我的兄弟奥塔·旺交谈。$B$B奥塔就在被兽人抓住的熊怪当中，他们被关在银风避难所北边的巨大牢笼里。魔棒可以让你说服奥塔和其他熊怪揭竿而起，攻打部落。$B$B然后你就可以继续你的旅程了。你知道，你所做的这一切，让你有了一个新朋友。
text.progress: You return, $n. What's that affixed to the top of the rod? A skull?
text.completion: So, you used the skull of the furbolg king to modify the power of Dartol's Rod? You then used that power to convince the captured furbolg to rise up and attack the Horde at Silverwind Refuge? I am more than pleased and impressed with your abilities, $n. The Sentinels cannot thank you enough. It should be a simple matter for us to sweep away the orcs and retake the refuge now! Teronis would be proud. You have my deepest respect.
text.completed: Deliver Dartol's Rod to Raene Wolfrunner at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

english.title: True Power of the Rod
english.objectives: Use Dartol's Rod and speak with Ota Wen. Convince him to rise up against his Horde oppressors. Then, deliver Dartol's Rod to Raene Wolfrunner.
english.description: Now, take the rod and while using its power, speak with my brother, Ota Wen.$B$BOta is amongst the other furbolg that the orcs have captured and have penned in the giant cage on the north side of Silverwind Refuge. The rod will allow you to convince Ota and the other furbolg to rise up and attack the Horde.$B$BThen you may go wherever your path leads you. Just know that you have found a new friend for that which you have done.
english.progress: You return, $n. What's that affixed to the top of the rod? A skull?
english.completion: So, you used the skull of the furbolg king to modify the power of Dartol's Rod? You then used that power to convince the captured furbolg to rise up and attack the Horde at Silverwind Refuge? I am more than pleased and impressed with your abilities, $n. The Sentinels cannot thank you enough. It should be a simple matter for us to sweep away the orcs and retake the refuge now! Teronis would be proud. You have my deepest respect.
english.completed: Deliver Dartol's Rod to Raene Wolfrunner at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

text.title: 甘德朗达
text.objectives: 杀死甘德朗达。
text.description: 把这些巨魔打得屁滚尿流确实有意思，但我们还有其他的事情要做。不过能把仗打完还是挺不错的，对吧？$B$B他们的指挥官甘德朗达就盘踞在战场东南边的废墟高墙里。我们大部分的兵力都被占住了，所以我要你溜进去把甘德朗达干掉。当看到一个$r站在己方的大英雄的尸体上，他们的士气一定会极度低落！
text.completion: Now that's what I like to hear! Good on ya.
text.completed: Return to Kerr Ironsight at Stormfeather Outpost in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: 如果除掉了这个莽夫，我们矮人士兵的胜算定会大大提高。

english.title: Gan'dranda
english.objectives: Kill Gan'dranda.
english.description: As fun as it is to butt heads with these trolls, we've got other things to do down here. It'd be nice to get this battle over with, aye?$B$BTheir commander, Gan'dranda, sits in the ruined walls to the southeast of the battlefield. Our boys have most of their forces locked up, so I want you to slip in there and take out Gan'dranda. When they see a $r standin' over the corpse of their biggest hero it should take some of the fight out of 'em!
english.completion: Now that's what I like to hear! Good on ya.
english.completed: Return to Kerr Ironsight at Stormfeather Outpost in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: Our dwarves stand a much better chance once this brute is dead on the ground.

text.title: 增援巨石之炉
text.objectives: 与深岩之洲巨石之炉的克拉格·摧石者谈一谈。
text.description: 在一万五千年前，土灵和石腭怪不知怎的就找到了从奥丹姆通往深岩之洲的路。自那天起，他们就一直交战不休。$B$B假如我们想获得世界之柱的中部碎片，就要把石父救出来。$B$B请前往巨石之炉，尽你所能帮土灵打赢对石头穴居人的战争。$B$B你是我们最佳的指望了，$n。
text.completion: The Stonefather's son, Flint, sent you? No time to talk. We must prevent a second front from opening up on the war!

english.title: To Stonehearth's Aid
english.objectives: Speak with Crag Rockcrusher at Stonehearth in Deepholm.
english.description: The earthen and the stone troggs somehow found their way to Deepholm through Uldum more than fifteen thousand years ago. They've been warring ever since.$B$BIf we're to recover the middle fragment of the World Pillar, the Stonefather must be rescued.$B$BPlease go to Stonehearth and do everything that you can to aid the Earthen in their war against the stone troggs.$B$BYou're our best hope, $n.
english.completion: The Stonefather's son, Flint, sent you? No time to talk. We must prevent a second front from opening up on the war!

text.title: 钳嘴，小子！
text.objectives: 从海水钳嘴龟身上取得8副钳嘴龟胃囊。
text.description: 我打算给那些烦人的巨魔酿点特别的。没错，就是他们……一种他们无法忘怀的饮料！一种会让他们喝掉獠牙的饮料！$B$B我已经准备好了几样原料，但要是有人能帮我再收集点自然更好。在东边望海崖的底部，靠近海岸的地方全是钳嘴龟。我需要它们新鲜、完整的胃囊。
text.progress: Got those gizzards?
text.completion: Ah, nice an' fresh. I'll get those going while you fetch me some more goods then...
text.completed: Return to Dron Blastbrew at Stormfeather Post in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Snapjaws, Lad!
english.objectives: Collect 8 Snapjaw Gizzards from Saltwater Snapjaws.
english.description: I've got plans to brew up somethin' special for those pesky trolls. Aye, I said for them... a brew they won't ever forget! A brew that'll have them pickin' their tusks out of the hillsides!$B$BI've got a few ingredients steepin' already, but I could use a hand gatherin' more. At the bottom of the Overlook Cliffs to the east, near the shore, is a whole mess o' snapjaws. I need fresh, whole gizzards from them for my blastbrew.
english.progress: Got those gizzards?
english.completion: Ah, nice an' fresh. I'll get those going while you fetch me some more goods then...
english.completed: Return to Dron Blastbrew at Stormfeather Post in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 海滩上有99瓶酒
text.objectives: 收集12瓶紫葡萄酒。
text.description: 瞧，我知道咱们有场小仗要打，不过就在望海崖下面，散落着不少漂亮的酒瓶。我可不想那些好喝的落入部落的手中！$B$B如果你要下去的话，帮我把它们带回来。我可以按全额付你钱。
text.progress: About 12 should do the trick, aye?
text.completion:
That's the stuff! Wouldn't want any trolls or goblins gettin' pleasure out of these, now would we!

Maybe I can work a bit of this into my next brew...
text.completed: Return to Dron Blastbrew in the Hinterlands.

english.title: 99 Bottles of Booze on the Beach
english.objectives: Collect 12 bottles of Pupellyverbos Port.
english.description: Now, I know we've got a little battle ragin' and all that, but down at the overlook cliffs are some nice lookin' bottles strewn all over the place. I don't want good drink to fall into the hands o' the Horde!$B$BIf you're down that way, collect the bottles for me and bring 'em back here. I'll pay in full for it as if you bottled 'em yourself.
english.progress: About 12 should do the trick, aye?
english.completion:
That's the stuff! Wouldn't want any trolls or goblins gettin' pleasure out of these, now would we!

Maybe I can work a bit of this into my next brew...
english.completed: Return to Dron Blastbrew in the Hinterlands.

text.title: 海蛇草论捆卖
text.objectives: 从纳迦探险者身上获得6捆海蛇草。
text.description: 运营五星级异国情调度假村兼丛林资源回收站可不是什么容易事！也就是说，要不是我有贸易大王的私人助理的组织能力，根本就没戏！$b$b头一招叫做多进程。比如说：南边的纳迦探险者带着一种值钱的海草——海蛇草。我们可以把它们卖给海外客户，我们也可以用它们给游客塞褥子！想想看吧，我们可能用得着更多的海蛇草。
text.progress: Let's see... we're going to need some shotguns for our nature hikes, rowboats for the oil rig day trip, and... Oh, you're back already?
text.completion: Hey hey!  Not bad, not bad at all!  You may have a future in resource acquisition.  Or hotel management.
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Akiris by the Bundle
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Akiris Reeds from Naga Explorers.
english.description: It's not easy running a combination 5-star exotic resort/jungle resource salvaging plant!  That is, it wouldn't be easy, if I didn't have the organizational skills of a trade prince's personal assistant!$b$bThe first trick is multitasking.  For example: the naga explorers to our south carry a valuable ocean reed - Akiris reeds.  We can sell these reeds to our clients overseas, and we can also stuff our visitors' mattresses with them!  Come to think of it, we could probably use some more of that stuff.
english.progress: Let's see... we're going to need some shotguns for our nature hikes, rowboats for the oil rig day trip, and... Oh, you're back already?
english.completion: Hey hey!  Not bad, not bad at all!  You may have a future in resource acquisition.  Or hotel management.
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 大胃口
text.objectives: 从暴风城英雄谷的护城河里钓起一条皇家扁鲨。当你捉住扁鲨后，就剖开鱼腹看看盒坠在不在它的肚子里。
text.description: 阿诺德和我以前经常在英雄谷的护城河那边休息。有一天，我的盒坠掉进了湖里，再也找不到了。据说护城河里生活着巨大的皇家扁鲨，而且它们什么都吃！我知道这听起来有点不切实际，但是你能不能抓几条扁鲨，帮我找找盒坠？$B$B如果你找到了的话，请立刻告诉我，它对我来说意义重大。
text.progress: 你有找到我的墜盒嗎?
text.completion: 你找到了!我不敢相信它這些年來一直在水裡!你不知道這對我有多麼的重要，$n。
text.completed: Deliver the Precious Locket to Catherine Leland in Stormwind City.

english.title: Big Gulp
english.objectives: Fish up a Royal Monkfish from the moat in the Valley of Heroes district of Stormwind.  Once you catch a monkfish, fillet it and check if it swallowed the locket.
english.description: Arnold and I used to relax down at the moat in the Valley of Heroes.  One day, I lost my locket in the lake and I have never been able to find it.  Rumor has it that huge royal monkfish live in that moat and that they eat anything!  I know its a long shot, but do you think you could catch a few monkfish and look for my locket?$b$bPlease let me know right away if you find it, it's very precious to me.
english.progress: Were you able to find my locket?
english.completion: You found it!  I can't believe it was down there all those years!  You have no idea how much this means to me $n.
english.completed: Deliver the Precious Locket to Catherine Leland in Stormwind City.

text.title: 是你！！
text.objectives: 从纳迦探险者身上获得6捆海蛇草。
text.description: 是的，我能帮你什……$b$b<莎希的下巴都掉到地板上了。>$b$b$n!真的是你吗？看你变得多高多壮？！让我摸摸这二头肌！$b$b我吗？我一直尝试在丛林里寻财路。我们主要从事资源采取，但也做些旅游生意。$b$b我知道，很天才，不是吗？$b$b嘿，听着。我在想……南边那些纳迦探险者带着的海蛇草，我们能卖啊，还能给游客们塞褥子。你有兴趣杀几只纳迦吗？就像以前那样！
text.progress: Let's see... we're going to need some shotguns for our nature hikes, rowboats for the oil rig day trip, and... Oh, hey Boss $n.  You're back already?
text.completion: I knew you had it in you, boss-man.  You know what they say: You can take the $r out of the islands, but you can't take the murderous tendencies out of $n.
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: It's You!!
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Akiris Reeds from Naga Explorers.
english.description: Yes, can I help...$b$b<Sassy's jaw drops to the floor.>$b$b$n!  Is it really you?!  Look how big and strong you've gotten!  Let me feel that bicep!$b$bMe?  I've been trying to make my gold here in the jungle.  We're mainly in resource acquisition, but we also do tourism.$b$bI know, genius, right?$b$bHey, listen.  I was thinking... the naga explorers to the south carry Akiris reeds, which we could sell, and use to stuff visitor mattresses.  You interested in killing some naga?  It'll be just like old times!
english.progress: Let's see... we're going to need some shotguns for our nature hikes, rowboats for the oil rig day trip, and... Oh, hey Boss $n.  You're back already?
english.completion: I knew you had it in you, boss-man.  You know what they say: You can take the $r out of the islands, but you can't take the murderous tendencies out of $n.
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 泥浆怪之母
text.objectives: 从一只恐泥怪身上获得恐泥怪样本。
text.description: 很少有矮人知道这一点，但我的饮料之所以来劲，是因为我在里面加了一点软泥怪。没错，那种又大又绿，吃矮人的软泥怪，就是它们。$B$B不过，饮料的劲头还不够大，因此我们需要一个巨大的泥浆怪！隐匿石下面潜伏着一只，乃是所有泥浆怪之母，绝对巨大……我们叫它恐泥怪。$B$B要是你有胆量的话，就去那儿从恐泥怪身上揪一大块下来给我！
text.progress: Aye, do ya have it?
text.completion: Look at it! That'll put some oomph into the mix!
text.completed: Return to Dron Blastbrew at Stormfeather Post in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: 尽量别靠得太近了…谁知道这玩意儿到底有什么能耐呢？

english.title: Prime Slime
english.objectives: Collect a Direglob Sample from The Direglob.
english.description: Not many dwarves know this, but to get a REAL kick out of my brew I add a wee bit of the oozes around here. Aye, the giant green dwarf-eatin' oozes, those ones.$B$BThis brew's gonna have a HUGE kick to it though, so we need a huge slime! There's one lurkin' down in Skulk Rock that's the mother o' them all, absolutely huge...the Direglob, we call it.$B$BIf you've got what it takes, head down there and take a chunk out of the Direglob for me!
english.progress: Aye, do ya have it?
english.completion: Look at it! That'll put some oomph into the mix!
english.completed: Return to Dron Blastbrew at Stormfeather Post in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: Try not to get too close... Who knows what this thing is capable of?

text.title: 隐匿石大扫除
text.objectives: 杀掉10只玉石软泥怪。
text.description: 多年前，在隐匿石深处有过一个部落基地。它已经被废弃很久了，但仍是一个战略要地，值得为我们的盟友将其夺下！$B$B问题是，那里到处都是吃矮人的泥浆怪和软泥怪。巨魔就比那些东西恶心一点点，但它们对我们来说还是一个麻烦。$B$B我们的人手在和恶齿作战，分身乏术，我要你到隐匿石去把那地方给我清出来。
text.completion: It's good to see you back... and not missing any limbs, either.
text.completed: Return to Kerr Ironsight at Stormfeather Outpost in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Skulk Rock Clean-Up
english.objectives: Kill 10 Jade Oozes.
english.description: Years ago, there used to be a Horde base deep within Skulk Rock. It's been abandoned since then, but it's still prime territory, worth takin' for our allies!$B$BProblem is, it's full of dwarf-eating slimes and oozes. Those things are slightly less disgustin' than trolls, but they'll still give us a hassle.$B$BWith our boys tied up fightin' the Revantusk, I need you to go to Skulk Rock and clear the place out for me.
english.completion: It's good to see you back... and not missing any limbs, either.
english.completed: Return to Kerr Ironsight at Stormfeather Outpost in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 隐匿石补给
text.objectives: 收集5个污泥覆盖的补给箱。
text.description: 我在第二次兽人大战的时候有个远亲！他常跟我说关于他们袭击隐匿石的故事。他们冲进去，把那儿的巨魔像耗子一样从巢里赶出来，一直赶到奥特兰克！$B$B不久之后泥浆怪就搬了进来，而里面还有不少旧的部落物资呢。我说我们不要让巨魔把它们拿回去！$B$B到西北边的隐匿石给我拿几箱回来。
text.progress: You got the crates?
text.completion:
Looks like it's still good inside! Huh... is that banana bread? Still fresh!

Here, lad, take your share of goods.
text.completed: Return to Kerr Ironsight at Stormfeather Outpost in the Hinterlands.

english.title: Skulk Rock Supplies
english.objectives: Collect 5 Ooze-Coated Supply Crates.
english.description: I had a cousin in the second war! He used to tell me all about when they led a raid on Skulk Rock. Swept in there and drove the trolls out like rats from a nest. They chased right after 'em all the way to Alterac!$B$BThe slimes moved in right quick after that, and there's still cratefuls of old Horde goods sittin' in there. I say we don't let the trolls get it back!$B$BBring me back a few crates from Skulk Rock to the northwest.
english.progress: You got the crates?
english.completion:
Looks like it's still good inside! Huh... is that banana bread? Still fresh!

Here, lad, take your share of goods.
english.completed: Return to Kerr Ironsight at Stormfeather Outpost in the Hinterlands.

text.title: 外头有人要呢
text.objectives: 从水晶矿洞的钢尾和铁腭蜥蜴身上获得7份莎希的秘密原料。
text.description: 趁你因为别的事情忙得满头大汗的时候，我想我又替你找了一份差事。你不介意，是吧？$b$b最新一期《科学与爆炸》刚从锈水港寄到，上面有篇关于热门新材料的文章。这材料的价格一飞冲天，我们正好就处于原产地！$b$b<莎希凑过身来对你耳语着细节。>$b$b你明白了吗？好的。你可以在东边远处的洞里找到石化蜥蜴。
text.progress: I hope you used the extraction procedure we discussed.
text.completion: Great!  These look... disgusting.  But probably pretty valuable.  Let's get to splitting these up.  Some for me, some for Jasper, some for Chabal...
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: There's Somebody Out There Who Wants It
english.objectives: Obtain 7 of Sassy's Secret Ingredient from Thrashtail and Ironjaw Basilisks in the Crystalvein Mine.
english.description: So, while you're already all sweaty from doing all that other stuff, I was thinking I might grab you for one more task.  You don't mind, do you?$b$bThe latest Science and Explosions journal just came in from Bilgewater Harbor, and there's this article about this hot new reagent.  Prices on the reagent are skyrocketing, and we're in prime position to capitalize!$b$b<Sassy leans over and whispers the details into your ear.>$b$bYou got that?  Good.  You can find the basilisks in a cave, far to the east.
english.progress: I hope you used the extraction procedure we discussed.
english.completion: Great!  These look... disgusting.  But probably pretty valuable.  Let's get to splitting these up.  Some for me, some for Jasper, some for Chabal...
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 混合大师加斯帕
text.objectives: 把莎希的样本交给硬钳避世乐园的混合大师加斯帕。
text.description: 介不介意把这东西拿点给加斯帕，就在豪华套间那儿？我肯定他会用的着的。$b$b谢谢啦，$n！
text.progress: Hey, is that the stuff?  From the magazine?
text.completion: I'll file these away for now.  Maybe we can experiment later. Yeah, you'll do.

english.title: Mixmaster Jasper
english.objectives: Bring Sassy's Samples to Mixmaster Jasper in Hardwrench Hideaway.
english.description: Mind giving some of this stuff to Jasper, over by the luxury suites?  I'm sure he can find some use for it.$b$bThanks, $n!
english.progress: Hey, is that the stuff?  From the magazine?
english.completion: I'll file these away for now.  Maybe we can experiment later. Yeah, you'll do.

text.title: 查巴尔
text.objectives: 将莎希的馈赠交给硬钳避世乐园的查巴尔。
text.description: 查巴尔，就是那个在植物园/生化武器实验室旁边的巨魔，是我们的嘉宾。他代表赞达拉巨魔，长途跋涉而来。$b$b<莎希把你收集到的一些物品打了个小包交给你。>$b$b给，把这个交给他。告诉他硬钳避世乐园将永远欢迎赞达拉！别忘了搞好公关是做好这门生意的关键！
text.progress: Care to explain yourself, $c?
text.completion: You have my thanks. I have been waiting for you to approach me, $r.  I have identified you as the most promising $r here in this strange town.  I have a task for you, if you would be willing to take it.

english.title: Chabal
english.objectives: Bring Sassy's Largesse to Chabal in Hardwrench Hideaway.
english.description: Chabal, that troll over by the botanical gardens/biological weapons lab, is a special guest.  He's a representative of the Zandalari trolls, and has traveled quite far to stay with us.$b$b<Sassy places some of the items you've collected in a small parcel and hands it to you.>$b$bHere, give this to him.  Tell him that the Zandalari are always welcome at Hardwrench Hideaway!  And mention that referrals are key to maintaining our business!
english.progress: Care to explain yourself, $c?
english.completion: You have my thanks. I have been waiting for you to approach me, $r.  I have identified you as the most promising $r here in this strange town.  I have a task for you, if you would be willing to take it.

text.title: 邪枝的倒台
text.objectives: 去找辛特兰辛萨罗的多兰·刚翼。
text.description: 恶齿部族不是我们唯一要操心的堕落巨魔部族！邪枝部族已经通过他们建造在辛萨罗的要塞，腐蚀了这片土地多年。$B$B不知道你注意到没有，我们终于可以不用再这么坐在鹰巢山里掰着手指头了。多兰·刚翼带领了手下，要从南边的营地里发起对邪枝巨魔的攻势。跟他谈谈，加入战斗！
text.completion: Well met, $n! We've got a lot of trolls to kill and only so many hands to do it with!

english.title: Down with the Vilebranch
english.objectives: Find Doran Steelwing at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.
english.description: The Revantusk isn't the only tribe of foul trolls we're here to take care of! The Vilebranch have corrupted this land for years from their stronghold of Jintha'Alor.$B$BWe're done sittin' by in Aerie Peak twiddlin' our thumbs, if you haven't noticed. Doran Steelwing leads the charge against the Vilebranch from a camp the boys took just to the south. Speak with him and join the fight!
english.completion: Well met, $n! We've got a lot of trolls to kill and only so many hands to do it with!

text.title: 邪枝渣滓
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗杀死5名邪枝巫医和5名邪枝猎头者。
text.description: 邪枝是和恶齿完全不同的部族，不过其中的差别只是形式上的。就我们而言，唯一一种善良的巨魔，就是死掉的巨魔！$B$B不过别搞错了，邪枝巨魔的脖子上就算没有拴着部落的链子，他们也一样卑鄙。除非我们站起来除掉他们，否则他们会毒害整个大地。$B$B你可以从下层平台他们的巫医和猎头者开始。你把他们杀得差不多了就来告诉我。
text.completion: Aye, we'll have these trolls cleared out yet.
text.completed: Return to Doran Steelwing at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Vilebranch Scum
english.objectives: Kill 5 Vilebranch Witch Doctors and 5 Vilebranch Headhunters in Jintha'Alor.
english.description: The Vilebranch are a different tribe from the Revantusk, but the difference is academic. Far as we're concerned the only good troll is a dead troll!$B$BBut make no mistake, the Vilebranch are just as nasty even without the Horde's chain around their neck. They'll poison this whole land unless we take this stand and get rid of them$B$BYou can start with their witchdoctors and headhunters on the lower tier. Let me know when you've killed a fair share of 'em.
english.completion: Aye, we'll have these trolls cleared out yet.
english.completed: Return to Doran Steelwing at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 邪枝之死
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗杀死5名邪枝狂战士和5名邪枝暗影法师。
text.description: 我们进展很顺利。继续保持，不要退缩！$B$B邪枝狂战士战斗起来仿佛是野蛮的动物，会突然进入嗜血的狂暴中。他们的暗影法师则把污秽的灵魂召唤到这个世界里来！这就是为什么我要除掉这些堕落的生物，$n，好好记住。$B$B到中层平台去杀掉那些狂战士和暗影法师！
text.completion: It won't be long until we're the only dwarves left breathing on these walls.
text.completed: Return to Doran Steelwing at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Death to the Vilebranch
english.objectives: Kill 5 Vilebranch Berserkers and 5 Vilebranch Shadowcasters in Jintha'Alor.
english.description: We're makin' good progress. Keep pressing on, and don't falter!$B$BThe Vilebranch berserkers fight like savage animals, whipped into a blood frenzy. Their shadowcasters summon foul spirits from beyond this world! This is why we're getting rid of these depraved creatures, $n, never forget that.$B$BHead to the middle tier and kill the berserkers and shadowcasters!
english.completion: It won't be long until we're the only dwarves left breathing on these walls.
english.completed: Return to Doran Steelwing at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 石父的旗帜
text.objectives: 将石父的旗帜赐予12名土灵防御者。
text.description: 石父被俘，我的部队士气低迷。通常随便一个对付这些石头穴居人都能以一当五。可现在……$B$B我要你去镇子四周的地里，将石父岩幔的旗帜插在我的防御者身边。让他们沐浴在他的恩典中，提醒他们自己在为谁而战。
text.completion: You have my thanks, $n. You've made all the difference, and the fate of these cowardly stone trogg ambushers is set in stone. Now we must get about the business of retaking Stonehearth.
text.completed: Return to Crag Rockcrusher at Stonehearth in Deepholm.

english.title: Stonefather's Boon
english.objectives: Grant the Stonefather's Boon to 12 Earthen Defenders.
english.description: With the Stonefather taken prisoner, our forces are demoralized. Normally any one of mine could take five times his number of stone troggs. But now....$B$BI want you to head out into the field surrounding the town. Plant Stonefather Oremantle's banner near my defenders. Grant them his boon and remind them of that for which they fight.
english.completion: You have my thanks, $n. You've made all the difference, and the fate of these cowardly stone trogg ambushers is set in stone. Now we must get about the business of retaking Stonehearth.
english.completed: Return to Crag Rockcrusher at Stonehearth in Deepholm.

text.title: 我们被包围了
text.objectives: 消灭12名石头穴居人伏击者。
text.description: 我们的战争从你们有历史之前就开始了。让我看看你是不是能起上作用，$r。$B$B石头穴居人的存在是泰坦的错误所致。在你们的世界里，它们遭受血肉的诅咒。但在这里，深岩之洲，你见到的才是它们的真正形态。$B$B我们被包围了。也许你可以出去为我们杀出一条路来。顺便看看它们到底是啥做的？
text.completion: Not a bad start, though you'll have to destroy more of them than that if you're going to rescue the Stonefather. A lot more.
text.completed: Return to Earthbreaker Dolomite at Stonehearth in Deepholm.

english.title: We're Surrounded
english.objectives: Slay 12 Stone Trogg Ambushers.
english.description: Our war has been waged for longer than your kind counts time. Let us see if you can make a difference, $r.$B$BThe stone troggs are a mistake of the titans. On your world they have succumbed to the Curse of Flesh. But here, in Deepholm, you see them in their true form.$B$BWe're surrounded. Maybe you could go out there and break a few troggs down for us. See what they're really made of?
english.completion: Not a bad start, though you'll have to destroy more of them than that if you're going to rescue the Stonefather. A lot more.
english.completed: Return to Earthbreaker Dolomite at Stonehearth in Deepholm.

text.title: 封锁道路
text.objectives: 帮助土灵地卜师摆脱战斗，将崩岩试剂交给他们以封锁军械库、旅店、兵营和神龛。
text.description: 石头穴居人居然从我们老家底下挖了条路上来了！$B$B我已经派我们的地卜师们去封锁所有的建筑，但他们需要这些材料，以及从战斗中抽身的时间，才能进行崩岩仪式。$B$B你完事之后，去向将军格拉维尔·长铲报告，他就在巨石之炉北边碎裂前线上。
text.completion: This is good. We no longer need to worry about stone trogg attacks from the rear. Let's see what you can do for us on the front.
text.completed: Speak with Gravel Longslab on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.

english.title: Sealing the Way
english.objectives: Help the Earthen Geomancers to get out of combat and then give them the Rockslide Reagents so that they can seal the Armory, Inn, Barracks, and Shrine.
english.description: The stone troggs have found a way to burrow up from underneath our homes!$B$BI've sent our geomancers to seal all of the buildings, but they need these reagents and enough time out of battle to properly cast their rockslide rituals.$B$BWhen you're done, report to, Gravel Longslab, just to the north on the Fractured Front.
english.completion: This is good. We no longer need to worry about stone trogg attacks from the rear. Let's see what you can do for us on the front.
english.completed: Speak with Gravel Longslab on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.

text.title: 雷霆之石
text.objectives: 收集12块雷霆之石。
text.description: 北边就是碎裂前线了。最激烈的战斗都在那里发生。$B$B去巨石之炉城区拿上你能找到的所有雷霆之石。我们的工程师需要用它来装填投石车。$B$B拿够了之后就去找克莱·泥轴。别介意他说的话。那家伙又老又怪，几千年前就该入土了。
text.progress: What are you supposed to be? Some kind of fleshy mistake? Cursed is what you are! Make yourself useful or get off of my front!
text.completion: Those'll do. Just put them down over there. I'm going to have something for you to do in a moment. Maybe.
text.completed: Deliver the Thunder Stones to Clay Mudaxle on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.

english.title: Thunder Stones
english.objectives: Collect 12 Thunder Stones.
english.description: To the north lies the Fractured Front. That is where most of the heavy fighting is happening.$B$BGo into Stonehearth proper and grab all of the thunder stones that you can. Our engineers need them for the catapults.$B$BWhen you have enough, take them to Clay Mudaxle. Don't mind his tongue. He's old and cranky, and should have gone back into the earth thousands of years ago.
english.progress: What are you supposed to be? Some kind of fleshy mistake? Cursed is what you are! Make yourself useful or get off of my front!
english.completion: Those'll do. Just put them down over there. I'm going to have something for you to do in a moment. Maybe.
english.completed: Deliver the Thunder Stones to Clay Mudaxle on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.

text.title: 继续评估威胁
text.objectives: 偷取豺狼人作战计划、豺狼人的命令以及豺狼人战略指南。
text.description: 该死的豺狼人废物就没安好心，我骨子里能感觉得到。在过去两个星期里，豺狼人在这个地区的活动量是以前的三倍。我担心他们可能在酝酿攻打湖畔镇。$B$B我要你到该地区的每一处豺狼人营地去，尽可能地收集情报。到北边、东边和东南边的营地里查看一番。不管你找到什么，都给我带回来。
text.progress: Did you find the gnoll plans?
text.completion: I knew it! Looks like Yowler is behind this uprising - which is incredible, because we keep killing gnolls named Yowler. I don't know how many sons the original Yowler had, but it's got to be close to a hundred. Well, looks like we got ourselves another Yowler to kill. Magistrate Solomon must be notified.
text.completed: Return to Watch Captain Parker at Tower Watch in Redridge.

english.title: Still Assessing the Threat
english.objectives: Steal the Gnoll Battle Plans, Gnoll Orders and Gnoll Strategy Guide.
english.description: Damned worthless gnolls are up to no good. I can feel it in my bones. Gnoll activity in the area has tripled in the past two weeks. I fear they might be mounting up to make an assault on Lakeshire.$B$BI need you to head to each of the gnoll camps of this area and gather any information that you come across. Check the camps directly north of here, east of here and southeast of here. Bring back whatever you find.
english.progress: Did you find the gnoll plans?
english.completion: I knew it! Looks like Yowler is behind this uprising - which is incredible, because we keep killing gnolls named Yowler. I don't know how many sons the original Yowler had, but it's got to be close to a hundred. Well, looks like we got ourselves another Yowler to kill. Magistrate Solomon must be notified.
english.completed: Return to Watch Captain Parker at Tower Watch in Redridge.

text.title: 通缉：赤脊山豺狼人
text.objectives: 在赤脊山的三角路口地区杀掉15名赤脊山豺狼人。
text.description: 奉暴风城皇家卫兵之命，赤脊山西南角三角路口地区的所有豺狼人，都必须要消灭。$B$B如果你成功地驱散该地区的豺狼人，就把捷报告诉瞭望塔的卫兵队长帕克。
text.completion: A job well done deserves a reward, wouldn't you say? Don't spend this all in one place, $c. Better to spread it around, if you catch my drift.
text.completed: Return to Watch Captain Parker at Tower Watch in Redridge.

english.title: Wanted: Redridge Gnolls
english.objectives: Kill any 15 Redridge Gnolls in the Three Corners region of Redridge Mountains.
english.description: By order of the Stormwind Royal Guard, all gnolls of the region known as Three Corners in the southwestern corner of Redridge Mountains, are wanted dead.$B$BShould you dispatch of the gnolls of the region, report your victory to Watch Captain Parker at Tower Watch.
english.completion: A job well done deserves a reward, wouldn't you say? Don't spend this all in one place, $c. Better to spread it around, if you catch my drift.
english.completed: Return to Watch Captain Parker at Tower Watch in Redridge.

text.title: 帕克的报告
text.objectives: 将帕克的报告交给赤脊山湖畔镇的所罗门镇长。
text.description: <卫兵队长帕克递给你一份报告。>$B$B拿好，$n。把我的报告送回湖畔镇，就在这座塔的北方，把它交给所罗门镇长。告诉他，我们需要一个更为全面的豺狼人解决方案。建议使用炸药。大量的炸药。$B$B如果你知道好歹，就别离开大路。$B$B顺便一说，知道好歹的意思就是别丢了性命。这么说是就怕万一你不知道好歹。现在你知道了……算了算了！
text.progress: Where did I put my monocle?! Conacher is that you?
text.completion: Oh, you're not Conacher. What have you got there? Oh for pity's sake. Yowler? AGAIN?

english.title: Parker's Report
english.objectives: Deliver Parker's Report to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge.
english.description: <Watch Captain Parker hands you a report.>$B$BHere it is, $n. Take my report to Lakeshire, located north of this tower, and deliver it to Magistrate Solomon. Inform him that we need a more comprehensive solution for dealing with the gnolls. Suggest explosives. Lots of explosives.$B$BAnd stick to the road if you know what's good for you.$B$BWhat's good for you is staying alive, by the way. In case you didn't know what was good for you. You now know... Oh never mind!
english.progress: Where did I put my monocle?! Conacher is that you?
english.completion: Oh, you're not Conacher. What have you got there? Oh for pity's sake. Yowler? AGAIN?

text.title: 茄汁黄豆
text.objectives: 收集4颗狼蛛眼球、4副秃鹰的内脏和4副血牙野猪的肾脏。
text.description: 我需要你的帮助，$r！我们的口粮见底了，卫兵们饥饿难耐。他们直嚷嚷要吃我做的举世闻名的茄汁黄豆，可我手头没有食材。你能不能好心帮帮我？$B$B我需要一些血牙野猪的肾脏、秃鹰的内脏，还有狼蛛眼球。你可以在这座塔附近找到血牙野猪、秃鹰和狼蛛。去找找看！
text.progress: Have you gotten my ingredients?
text.completion: PERFECT! I'll put these in the pot right away. Dinner should be ready in a few hours. Thank you, darling!
text.completed: Return to Darcy Parker at Tower Watch in Redridge.

english.title: Franks and Beans
english.objectives: Collect 4 Tarantula Eyes, 4 Condor Giblets and 4 Goretusk Kidneys.
english.description: I need your help, $r! Our rations have run out and the guards are getting hungry. They're clamoring for my world famous franks and beans, but I have no ingredients on hand. Would you be a darling and help me out?$B$BI need some goretusk kidneys, condor giblets, and tarantula eyes. You'll find goretusks, condors and tarantulas near this tower. Just look around!
english.progress: Have you gotten my ingredients?
english.completion: PERFECT! I'll put these in the pot right away. Dinner should be ready in a few hours. Thank you, darling!
english.completed: Return to Darcy Parker at Tower Watch in Redridge.

text.title: 僵硬的美餐
text.objectives: 为佩波收集12只石化蝙蝠。
text.description: 石化蝙蝠。$B$B元素在这个尺寸时可是很挑食的。你不大可能找得到更好的来喂了。$B$B东边有一些石化蜥蜴，它们饿的时候就会把飞得太近的蝙蝠石化了当点心。你可以在它们的领地周围找到散落的蝙蝠。$B$B我必须提醒你……如果你过于关心那个小元素生物，就少不了麻烦。它可是非常……粘人的。
text.progress: <Pebble starts to look up at you, eyes glowing faintly, growing rounder and larger every moment.>
text.completion: <Pebble leaps upon the pile of petrified bats and rolls around in them, seeming to forget that you exist entirely. Perhaps for the best, if Kor's warnings are to be trusted.>
text.completed: Speak to Pebble. You last saw him in the Shuddering Spires.

english.title: Petrified Delicacies
english.objectives: Gather 12 Petrified Stone Bats for Pebble.
english.description: Petrified bats.$B$BElementals of that size are picky. You're not likely to find anything better easily.$B$BTo the east are basilisks. They petrify stone bats that fly too close and snack on them when they grow hungry. You may find bats scattered around their territory.$B$BI must warn you... if you show that little elemental too much attention, you're unlikely to be rid of it. It can be very... needy.
english.progress: <Pebble starts to look up at you, eyes glowing faintly, growing rounder and larger every moment.>
english.completion: <Pebble leaps upon the pile of petrified bats and rolls around in them, seeming to forget that you exist entirely. Perhaps for the best, if Kor's warnings are to be trusted.>
english.completed: Speak to Pebble. You last saw him in the Shuddering Spires.

text.title: 尼达的项链
text.objectives: 找到尼达的项链。
text.description: 我的朋友尼达把她的项链弄丢了，我们找不到。我们已经在这里钓了一天，也找了一天。我唯一能想得起来的，就是它掉到湖里去了。我们的父母不让我们游到湖里去……我的妈妈说水底下有坏东西，但你看上去不怕坏东西。$B$B你能不能帮她找到项链？求求你啦！
text.progress: 你好。我很想我的项链!是我爸爸送我的。爸爸说湖水中有怪兽，你打败它们了吗?
text.completion: 谢谢你帮我找到项链，$C$G先生:小姐;……你可真好!我的小猫也感谢你─对吗，喵喵?$B$B
text.completed: Return to Nida at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.title: Nida's Necklace
english.objectives: Find Nida's Necklace.
english.description: My friend Nida lost her necklace, and we can't find it.  We've been fishing all day right here, and we looked around here already.  The only thing I can think of is that it fell into the lake.  Our parents don't want us to swim in the lake... my mom says there's some mean things underwater, but you look like you aren't scared of mean things.$B$BCould you find it for her, please?
english.progress: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
english.completion: Thank you for finding my necklace mister $c... you are very kind!  My kitty thanks you too - isn't that right Effsee?
english.completed: Return to Nida at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: 不速之客
text.objectives: 杀死贝利格拉布，并带回它的獠牙作为证明。
text.description: 前几天我的花园又被搞得一塌糊涂，不过现在我已经知道是哪个混蛋干的了。就是那只被治安官马瑞斯先生称作“贝利格拉布”的野猪。$b$b你瞧，我在下一季来临之前都没法种我的水仙花了。全毁了！一切都被那只混蛋野猪给毁了！把那祸害给我干掉！把它的獠牙给我带回来，我会付给你酬劳的。它一般就在湖畔镇西南的田边闲逛，但有时候也会跑进我的花园里来。
text.progress: 贝利格拉布还活着吗?还是你已经永远的替湖畔镇把这个祸害除掉了?
text.completion: 哈哈，终於把这个祸害除掉了。多谢你，$N，你做了一件好事。今年花园里的花一定会开得很茂盛!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Martie Jainrose at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.title: An Unwelcome Guest
english.objectives: Kill Bellygrub and take Bellygrub's Tusk.
english.description: Once again my garden was trampled and pillaged.  And I know the brute who is doing it.  It's that forsaken boar, the one Marshal Marris has taken to calling Bellygrub.$b$bI won't be able to re-plant the daffodils until next season now.  Ruined!  All ruined by that one menacing boar.  Put an end to that pest!  Show me his tusk and I'd be happy to reward you.  He seems to spend his time foraging in the field southwest of Lakeshire but occasionally he roams over here and into my garden.
english.progress: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
english.completion: Finally the menace is laid to rest!  Thank you, $n, you have done me a great service.  The garden shall be in full bloom this season!
english.completed: Return to Martie Jainrose at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: 必须准备万全！
text.objectives: 找回侏儒通讯器。
text.description: 每天失踪的民众越来越多了。我们认为是那些豺狼人搞的事，不过它们抓走我们的人想要干什么呢！如果你要去干掉那些豺狼人，帮我们找回失踪的民众，你必须要全副武装才行。真不赶巧，我们的侏儒通讯器都没了。没有侏儒通讯器，你就不能在战场上和我们沟通了。$B$B我们最后一个还能用的侏儒通讯器上周被鱼人强盗偷走了。你得去趟止水湖，就在东边，去把那录制器找回来！
text.progress: Have you recovered the gnomecorder?
text.completion: Excellent! Let me make a few adjustments here and we should be good to go.
text.completed: Return to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge.

english.title: We Must Prepare!
english.objectives: Recover the Gnomecorder.
english.description: More of our citizens go missing every day. We think the gnolls are responsible, but we have no idea where they are taking them! If you are to help us defeat the gnolls and find our people, you must be properly equipped. Unfortunately, we are all out of gnomecorders. Without a gnomecorder, there is no way for us to communicate with you when you are in the field.$B$BOur last good gnomecorder was stolen by marauding murlocs last week. You will have to go to Lake Everstill, east of here, and recover it!
english.progress: Have you recovered the gnomecorder?
english.completion: Excellent! Let me make a few adjustments here and we should be good to go.
english.completed: Return to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge.

text.title: 打扫止水湖
text.objectives: 杀掉止水湖的任意10名鱼人。
text.description: 要去止水湖吗？你也许很高兴知道，我们现在对鱼人进行悬赏。尽你所能杀掉它们，就可以拿到赏金！什么鱼人都行。你要做的就是不分青红皂白地杀。$B$B止水湖就在湖畔镇的正东边。那里面有水……想起来了吗？
text.completion: That ought to teach those murlocs a lesson. Hopefully the next time they decide to raid our town they'll think twice. We both know that won't happen.
text.completed: Return to Bailiff Conacher at Lakeshire in Redridge.

english.title: Lake Everstill Clean Up
english.objectives: Kill any 10 Murlocs in Lake Everstill.
english.description: Headed out to Lake Everstill? You'll be happy to know that we currently have a bounty on murlocs. Kill as many as you can and be rewarded! Any murloc will do. All you need to do is kill indiscriminately.$B$BYou'll find Lake Everstill directly east of Lakeshire. It's the lake. Has water in it... Any of this ring a bell?
english.completion: That ought to teach those murlocs a lesson. Hopefully the next time they decide to raid our town they'll think twice. We both know that won't happen.
english.completed: Return to Bailiff Conacher at Lakeshire in Redridge.

text.title: 调试侏儒通讯器
text.objectives: 前往湖畔镇墓地来调试侏儒通讯器的信号接收。
text.description: 侏儒通讯器看上去能用了。我已经帮你设置好了，现在只需要调试一下信号接收就行了。$B$B去湖畔镇北边，然后顺着路到墓地里。等你到了墓地，我就会发送信号。
text.completion: Can you hear me, $n? Is this thing on? Ah, yes, I see you there now. Let's get to work!
text.end: 在湖畔镇墓地测试侏儒通讯器。

english.title: Tuning the Gnomecorder
english.objectives: Go to the Lakeshire Graveyard to tune the Gnomecorder.
english.description: The gnomecorder looks to be in working order. I've got you all hooked up, now we just need to tune the gnomecorder for reception.$B$BHead north out of Lakeshire and follow the road up to the graveyard. Once you reach the graveyard I'll attempt to transmit.
english.completion: Can you hear me, $n? Is this thing on? Ah, yes, I see you there now. Let's get to work!
english.end: Test the Gnomecorder at the Lakeshire Graveyard
english.turninWindow: Reception coming in loud and clear!

text.title: 无影无踪
text.objectives: 收集8个赤脊山补给箱。
text.description: 昨天晚上我们遭到了洗劫，也许是前天晚上。我真的不是很确定，我已经三天没有合眼了。这会儿我可能都出现幻觉了。$B$B听好，豺狼人袭击了我们的补给库，把一切都抢走了。他们来无影去无踪！我的士兵们看到他们往西北边的峡谷里跑了。把我们的补给拿回来，$c！
text.progress: Did you recover the supplies?
text.completion: Thank you, citizen. Without you, we would have starved or worse, been forced to go out and get food for ourselves.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Marris at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.title: Like a Fart in the Wind
english.objectives: Recover 8 Redridge Supply Crates.
english.description: We were raided last night, or perhaps it was the night before. I'm not really sure when it was as I haven't had a wink of sleep in three days. I'm probably delusional at this point.$B$BListen, gnolls raided our supply stores and took off with everything! Just like a fart in the wind, they were in and they were OUT! My soldiers saw them running back towards the canyons, northwest of here. Recover our supplies, $c!
english.progress: Did you recover the supplies?
english.completion: Thank you, citizen. Without you, we would have starved or worse, been forced to go out and get food for ourselves.
english.completed: Return to Marshal Marris at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: 峡谷嬉戏
text.objectives: 收集10副赤脊山豺狼人项圈。
text.description: <侏儒通讯器嗡嗡地响着。>$B$B第一件事情轻轻松松，从湖畔镇直接往北到赤脊峡谷，杀掉你看到的所有侏儒……哎呀，我说侏儒了吗？我是说豺狼人。杀掉你看到的所有豺狼人，把他们的项圈作为证据拿到手。$B$B我必须警告你，$n，当心外面的双头魔。我的斥候报告说巨大、嗜血的双头魔最近在峡谷里游荡。如果你想活命，就别去招惹他们。$B$B所罗门通话完毕。我会再联络的。
text.progress: Did you recover those collars?
text.completion: Good work, $n. I've just been handed some important information. It would appear that our most hated enemy, the Blackrock orcs, have wised up... I've transferred a few silver over to you for the gnome, erm, gnoll kills.
text.giverWindow: 当心峡谷双头魔！

english.title: Canyon Romp
english.objectives: Collect 10 Redridge Gnoll Collars.
english.description: <The gnomecorder hums.>$B$BThe first order of business is a romp through the Redridge Canyons, directly north of Lakeshire. Kill every gnome that you see... woops, did I say gnome? I meant gnoll. Kill every GNOLL that you see and take their collars as proof of deed.$B$BI must warn you, $n; while you are out there, watch out for ettins. My scouts have reported seeing huge, bloodthirsty ettins roaming the canyons lately. Stay out of their way if you want to remain alive.$B$BSolomon out. I'll be in touch.
english.progress: Did you recover those collars?
english.completion: Good work, $n. I've just been handed some important information. It would appear that our most hated enemy, the Blackrock orcs, have wised up... I've transferred a few silver over to you for the gnome, erm, gnoll kills.
english.giverWindow: Watch out for canyon ettins!

text.title: 昂格隆格的复仇
text.objectives: 和昂格隆格交手，直到他挣脱束缚。
text.description: 我有个主意，可以让巨魔自相残杀。$B$B邪枝巨魔把一名大个儿的恐怖巨魔用看上去不是很结实的链条锁在斗兽场里。我见过他们打斗，那种大个子要是发起蛮劲来是锁不住的！$B$B我要你去找到那头恐怖巨魔，和他战斗，$n。别把他杀了……揍他就行，直到他两眼发红，然后挣脱锁链一路杀出来！光是他就能叫邪枝巨魔吃不了兜着走！
text.completion: Ain't that a hoot! Wish I could've seen it myself.
text.completed: Return to Doran Steelwing at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: 惹他发火，然后别挡他的道！

english.title: Ongo'longo's Revenge
english.objectives: Fight Ongo'longo until he breaks free.
english.description: I've got a plan to pit troll against troll.$B$BThe Vilebranch have a big ol' dire troll locked up in a pit with some flimsy-lookin' chains. I've seen those things fight, and there's no way those'll hold if that big brute gets swingin' mad!$B$BI want you to find the dire troll and fight him, $n. Don't kill him... just smack him around til' he's seein' red, then let him break free and get out of his way! He'll be a big pain for the Vilebranch.
english.completion: Ain't that a hoot! Wish I could've seen it myself.
english.completed: Return to Doran Steelwing at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: Get him angry, then get out of his way!

text.title: 现在它是我们的了
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗杀死5名邪枝饮血者和5名邪枝噬魂者。
text.description: 现在只剩最强大和最邪恶的邪枝巨魔了。噬魂者和饮血者，都是邪神哈卡卑鄙的崇拜者。$B$B别忘了你不仅仅是在和巨魔战斗，$n。你还是在和黑暗与邪恶力量战斗，不把它们消灭的话，这片土地就会被搅成一片死灰！$B$B不要留情！
text.completion: We've cleared straight through 'em! Jintha'Alor is as good as wiped out!
text.completed: Return to Doran Steelwing at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: It's Ours Now
english.objectives: Kill 5 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers and 5 Vilebranch Soul Eaters in Jintha'Alor.
english.description: Only the strongest and foulest Vilebranch are left now. The soul eaters and blood drinkers, foul worshippers of the evil god Hakkar.$B$BDon't forget you're not just fighting trolls here, $n. You're fighting dark and evil forces that'll churn this land into ash if we let them live!$B$BShow no mercy!
english.completion: We've cleared straight through 'em! Jintha'Alor is as good as wiped out!
english.completed: Return to Doran Steelwing at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 命运之巅
text.objectives: 从辛萨罗山顶的邪枝手里取得8尊蜘蛛神像。
text.description: 你现在得到山顶去，$n。我们的战士无法穿过最后一道大门。他们说它静得像是一座坟墓，没有声音，没有呼吸，没有一丝动静。$B$B他们觉得这是一个陷阱，但从你所带给我的东西看，我担心它比陷阱还要险恶。到祭坛那儿去，调查一下发生了什么……把你能找到的任何神秘物件或是黑暗神像都带给我！你听到了吗？
text.progress: What did you find?
text.completion:
Dead? All of them, around the altar? And you found these spider idols on them...

It's Shadra. The Spider Loa! They're trying to tap her power!
text.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Summit of Fate
english.objectives: Collect 8 Spider Idols from the Vilebranch at the summit of Jintha'Alor.
english.description: You have to go to the summit now, $n. Our warriors won't go past the final gates. They say it's still as a tomb; not a sound, not a breath, not a hint of motion.$B$BThey think it's a trap, but based on what you've brought me, I'm worried it's something even more sinister. Go to the altar, investigate what happened... and bring me back ANY sort of mystical object or dark idol you find! Do you hear me?
english.progress: What did you find?
english.completion:
Dead? All of them, around the altar? And you found these spider idols on them...

It's Shadra. The Spider Loa! They're trying to tap her power!
english.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 枯竭的魔精
text.objectives: 打败“三头怪”昂波达，拿到他的魔精。
text.description: “三头怪”昂波达是你在附近能见到的最大的巨魔。他是个野蛮的屠夫，收集各种魔精，矮人的巨魔的都喜欢！该让他得到报应。$B$B到下层平台去找到那个大块头，取回他的魔精！
text.progress: Let's see it!
text.completion: That's one ugly mug. Maybe he was takin' other heads tryin' to find a prettier one!
text.completed: Return to Doran Steelwing at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: 拿到他的魔精。

english.title: Heads Up
english.objectives: Defeat Umboda Three-Heads and collect his head.
english.description: Umboda Three-Heads is one o' the biggest trolls you'll see around. He's a savage butcher, takin' heads for his own collection, dwarf and troll alike! It's time he got what he deserved.$B$BLook for the big brute on the lower terraces, and you take his own head right back here!
english.progress: Let's see it!
english.completion: That's one ugly mug. Maybe he was takin' other heads tryin' to find a prettier one!
english.completed: Return to Doran Steelwing at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: Bring back his head.  The middle one.

text.title: 只要控制了双头魔
text.objectives: 杀死阿尔多·泥爪。
text.description: 你找到一份豺狼人的文件。这份豺狼人宣传材料半文半白：$B$B犹勒的兄弟们，听泥爪说！泥爪从兽人那里得到了宝珠！泥爪控制双头魔！泥爪把人类碾碎！到瑞斯班洞穴来拿泥爪的爪印吧。洞穴就在西边，隐藏在峡谷里！$B$B<下面有个爪印作为签名。>$B$B<卷轴好像还被咬掉一块。>$B$B或许你该调查一下。
text.completion: <The orb hisses as you touch it.>
text.completed: Use the Ettin Control Orb.

english.title: He Who Controls the Ettins
english.objectives: Kill Ardo Dirtpaw.
english.description: You've stumbled upon a gnoll document. The gnoll that wrote this propaganda is semi-literate:$B$BBROTHERS OF YOWLER, HEAR DIRTPAW! DIRTPAW GIVEN ORB FROM ORCS! DIRTPAW CONTROL ETTIN THINGS! DIRTPAW CRUSH HUMIES! COME GET DIRTPAW PAW-O-GRAPH IN RETHBAN CAVE. CAVE IS WEST, HIDDEN IN CANYON!$B$B<There's a paw print as the signature.>$B$B<There also appears to be a bite taken out of the scroll.>$B$BYou should probably investigate.
english.completion: <The orb hisses as you touch it.>
english.completed: Use the Ettin Control Orb.

text.title: 拯救工头奥斯洛
text.objectives: 使用双头魔控制宝珠控制一名双头魔，用双头魔控制宝珠让被降服的峡谷双头魔举起湖畔镇困住工头奥斯洛的巨石。
text.description: <刚碰到宝珠，你就听到咔嗒的一声轻响。>$B$B<你把宝珠从台座上拿了下来。>$B$B<现在你控制了宝珠，因而也就控制了双头魔。也许你可以操纵双头魔，把压在湖畔镇工头奥斯洛身上的巨石给挪走。去找一只双头魔，在它身上使用宝珠。然后到湖畔镇去。>
text.completion: You used an ettin to remove the boulder that was crushing Foreman Oslow? Incredible work, $n! Oslow will be grateful once he regains his composure.
text.completed: Report to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge.
text.giverWindow: 峡谷双头魔：又丑又坏。

english.title: Saving Foreman Oslow
english.objectives: Use the Ettin Control Orb to control an Ettin and then use the Ettin Control Orb on your Subdued Canyon Ettin to lift the Huge Boulder off of Foreman Oslow at Lakeshire.
english.description: <Upon touching the orb you hear a faint click.>$B$B<You remove the orb from the pedestal.>$B$BYou now control the orb, therefore you now control the ettins. Maybe you can use an ettin to remove the huge boulder currently crushing Foreman Oslow over at Lakeshire. Find an ettin and use the orb on the ettin. Then head over to Lakeshire.
english.completion: You used an ettin to remove the boulder that was crushing Foreman Oslow? Incredible work, $n! Oslow will be grateful once he regains his composure.
english.completed: Report to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge.
english.giverWindow: Canyon Ettins: Ugly and mean.

text.title: 邪恶的面貌
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗用蒂基之炬点燃8张蒂基面具。
text.description: 邪枝巨魔在辛萨罗的墙上到处挂着蒂基面具。我们不能容忍他们下作的妖术和黑魔法。$B$B是时候给他们点颜色，永远撕碎他们的防御了！带上这把火炬，$c。点燃他们的蒂基面具，看着它们烧掉。当他们看见黑暗的塑像被毁，就该知道蛮锤不欢迎他们！
text.completion: The elements dance, and fire consumes. Let the flame show 'em the cost of their wickedness!
text.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Faces of Evil
english.objectives: Use the Tiki Torch to set fire to 8 Tiki Masks at Jintha'Alor.
english.description: The Vilebranch have hung their tiki masks all across the walls of Jintha'Alor. We won't tolerate their foul hexes and dark magic.$B$BIt's time to send a message, and tear down their defenses, all at once! Take this torch, $c. Set fire to their tiki masks and watch 'em burn. They'll know the Wildhammer want them gone when they see their dark idols consumed!
english.completion: The elements dance, and fire consumes. Let the flame show 'em the cost of their wickedness!
english.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 邪恶的面貌
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗用蒂基之炬点燃8张蒂基面具。
text.description: 邪枝巨魔在辛萨罗的墙上到处挂着蒂基面具。神灵已经看不下去了。$B$B带上这把火炬，杀到邪枝中去，$C。点燃他们的蒂基面具。我会在这儿看着他们的结界和妖术消失，看着他们异端的黑巫毒飘散在烟雾中。
text.completed: Return to Kotonga at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Faces of Evil
english.objectives: Use the Tiki Torch to set fire to 8 Tiki Masks at Jintha'Alor.
english.description: The Vilebranch have hung their tiki masks all across the walls of Jintha'Alor. The spirits not gonna be watchin' over them much longer.$B$BTake this torch with ya as ya fight through the Vilebranch, $c. Set fire to their tiki masks. I'll be watchin' from here as their wards and hexes fade away, an' their heretical dark voodoo goes up in smoke.
english.completed: Return to Kotonga at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 那些小东西们
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗抓8只迅捷小蜘蛛。
text.description: 我注意到一件事……辛萨罗到处都是蜘蛛。跟你手掌一样大的小蜘蛛。这事在辛特兰也并非不寻常，不过总有些什么不对劲。$B$B老实说，我不相信巨魔还会养宠物。他们必然是有某种打算。我要你去把那些蜘蛛给我带来。尽量抓活的，我们来看看神灵都怎么说……
text.progress: 让我们看看你有什么本事吧。
text.completion: By Kurdan's beard... these don't look like any spiders I've seen before. Dark magic's at work here.
text.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: All That Skitters
english.objectives: Collect 8 Skittering Spiderlings in Jintha'Alor.
english.description: There's somethin' I've noticed up there... Jintha'Alor's full of spiders. Small ones about as big as yer hand. Not an unusual sight for the Hinterlands, but somethin's amiss.$B$BTo be honest, I don't trust the trolls to keep pets. They're up to somethin'. I need you to bring me some of those spiders. Keep 'em alive if you can, and we'll see what the spirits tell me...
english.progress: Let's see what you've got.
english.completion: By Kurdan's beard... these don't look like any spiders I've seen before. Dark magic's at work here.
english.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 黑暗容器
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗收集5份腐化之血。
text.description: 这里的邪枝巨魔向来崇拜他们的血之神，邪神哈卡。他是一个邪恶而扭曲的实体，很久以前几乎曾一度冲破障碍来到我们的世界，但还是被击败了。$B$B邪枝巨魔还在搅动他们黑暗的锅子，那里面多年前就装了满了血。他们要么是把希望寄托在一个死去很久的神灵上，要么是在做新的打算，只是同样罪恶。$B$B把那些容器给我弄几个来，$n。我们需要把它们和蜘蛛一同检查，看到底发生了什么事！
text.progress: Be careful near those cauldrons, $c. The Vilebranch won't give them up easily!
text.completion:
This isn't just blood... it's venom!

Spiders... venom... I hope I'm wrong about my hunches here, $n.
text.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Dark Vessels
english.objectives: Collect 5 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor.
english.description: The Vilebranch trolls here were always worshippers of the foul god Hakkar, the loa of blood. He was a sick and twisted entity that nearly broke through to our world, but he was defeated long ago.$B$BThe Vilebranch are still stirring their dark cauldrons, ones they filled with blood years before. They're either holding onto hope for a long-dead spirit, or they're up to something new and just as sinister.$B$BGet me those vessels, $n. We need to examine them with the spiders and see just what's going on here!
english.progress: Be careful near those cauldrons, $c. The Vilebranch won't give them up easily!
english.completion:
This isn't just blood... it's venom!

Spiders... venom... I hope I'm wrong about my hunches here, $n.
english.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 剧毒的秘密
text.objectives: 杀死8只沙德拉幼蛛。
text.description: 假如祭品已经奉上，那么沙德拉的实体很快就会蔓延到这个世界来。那个洞穴里可能已经爬满了她的子嗣。$B$B别让它们跑了，$n。把你能找到的所有邪恶蜘蛛都杀掉！
text.completion: Good riddance. May those horrid things never walk these lands again.
text.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Venomous Secrets
english.objectives: Kill 8 Spawn of Shadra.
english.description: If the sacrifice has already been made, Shadra's presence is going to start creepin' into this realm. That cave's probably full of her spawn by now.$B$BDon't let them escape, $n. Slay any of those vile spiders you find!
english.completion: Good riddance. May those horrid things never walk these lands again.
english.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 捕杀守护者
text.objectives: 杀死守护者莫塔加亚，获得沙德拉石板。
text.description: 蜘蛛之神沙德拉……毒蜘蛛女王，黑暗与死亡的神灵！如果那是祭品的话，就说明他们打算孤注一掷地将她带到这里来。$B$B如果邪枝巨魔在举行仪式，我就不能让他们完成。$B$B到辛萨罗顶部祭坛后面的洞穴里去看看。在那深处，可能还潜伏着沙德拉的一名守护者。杀掉她，把她身上的东西带回来，好让我们知道发生了什么事。
text.progress: Be sure you search her body. I don't want any traps laid by the Vilebranch to be hidden by their deaths.
text.completion:
A tablet! If I can read this... this is a ritual to summon Shadra herself into this world, and a list of the idols needed.

You've done a good job slaying the keeper and getting ahold of this, $n.
text.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: 毫无疑问，她肯定缩在洞穴的最深处。

english.title: Hunt the Keeper
english.objectives: Kill Morta'gya the Keeper and obtain the Tablet of Shadra.
english.description: Shadra the spider loa... the venom queen, a spirit of darkness and death! If there's been a sacrifice, they're trying to bring her forth as a last-ditch effort.$B$BIf the Vilebranch are performing rituals, I'm not going to let them finish.$B$BCheck the cave behind the altar at the top of Jintha'Alor. Deep within it, one of Shadra's keepers might still be lurking. Kill her and take whatever she carries back here so we can know what's going on.
english.progress: Be sure you search her body. I don't want any traps laid by the Vilebranch to be hidden by their deaths.
english.completion:
A tablet! If I can read this... this is a ritual to summon Shadra herself into this world, and a list of the idols needed.

You've done a good job slaying the keeper and getting ahold of this, $n.
english.completed: Return to Fraggar Thundermantle at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: She'll be cowering in the back of the cave, no doubt.

text.title: 狮鹫管理员沙拉克·鹰斧
text.objectives: Deliver the Tablet of Shadra to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
text.description: I'd smash this tablet to bits if I had the right, but that's not for me to decide. Gryphonmaster Talonaxe needs to see this.$B$BYou've got to return to Aerie Peak with the tablet. Gryphon Master Talonaxe is in the aviary, tending to the gryphons.$B$BBe swift... and don't let that tablet leave your grasp for a moment!

english.title: Gryphon Master Talonaxe
english.objectives: Deliver the Tablet of Shadra to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
english.description: I'd smash this tablet to bits if I had the right, but that's not for me to decide. Gryphonmaster Talonaxe needs to see this.$B$BYou've got to return to Aerie Peak with the tablet. Gryphon Master Talonaxe is in the aviary, tending to the gryphons.$B$BBe swift... and don't let that tablet leave your grasp for a moment!

text.title: 沙德拉之眼
text.objectives: 在亚戈瓦萨找到沙德拉之眼。
text.description: 狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯派我来对付毒蜘蛛女王沙德拉。征服辛萨罗是不够的……巨魔可以趁我们不注意的时候，重新集结，把这个生物召唤出来。$B$B我们首先要收集神器，用我们的手段把沙德拉带到这个世界里来，然后用我们的铁锤砸烂那恶心的生物。我要你去帮忙寻找神器，给其他巨魔尝尝苦头。$B$B我们需要的第一件是沙德拉之眼，它就被把守在北边的亚戈瓦萨里。
text.progress: Was the tablet right? Did you find the eye?
text.completion: Well done, $n. We'll be knockin' on this bug's door in no time.
text.completed: Return to Gilda Cloudcaller at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

english.title: The Eye of Shadra
english.objectives: Recover the Eye of Shadra from Agol'watha.
english.description: Gryphon Master Talonaxe has sent me here to deal with Shadra, the Venom Queen. The conquest of Jintha'Alor isn't enough... the trolls could regroup and summon this creature later, when we're not expecting it.$B$BWe'll gather the artifacts first, pull Shadra into this world on our own terms, and put our hammers to that foul creature. I'll need you to help find the artifacts, and put a hurt on the rest of the trolls while you're at it.$B$BWe first need the Eye of Shadra, guarded in Agol'watha to the north.
english.progress: Was the tablet right? Did you find the eye?
english.completion: Well done, $n. We'll be knockin' on this bug's door in no time.
english.completed: Return to Gilda Cloudcaller at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 沙德拉之牙
text.objectives: 在爬虫废墟找到沙德拉之牙。
text.description: 我们接下来需要沙德拉之牙。$B$B它被保存在东边的爬虫废墟，由沙德拉的子嗣看守。那些可怕的蜘蛛有一个矮人那么大，比矮人强壮两倍。它们的毒液也很厉害，$n……切莫轻敌。
text.progress: Have you got the fang?
text.completion: There it is... only one left, lad.
text.completed: Return to Gilda Cloudcaller at the Quel'danil Lodge.

english.title: The Fang of Shadra
english.objectives: Collect the Fang of Shadra from the Creeping Ruins.
english.description: We'll need the Fang of Shadra next.$B$BIt's kept in the Creeping Ruins to the east, guarded by Shadra's own spawn. Hideous spiders the size of a dwarf, and twice as strong. Their venom is strong, $n... don't get careless.
english.progress: Have you got the fang?
english.completion: There it is... only one left, lad.
english.completed: Return to Gilda Cloudcaller at the Quel'danil Lodge.

text.title: 沙德拉之壳
text.objectives: 杀死守护者奇尔加，获得沙德拉之壳。
text.description: 只差最后一件，我们就能永远地消灭沙德拉了。$B$B掌握沙德拉之壳的，是蜘蛛之神最后一名活着的高阶女祭司，守护者奇尔加。她站在祖尔祭坛的顶端，被其他盲信的狂热者所守护着。$B$B你得爬上祭坛顶部，将她干掉！那壳就在她的身上。把它带回来。
text.progress: Do you have it?
text.completion: This is it, lad! We're ready!
text.completed: Return to Gilda Cloudcaller at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: 奇尔加是沙德拉的狂热信徒。她不会轻易放弃沙德拉之壳的。

english.title: The Shell of Shadra
english.objectives: Kill Qiaga the Keeper and collect the Shell of Shadra.
