english.description: The final piece is all we need to burn Shadra out for good.$B$BThe Shell of Shadra is held by the spider god's last living high priestess, Qiaga the Keeper. She stands atop the Altar of Zul, guarded by other fanatical zealots.$B$BYou've got to climb that altar to the top and take her out! She'll have the Shell in her possession. Bring it back here.
english.progress: Do you have it?
english.completion: This is it, lad! We're ready!
english.completed: Return to Gilda Cloudcaller at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: Qiaga is a devoted disciple of Shadra.  She will not part with the shell easily.

text.title: 召唤沙德拉
text.objectives: 在沙德拉洛西北、西南，以及东部神殿里使用沙德拉塑像。
text.description: 我们最好的战士准备就绪，塑像也收集起来……是时候了，$n。$B$B我们的计划是这样的。你先我们一步，带着塑像到沙德拉洛的西南边去。你必须打倒守卫的巨魔，在三座神殿里使用塑像。$B$B当你做完这些事之后，沙德拉就会浮现在我们的世界里，我们会在那里满腔怒火地等着她。等你举行完了仪式，就告诉我在现场的手下们！
text.completion: Talonaxe and the boys are right behind. Let's do this!
text.completed: Return to the Wildhammer Lookout at Shadra'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Summoning Shadra
english.objectives: Use the Idol of Shadra at the Northwestern, Southwestern, and Eastern Temples in Shadra'Alor.
english.description: Our best fighters are ready, we've got the idol assembled... it's time, $n.$B$BHere's what we're gonna do. You'll travel southwest to Shadra'Alor ahead of us with the idol. You'll need to use the idol at each of the three temples, fighting through the trolls guardin' them.$B$BWhen you do that, Shadra will emerge into our world, and we'll be right there waiting for her with fury in our hearts. Talk to my boys on the scene as soon as you've performed the ritual!
english.completion: Talonaxe and the boys are right behind. Let's do this!
english.completed: Return to the Wildhammer Lookout at Shadra'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 毒蜘蛛女王沙德拉
text.objectives: 杀死毒蜘蛛女王沙德拉。
text.description: 没时间浪费了，$n！她马上就要从水里出来了！$B$B狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯和他的部下立刻就到，让我们给这只虫子一点颜色看看！
text.completion:
You've done a great thing for the Wildhammer today, $n. I wish Falstad could've been here for that.

On behalf of the whole clan, I'd like to repay you for keeping these lands free from that foul shadow. You've earned this reward.
text.completed: Return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe at Aerie Peak in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Shadra the Venom Queen
english.objectives: Kill Shadra the Venom Queen.
english.description: No time to waste, $n! She's comin' out of the water right now!$B$BGryphon Master Talonaxe is comin' right now with the boys, let's show that bug what for!
english.completion:
You've done a great thing for the Wildhammer today, $n. I wish Falstad could've been here for that.

On behalf of the whole clan, I'd like to repay you for keeping these lands free from that foul shadow. You've earned this reward.
english.completed: Return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe at Aerie Peak in The Hinterlands.

enders.name: 狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯

text.title: 赞吉尔的秘密
text.objectives: 获取5瓶赞吉尔的药剂。
text.description: 多年前，古拉巴什将一名自己人逐出了祖尔格拉布：那个巨魔名叫赞吉尔。原因为何不是很清楚，但我想多半是因为他倾向对所有人都投放一种强大的行为控制药剂有关。不管怎么说，古拉巴什的祭司们和他们的血神已经被消灭了，但流亡者赞吉尔却幸存了下来……$b$b……还有他那强大的行为控制药剂。$b$b我接下来的实验需要他的药剂。去北边的僵尸身上找找看。
text.progress: Excellent... you're not a zombie yet.  That's good. Oh, umm... nothing.  It's just that... that was a potential risk.  Did I forget to warn you?
text.completion: This mixture is... I don't understand it.  Perhaps we need to run some clinical trials.
text.completed: Return to Mixmaster Jasper at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Zanzil's Secret
english.objectives: Obtain 5 vials of Zanzil's Mixture.
english.description: Years ago, the Gurubashi exiled one of their own from Zul'Gurub: a troll by the name of Zanzil.  The reasons why aren't all that clear, but I'd guess it had something to do with his tendency to administer powerful, behavior-altering drugs to anyone he saw.  Anyhow, the Gurubashi priests and their blood god have been slain, but Zanzil the Outcast remains...$b$b...as do his powerful, behavior-altering drugs.$b$bI'd like to get my hands on some, $r.  Check the zombies to the southeast.
english.progress: Excellent... you're not a zombie yet.  That's good. Oh, umm... nothing.  It's just that... that was a potential risk.  Did I forget to warn you?
english.completion: This mixture is... I don't understand it.  Perhaps we need to run some clinical trials.
english.completed: Return to Mixmaster Jasper at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 让我瞧瞧你的本事，赞吉尔
text.objectives: 把加斯帕的丛林冷饮给咕姆尔格、奥古斯和巴索罗姆·软须船长喝。
text.description: 来硬钳避世乐园的旅客都会签一些免责条款，其中一份允许我们在他们身上做一些基本的测试。我得说是时候再次引用这些条款了。$b$b事实上，这次咱们就别给顾客下毒了。为了生意好嘛。$b$b<加斯帕往一个大罐子里搁了点碎冰和赞吉尔的药剂。>$b$b东南边的高塔是个临时监狱。咱们都管它叫“硬钳拘留所”。总之，把这个给囚犯们喝，然后告诉我发生了什么。
text.completion: You don't say!  Well, that certainly is interesting.  In that case... Forget understanding how the stuff works!  I gotta get my hands on that recipe!
text.completed: Return to Mixmaster Jasper at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Let's See What You've Got, Zanzil
english.objectives: Offer Jasper's Jungle Cooler to Gmurgl, Orgus, and Captain Bartholomew Softbeard.
english.description: Visitors to Hardwrench Hideaway sign a number of waivers upon arrival, one of which allows us to perform basic tests on them.  I'd say it's about time we invoked that clause again.$b$bActually, let's avoid poisoning our customers this time.  Better for business.$b$b<Jasper fills a pitcher with Zanzil's Mixture and some crushed ice.>$b$bThe Hideaway's southeastern tower serves as a temporary jail.  "Hardwrench Hoosegow," we call it.  Anyways, give the prisoners a drink and tell me what happens.
english.completion: You don't say!  Well, that certainly is interesting.  In that case... Forget understanding how the stuff works!  I gotta get my hands on that recipe!
english.completed: Return to Mixmaster Jasper at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

objectiveDetails.description: 测试巴索罗姆·软须船长

text.title: 灾难的配方
text.objectives: 从阿博拉兹废墟赞吉尔的追随者手里获得赞吉尔的配方。
text.description: 我得弄到赞吉尔的配方，一定得要。阿博拉兹废墟里赞吉尔的马屁精里肯定有人拿着它。去东边海角岸边，帮我抢过来！
text.progress: Did he use shimmerweed?  I'm guessing he used shimmerweed. No wait... amberseeds!  It's gotta be amberseeds.
text.completion: This is fascinating!  Just think of all the applications! Just so we're clear, I'm not thinking about using this to make an army of slaves or anything like that.  No, no... I'm much more interested in the ogre explosions!
text.completed: Return to Mixmaster Jasper at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Recipe for Disaster
english.objectives: Obtain Zanzil's Formulation from one of Zanzil's followers in the Ruins of Aboraz.
english.description: I need Zanzil's recipe, now more than ever.  One of Zanzil's flunkies at the Ruins of Aboraz must have it on him.  Head east, to the other coast of the Cape, and snatch it for me!
english.progress: Did he use shimmerweed?  I'm guessing he used shimmerweed. No wait... amberseeds!  It's gotta be amberseeds.
english.completion: This is fascinating!  Just think of all the applications! Just so we're clear, I'm not thinking about using this to make an army of slaves or anything like that.  No, no... I'm much more interested in the ogre explosions!
english.completed: Return to Mixmaster Jasper at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 雷霆瀑布
text.objectives: 在暴风城南面的雷霆瀑布捕捉4条紫色鲈鱼，然后把它们交给凯瑟琳·利兰。
text.description: 阿诺德和我在暴风城内外钓鱼，已经有好些年头了。要摸清哪里是钓鱼的好去处，就得这么久。我最喜欢的地方之一是雷霆瀑布。$B$B雷霆瀑布就在暴风城南边的艾尔文森林里，它的特点在于紫色鲈鱼。我从没有在别的地方见到过这种鱼，只在那道瀑布下才有。不过这几天对我和阿诺德来说，去那里有点太远，你能去帮我们钓一些紫色鲈鱼回来吗？
text.progress: 你找到瀑布了嗎?
text.completion: 這些鱸魚看起來太棒了$n。你何不加入我們今晚的炸魚餐會?
text.completed: Deliver the Violet Perch to Catherine Leland in Stormwind City.

english.title: Thunder Falls
english.objectives: Catch 4 Violet Perch from Thunder Falls, south of Stormwind.  Return to Catherine Leland with your catch once you are done.
english.description: Arnold and I have been fishing in and around Stormwind for years now.  That's the kind of time it takes to find a good fishing spot.  One of my favorites is called Thunder Falls.$b$bIt's just south of Stormwind in Elwynn Forest.  Best part about Thunder Falls is the violet perch.  I have never seen them anywhere else, only up there at the falls.  It's a bit of hike for me and Arnold to get out there these days though, do you think you could head up there and fetch some of those perch for us?
english.progress: Were you able to find the falls?
english.completion: These perch look great $n.  Why don't you join us for a fish fry tonight?
english.completed: Deliver the Violet Perch to Catherine Leland in Stormwind City.

text.title: 轰至渣！
text.objectives: 在碎裂前线消灭12只任意种类的石头穴居人。
text.description: 我要你去把他们干掉。$B$B狂暴者、碎地者、逐死者……我不管！我要那些石头穴居人被轰成渣！
text.completion: That's a good dent, but it's clear to me that we're going to have to handle this a slightly different way.
text.completed: Return to Gravel Longslab on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.

english.title: Shatter Them!
english.objectives: Slay any 12 stone troggs on the Fractured Front.
english.description: I want you to go out there and I want you to finish them.$B$BBerserkers, Earthrenders, Deathriders... I don't care! I want those stone troggs shattered!
english.completion: That's a good dent, but it's clear to me that we're going to have to handle this a slightly different way.
english.completed: Return to Gravel Longslab on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死碎裂前线的石头穴居人

text.title: 紧急援助
text.objectives: 从岸边的龙喉哨站找名医师。
text.description: 咱们航空舰队的许多战士没能从暮光的进攻中幸存下来。活下来的正游向舰队残部，不是失血就是严重烧伤。我需要岸上支援，不能让我的人牺牲了！$B$B龙喉哨站里一定有医生或是药草师愿意帮助他的兽人同胞。上岸看看你能不能给舰队带些医疗补给来！
text.completion: If it is Zaela's wish, then you shall have your supplies. Just don't tell the Dragonmaw Warchief...
text.completed: Speak again with Gregor at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Emergency Aid
english.objectives: Seek out a Medicine Man in Dragonmaw Port, somewhere near the shore.
english.description: Many of our warriors didn't survive the Twilight attack on our air fleet. Those that did are swimming to the remains of the fleet, bleeding and badly burned. I need support from the shore to keep my men alive!$B$BThere should be some sort of doctor or medicine man inside of Dragonmaw Port who would be willing to help his fellow orcs out. Go ashore and see if you can bring some medical supplies back to the fleet!
english.completion: If it is Zaela's wish, then you shall have your supplies. Just don't tell the Dragonmaw Warchief...
english.completed: Speak again with Gregor at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 停摆的谈判
text.objectives: 同龙喉哨站的欧纳克交谈。霍尔佐格可以为你提供通往岸边的快速交通。
text.description: 酋长去向不明！但我们的计划还得执行下去。$n，看来你能把事办成。$B$B同龙喉的谈判叫停了。他们的酋长……和我们期望的不一样。我需要你去把谈判重新纳入轨道。$B$B同岸边的欧纳克见面，他会给你说明的。$B$B和甲板上的霍尔佐格对话可以让你迅速前往上岸。
text.completion: I'm glad you're here, $c. Perhaps a seasoned veteran of the Horde's campaigns in Northrend and elsewhere can talk some sense into the Dragonmaw leadership...
text.completed: 同龙喉哨站的欧纳克交谈。霍尔佐格可以为你提供通往岸边的快速交通。

english.title: Stalled Negotiations
english.objectives: Speak with Ornak in Dragonmaw Port. Horzog can provide you with quick transportation to the shore.
english.description: The Warchief's whereabouts are unknown! But we have to keep his plan moving forward. $n, you look like you can get things done.$B$BOur negotiations with the Dragonmaw have stalled. Their Warchief is... not what we expected. I need you to go in there and get negotiations back on track.$B$BMeet with Ornak on the shore, he'll fill you in.$B$BTalk to Horzog on deck here for quick transportation to the shore.
english.completion: I'm glad you're here, $c. Perhaps a seasoned veteran of the Horde's campaigns in Northrend and elsewhere can talk some sense into the Dragonmaw leadership...
english.completed: Speak with Ornak in Dragonmaw Port. Horzog can provide you with quick transportation to the shore.

text.title: 危险的同情
text.objectives: 将一箱龙喉绷带交给龙喉哨站海岸边的督军克罗格。
text.description: 红龙军团代表着生命。因此，他们的血液具有治疗的功效。$B$B这箱绷带在红龙血里浸过。这是我最后的补给了。愿它能让你的战士们迅速恢复。$B$B无论你们协商的结果如何，不要忘记你们在龙喉还有朋友。
text.progress: Do you bring any hope for our wounded?
text.completion: Dragon's Blood!? We best not tell our red dragon allies that we've used these. Still, it's powerful magic... We'll have our fighting force back in no time.
text.completed: Bring the Crate of Dragonmaw Bandages back to Warlord Krogg off the coast of Dragonmaw Port.

english.title: Dangerous Compassion
english.objectives: Bring the Crate of Dragonmaw Bandages back to Warlord Krogg off the coast of Dragonmaw Port.
english.description: The red dragonflight represents the aspect of life. As such, their blood has healing properties.$B$BThis crate of bandages has been soaked in red dragon blood. It is the last of my supply. May it bring a speedy recovery to your warriors.$B$BWhatever the outcome of your negotiations here, do not forget that you have friends among the Dragonmaw.
english.progress: Do you bring any hope for our wounded?
english.completion: Dragon's Blood!? We best not tell our red dragon allies that we've used these. Still, it's powerful magic... We'll have our fighting force back in no time.
english.completed: Bring the Crate of Dragonmaw Bandages back to Warlord Krogg off the coast of Dragonmaw Port.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：辛特兰！
text.objectives: 去找辛特兰鹰巢山的狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向鹰巢山的狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯报到。$B$B联盟的新同胞需要你们的帮助，抵挡部落对他们深爱家园的入侵。从阿拉希高地往北进发，通过山中的矮人小径，沿着西北方的路前往鹰巢山。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: Welcome to Aerie Peak, $n. On behalf of High Thane Falstad, I thank ye for comin' to help us.

english.title: Hero's Call: The Hinterlands!
english.objectives: Travel to Aerie Peak in The Hinterlands and speak with Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Gryphon Master Talonaxe at the aviary in Aerie Peak.$B$BOur new brothers in the Alliance need your help to fend off the aggressive Horde offensive in their beloved homeland. Travel north from the Arathi Highlands, through the dwarven mountain pass and follow the road northwest to Aerie Peak.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Welcome to Aerie Peak, $n. On behalf of High Thane Falstad, I thank ye for comin' to help us.

enders.name: 狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯

text.title: 湿冷的双手
text.objectives: 在奥格瑞玛城南的海岸线东部，收集10份巨大的蚌肉。完成任务之后，向纳兹加尔复命。
text.description: 没什么比新鲜肥美的蚌肉更上等的佳肴了，$n。这几周我忙得团团转，根本没时间到产蚌的水域去。你能去一趟，帮我弄点美味的蚌肉回来吗？$B$B你可以在杜隆塔尔的东部海岸线上找到蚌壳，尤其是奥格瑞玛的码头附近应该有很多。
text.progress: Were you able to find the clams?
text.completion: Looks like you found the clams, $n.  These will do nicely.
text.completed: Deliver the Monstrous Clam Meat to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Clammy Hands
english.objectives: Collect 10 Monstrous Clam Meat from the clams near the eastern shoreline, just south of Orgrimmar.  Return to Razgar once you are done.
english.description: Nothing tastes like fresh monstrous clam meat, $n.  I have been so busy with work these past few weeks that I have not been able to make it out to the local clam spawning grounds.  Think you could run down there and gather some of those tasty treats for me?$b$bThe clams can be found near the shoreline on the eastern coast of Durotar.  Should be plenty right around the Orgrimmar docks.
english.progress: Were you able to find the clams?
english.completion: Looks like you found the clams, $n.  These will do nicely.
english.completed: Deliver the Monstrous Clam Meat to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 他们变聪明了……
text.objectives: 缴获黑石兽人信函。
text.description: <侏儒通讯器劈啪作响。>$B$B看起来，黑石兽人终于放聪明了。我收到报告说他们和豺狼人组成了联军，打算发动进攻。我需要详细的报告，$n！$B$B我要你到赤脊峡谷西部地区的瑞斯班洞穴侦察一下。寻找黑皮肤的兽人。只要遇见就格杀勿论，从他们的尸体上搜点情报出来。$B$B所罗门通话完毕。
text.progress: What have you found out?
text.completion: Just put the missive in the little compartment and I'll read it. I am fluent in orcish. It looks like these orcs are here under the direct command of Yowler. That means Yowler must have the orc invasion plan.
text.completed: Report to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.
text.giverWindow: 黑石兽人就意味着麻烦。

english.title: They've Wised Up...
english.objectives: Recover the Blackrock Orc Missive.
english.description: <The gnomecorder crackles and pops.>$B$BIt would appear that the Blackrock orcs have finally wised up. I'm getting reports that they're joining forces with the gnolls and planning an attack. I want details, $n!$B$BI need you to check out Rethban Caverns, located in the western region of Redridge Canyons. Look for orcs with dark skin. Kill any that you encounter and search their corpses for information.$B$BSolomon, out.
english.progress: What have you found out?
english.completion: Just put the missive in the little compartment and I'll read it. I am fluent in orcish. It looks like these orcs are here under the direct command of Yowler. That means Yowler must have the orc invasion plan.
english.completed: Report to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.
english.giverWindow: Blackrock orcs mean trouble.

text.title: 犹勒必须死！
text.objectives: 杀死犹勒，缴获黑石攻击计划书。
text.description: <侏儒通讯器嗡嗡地响着。>$B$B你要找到犹勒，$n。他就在赤脊峡谷北部地区的某处。杀掉那混血豺狼人，在他的尸体上找到黑石攻击计划书。事成之后，就把计划书带到湖畔镇大厅来给我。$B$B所罗门通话完毕。
text.progress: Do you have the Blackrock invasion plans?
text.completion: Shadowhide army!? Damn those orcs to hell! These invasion plans speak of a massive build up of orcish and gnoll forces in the east. Looks like Gath'Ilzogg, the Blackrock general, is preparing to march his armies across Lakeshire and attack Stormwind directly!
text.completed: Report to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.
text.giverWindow: 犹勒，犹勒之子

english.title: Yowler Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Yowler and recover the Blackrock Invasion Plans.
english.description: <The gnomecorder hums.>$B$BYou need to find Yowler, $n. He'll be located somewhere in the northern region of Redridge Canyons. Kill that mongrel and search his corpse for the Blackrock invasion plans. Should you succeed, bring the plans to me over at the town hall in Lakeshire.$B$BSolomon, out.
english.progress: Do you have the Blackrock invasion plans?
english.completion: Shadowhide army!? Damn those orcs to hell! These invasion plans speak of a massive build up of orcish and gnoll forces in the east. Looks like Gath'Ilzogg, the Blackrock general, is preparing to march his armies across Lakeshire and attack Stormwind directly!
english.completed: Report to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.
english.giverWindow: Yowler, Son of Yowler

text.title: 锋喙之友
text.objectives: 用狮鹫大餐给7头训练有素的锋喙狮鹫喂食。
text.description: 我们的氏族将狮鹫视为神圣的动物。它们是天空中优雅的生物，而不仅仅是野兽，它们非常聪慧而狡黠。$B$B有人说我们在饲养它们，但这更像是一种友谊。如果你想和蛮锤交朋友，首先就得和我们的狮鹫交朋友！拿上这袋新鲜美味的兽肉。我们训练有素的锋喙狮鹫在鹫笼南边的森林里游荡。去帮我喂几只，好不好？
text.completion:
Treat them with respect, and they'll treat you with it as well.

Give 'em guff and you'll be out an eye!
text.completed: Return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe at Aerie Peak in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Razorbeak Friends
english.objectives: Use Gryphon Chow to feed 7 Trained Razorbeak gryphons.
english.description: Our clan reveres the gryphon as a sacred animal. They're majestic creatures of the skies, and more than just beasts; they're intelligent and cunning.$B$BSome say we keep them, but it's more of a friendship. If you want to befriend the Wildhammer here, first befriend our gryphons! Take this bag o' chow, it's nice and fresh. Our trained razorbeak gryphons wander the forests to the south of the aviary. Go on and feed a few of 'em for me, aye?
english.completion:
Treat them with respect, and they'll treat you with it as well.

Give 'em guff and you'll be out an eye!
english.completed: Return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe at Aerie Peak in The Hinterlands.

starters.name: 狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯

enders.name: 狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯

objectiveDetails.description: 喂食训练有素的锋喙狮鹫

text.title: 癞皮的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死8条癞皮银鬃狼。
text.description: 我们尽一切所能保护我们的族人，还有我们的狮鹫。这其中包括赶走捕食者，无论它是来自森林还是来自部落。$B$B目前我还不会要你把我们从两条腿的怪物手里拯救出来。癞皮银鬃狼潜伏在南边的林子里，我们的狮鹫若是飞得过低，就会被它们逮住。去杀掉几只，让它们知道我们的狮鹫可不是拿来吃的。
text.completion: Much appreciated, $n.
text.completed: Return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe at Aerie Peak in The Hinterlands.

english.title: A Mangy Threat
english.objectives: Kill 8 Mangy Silvermanes.
english.description: We do everything we can to protect our kin and our gryphons. That includes chasin' off predators, whether they be from the forest or from the Horde.$B$BI won't ask you to save us from two-legged monsters just yet. Mangy silvermane prowl the woods to the south where our gryphons range, and they're known to get 'em if they stray too low. Hunt a few of the silvermane and make sure they know our gryphons aren't food.
english.completion: Much appreciated, $n.
english.completed: Return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe at Aerie Peak in The Hinterlands.

starters.name: 狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯

enders.name: 狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯

text.title: 前往前线
text.objectives: 跟风暴之羽哨站的科尔·铁眼谈一谈。
text.description: 我们有更紧要的事情需要你的帮助，$n。$B$B部落愈发大胆了。他们进入了我们的领土，开始明目张胆地攻击我们。恶齿森林巨魔在光天化日之下就敢来攻打风暴之羽哨站！$B$B我要你去帮忙。跟外面的戈斯鲁姆谈谈，他会给你一头狮鹫，让你飞到风暴之羽哨站去。到那边以后，科尔·铁眼会做安排的。
text.completion: Good to see you out here! Let's get to it.

english.title: Out to the Front
english.objectives: Speak with Kerr Ironsight at Stormfeather Outpost.
english.description: We need your help with somethin' more pressin', $n.$B$BThe Horde's been gettin' bolder out here. They've moved in on our territory and started attackin' us outright. The Revantusk forest trolls are attackin' Stormfeather Outpost in broad daylight!$B$BI need you to help out. Talk to Guthrum Thunderfist just outside. He'll put you on a gryphon to Stormfeather Outpost. Kerr Ironsight will fill you in when you get there.
english.completion: Good to see you out here! Let's get to it.

starters.name: 狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯

text.title: 疯狂
text.objectives: 把部落交涉者护送到龙喉哨站的主厅去同龙喉酋长莫格霍尔会面。要是你失去了你的交涉者，就去同海边的欧纳克交谈。
text.description: 前去同龙喉酋长谈判的两个交涉者都没能回来。我想咱们需要显示点实力才行。$B$B这一次，我要你同交涉者一块去。他们的酋长也许看到部落全是你这样历经百战的英雄，会三思而行。$B$B只要把我们的交涉者护送到龙喉哨站中央的主要塞去，然后看起来凶一点就好。
text.progress: $N, I understand you're going to speak with our "Warchief" about joining your Horde.$B$BBe careful, $c.$B$BSee me afterwards...
text.completion: Wake up, $n! We don't have much time. I rescued your gear for you. At least now you've seen the foolishness of our leader first-hand. His blood is contaminated, his rage is unquenchable -- and he'll destroy us all trying to defeat the Horde!
text.completed: Speak with Zaela at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Madness
english.objectives: Escort the Horde Negotiator to the main hall in Dragonmaw Port to meet with Warchief Mor'ghor of the Dragonmaw. Speak with Ornak on the coast if you lose your Negotiator.
english.description: Our last two negotiators haven't returned from speaking with the Dragonmaw Warchief. I think we might need to flex a little bit of muscle.$B$BThis time, I want YOU to accompany the negotiator. Their Warchief might think twice once he realizes the Horde is full of battle-hardened heroes like yourself.$B$BSimply escort our negotiator into the main hold in the center of Dragonmaw Port and look menacing.
english.progress: $N, I understand you're going to speak with our "Warchief" about joining your Horde.$B$BBe careful, $c.$B$BSee me afterwards...
english.completion: Wake up, $n! We don't have much time. I rescued your gear for you. At least now you've seen the foolishness of our leader first-hand. His blood is contaminated, his rage is unquenchable -- and he'll destroy us all trying to defeat the Horde!
english.completed: Speak with Zaela at Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 幕后交易
text.objectives: 将古拉巴什熏香放在希里克图腾前，然后听取赞吉尔的阴谋。
text.description: 我的目标，是被古拉巴什部落放逐的流亡者赞吉尔。最近，我听兄弟们说他打算重新加入部落，并打算往劈颅派遣使者。这可不是好消息。$b$b我要你去刺探赞吉尔眼下的计划。带上这焚香，把它放在北边朱布瓦尔废墟的蝙蝠图腾前。希里克会指引你去那里。
text.completion: It is as I suspected.  Zanzil is too haughty to interfere with the squabbles between the Bloodscalps and the Skullsplitters.  No, he is playing a part in a grander scheme... Jin'do the Hexxer is using him to help bring Hakkar back to Zul'Gurub. It's good that we found this out now, because it offers us a simple solution.
text.completed: Return to Chabal at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Backdoor Dealings
english.objectives: Place the Gurubashi Incense in front of the Totem of Hir'eek, then listen to Zanzil's plot.
english.description: Zanzil the Outcast, an exile from the Gurubashi tribe, is my quarry.  Recently, I have heard tales from my brothers in the north about his planned reentry into society, starting with the emissary he sent to the Skullsplitters.  This is not good news.$b$bI want you to peer into Zanzil's current plans.  Take this incense, and place it in front of the bat totem in the Ruins of Jubuwal, to the east.  Hir'eek will guide you from there.
english.completion: It is as I suspected.  Zanzil is too haughty to interfere with the squabbles between the Bloodscalps and the Skullsplitters.  No, he is playing a part in a grander scheme... Jin'do the Hexxer is using him to help bring Hakkar back to Zul'Gurub. It's good that we found this out now, because it offers us a simple solution.
english.completed: Return to Chabal at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

objectiveDetails.description: 将焚香放在希里克图腾前

text.title: 消灭流亡者
text.objectives: 前往荆棘谷海角阿博拉兹废墟对付流亡者赞吉尔。
text.description: 你得去杀掉赞吉尔。希里克的翅膀带你飞翔，希里克的双眼为你所及。去把他杀掉。$b$b哦，对了$r：要是我们走散了，你可以使用这尊神像。它只在荆棘谷有效，不过却可以迅速把你传送到我这里来。$b$b祝你好运，$r。赞吉尔可不是一般的对手。
text.giverWindow: 他搅合药剂的日子结束了。

english.title: Eliminate the Outcast
english.objectives: Travel to the Ruins of Aboraz in the Cape of Stranglethorn and deal with Zanzil the Outcast.
english.description: You are to kill Zanzil.  You rode on Hir'eek's wings and saw through Hir'eek's eyes; you know where Zanzil hides within the Ruins of Aboraz.  Travel there and kill him.$b$bOh, and $r: if we become separated, you should use this fetish.  It only works within Stranglethorn, but it will transport you back here to me should you need to return switfly.$b$bGood luck, $r.  Zanzil is no ordinary opponent.
english.giverWindow: His potion-mixing days are at an end.

text.title: 穿过巨魔洞
text.objectives: 用赞吉尔的传送门进入祖尔格拉布。$b$b假如你迷路了或者需要回到祖尔格拉布，去跟探险者协会挖掘场的梅维克交谈。
text.description: 看来赞吉尔前往祖尔格拉布的传送门还开着。祖尔格拉布是个危险的地方，但梅维克觉得你能胜任。$b$b传送门就在前面正等着你呢。

english.title: Through the Troll Hole
english.objectives: Use Zanzil's Portal and enter Zul'Gurub.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Chabal at Hardwrench Hideaway.
english.description: It looks like Zanzil's portal into Zul'Gurub is still open.  Zul'Gurub is a dangerous place, but Chabal entrusted this task to you.$b$bThe portal lies in wait in front of you.

text.title: 高阶祭司耶克里克
text.objectives: 在赞吉尔复活他之前消灭高阶祭司耶克里克。$b$b假如你迷路了或者需要回到祖尔格拉布，去跟探险者协会挖掘场的梅维克交谈。
text.description: 你的前方涌现出一条坡道，通向城市众多平台之一。前面蝙蝠形状的图腾表明这是的追随者，高阶祭司耶克里克的领域。$b$b耶克里克是众多崇拜哈卡的祭司之一，赞吉尔正打算复活他。假如你动作快，或许可以阻止他的复活！
text.giverWindow: 蝙蝠之灵希里克的追随者。

english.title: High Priestess Jeklik
english.objectives: Destroy High Priestess Jeklik's body before Zanzil can resurrect her.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Chabal at Hardwrench Hideaway.
english.description: Ahead of you looms a ramp up to one of the city's many terraces.  The bat-shaped totems ahead of you indicate that this is the domain of High Priestess Jeklik, a follower of Hir'eek.$b$bJeklik was one of the Hakkar-worshipping priests that Zanzil was planning to resurrect.  Perhaps if you hurry, you can stop the resurrection!
english.giverWindow: Follower of Hir'eek, the bat loa.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭高阶祭司耶克里克的肉身

text.title: 身陷祖尔格拉布
text.objectives: 穿过赞吉尔的传送门。$b$b假如你迷路了或者需要回到祖尔格拉布，去跟探险者协会挖掘场的梅维克交谈。
text.description: 流亡者赞吉尔再次从另一道传送门逃了。追上他！

english.title: Plunging Into Zul'Gurub
english.objectives: Pass through Zanzil's Portal.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Chabal at Hardwrench Hideaway.
english.description: Zanzil the Outcast has once again escaped through one of his portals.  Follow him!

text.title: 高阶祭司温诺希斯
text.objectives: 对付流亡者赞吉尔和高阶祭司温诺希斯。$b$b假如你迷路了或者需要回到祖尔格拉布，去跟探险者协会挖掘场的梅维克交谈。
text.description: 温诺希斯是赞吉尔打算复生的两名祭司之一。你已经成功地摧毁了高阶祭司耶克里克的肉身……温诺希斯将是下一个。
text.completion: I ask you to slay Zanzil the Outcast, a lowly, hermetic exile of the Gurubashi, and what do you do?  You dash headfirst into the Gurubashi capital and eliminate one of their High Priests!  Very nearly two!  Only one word suffices to explain such a rash and foolhardy endeavor: Heroism. Jin'do the Hexxer still walks within Zul'Gurub's walls, but he lost one of his legs when you crushed Jeklik.  Today's battle is ours.
text.completed: Return to Chabal at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 盘蛇之灵赫希斯的追随者

english.title: High Priest Venoxis
english.objectives: Deal with Zanzil the Outcast and High Priest Venoxis.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Chabal at Hardwrench Hideaway.
english.description: Venoxis was the second of the two priests that Zanzil planned to bring back from the dead.  You have already succeeded in destroying the body of High Priestess Jeklik... Venoxis must be the next.
english.completion: I ask you to slay Zanzil the Outcast, a lowly, hermetic exile of the Gurubashi, and what do you do?  You dash headfirst into the Gurubashi capital and eliminate one of their High Priests!  Very nearly two!  Only one word suffices to explain such a rash and foolhardy endeavor: Heroism. Jin'do the Hexxer still walks within Zul'Gurub's walls, but he lost one of his legs when you crushed Jeklik.  Today's battle is ours.
english.completed: Return to Chabal at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: Follower of Hethiss, the snake loa.

objectiveDetails.description: 对付高阶祭司温诺希斯

text.title: 不许倾倒垃圾
text.objectives: 钓起6条剧毒泥鱼。完成任务之后，向荣誉谷的纳兹加尔复命。
text.description: 自从那些地精跑到奥格瑞玛定居以来，他们就把各种废料倒进我们的水源。$B$B我不太清楚这会对我们的水产品供应产生什么样的影响，但肯定不是好事。我听说在地精营地附近的毒水池里出现了一种新的变异鱼类，如果能搞到一些样本的话，就可以帮我搞清楚到底发生了什么事。$B$B你能帮帮我吗？
text.progress: Were you able to fish up a few specimens?
text.completion: Nice work $n.  These samples will help us figure out what is going on in that toxic soup over there.
text.completed: Deliver the Toxic Puddlefish to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

english.title: No Dumping Allowed
english.objectives: Fish up 6 Toxic Puddlefish and return them to Razgar in the Valley of Honor once you are done.
english.description: Ever since those goblins took up refuge in Orgrimmar, they have been dumping all of their waste in our water supply.$b$bI have no idea what effect this is having on our local fishing supply, but I don't think it's good.  I have heard reports of a new mutated fish species spawning in that toxic pool near their camp.  A few specimens would really help me figure out what exactly is going on.$b$bCan you help me out?
english.progress: Were you able to fish up a few specimens?
english.completion: Nice work $n.  These samples will help us figure out what is going on in that toxic soup over there.
english.completed: Deliver the Toxic Puddlefish to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 鹿眼之诱
text.objectives: 在奥格瑞玛北面杀死一头鹿，用它的眼球当鱼饵，在智慧谷中捕捉一条沙地锦鲤。完成任务之后，向荣誉谷的纳兹加尔复命。
text.description: 几年来，我一直在奥格瑞玛的水域里钓沙地锦鲤。最近，我发现我的鱼饵不如以前好用了。我疑心这事跟智慧谷的那些牛头人有关。$B$B我跟他们当中的一位渔夫聊了聊，发现原来是鱼儿们的口味变了，最近它们喜欢吃鹿眼。你应该可以在奥格瑞玛北面找到许多鹿，就在北门外。
text.progress: Did the eye work as bait?
text.completion: Outstanding!  Those sandy carp are picky eaters aren't they?
text.completed: Deliver the Sandy Carp to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

english.title: A Staggering Effort
english.objectives: Slaughter a Stag north of Orgrimmar and use its eye as bait to catch a Sandy Carp in the Valley of Wisdom. Return to Razgar in the Valley of Honor once you are done.
english.description: I've fished sandy carp in Orgrimmar's local waters for years now.  Recently, I have noticed my bait is not working as well as it used to.  I suspect it has something to do with all the tauren that moved into the Valley of Wisdom.$b$bI spoke with one of their local fisherman and it just turns out their appetite has changed.  They are biting on stag eyes these days.  You should be able to find plenty of stags north of Orgrimmar, just outside the northern gate.
english.progress: Did the eye work as bait?
english.completion: Outstanding!  Those sandy carp are picky eaters aren't they?
english.completed: Deliver the Sandy Carp to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 召唤沙德拉
text.objectives: 在沙德拉洛西北、西南，以及东部神殿里使用沙德拉塑像。
text.description: 塑像已经准备好了，$n。我相信你也一样吧？$B$B你将先我们一步前往西南边的沙德拉洛。你要在三座神殿里使用塑像。$B$B完成之后，沙德拉就会被召唤到我们的世界里来。死亡猎手和我稍后会来将其制服，收割她的尸体。等你举行完了仪式，就跟我派出去的哨兵谈谈，然后等我到来。
text.completion: Marnal draws close... and Shadra even closer. Prepare for bloodshed.
text.completed: Return to the Deathstalker Lookout at Shadra'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Summoning Shadra
english.objectives: Use the Idol of Shadra at the Northwestern, Southwestern, and Eastern Temples in Shadra'Alor.
english.description: The idol is prepared, $n. I trust that you are as well?$B$BYou will go southwest to Shadra'Alor ahead of us with the idol. You'll need to use the idol at each of the three temples.$B$BWhen you do that, Shadra will be summoned to this realm. The Deathstalkers and I will be along shortly to subdue and harvest her body. Speak with the lookout I've sent ahead once you've performed the ritual, and await my arrival.
english.completion: Marnal draws close... and Shadra even closer. Prepare for bloodshed.
english.completed: Return to the Deathstalker Lookout at Shadra'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: [NYI] Breaking Out is Hard to Do

english.title: [NYI] Breaking Out is Hard to Do

text.title: 约根森
text.objectives: 获得约根森的牢笼钥匙。
text.description: 我不知道卡拉克尔或丹弗斯在哪儿，不过约根森就关在西北边的撕裂者营地里。他们把我转移到奥瑟尔伐木场之前，我就和他关在同一个笼子里。$B$B如果我们要把他救出来，就得找到钥匙。钥匙管理者乌卓卡是个从地狱里来的心肠恶毒的巫婆，东西在她手上。我们得把她杀掉，才能拿到约根森的牢笼钥匙。她就在北边通往燃烧平原的山谷里。$B$B咱们走，孩子。
text.progress: Messner! Damn, it's good to see a friendly face. Get me out of here!
text.completion: I know where they're holding Krakauer and Danforth. We gotta hurry. They were prepping those two for a sacrifice!
text.completed: Find Jorgensen at Render's Camp in Redridge.

english.title: Jorgensen
english.objectives: Retrieve Jorgensen's Cage Key.
english.description: I don't know where Krakauer or Danforth are, but Jorgensen was being held at Render's Camp, northwest of here. I was in the same crap filled cage with him before they relocated me to Alther's Mill.$B$BIf we're gonna get him out we'll need the key. A stone cold witch from hell known as Utroka the Keymistress holds on tight to that thing. We'll have to kill her if we're going to get Jorgensen's cage key. She's up north in the valley leading to the Burning Steppes.$B$BLet's go, kid.
english.progress: Messner! Damn, it's good to see a friendly face. Get me out of here!
english.completion: I know where they're holding Krakauer and Danforth. We gotta hurry. They were prepping those two for a sacrifice!
english.completed: Find Jorgensen at Render's Camp in Redridge.

text.title: 卡拉克尔
text.objectives: 杀死仪祭师塔拉卡。
text.description: 眼下卡拉克尔就是任人宰割的鱼肉！兽人找了一个古拉巴什的巫医来在他身上举行黑暗仪式。我们得杀掉那个巨魔，救出卡拉克尔！$B$B咱们走！他就在这座山洞里面。第一个岔路往右。
text.completion: Wha... Where am I? What happened? Messner? Jorgensen? OH MY GOSH! We have to get to Danforth! It might already be too late!
text.completed: Speak with Krakauer at Render's Rock in Redridge.

english.title: Krakauer
english.objectives: Kill Ritualist Tarak.
english.description: Krakauer is up on the chopping block as we speak! The orcs brought in a Gurubashi witch doctor to perform a dark ritual on him. We need to kill that troll to free Krakauer!$B$BLet's go! He's just inside the cave here. Hang a right at the first fork.
english.completion: Wha... Where am I? What happened? Messner? Jorgensen? OH MY GOSH! We have to get to Danforth! It might already be too late!
english.completed: Speak with Krakauer at Render's Rock in Redridge.

text.title: 最后但同样重要的……丹弗斯
text.objectives: 杀掉巴尔贝留斯大王，拿到黑石控制杆钥匙，用它救出丹弗斯。
text.description: 丹弗斯在洞穴的另一头遭受拷打。说不好他现在什么状况！我们得赶过去救他！$B$B巴尔贝留斯大王拿着锁住丹弗斯的控制杆钥匙。我们同心协力，就能杀掉巴尔贝留斯那个混蛋。一旦巴尔贝留斯死了，我们就用钥匙把丹弗斯放下来，然后离开这儿！$B$B准备好了吗？
text.progress: Well look at that! The team's all here... everyone but Keeshan.
text.completion: About damn time you sissies showed up. My arms were gettin' tired.

english.title: And Last But Not Least... Danforth
english.objectives: Kill Overlord Barbarius and recover the Blackrock Lever Key. Use the Blackrock Lever Key to free Danforth.
english.description: Danforth's being tortured on the other side of the cave. There's no telling what state he's in by now! We need to get over there and save him!$B$BOverlord Barbarius has the key to the lever holding Danforth up. We work together as a team and we can kill that bastard, Barbarius. Once Barbarius is dead, we use his key to get Danforth down and get out of here!$B$BReady?
english.progress: Well look at that! The team's all here... everyone but Keeshan.
english.completion: About damn time you sissies showed up. My arms were gettin' tired.

text.title: B连归来
text.objectives: 去找赤脊山湖畔镇的托德曼上校。
text.description: 我不知道你是谁，$g先生:小姐;，但你获得了B连的尊敬与敬佩。你成功地解救了我们这帮人，一路上还杀掉了无数兽人。现在我们要还这个人情。$B$B回到湖畔镇报告托德曼上校。我们会找到约翰尼，把好消息亲自送到。B连重新报到，兽人就别想好过了。
text.completion: Unbelievable work, $n. You've managed to rescue the entire Bravo Company from the clutches of the Blackrock orcs? With Keeshan's team rescued and Keeshan's belongings returned, there's no way Keeshan could refuse us.

english.title: Return of the Bravo Company
english.objectives: Report to Colonel Troteman at Lakeshire in Redridge.
english.description: I don't know who you are, $g mister:missy;, but you've earned the respect and admiration of the Bravo Company. You've managed to save all our hides and kill a boatload of orcs in the process. Now we return the favor.$B$BGet back to Lakeshire and report to Colonel Troteman. We'll find Johnny and deliver the good news in person. With the Bravo Company back in action, these orcs don't stand a chance.
english.completion: Unbelievable work, $n. You've managed to rescue the entire Bravo Company from the clutches of the Blackrock orcs? With Keeshan's team rescued and Keeshan's belongings returned, there's no way Keeshan could refuse us.

text.title: 装修改建
text.objectives: 收集6个投石车零件。
text.description: <克莱对你嗤笑了一下，发出来好像是两块石头在一块儿磨蹭的声音。>$B$B它们砸烂了我们所有的投石车。我试着让这辆正常运作，可没能成。$B$B也许你可以派上用场。到前线把能找到的零件都给我拿来。$B$B你觉得你能做到么，肉袋子？
text.progress: Well? I don't have all day.
text.completion: Well then. Maybe you're okay after all. Alright, alright... don't get all bent out of shape. Just give me a few moments with these parts.
text.completed: Return to Clay Mudaxle on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.

english.title: Fixer Upper
english.objectives: Collect 6 Catapult Parts.
english.description: <Clay sneers at you and makes a sound much like two stones rubbing against each other.>$B$BThey've smashed all of our catapults. I've been trying to get this one working, but no luck so far.$B$BMaybe you'd like to make yourself useful. Head out onto the front and grab me any spare parts you come across.$B$BYou think you can handle that, flesh bag?
english.progress: Well? I don't have all day.
english.completion: Well then. Maybe you're okay after all. Alright, alright... don't get all bent out of shape. Just give me a few moments with these parts.
english.completed: Return to Clay Mudaxle on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.

text.title: A Furious Catch (REMOVED)
text.objectives: Catch a Furious Pike in the Southfury River.  The Southfury River can be found just outside Orgrimmar's western gate. Return to Razgar in the Valley of Honor once you are done.
text.description: Are you up for a challenge, $n?  Good, I was hoping you would be.  The southfury river flows just west of Orgrimmar and your challenge can be found within it's mighty flow.$b$bWe are looking for a furious pike.  This mighty fish used to be prevalent in these areas but ever since the floods hit, they have been much harder to find.  Head out to the river and let's see just how good of an angler you really are.
text.completed: Deliver the Furious Pike to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

english.title: A Furious Catch (REMOVED)
english.objectives: Catch a Furious Pike in the Southfury River.  The Southfury River can be found just outside Orgrimmar's western gate. Return to Razgar in the Valley of Honor once you are done.
english.description: Are you up for a challenge, $n?  Good, I was hoping you would be.  The southfury river flows just west of Orgrimmar and your challenge can be found within it's mighty flow.$b$bWe are looking for a furious pike.  This mighty fish used to be prevalent in these areas but ever since the floods hit, they have been much harder to find.  Head out to the river and let's see just how good of an angler you really are.
english.completed: Deliver the Furious Pike to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 侏儒才智的胜利
text.objectives: 跟新工匠镇的工程师格林德斯巴克谈一谈。
text.description: 为了打败碎轮和他的追随者，我们需要手头上能弄来的所有武器、发明和士兵。$B$B你可以在东北方找到工程师格林德斯巴克，他是新一代侏儒聪明才智的代表。嘿，他已经制作了三个还从未爆炸过的原型机！$B$B闲话少说。工程师格林德斯巴克在制造一种机器人，号称可以清理剧毒机场。你应该去见见他，看他是不是要人帮忙来测试一下。
text.completion: So the high tinker himself has heard of my little project? Splendid! I've almost finished my latest prototype, but maybe you can help me chase down those last few parts.
text.completed: 跟新工匠镇的工程师格林德斯巴克谈一谈。

english.title: A Triumph of Gnomish Ingenuity
english.objectives: Speak with Engineer Grindspark in New Tinkertown.
english.description: We will need all the weapons, inventions, and soldiers we can get in order to defeat Razlo Crushcog and his followers.$B$BOver to the northeast, you'll find Engineer Grindspark, one of a new generation of brilliant gnomish minds. Why, he hasn't had an explosion in over three prototypes!$B$BBut enough bragging. Engineer Grindspark is working on a bot that he says will help clean up the toxic airfield. You should introduce yourself to him and see if he needs any help testing it.
english.completion: So the high tinker himself has heard of my little project? Splendid! I've almost finished my latest prototype, but maybe you can help me chase down those last few parts.
english.completed: Speak with Engineer Grindspark in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 约翰·J·基沙恩
text.objectives: 在湖畔镇的湖畔镇旅店征募约翰·J·基沙恩。
text.description: 听说过约翰·基沙恩吗，$n？三次大战里我都是他的指挥官。我这么跟你说吧，那人杀过的兽人比任何活人都要多。如果有人能阻止黑石兽人入侵，那就是约翰·J·基沙恩。我们必须得到他的帮助，不然黑石大军穿过艾尔文后，湖畔镇就将是一处断壁残桓。$B$B我听说他在湖畔镇旅店的地下搏击俱乐部打黑拳。找到他，把你所知的一切都告诉他。
text.completion: Help you? Help these people? These people that would rather spit on me than crack a smile?

english.title: John J. Keeshan
english.objectives: Enlist the help of John J. Keeshan at the Lakeshire Inn in Lakeshire.
english.description: You ever heard of John Keeshan, $n? I was his commanding officer throughout all three great wars. Let me tell you, that man has killed more orcs than any man alive. If anyone can stop the Blackrock orc invasion, it's JOHN J. KEESHAN. We need to get him to help us or Lakeshire will be nothing more than a mound of rubble and ash after that massive Blackrock army marches through to Elwynn.$B$BI heard he was fighting in the underground fight club at the Lakeshire inn. Find him and tell him everything you know.
english.completion: Help you? Help these people? These people that would rather spit on me than crack a smile?

text.title: 和我无关
text.objectives: 去找托德曼上校。
text.description: 是他们要我参加那些战争的，不是我！为了能赢，我尽我所能。于是我被肮脏污秽、满嘴泔水、身上长蛆的兽人当做厕所整整关了五年。当我终于逃了出来，回到我的家乡，得到的是什么？人们唾弃我，反对我，叫我兽人婴儿杀手，还有所有那些卑鄙的鬼话！$B$B不，我想我不会帮你。你回去告诉托德曼，这场战争不关我的事。
text.completion: I'm not giving up on him, $n, and I'm not giving up on Redridge. We need to boost his spirits... Rouse the slumbering monster within him!

english.title: This Ain't My War
english.objectives: Return to Colonel Troteman.
english.description: They asked me to fight in those wars. I didn't ask them! I did what I had to do to win. So I end up getting captured by those filthy, crap-swilling, maggot orcs and for five long years they used me as a toilet. Finally I break out and head back to my hometown and what do I get? People spitting on me, protesting me, calling me a baby orc killer and all kinds of vile crap!$B$BNo, I don't think I'll be helping you. You go back to Troteman and you tell him that this ain't my war.
english.completion: I'm not giving up on him, $n, and I'm not giving up on Redridge. We need to boost his spirits... Rouse the slumbering monster within him!

text.title: 测量设备
text.objectives: 收集5个黑石望远镜。
text.description: 啊，我的救星！我早就听说你要来执行拯救湖畔镇的任务……以及我的桥。我辛辛苦苦花了半辈子建了这座桥，结果被一群天杀的兽人给毁了！$B$B听着，如果你要去撕裂者营地，你能帮我个忙吗？给我从那里的黑石追踪者身上弄点望远镜来，我会用它们来装配我的新测量仪器。
text.progress: Did you recover the spyglasses?
text.completion: Fantastic work, $n! These will come in handy for our next project, the Lakeshire SUPER BRIDGE, meant to traverse the length of Lake Everstill. It should be done in 20 or so years. Give or take a decade or two.
text.completed: Return to Foreman Oslow at Lakeshire in Redridge.

english.title: Surveying Equipment
english.objectives: Recover 5 Blackrock Spyglasses.
english.description: Ah, my savior! I've heard that you're on a mission to save Lakeshire... and my bridge. Yep, worked too damned long on that thing to let it get destroyed by an army of marauding orc monsters!$B$BListen, if you're headed up north towards Render's Camp, would you do me a solid and get me some spyglasses from the Blackrock trackers up there? I could sure use 'em for my new surveying gear.
english.progress: Did you recover the spyglasses?
english.completion: Fantastic work, $n! These will come in handy for our next project, the Lakeshire SUPER BRIDGE, meant to traverse the length of Lake Everstill. It should be done in 20 or so years. Give or take a decade or two.
english.completed: Return to Foreman Oslow at Lakeshire in Redridge.

text.title: 撕裂者大军
text.objectives: 在奥瑟尔伐木场或撕裂者营地击败25名黑石兽人。
text.description: 要去北边吗，啊？跟那些黑石怪物打一场你自己的小仗如何？你怎么说，$n？在奥瑟尔伐木场或撕裂者营地里攻击你看见的所有黑石兽人。击败他们，直到他们知道你的厉害，然后再回来找我，我会大加奖赏你的。$B$B这也许无法阻止黑石入侵，但肯定可以给他们的计划增添一些变数的。
text.completion: You've probably bought us another day, maybe two. Nice work, $n.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Marris at Lakeshire in Redridge.

english.title: Render's Army
english.objectives: Kill any 25 Blackrock Orcs in Alther's Mill or Render's Camp.
english.description: Heading up north, eh? How about you wage your own little war against those Blackrock monsters? What do you say, $n?$B$BKill any Blackrock orc that you see at Alther's Mill or Render's Camp. Kill until your skin turns red from their blood splatter and then come back to me and I'll pay you handsomely.$B$BIt might not stop the Blackrock invasion, but it'll be sure to put a kink in their plans.
english.completion: You've probably bought us another day, maybe two. Nice work, $n.
english.completed: Return to Marshal Marris at Lakeshire in Redridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败奥瑟尔伐木场或撕裂者营地的黑石兽人

text.title: 战争的武器
text.objectives: 获得基沙恩的弓和基沙恩的生存刀。
text.description: 我即将要你去做的事情可不简单，$n。基沙恩把一切都留在了兽人牢狱里，但我要说的不是他的灵魂或者生存意志。$B$B如果我们要让约翰尼做好战争的准备，就要把他宝贵的财物拿回来。基沙恩的弓和生存刀都在兽人手里。$B$B到东边的奥瑟尔伐木场去找两名兽人中士，穆尔顿克和霍尔穆克。基沙恩的装备在他们手上。全都拿回来。$B$B我会通过侏儒通讯器保持联络。
text.progress: Did you terminate Murdunk and Homurk?
text.completion: Come in, $n. Do you copy? Troteman here! Great job on getting Keeshan's weapons back! Now there's one final mission you have to run. Are you up to the challenge?
text.completed: Return to Colonel Troteman at Lakeshire in Redridge.
text.turninWindow: 你派了那么多人，有一件事切不能忘记。带够裹尸袋。

english.title: Weapons of War
english.objectives: Recover Keeshan's Bow and Keeshan's Survival Knife.
english.description: What I'm about to ask of you isn't going to be easy to accomplish, $n. Keeshan left everything back there in that orc prison, and I'm not just talking about his soul or his will to live.$B$BIf we're going to get Johnny ready for war, we need to recover his prized possessions. The orcs now hold Keeshan's bow and his survival knife.$B$BHead to Alther's Mill, east of here and look for two orc lieutenants, Murdunk and Homurk. They've got Keeshan's gear. Get it back.$B$BI'll be in touch via gnomecorder.
english.progress: Did you terminate Murdunk and Homurk?
english.completion: Come in, $n. Do you copy? Troteman here! Great job on getting Keeshan's weapons back! Now there's one final mission you have to run. Are you up to the challenge?
english.completed: Return to Colonel Troteman at Lakeshire in Redridge.
english.turninWindow: You send that many, don't forget one thing. A good supply of body bags.

text.title: 金色的机遇
text.objectives: 前往奥格瑞玛南边的雷霆山，使用纳兹加尔的鱼肉切片刀切下一条淹死的雷霆蜥蜴尾巴。然后在金鳞石鱼附近使用这条尾巴，将其杀死。完成任务之后，向荣誉谷的纳兹加尔复命。
text.description: 你听说过金鳞石鱼吗，$n？这种鱼是没法通过正常手段捕获的，它们的颚非常有力，可以咬断任何鱼钩或鱼饵。$b$b你可以在奥格瑞玛南边的雷霆山找到许多金鳞石鱼。那座山上曾经生活着许多雷霆蜥蜴，但是它们都被大洪水淹死了。$b$b拿着我的小刀，游到那里去砍下它们的尾巴，你可以用这种蜥蜴尾巴搞定金鳞石鱼。
text.progress: How did it go down there?  Any luck with the tails and the stonefish?
text.completion: Nice one, $n!  I tell ya, golden stonefish are not easy to come by so this is a nice treat.
text.completed: Deliver the Golden Stonefish to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

english.title: A Golden Opportunity
english.objectives: Use Razgar's Fillet Knife to cut off a Drowned Thunder lizard Tail in Thunder Ridge, south of Orgrimmar.  Once you have the tail, use it near a Golden Stonefish to kill it. Return to Razgar in the Valley of Honor once you are done.
english.description: You heard of the golden stonefish, $n?  The thing with these fish is that they can't be caught by normal means.  They have jaws so strong that they snap right though any hooks or lures you try to use on 'em.$b$bYou can find a number of them in Thunder Ridge, south of Orgrimmar.  That ridge used to be full of thunder lizards, but they all drowned in the flood.$b$bTake my knife, swim down there and cut off their tails.  You should be able to use the tail to zap any stonefish you find.
english.progress: How did it go down there?  Any luck with the tails and the stonefish?
english.completion: Nice one, $n!  I tell ya, golden stonefish are not easy to come by so this is a nice treat.
english.completed: Deliver the Golden Stonefish to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 他的心必须在
text.objectives: 获得基沙恩的红头带和基沙恩的翡翠坠饰。
text.description: <侏儒通讯器咔嗒响了。>$B$B光有他的装备还不够，$n。得让他的心回到这场战斗里来。为此，我们就需要几件纪念性的物品。北边撕裂者营地里的黑石兽人拿着另外两件属于基沙恩的东西。$B$B到那里去，在他们的保险箱里找到基沙恩的头带，还有一副他妻子留给他的翡翠坠饰——她在一次黑石兽人入侵中被残忍地杀害了。$B$B事成之后把它们带回来。
text.progress: Did you locate the headband and amulet?
text.completion: I hope with these items and with his crew all rescued he'll have a change of heart. We can't do this without Keeshan.
text.completed: Return to Colonel Troteman at Lakeshire in Redridge.
text.giverWindow: 他们把他……榨干了。

english.title: His Heart Must Be In It
english.objectives: Recover Keeshan's Red Headband and Keeshan's Jade Amulet.
english.description: <The gnomecorder clicks.>$B$BHis gear alone won't be enough, $n. His heart must also be in this battle. To capture that, we need items of sentimental value. The Blackrock orcs of Render's Camp, located in the north, hold two such items that belong to Keeshan.$B$BGet up there and search their coffers for Keeshan's headband and a jade amulet left to him by his wife - who was brutally killed during a Blackrock orc invasion.$B$BBring them back to me should you succeed.
english.progress: Did you locate the headband and amulet?
english.completion: I hope with these items and with his crew all rescued he'll have a change of heart. We can't do this without Keeshan.
english.completed: Return to Colonel Troteman at Lakeshire in Redridge.
english.giverWindow: They shaved him... dry.

text.title: 艾德娜的秘密营地
text.objectives: 跟菲拉斯蔽日林的艾德娜谈一谈。
text.description: 珊蒂斯女士已经点名要你进一步帮助我们了。$B$B艾德娜已经向东边进发，在木爪豺狼人的地界上，莫沙彻营地的南边建立了根据地。如果你想进一步援助珊蒂斯女士和联盟，就去那边向她报告。$B$B不要太接近莫沙彻营地……部落会毫不犹豫地向你发动进攻。往南走，留意我们的旗帜。
text.completion: Welcome to Shadebough, $n. Lady Shandris sent word of you.

english.title: Adella's Covert Camp
english.objectives: Report to Adella at Shadebough in Feralas.
english.description: Lady Shandris has already asked for you to assist us further.$B$BAdella has struck out to the east, among the woodpaw gnolls, and established a foothold south of Camp Mojache. You are to report to her if you wish to assist Lady Shandris and the Alliance further.$B$BDon't stray too close to Camp Mojache... the Horde will not hesitate to attack. Keep to the south and look for our banners.
english.completion: Welcome to Shadebough, $n. Lady Shandris sent word of you.

text.title: 石之底
text.objectives: 杀死戈尔贡尼特。
text.description: 我还有一个忙要你帮，血肉之躯。$B$B有一只石化蜥蜴，比其它的都要大，都要老。尽管通常我们都不怕它们，不过这一只却有可能足以石化我的孩子们。这可不允许。$B$B去东边找到戈尔贡尼特并杀掉他。他活得也够长了。
text.completion: Thank you, $r. You've done all that I can ask of you. I shall impart my favor for you to the Stonemother.$B$BMay the stone beneath your feet hold you steady during your quest for the World Pillar.
text.completed: Return to Kor the Immovable amongst the Shuddering Spires in Deepholm.
text.giverWindow: 柯尔之子的灾祸。

english.title: Rock Bottom
english.objectives: Kill Gorgonite.
english.description: I've one more favor to ask, fleshling.$B$BThere is a basilisk, much larger and much older than the rest. Though we normally fear nothing from their kind, this one has become so potent as to petrify some of my sons. This shall not be abided.$B$BFind Gorgonite to the east and slay him. He has lived much longer than necessary.
english.completion: Thank you, $r. You've done all that I can ask of you. I shall impart my favor for you to the Stonemother.$B$BMay the stone beneath your feet hold you steady during your quest for the World Pillar.
english.completed: Return to Kor the Immovable amongst the Shuddering Spires in Deepholm.
english.giverWindow: Bane of the Sons of Kor.

text.title: 坚定者的手腕
text.objectives: 跟苍白栖地的坚定者特尔拉斯谈一谈。
text.description: 在北边不远的地方，你可以找到坚定者特尔拉斯。他接受的任务是将石龙们收拾服帖。我们每几百年就要重复一次这种仪式……那些石龙反复无常，只屈从于力量。$B$B特尔拉斯通情达理，不偏不倚，但他的目标不是那么容易就能实现的。去找他。向石母诉诸更为公平的一面。
text.completion: Greetings, $r. I have been told of your coming. If you wish to aid me, then perhaps I can be of aid to you as well.

english.title: Steady Hand
english.objectives: Speak to Terrath the Steady at the Pale Roost.
english.description: Nearby to the north, you will find Terrath the Steady. He has taken upon the task of pulling the stone dragons back into the fold. We find ourselves repeating this trial every few hundred years... the stone dragons are fickle, and bend only to strength.$B$BTerrath is balanced and reasonable, but his goals may not be easily accomplished. Go to him. Appeal to the more balanced side of the Stonemother.
english.completion: Greetings, $r. I have been told of your coming. If you wish to aid me, then perhaps I can be of aid to you as well.

text.title: 岩间动乱
text.objectives: 跟赤红岩床的动荡者格尔西克谈一谈。
text.description: 格尔西克在东边的赤红岩床那里。他是我们当中情绪最不稳定，也最暴力的一个。他既不友好，又不信任他人，但他的话很有份量。$B$B同格尔西克建立信任，你就在同石母建立信任的路上前进了一大步。
text.completion: You are Diamant's chosen. So small. So fragile. Do you realize that your actions shall be the basis by which your entire, "Earthen Ring" is judged? You truly think you can stand for so many? You are a fool. A confident fool. We shall see if you are a capable fool as well.

english.title: Rocky Upheaval
english.objectives: Speak to Gorsik the Tumultuous upon the Crimson Expanse.
english.description: To the east, on the Crimson Expanse, you will find Gorsik. He embodies the more unstable and violent nature of our kind. He is neither friendly, nor trusting, but his word carries weight.$B$BProving yourself to Gorsik will go a long way towards proving yourself to the Stonemother.
english.completion: You are Diamant's chosen. So small. So fragile. Do you realize that your actions shall be the basis by which your entire, "Earthen Ring" is judged? You truly think you can stand for so many? You are a fool. A confident fool. We shall see if you are a capable fool as well.

text.title: 末日菇
text.objectives: 摧毁10株末日菇。
text.description: 降临到你们世界的裂隙也毒害着我们的家园。腐败、污染着它。$B$B不停地扩大、溃脓，在这污浊之下几乎难见岩石的纯净。$B$B要是你愿意伸出援手，去净化这一传染。你要找的是比其他品种明显生长得都要快的蘑菇。它们是祸害之首。
text.completion: You have appealed to Diamant. He is patient. Trusting. Perhaps too much so. You have much to prove if you wish my favor, $r. Still, this is a start.
text.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous in the Crimson Expanse.

english.title: Doomshrooms
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Doomshrooms.
english.description: The rift to your world has poisoned our home. Corrupted it. Polluted it.$B$BThis expanse festers and grows. It becomes difficult to even see the purity of the rock beneath this filth.$B$BIf you are here to lend your aid, then go about cleansing this overgrowth. Look for the brightly glowing mushrooms that are growing faster than the others. They are the worst of the offenders.
english.completion: You have appealed to Diamant. He is patient. Trusting. Perhaps too much so. You have much to prove if you wish my favor, $r. Still, this is a start.
english.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous in the Crimson Expanse.

text.title: 软化
text.objectives: 杀死8头真菌巨兽。
text.description: 我们周围的真菌巨兽染上了一种毛病，同感染你们的类似。它们的皮肤不再坚硬。它们不复属于岩石。$B$B杀掉它们，我们不希望感染被传播。
text.completion: You carry with you a certain degree of potency. I can find some respect for such strength, especially in your kind. My concerns are not yet abated. Not for the source of the overgrowth, and not for you.
text.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous on the Crimson Expanse.

english.title: Gone Soft
english.objectives: Kill 8 Fungal Behemoths.
english.description: The fungal behemoths that surround us have succumbed to a weakness very similar to that that affects your kind. Their skin has grown soft. They no longer belong with the stone.$B$BKill them. We do not wish to see this infection spread.
english.completion: You carry with you a certain degree of potency. I can find some respect for such strength, especially in your kind. My concerns are not yet abated. Not for the source of the overgrowth, and not for you.
english.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous on the Crimson Expanse.

text.title: 熟悉的入侵者
text.objectives: 跟赤红岩床“血肉之躯”的入侵者们谈一谈。
text.description: 血肉之躯。你的一些同类逡巡在岩石中。懦弱得不敢接近，又快得难以碾碎。$B$B要是你想赢得我的欣赏，对付他们。我厌倦这种游戏了。
text.completion: It is good to see you again, brother. I see that your efforts go well. The Stone Lords appear to be showing you some degree of trust. We've come to help. We might be of some aid in tracking down the source of this sudden growth. I highly suspect your giant friend's aggressions are focused in the wrong direction.

english.title: Familiar Intruders
english.objectives: Speak to the "fleshling" intruders in the Crimson Expanse.
english.description: Fleshling. Some of your kind skitter among the rocks. Too cowardly to approach, too swift to be crushed.$B$BIf you wish my favor, deal with them. I tire of these games.
english.completion: It is good to see you again, brother. I see that your efforts go well. The Stone Lords appear to be showing you some degree of trust. We've come to help. We might be of some aid in tracking down the source of this sudden growth. I highly suspect your giant friend's aggressions are focused in the wrong direction.

text.title: 两耳清风
text.objectives: 将洛瓦留斯的风灵怪带到赤红岩床的水域旁的红色雾状云去，并采一份样本回来。
text.description: 我不是德鲁伊，但这些蘑菇看来不像是天然品种。我知道我们的石领主朋友倾向于怪罪艾泽拉斯，但我怀疑这更可能是在本地引起的。$B$B我在东北边看到几团红雾般的云团仿佛刺激了新的生长。带上一只我的风灵怪，给我采集一些云朵的样本来。你回来以后，我就能知道它们到底是否魔法所为。你可能得靠近地面才能看到它们。
text.completion: You let the mist touch your skin? I hope there weren't any adverse affects.
text.completed: Return with the sample to Windspeaker Lorvarius in the Crimson Expanse.

english.title: A Head Full of Wind
english.objectives: Bring Lorvarius' wind-devil to the clouds of red mist in the Crimson Expanse, near the water, and then return with a sample.
english.description: I'm no druid, but some of these mushrooms do not look to be naturally occurring. I know that our Stone Lord friend over there is eager to blame this on exposure to Azeroth, but I suspect more domestic causes.$B$BI saw some clouds of red mist to the northeast, near the water's edge. They seemed to be spurring new growth in their wake. Take one of my wind-devils with you and get me a sample from those clouds. You may have to stay close to the ground to spot them.
english.completion: You let the mist touch your skin? I hope there weren't any adverse affects.
english.completed: Return with the sample to Windspeaker Lorvarius in the Crimson Expanse.

text.title: 非自然原因
text.objectives: 跟赤红岩床的动荡者格尔西克谈一谈。
text.description: 这基本上可以肯定是魔法所为。甚至不是德鲁伊魔法。我认为北边的一只石头穴居人很可疑。$B$B去找格尔西克并为他指明方向。但愿这能博得他的欣赏。
text.completion: The stone troggs? And I am to trust you at your word? I have no love for the Verlok anyway. Suspicion is more than enough reason to lay waste to them. We shall see if your word is true.

english.title: Unnatural Causes
english.objectives: Speak to Gorsik the Tumultuous in the Crimson Expanse.
english.description: This is most definitely magic in origin. Not even druidic. I suspect one among the stone troggs to the north.$B$BGo to Gorsik and point him in their direction. Hopefully this will help earn his favor.
english.completion: The stone troggs? And I am to trust you at your word? I have no love for the Verlok anyway. Suspicion is more than enough reason to lay waste to them. We shall see if your word is true.

text.title: 真菌占卜者之怒
text.objectives: 跟大地治愈者诺莎拉谈一谈，然后杀掉真菌占卜者戈洛普。
text.description: 他们的头领藏在前面的洞窟里。就是他把瘟疫带到赤红岩床来的。$B$B必须干掉她。$B$B你在大地之环的一名伙伴已经在里面了，你可以同她谈谈。
text.completion: Well done, $r. Gorsik shall hear of your deed. Therazane shall hear of your deed. You are quite vicious for one so small... and so soft.
text.completed: Return to Ruberick in the lower portion of Verlok Stand.
text.giverWindow: 毒菇怪客本尊。

english.title: Wrath of the Fungalmancer
english.objectives: Speak to Earthmender Norsala, then kill Fungalmancer Glop.
english.description: Their leader hides within his hole ahead. He is the one that has brought the plague upon the crimson expanse.$B$BHe must be killed.$B$BOne of your Earthen Ring companions is already inside. You should speak with her.
english.completion: Well done, $r. Gorsik shall hear of your deed. Therazane shall hear of your deed. You are quite vicious for one so small... and so soft.
english.completed: Return to Ruberick in the lower portion of Verlok Stand.
english.giverWindow: The Shroomgroomer himself.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟大地治愈者诺莎拉谈一谈

text.title: 摇一摇晃一晃
text.objectives: 在维罗克岩台下层杀死8名维罗克石柱翻滚者。
text.description: 我已派兄弟们前去攻打维罗克村庄。维罗克会聚集在他们的石崖边，一如他们一贯躲避我们一般。要是他们那样的话，我们就要让大地摇晃起来，把他们摔在我们脚下。$B$B这时候你就要派上用场了。当他们掉下来落入我们弟兄当中，确保他们站不起来。
text.completion: Well done fleshling. Your presence complimented my brothers well.
text.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous in the Crimson Expanse.

english.title: Shaken and Stirred
english.objectives: Kill 8 Verlok Pillartumblers in the lower section of Verlok Stand.
english.description: I have sent my brothers to assault the Verlok village from below. The Verlok will gather on their rocky ledges, as they always do to avoid our ire. When they do, we shall make the earth itself shake them until they fall at our feet below.$B$BThat is where you prove your use. When they fall to the ground amongst my brothers, make sure that they do not rise again.
english.completion: Well done fleshling. Your presence complimented my brothers well.
english.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous in the Crimson Expanse.

text.title: 腐坏的覆灭
text.objectives: 收集8包维罗克的神奇增长素。
text.description: 假如这次恶心的生长的确是维罗克所致，那么他们的补给应该就在北边的村庄里。把它们给我带来，我好确认你说的是否属实。
text.progress: I await your proof, $r...
text.completion: So your words prove true. You have my gratitude, $r.
text.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous in the Crimson Expanse.

english.title: Corruption Destruction
english.objectives: Retrieve 8 bags of Verlok Miracle-Grow.
english.description: If this disgusting growth is truly brought on by the Verlok, then their supplies will be in their village to the north. Bring them to me so that I can verify your claims.
english.progress: I await your proof, $r...
english.completion: So your words prove true. You have my gratitude, $r.
english.completed: Return to Gorsik the Tumultuous in the Crimson Expanse.

text.title: 寻找B连
text.objectives: 到奥瑟尔伐木场去找一名B连成员。
text.description: 如果你和基沙恩要保卫湖畔镇，我们就要找到他的旧部。我知道的最新消息是，他们所有人——梅森纳、约根森、卡拉克尔还有丹弗斯——都被黑石兽人给抓了。现在我不知道他们可能在哪儿，或者是不是还活着，但如果我不让你去试着找到他们，我就是一个该死的傻瓜。$B$B到东边奥瑟尔伐木场找找看有没有线索。
text.completion: Keeshan? You mean JOHNNY'S ALIVE? You bet your sweet behind I'll help, but first you gotta get me out of this damned cage.

english.title: In Search of Bravo Company
english.objectives: Search Alther's Mill for a member of the Bravo Company.
english.description: If you and Keeshan are going to defend Lakeshire, we're going to need to find his old battalion. Last I heard all of 'em - Messner, Jorgensen, Krakauer and Danforth - were captured by the Blackrock orcs. Now I don't know where they could possibly be or if they're even alive, but I'd be a damned fool if I didn't ask you to try and find 'em.$B$BSearch Alther's Mill, east of here, for any clues.
english.completion: Keeshan? You mean JOHNNY'S ALIVE? You bet your sweet behind I'll help, but first you gotta get me out of this damned cage.

text.title: 越狱不容易
text.objectives: 获得梅森纳的牢笼钥匙。
text.description: 牢笼的钥匙存放在北边座狼洞穴里的一个小包里。问题是那个小包安全地放在一棵树桩上，周围则是海量的嗜血杀人座狼。$B$B要想不惊醒那些熟睡的座狼拿到钥匙，你只有一次机会。想办法到座狼洞穴的中心去，小心你的步伐，当心黑石狼骑首领。拿到钥匙然后回来。$B$B如果你有一只宠物，我建议你告诉它别跟着！
text.progress: Did you get the cage key?
text.completion: 还债的时候到了！
text.completed: Return to Messner at Alther's Mill in Redridge.

english.title: Breaking Out is Hard to Do
english.objectives: Retrieve Messner's Cage Key.
english.description: The key to this cage is stored in a pouch over at the worg den, just north of our location. The problem is that the pouch is resting safely atop a tree stump amidst a sea of bloodthirsty man-killing worgs.$B$BYou've got one shot to get that key without waking up any of those sleeping worgs. Head to the worg den and find a way into the center. Tread carefully and watch out for the Blackrock worg captain. Get the key and return to me.$B$BIf you got a pet, I'd recommend telling it to stay back!
english.progress: Did you get the cage key?
english.completion: IT'S PAYBACK TIME!
english.completed: Return to Messner at Alther's Mill in Redridge.

text.title: 狂怒的大鱼
text.objectives: 在怒水河中捕捉一条巨型狂怒之刺，怒水河就在奥格瑞玛西边的大门外。完成任务之后，向荣誉谷的纳兹加尔复命。
text.description: 你想挑战一下自己吗，$n？很好，我就知道你会的。奥格瑞玛西面有一条怒水河，你将要在它湍急的水流中迎接挑战。$b$b我们正在寻找一条巨型狂怒之刺。这种贵重的鱼曾经大量生活在这一区域，但是自从大洪水过后，就很难找到大鱼了。到怒水河去，看看你的垂钓技术究竟有多么出众吧。
text.progress: Were you able to catch a giant pike?
text.completion: $n, you got one!  It's a rare day that I get to see such a strong, beautiful fish.
text.completed: Deliver the Giant Furious Pike to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

english.title: A Furious Catch
english.objectives: Catch a Giant Furious Pike in the Southfury River.  The Southfury River can be found just outside Orgrimmar's western gate. Return to Razgar in the Valley of Honor once you are done.
english.description: Are you up for a challenge, $n?  Good, I was hoping you would be.  The southfury river flows just west of Orgrimmar and your challenge can be found within its mighty flow.$b$bWe are looking for a giant furious pike.  This esteemed fish used to be prevalent in these areas but ever since the floods hit, the big ones have been much harder to find.  Head out to the river and let's see just how good of an angler you really are.
english.progress: Were you able to catch a giant pike?
english.completion: $n, you got one!  It's a rare day that I get to see such a strong, beautiful fish.
english.completed: Deliver the Giant Furious Pike to Razgar in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 菲拉斯的荒野
text.objectives: 到菲拉斯去跟阿塔亚营地的努·符文图腾谈一谈。
text.description: 你能来帮助我们保护这片土地，真是勇气可嘉，英雄。假如你愿意为荒野付出更多，还有其他人需要你的援助。$B$B菲拉斯的青翠森林就在南方。那里，在伟岸的双塔山庇荫下，你一定要找到克努·符文图腾。他发现了某种恶疾的迹象。$B$B沿着道路往西，绕过双塔山，就是阿塔亚营地。一路平安，$n，愿大地母亲与你同行。
text.completion: Peace, friend. I wish we could have met under less troubling circumstances.

english.title: The Wilds of Feralas
english.objectives: Travel to Feralas and speak with Konu Runetotem at Camp Ataya.
english.description: You are truly brave to help us protect these lands, hero. If you wish to do more for the wilds, there are others in need of your aid.$B$BThe verdant forests of Feralas lie to the south. There, in the shade of the mighty Twin Colossals, you must seek out Konu Runetotem. He has found signs of a disturbing illness.$B$BFollow the road west around the Twin Colossals to find Camp Ataya. Go in peace, $n, and walk with the Earth Mother.
english.completion: Peace, friend. I wish we could have met under less troubling circumstances.

text.title: 澄澈圣水
text.objectives: 从荆棘谷海角纳克迈尼圣泉里打上澄澈圣水。
text.description: 嘿，听着。你看来不像是游客，而我有点麻烦要处理。我北边的表兄给我送来了这个奇怪的神器，我需要你帮我……嗯……鉴定一下。$b$b首先呢，我要你去取点澄澈圣水。谣传无论谁喝了，都能拨云见日，醍醐灌顶。$b$b听上去很诱人，不是吗？$b$b去纳迦营地顶上的纳克迈尼圣泉打点过来。祝你好运！
text.progress: The Holy Water of Clarity?  Is it here!?
text.completion: Ahh... do you know how hard it is to get fresh water in Stranglethorn?  It's no wonder that the nagas guard their shrine so ferociously! Oh, right... that artifact.  Clarity... I've got it!
text.completed: Return to Flem Gizzix at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Holy Water of Clarity
english.objectives: Obtain The Holy Water of Clarity from the Nek'mani Wellspring in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: Hey, listen.  You don't look like any old tourist, and I'm in a bit of a pickle.  My cousin up north sent me this weird artifact, and I need your help to... ah... identify it.$b$bTo start out, I'm going to need you to obtain The Holy Water of Clarity.  Rumor has it that whoever drinks from this spring is given a vision of clarity.$b$bSounds pretty promising, doesn't it?$b$bObtain it from the Nek'mani Wellspring at the peak of the naga camp.  Good luck!
english.progress: The Holy Water of Clarity?  Is it here!?
english.completion: Ahh... do you know how hard it is to get fresh water in Stranglethorn?  It's no wonder that the nagas guard their shrine so ferociously! Oh, right... that artifact.  Clarity... I've got it!
english.completed: Return to Flem Gizzix at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 战地治疗
text.objectives: 包扎10名受伤的土灵。
text.description: 你看起来腿脚不慢，$r。我要个人去打成一锅粥的前线包扎伤员。$B$B带上我的急救包，应该不难用。$B$B赶在石头穴居人结果他们之前治好他们。
text.completion: If you ever get tired of your being a $c, come look me up. You seem very good with those fleshy hands of yours.
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Deepvein on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.

english.title: Battlefront Triage
english.objectives: Patch up 10 Injured Earthen.
english.description: You seem quick on your feet, $r. I need someone to go out into the chaos of the front and patch up our injured.$B$BTake my kit. It's simple enough to use.$B$BHeal them before the stone troggs finish them off for good.
english.completion: If you ever get tired of your being a $c, come look me up. You seem very good with those fleshy hands of yours.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Deepvein on the Fractured Front in Deepholm.

text.title: 分示检色仪
text.objectives: 获得一颗血帆红宝石和一颗血帆蓝宝石。
text.description: 要想正确鉴定这件神器，我需要分析工具。我想，能有一台分示检色仪就行了。$b$b最难入手的部分，秘银外壳我已经拿到了。我们只需要另外两个部分：一颗红宝石和一颗蓝宝石。$b$b附近就有海盗出没，就在南边，然后朝东边稍微过去一点。海盗们都爱财宝……你干嘛不去帮我看看他们有没有我要的宝石呢？
text.progress: Are those gems I see?
text.completion: Yes, these will do.  Now to perform the analysis... Oh, you're still here?  You don't think I'm a fraud or something, do you?
text.completed: Return to Flem Gizzix at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Diffractory Chromascope
english.objectives: Obtain a Bloodsail Ruby and a Bloodsail Sapphire.
english.description: To properly identify this artifact, I will need tools for analysis.  A diffractory chromascope should suffice, I think.$b$bI already have the mithril casing, which surprisingly, is the hardest part to find.  We simply need two other pieces: a ruby and a sapphire.$b$bThere's pirates nearby, just to our south, and a bit farther to the east.  Pirates love treasure... why don't you see if you can find some gems for me?
english.progress: Are those gems I see?
english.completion: Yes, these will do.  Now to perform the analysis... Oh, you're still here?  You don't think I'm a fraud or something, do you?
english.completed: Return to Flem Gizzix at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 瑟瑟发抖的“病鬼”
text.objectives: 从老迈的薄雾谷猩猩身上获得5副薄雾谷猩猩的内脏。
text.description: 若是有一件事我不能忍，那就是有人不肯付赌债！这儿有很多人欠我的钱。你觉得能帮我去讨么？$B$B首先，是码头上的“病鬼”菲利普。上星期后他就欠我好大一笔，我要讨回来！不过咱们得吓唬他才行。$B$B出城打几只老迈的薄雾谷猩猩来。弄几副好下水，给“病鬼”捎去。别让他知道这是动物身上的，让他自己想象去。
text.progress: 嘿，你看我干什麽啊，$G小子:小姑娘;!
text.completion: 哎呀!你从哪儿搞到这些的?不不，不要告诉我了。我不想知道!$B$B是谁派你来的?海狼?$B$B
text.completed: Bring the giblets to "Shaky" Phillipe at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Scaring Shaky
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Mistvale Giblets from Elder Mistvale Gorillas.
english.description: If there's one thing I can't stand, it's people who don't pay their gambling debts!  And there are a lot of people who owe me.  Think you can help me collect?$B$BFirst, there's "Shaky" Phillipe down by the docks.  He owes me plenty after last week's game and I want my due!  But to get it, we'll have to scare him.$B$BGo out of town and hunt elder mistvale gorillas.  Find a nice selection of giblets, then take them to Shaky.  Don't let on that they're from an animal; let him think the worst.
english.progress: Hey!  I don't like the look you're giving me, $gmister:lady;.
english.completion: Ack!  Where'd you get these?  No, don't tell me. I don't want to know! Who sent you?  Sea Wolf?
english.completed: Bring the giblets to "Shaky" Phillipe at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 去找马克基雷
text.objectives: 把菲利浦的还款带给“海狼”马克基雷。
text.description: 给，拿上这包钱给“海狼”。告诉他我打算还他钱！我发誓！！$B$B我只是有点醉，迷路了，而且……你知道怎么回事。他会明白的——你不用来硬的！
text.progress: 你好啊，$N。拿到那病鬼的钱没?
text.completion: 嘿嘿，太好啦!对了，你给病鬼看那些东西的时候，他的表情怎麽样呀?$B$B哈!他实在是蠢了，跟他玩牌想输比想赢还要难上一万倍呀!$B$B太感谢你的帮助了，$N。给，这是你应得的……$B$B
text.completed: Report to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Return to MacKinley
english.objectives: Bring Shaky's Payment to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley.
english.description: Here, take this pouch and give it to Sea Wolf.  And tell him I meant to pay him back!  I swear!!$B$BI just got a little drunk and lost my way, and...you know how things are.  He'll understand - you don't have to get rough!
english.progress: Here here, $n.  Did you get Shaky's payment?
english.completion: Heh heh, well done!  And when you showed Shaky those giblets, how hard did he shake? Hah!  He's so easy to read, when I play cards with him I can't help but win! Thanks for your help, $n.  Now it's your turn to get paid...
english.completed: Report to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 催命债
text.objectives: 拿到玛雷的畸形足、菲兹提特的棘轮扭矩扳手和艾芙兰的宝石镜。
text.description: 讨债分三个阶段：好好说，动手说，还有我所谓的“第三阶段”。$b$b不幸的是，我这条老狗已经不能再亲自去进行讨债的第三阶段啦。这就是为什么我雇佣这么多狐朋啦、狗友啦、阿呆啦、阿瓜啦，还有像你这样高贵的冒险者！$b$b琼兹·菲兹提特、艾弗兰·月落和玛雷·维尔金斯藏在东边海岸那儿。你应该不难一次把他们都找全……然后把他们值钱玩意儿都拿回来。
text.progress: $n, did you find those debtors?
text.completion: 太好啦!把这些东西卖掉之後，我就可以狠赚一笔了，特别是玛雷的这条木脚里的东西，值钱得很!非常感谢你，$N!$B$B我希望这下他们三个能学会「欠债还钱，天经地义」这个理儿。$B$B还有，虽然听起来有些马後炮，但我还是要说，这帮家伙也该戒赌了。$B$B
text.completed: Return to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Kill-Collect
english.objectives: Obtain Maury's Clubbed Foot, Fitztittle's Ratcheting Torque Wrench, and Ephram's Jeweled Mirror.
english.description: There's three phases to debt collecting: asking nicely, asking forcefully, and something I like to call "Phase Three".$b$bUnfortunately, collecting during Phase Three is something that this old dog can't do any more.  That's why I employ so many cronies, stooges, mooks, goons, and noble adventurers like yourself!$b$bJuntz Fitztittle, Ephram Moonfall, and Maury Wilkins are hiding out on the eastern coast.  You should have no problem visiting them all in one trip... and bringing back their valuables.
english.progress: $n, did you find those debtors?
english.completion: Great!  I can get a good price for these, especially for what's inside Maury's foot!  Thanks much, $n! I hope those three learned their lesson: don't bet something you can't afford to lose. And maybe it's too late for them, but...they should be careful of who they gamble with.
english.completed: Return to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 卡利姆多的召唤
text.objectives: 从藏宝海湾坐船去棘齿城，然后跟加兹鲁维谈一谈。
text.description: 塞拉摩的好心人们让我来寻找联盟的忠诚成员，去帮助吉安娜女士解决尘泥沼泽的麻烦。$b$b你不是真的在这里替地精干活，对不对？通往尘泥沼泽的路会把你带到棘齿城。在码头的这头等下一班船。你带了棘齿城以后，就去跟加兹鲁维谈谈。他会给你指点正确的方向。$b$b呃，我想我踩到了一条鱼！它打挺了！
text.completion: Yeah?  Whaddya need?
text.completed: 去找北贫瘠之地棘齿城的加兹鲁维。

english.title: The Call of Kalimdor
english.objectives: Ride the ship from Booty Bay to Ratchet, then speak with Gazlowe.
english.description: I've been sent by the good people of Theramore to find loyal members of the Alliance who are willing to help Lady Jaina with some problems in Dustwallow.$b$bYou weren't really here working for the goblins, were you?$b$bThe path back to Dustwallow will take you through Ratchet.  Wait on the end of this pier for the next boat.  Once you get to Ratchet, speak with Gazlowe.  He'll point you in the right direction from there.$b$bUgh, I think I stepped on a fish!  And it flopped!
english.completion: Yeah?  Whaddya need?
english.completed: Report to Gazlowe at Ratchet in the Northern Barrens.

text.title: 荆棘热
text.objectives: 找到巫医安巴格瓦，让他召唤野蛮的莫克。把莫克的精华带给芬·菲兹拉克。
text.description: 好难过……真的……好难难难过……得了荆棘热……$b$b……严格来说……是荆棘谷海角热……$b$b……致命的病病病毒……$b$b……唯一的疗法……就……就是……服用野蛮的莫莫莫莫莫克的精华……神出鬼没的白色野兽……$b$b……巫医安巴格瓦……是唯一能召召召唤它的……$b$b……在海角南部的秘洞里找到安巴格瓦……$b$b……赶快……要死……要死了……
text.progress: ……妈妈?$B$B好冷……$B$B……像是要掉进扭曲虚空了…抱…抱紧我，妈妈……
text.completion: ...feel strength returning.... Where might I be?  Booty Bay?  Oh my!  I had the strangest dream... ...the weakness has not completely left me....
text.completed: Return to Fin Fizracket at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Stranglethorn Fever
english.objectives: Seek out Witch Doctor Unbagwa and have him summon Mokk the Savage.  Bring the Heart of Mokk to Fin Fizracket.
english.description: Sick...so...very s-s-sick... have contracted Stranglethorn Fever....$b$b...technically... CAPE of Stranglethorn Fever....$b$b...deadly v-v-virus....$b$b...only cure... is... is... to eat the heart of M-m-m-m-mokk the Savage... elusive white beast....$b$b...Witch Doctor Unbagwa... only one who can s-s-summon....$b$b...seek Unbagwa in hidden cave on southern cape....$b$b...hurry... dying... dying....
english.progress: ....mother? ...so cold... ...heading into the Twisting Nether...h-h-h-hold me mother....
english.completion: ...feel strength returning.... Where might I be?  Booty Bay?  Oh my!  I had the strangest dream... ...the weakness has not completely left me....
english.completed: Return to Fin Fizracket at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 莫克之心
text.objectives: temp text 02 - log
text.description: temp text 02 - description
text.progress: 巫医安巴格瓦当然知道野人莫克是什麽。是的，是的!$B$B我与他的灵魂对话并把他召唤过来，我可以。$B$B但其他的猩猩也很喜欢精神交谈。这样吧，你保护好巫医安巴格瓦，我把它召唤到你面前。$B$B巫医安巴格瓦想先要点东西。你带一颗猩猩牙来，我就会马上开始召唤它!
text.completion: Witch Doctor Unbagwa like Gorilla Fangs!  For you I talk to spirits.  Make Mokk the Savage come. You protect Witch Doctor Unbagwa from other Gorilla-beast though or no Mokk for you!
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Unbagwa in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Heart of Mokk
english.objectives: temp text 02 - log
english.description: temp text 02 - description
